description_brief: Two stylized flowers are shown. On the left, a closed yellow tulip-like flower bud can be seen above two green leaves. On the right side, the illustration depicts the same flower in full bloom with yellow petals open wide and the same green leaves underneath. A red arrow points from the closed flower bud on the left to the open flower on the right, indicating the process of blooming or the transition from a bud to a fully blossomed flower.

A stylized illustration of a plant with a vertical stem, rounded leaves growing from it in a symmetrical manner, and two oval-shaped seeds or fruits hanging from the stem, using a limited color palette consisting mainly of grays.

A simplified representation of an Acacia tree is illustrated. On the left side, there's a stylized tree with a straight brown trunk and a rounded green canopy, adorned with several white flower buds. On the right side, a sprig with several white Acacia flowers in full bloom, each consisting of five petals with prominent yellow-tipped stamens, is shown connected to a cluster of green leaves through green stems. The entire image uses bold outlines and flat colors.

A cartoonish alligator primarily green with a lighter green underbelly and black dots along its back to represent scales. It's in profile with a long snout, visible sharp teeth, small limbs, and a ridged back, indicative of its scaly texture. Its tail curves upward and its eyes are simple and lack detail.

The illustration depicts a brown snake or serpent-like creature with green patterns resembling moss or natural camouflage markings. The creature has a simplified, rounded head with a stoic expression and a single visible fang protruding from the mouth. Its body coils at the base, creating a circular shape with the tail extending out from the coil, ending with a tapered tip. No specific environment or background details are present.

The illustration features four stylized fish lined up next to each other, depicted in a simplistic manner with smooth, curved bodies tapering to a point at one end. Each fish has a visible eye, gill, and a slight smile. The coloring is minimal, with shades of gray and beige indicating the body of the fish, and white for the belly area. The style is cartoonish and friendly.

A transparent jar with a yellow lid, filled with numerous small, brown, cube-shaped objects, resembling animal feed or pellets. A couple of pellets appear to have spilled outside the jar, resting next to it. The image conveys the concept of a container with pet or livestock feed.

The illustration depicts a simplified representation of an animal hospital facade. The building features a flat, rectangular structure with a yellow upper portion and a base with a light blue door and a large window sectioned into smaller panes. Above the door and window, there is a sign with the Korean text "동물병원," which translates to "animal hospital" or "veterinary hospital."

A simplified, stylized illustration of an ant with a segmented body, six legs and two antennae protruding from its head. The ant and its parts are colored in brown. The image has a cartoon-like feel with clean lines and no shading, and it is presented on a plain white backdrop.

A stylized, cartoon-like drawing of an anteater in side profile with its long snout pointing to the left. It has a rounded midsection, short legs, an elongated and striped tail and a pattern of triangular shapes along its back. The anteater is depicted against a plain white background and colored in shades of brown, tan, and white.

A rectangular aquarium with a blue water background sits on a flat, black surface. Inside, there's a layer of beige sand, a grey rock to the left and two green aquatic plants with wavy leaves on the right. The top has a black border or frame with small square shapes.

The illustration depicts a standing half-moon bear, also known as an Asiatic black bear or "반달곰" in Korean. The bear is shown in profile, standing upright on its hind legs, with its forepaws hanging by its sides and its head turned slightly towards the viewer. The fur is primarily a rich brown color, with a white crescent prominently displayed on its chest. The style of the illustration is cartoon-like.

Two stylized flowers with pink petals. Each flower has a central part made up of small magenta dots with several thin lines, radiating outwards. The petals themselves have a lighter pink color with darker pink spots near the center. The flowers appear to be a graphic representation of azaleas, which in Korean is "진달래" (jindallae).

A stylized bunch of flowers or plants with green slender stems that converge at the bottom. Each stem has small circular flowers with black centers and white petals. There is green foliage or a leafy base in the background. The overall look suggests they are bunched together at the roots and the stems are originating from it.

The illustration depicts two stems of flowers, one with bright red blooms and the other with pink blooms, both having a hint of darker shading at the petal bases. The flowers have a simplified, stylized appearance with visible outlines. The stems are green and bear elongated green leaves arranged alternately along the length. The background is plain white.

A cartoon bat with large, outstretched dark grey or black wings. Its body is fluffy with a lighter grey fur. The bat has a round face with pointed ears and small, dark eyes. It is in a front-facing position and is symmetrical. The background is white.

An illustration of a simplified cartoon character with a round head, straight black haircut, two dots for eyes, and a straight line for a mouth. The character has a hand with a finger placed over the lips, suggesting a gesture for silence or quietness. The image reflects a visual representation of "조용히해", which translates to "be quiet" in Korean.

An illustration of a bear standing on all fours with a predominantly light to medium brown coat, with darker shading around its belly and limbs. Its face is detailed with small circular ears, black eyes, and a darker snout. The image represents the word "곰," translating to "bear" from Korean.

A cartoon representation of a bee with a round face, large, friendly eyes, and a body of segmented in yellow and black stripes. It has two large, transparent wings with a light blue pattern and prominent, curvy antennae extending from its head.

A stylized flower with a single large, purple bloom in a five-pointed star-like shape with lighter purple details and a small white center with yellow stamen-like accents. There is a closed flower bud with a geometric, faceted appearance to the right of the bloom. The stem is green with a few leaves protruding at different points.

A simple and stylized drawing of a fish in side profile view. It has a streamlined body, a pointed head, a forked tail, an eye with a yellow outline, a gill slit, and a series of lines representing scales along the middle of its body. The tail fin is shaded darker. The fish is colored in shades of gray.

A stylized bird in mid-flight. The bird is predominantly blue with lighter blue shades depicting its wings and tail feathers. The bird's belly is white, and it has yellow feet extending backward. The bird's beak is pink-red, and a simple black line represents the eye. The overall style of the drawing is cartoonish and simple, with clean lines and solid colors.

The illustration shows a round bird's nest composed of interwoven brown and yellow lines that represent twigs and straws. The nest has a hollow center and appears to be empty with no eggs or birds present within it.

A simple, stylized illustration of a birdcage represented by a series of white vertical and horizontal lines forming a grid-like pattern. Inside the cage, there is a horizontal wooden perch positioned toward the upper half and a shallow green tray at the bottom. A small loop or ring is featured on top of the cage. There is no bird depicted in the cage.

An illustration shows two hands; one is holding a yellow flower with a green stem, and the other is holding a blue banknote with the number 1000 on it. The banknote seems to be given or exchanged for the flower.

A stylized image of a branch with a single green leaf attached. The branch is horizontal with the leaf hanging down at the right side. On the right end of the branch, opposite the leaf, there is a dotted outline of a circle with a small red arrowhead pointing clockwise.

A stylized broken branch with a few leaves on it. There's a vertical brown line presumably representing the trunk of a tree, and an angled branch with a clean break near the center. At the end of the broken branch, there is a star shape possibly denoting the point of breakage. The leaves are green.

A cartoon-like illustration of a brown horse standing in a profile view with its body facing to the left. It has a darker brown mane and tail, a white snout, and appears to be smiling. The horse's legs are straight, with the hooves differentiated by a darker brown color. The background is plain and white.

A stylized butterfly with two pairs of yellow wings with pink spots. The body of the butterfly is brown with segmented sections and features two black antennae protruding from the top of its head. The style is cartoon-like with a flat color palette and no complex shading.

A stylized butterfly with two large wings with a checkered pattern primarily in shades of cream or light beige. The butterfly has a darker brown segmented body and two antennae with small bulbous ends pointing upwards. It is a simple, cartoonish representation.

A green cactus with black thorns in a beige or light brown container, drawn in a simple cartoon style. There's a red triangular shape to the right of the cactus, with a dotted red elliptical line connecting the tip of one of the cactus arms to the tip of the triangle, indicating a directional or pointing gesture towards the triangle.

Illustration of two stylized bovine figures, an adult cow and a calf, depicted side by side in a cartoon-like manner. Both cows are tan or light brown, with darker brown outlines, and have similar facial features and expressions. The adult cow is positioned behind the calf and to the right, slightly overlapping. Both animals are facing toward the left. They exist within dashed red lines that form rectangles around them, partially intersecting their bodies.

A stylized image of a Bactrian camel with two humps. The camel, in profile view facing to the left, is drawn with smooth lines and minimal detail, using shades of brown for the body and darker colors for the outline and to define the legs, hooves, and facial features. The camel's expression is neutral and its tail hangs down behind its back legs.

The illustration shows a stylized depiction of a tree and a flower. The tree has a brown trunk with a round green canopy, with small red flowers each having a red outline and a black dot in the center. Next to the tree is a large red flower with a yellow center and a single white petal peeking out from underneath, with a couple of green leaves at its base.

A person standing to the right, with a happy facial expression, wearing a long sleeve shirt and pants. To the left of the person, there is a white dog with small black eyes and a black nose. Beside the dog, there is an orange tent with a gray floor and a black doorway, set up on a green patch that represents grass. In the background, there are two stylized green trees. The image represents a camping scene.

An illustration shows a cluster of stylized flowers with five yellow petals, slightly orange at the base. The centers of the flowers are small, round yellow or beige circles. Green stems with a pair of green leaves are depicted below the petals. The style is cartoon-like and flat.

Two flowers on a single stem. A larger flower with bright red petals and a visible core on the left, and a smaller bloom with soft pink petals on the right. Both flowers have green leaves attached to the stem. The background is plain and white.

A stylized depiction of a flowering plant with several pink flowers with frilled edges and darker pink centers, grouped closely together on green stems with slender elongated leaves. The style is reminiscent of a clip-art or cartoon-like depiction.

A cartoon-style image of a fish with a streamlined body, a gradient of gray to white from back to belly. It has lighter oval spots along its flank, a simple black eye with a yellow outline and fins indicated with darker gray lines. The fish is depicted in profile and appears to be in a neutral, swimming position.

A cartoon-style fish oriented horizontally with a pattern of alternating light and dark brown horizontal stripes along its body and a series of grey spots below the dorsal fin line. It has a yellow eye with a black pupil and a noticeable lateral line along the midsection of the fish’s body. The fins are simple, with the tail fin having a slight fork. The fish appears harmless and friendly.

The illustration depicts a stylized cartoon fish with a pink-toned body, cream belly, and diagonal crosshatch markings. It has a simple facial expression and its fins and tail match the body's color. The dorsal fin is large and prominent, while the pectoral and tail fins are smaller and proportionate to the body. The design is flat and graphic with well-defined outlines.

An illustration of a grey cat sitting upright with its tail curving on the ground. It has a lighter-colored muzzle and chest, large light amber eyes with a soft expression, pointed pink ears, and visible whiskers. The cat is looking straight ahead.

The illustration depicts a stylized centipede with a segmented body in varying shades of yellow and brown. It has numerous short legs protruding from its sides and two long antennae at the front of its head. The centipede is depicted in profile, seeming to crawl from top to bottom, with a dotted line trailing behind it, suggesting movement.

A simplified, cartoon-like drawing of a chameleon in a side profile with its coiled tail and a raised ridge on its back. The chameleon is predominantly green with yellow stripes, with a prominent eye looking forward, its limbs splayed out as if it is walking. The background is plain and white.

The illustration features a stylized representation of a cherry blossom tree. The left side has a simple brown tree trunk with branches leading up to a pink canopy, which suggests the full bloom of cherry blossoms. To the right of the trunk, a large, detailed cherry blossom flower with white petals tinged with pink, a cluster of yellow stamens in the center, and a few pink petals falling from the flower.

An illustration has two distinct elements. On the left, a tree with a brown trunk and a round, green canopy dotted with red circles, representing fruit. To the right, there is a branch with a cluster of red berries hanging from it with two green leaves above. The can be interpreted as a visual aid for "앵두나무," which means "cherry tree" in Korean.

A stylized depiction of a chestnut tree next to two chestnuts. The tree has a single brown trunk with a round, green canopy, from which three orange-brown chestnuts with visible spikes are hanging. The two chestnuts on the ground are shown with a shade of brown, partially enclosed in their spiky, golden-brown husks, split open.

A stylized chicken with a prominent red comb and wattle, primarily brown with a lighter brown or tan chest, yellow feet, and a yellow beak. It has an upright stance with a tail displayed in an upward curve. The chicken appears cartoonish and simplistic.

Two cartoon-style yellow birds standing in profile. They have rounded bodies with simplistic details indicating feathers, and their feet and beaks are in a light pink shade. The birds appear to be chicks based on their shapes and proportions, against a plain background.

A cartoon monkey sits down, holding a partially peeled banana. The monkey is facing slightly to the left with its head turned, sporting a calm expression. Its body is predominantly grey, its face and ears are brownish-grey, and the banana is yellow. The image symbolizes the term "치멤팬지" (chimpanzee), a transliteration error for "chimpanzee" in Korean.

A stylized image of a chipmunk facing the right side. It has a chunky body with shades of light and dark brown, a white underbelly, and distinctive dark stripes running along its back and head. Its eyes and nose are simplified, and it has small ears. Its bushy tail is curved upward, and it appears to be standing on its hind legs with its front paws held close to its chest. The style of the illustration is cartoonish with clean lines.

Two stylized yellow chrysanthemum flowers, with their iconic curled and layered petals. Each flower is connected to a separate slender green stem and both have a pair of green leaves projecting from their respective stems. This image might symbolize "국화" (chrysanthemum) in Korean.

A closed clamshell with characteristic concentric ridges and a slightly shiny, smooth surface. Its coloration is primarily in shades of brown, tan, and white with hints of a yellowish hue near the hinge area. The clamshell is depicted in a cartoonish style with a simple, clean outline.

Two cartoon clownfish are illustrated. One is orange with three white stripes and black outlines around the stripes. The other clownfish is yellow with identical white stripes and black outlines. They are presented with side profiles and have visible fins, tails, and eyes. The style is simple and child-friendly.

A stylized illustration of an upright cobra with its hood expanded. The cobra is painted in shades of yellow and tan with brown spots, displaying a natural appearance. Its face is simplistic with two eyes and a mild expression, and its body coils at the base.

The illustration depicts two pink bell-shaped columbine flowers hanging from their stems with pointed tips and prominent petal lines. Green leaves or bracts encase the stems with small thorn-like protrusions outlining the greenery. The style uses a color palette of pink, green, and minimal white for highlights.

A simple illustration of a comb. The comb has a straight handle with a brown base and a series of fine teeth extending from a solid white spine. The comb is depicted at an angle, giving a three-dimensional feel to the object.

A cartoon-style drawing of a person and a dog facing each other. The person is standing upright with arms outstretched towards the dog, wearing a teal shirt and navy pants. The dog has a white body, a beige face, and a red collar. It appears to be a small, friendly breed with a wagging tail, depicted in a playful stance.

The illustration depicts a conical snail shell with a spiral design starting from the apex and expanding towards the opening. The shell is primarily beige and brown with some shadowing and a white shiny spot that suggests a reflection. The aperture of the shell is also visible.

The image features a stylized bouquet with a conical shape adorned with yellow and pink flower motifs on a dark background. There are bunches of greenery resembling pine or fir branches around the cone, topped with a prominent pink bow with long trailing ribbons. A red arrow points directly at the bouquet from the left, and there's a small tag on the bow with Asian characters.

Two stylized coral branches are depicted. The coral on the left is pink with darker pink spots, while the one on the right is purple with similar patterning. Both corals have branching, irregular structures with rounded ends.

A simple cartoonish illustration of a cow. The cow has a brown body, lighter brown snout, small straight tail with a tuft at the end, two small horns, and it's standing in a profile view with all four legs visible. The cow has a neutral expression.

A stylized image of a cow in side profile with prominent horns, ears, and hooves. The cow is predominantly brown with lighter brown coloration along its back. The cow is standing on all four legs, appearing calm and stationary with no background detail. The art style is simple and cartoonish.

A stylized illustration of a red crab. It has a prominent, rounded carapace with a pattern of dots, possibly representing texture or spots. The crab has eight legs and two raised claws that are symmetrical. The style is cartoonish, with bold outlines and a simplified form. The illustration lacks a background and is presented on a plain white surface.

A stylized illustration of a crane with a long neck and long legs, a predominantly white body and black tips on its wings. There is a small red patch above its eye. The crane is standing in a profile view, looking towards the right of the image, with its beak slightly open.

A simple, cartoon-like representation of a fish with a streamlined body, pointed head and tail. It is colored primarily in shades of gray and yellow, with a distinctive yellow eye. The fins and tail are yellow, and there are subtle gray lines indicating scales on its body.

A simplified line drawing of two curved lines resembling an abstract object. Lines are somewhat parallel and diverge at the ends. The lines, outlined in blue, have a freehand sketch quality with few smaller lines or dots near the convergence, possibly indicating a focal point. The drawing does not clearly represent an animal or plant.

A simplistic, cartoon-style drawing of a person cutting down a tree. The person is depicted with a grey head, wearing a blue shirt and dark pants, and holding a large saw, which is being used to cut into the lower portion of a brown tree. The tree shows details like wood grain and rings, indicating where the saw is making its cut.

An illustration featuring two yellow daffodils with green stems and leaves. One bloom is fully facing forward, showcasing its trumpet-like corona, while the other is angled to show the side profile of the flower.

Two stylized yellow flowers with green leaves. The larger flower stands taller with a thick green stem and a circular bloom composed of many elongated, yellow petals. The smaller flower mirrors the larger one but on a shorter stem, positioned to the right and slightly below the larger flower. Both flowers emerge from a shared clump of four green leaves at the base. The illustration represents the term "민들레," which translates to "dandelion" in English.

A stylized, cartoonish butterfly with large, patterned wings that are a pale, tan color with a crisscross design. The body of the butterfly is elongated and segmented, resembling a caterpillar, and colored in a yellow hue with darker segments. One antenna stretches out from the head, curving elegantly. The style of the drawing is basic with clean lines and minimal shading.

A stylized representation of a deciduous tree shedding its leaves in the fall. A simple tree with a round yellow canopy and a straight trunk stands to the left side of the image. Five leaves, colored yellow with visible midribs, are depicted in various stages of falling from the tree towards the ground. The ground is represented as a brown horizontal layer, with several leaves already resting on it. Above and to the right of the tree, there is a small red triangle, possibly representing a simplified form of the sun. The background is plain white.

A stylized drawing of a deer in a side profile stance. It has large, branching antlers, with a warm brown body, lighter brown spots on its back, white spots on its hindquarters, and pale beige antlers. The deer's eyes, nose, and hooves are outlined in a darker brown.
An illustration of a simple, classic shaped dog bone. The bone is uniformly colored with minimal shading or detailing, giving it a flat, two-dimensional appearance.

The image shows two similar objects that look like dumbbells. Each dumbbell consists of a central straight bar with two equal-sized ends that are wider. The illustration is a simple line drawing with a white background.

A white pump bottle with a label that includes the text "린스" and the illustration of a dog's face. The label is yellow and the pump is mustard-colored. A single drop of liquid is above the pump, indicating the product is being dispensed. The image represents a pet conditioner product, typically used for dogs.

A simple, stylized dog house. It features a basic, symmetrical house shape with a peaked green roof. The walls of the house are white, and the entrance is a rounded archway outlined in gray with a brown base, suggesting a door or an entry barrier.

The image depicts a stylized illustration of a white pump bottle with a pink label. The label features Korean text and a simplified cartoon illustration of a dog's face. The pump mechanism is colored yellow, and a single drop of liquid is coming out of the pump. The text on the label reads "샴푸," translating to "shampoo" in English.

A cartoon-style drawing of a supplement bottle with a white label on a yellow background. There's a basic depiction of a dog's face on the label. Inside the bottle are numerous pink, circular pills visible through the transparent lower half. The bottle is capped with a gray lid. The image appears to be an icon for a pet supplement, likely for dogs.
A cartoon-like drawing of a white dog with brown ears, a small black nose, two dot eyes, a green collar with a yellow tag, and a small red detail on its back.

A stylized representation of a dog with large, floppy ears brown at the tips. The dog has a blue muzzle, or mask, over its nose and mouth area, with two horizontal white straps, a blue vertical strap, and three visible square slots. The dog's body is white, it is front-facing, and presents a cartoonish appearance.

Illustration of a dolphin depicted in side profile, gliding to the right. Its dorsal fin, pectoral fins, and tail are clearly visible. The dolphin has a long beak-like snout, with mouth curved upwards, expressing friendliness. The color of the dolphin is light blue with grey hint. The illustration style is minimalistic with clean lines.

The illustration depicts a stylized bird that resembles a domestic fowl. It has a predominantly gray body with a white face and a large red wattle hanging below its beak. The bird has a round body, short wings, and thick yellow legs.

A stylized illustration of a dragon in a side profile with its body stretched out horizontally. The dragon has a green scaly body with lighter green underbelly scales, four leg-like appendages with claws, and a tail that ends in a red, flame-like tip. Its head features sharp teeth, an open mouth, two yellow antler-like horns, and red eyes.

A stylized dragonfly with a long, slender yellow body and large, translucent blue wings with a checkerboard design. The dragonfly's head is small and brown with two black dots representing eyes, and it has tiny, black line-drawn appendages. The overall style is simplistic and cartoon-like.

A simple, cartoon-style illustration of a duck standing upright on two orange webbed feet, with predominantly white body and a yellow beak, looking towards the right with a content expression. It has simple lines to indicate the wing and tail feathers and is outlined in black.

A simple line drawing of a duck's head and neck. The duck has a prominent yellow beak, a small, black dot for an eye, and the rest of its head and neck are colored white. Above the duck's head, there is a small red, upside-down triangle.

A simple, cartoon-style illustration of a duck standing upright and facing to the right. It has a yellow body and wings, an orange beak and webbed feet. Its eye is closed, displaying a peaceful expression.

A stylized, simplistic depiction of a flying eagle with its wings spread wide. It has a brown body with slightly darker brown wing and tail feathers. The bird's beak is curved and yellow, with a small white patch on the underside of the wings. The image is set against a plain, light background.
A simple, cartoon-style drawing of an earthworm with a curved, segmented body. The worm is colored beige or light brown and has short lines suggesting setae or bristles.
A cartoon-style drawing of an earthworm. The worm has a segmented body with shades of yellow and beige and a slightly tapered shape at both ends on a plain white background.

A stylized depiction of an eel which is long, slender, and has a dark grey body with lighter grey spots along its sides. It has a beige underside that is visible towards the end of its tail and a pair of small, rounded beige fins near its head. Its head is tapered with a simple black dot indicating its eye. The eel is curved in an 'S' shape.

A simple, cartoon-styled depiction of a black eel with a grey underside. The eel has a streamlined body that curves slightly upwards, small, simplistic eyes and a mouth, and a tail that tapers to a point. The shape and coloration are indicative of an eel.

An illustration depicts a stylized eel. Its body is elongated and curves smoothly, resembling the letter 'S'. The eel is dark grey with lighter grey shading and highlights, a slightly tapered head with a pointed snout, and a long slender tail. The image represents "뱀장어," which translates to "eel" in English, set against a plain white background.
A grayscale illustration of an elephant in profile, standing with its body facing left. It features large ears, a long trunk, and visible tusks. The drawing style shows minimal shading or detail.

A simple, cartoon-style drawing of a standing person wearing a green top and blue pants. To the left of the person, there is a large, horizontally oriented red arrow pointing to the right. The text "멀어요", written in Korean, translates to "far away" in English. The image symbolizes distance or something being far from the person's current position.
A human hand with a turquoise sleeve pointing towards a bowl filled with brown, chunky contents that resemble pet food. The bowl is shown in a side profile with the top open.

The cartoon-style drawing shows a human hand with a pointing finger gesturing towards a tennis ball marked by its distinctive white curved line on a green background. A small, white dog with a spot over one eye, black ears, and a pink collar around its neck, is sitting to the right of the ball, appearing to be looking up at the pointing hand and the ball. The image represents the command given to a dog to fetch the ball.

The illustration depicts a stylized beetle, likely representing a firefly, with the Korean text "반딧불이" (banditbuli). The beetle has a brown elongated body divided into two main sections, a black head, long antennae, and six legs.

A stylized representation of a firefly with a black body, a distinct red head, two antennae, black elytra (wing covers), and six legs. The rear end of the firefly is depicted with a yellow section, representing its bioluminescent organ. The style is simple and cartoonish.

A stylized, simplified drawing of a fish. The fish is colored predominantly in shades of gray and white with a simple black line defining its body shape. It has one visible eye with a yellow iris and a black pupil. The fish also has a suggestion of a fin or gill slit along its side with black color accent. The image is set against a plain white background.

A stylized, cartoonish brown fish is depicted vertically with its head at the top and tail at the bottom. The fish has large yellow eyes with black pupils and a body that tapers down to a small pointed tail fin. It has two visible fins, one on each side of its body. The illustration is set against a plain white background.

The illustration depicts five white-bodied fish, arranged diagonally from top left to bottom right, appearing to swim in the same direction. Each fish has an eye with a black pupil and a yellowish iris, and their mouths are closed. There are no additional features or background elements in the image.

A simplistic, cartoon-style illustration of a pink flamingo standing upright on one leg, with the other leg tucked away. Its neck is curved in a gentle S-shape, and it has a black-tipped beak. The flamingo is set against a plain white background, outlined in black.

A stylized, side-view image of a flat-bodied fish with a broad head and a tail tapering to a point. The body is primarily a light tan or beige color, with darker brown lines marking its fins and gills. The eye is a simple, prominent yellow circle with a small black dot in the center.

A stylized image of a flea in a simple cartoon style. The flea is shown in profile view, with its body segments, legs, and antennae outlined in black. The body is colored in shades of yellow and tan, with small black dots spread over the surface. Its legs are bent, suggesting readiness to jump.

A cartoon image of a flatfish in a side-view profile. The fish has a beige body accentuated with a pattern of darker spots and lines, with the top part of the body having a darker shade. It features a visible eye and a mouth, with the eye pushed upwards, and simple, stylized fins with the tail fin distinctively shaped. The fish is oriented with its head to the left and tail to the right.

A bouquet of red roses with green leaves bundled together and placed in a beige vase or pot. The vase has a large pink bow tied around it. The image has a cartoon-like style, representing flowers or a gift of flowers.

An illustration of a tightly wrapped bouquet of flowers with petals in pink, yellow, and orange, and green leaves. The bouquet is encased in white wrapping paper and tied with a pink bow at the bottom. The style of the illustration is cartoonish and simplistic.

An illustration composed of three main elements against a white background. On the left, a simplified, cartoon-like representation of a green plant with two leaves and a thin stem. In the middle, a red "X" mark. On the right, a stylized, gray flower with five petals and a visible center. The image conveys the message "not a flower" or the concept of "something is missing or excluded."

A stylized illustration of a fly with a rounded body segmented into green on the upper portion and a blue pattern that resembles a mountain range on the lower part. It has two transparent wings, large, dark-colored eyes, six thin black legs, and two antennae.

An illustration of a branch with several yellow, five-petaled flowers and some green leaves along the stems. The flowers are bright, with a lighter yellow center and a darker yellow outline, and the leaves are a solid green, while the branches are brown with a simple texture.

A group of stylized purple flowers with five petals each, with dark lines outlining each petal, and a slight gradient of purple. There are green stems and leaves, suggesting the flowers are in full bloom. The leaves are lance-shaped and the stems seem to be supporting the blossoms upright.

A fox in a resting position with its eyes closed. The fox has a brown coat with noticeable ear tips and a white-tipped tail. It appears curled up comfortably, suggesting a state of sleep or relaxation.

A stylized illustration of a yellow flower with a green stem. The flower has four yellow petals and details suggesting the stamen at the center. There's a single green leaf attached to the stem, and two buds that are partially open, also in yellow. The entire illustration is outlined in black, giving it a bold and cartoon-like appearance.

The illustration shows a stylized cartoon frog with large protruding eyes, a wide mouth, and a robust body. The frog is light brown with darker brown spots. Its arms and legs are spread out to the sides, each ending with four simple digits. The background is white. The pose and the simple, rounded shapes of the body gives the frog a whimsical, child-friendly appearance.

A cartoon illustration of a frog standing upright and facing forward. It has a large, round head with big, protruding eyes. The body is simple, round with a lighter-colored belly, and it has four limbs with three toes on each foot. The frog's coloration is primarily green, with a white area on its belly. The background of the image is white.

An illustration depicts a stylized bouquet of yellow flowers with prominent black stamens in the center of each flower. The bouquet consists of several blossoms connected to a green stem adorned with multiple green leaves. The flowers bear a simple design with petal shapes outlined in black, giving a cartoon-like representation.

A stylized green gecko with a cartoon-like design. It has large yellow eyes with black centers. Its body is adorned with darker green spots and markings that resemble a natural pattern. The gecko's pose suggests movement, as if it's crawling to the viewer's right. The outline is bold and the colors are bright and flat, giving the image a vivid appearance.

A stylized tree with a rounded canopy bearing a lush green color, alongside a brown trunk and branches. Next to the tree, there is a simple brown park bench aligned to the right, suggesting a peaceful park scene. Both elements are outlined in black.

The illustration shows a giraffe standing in profile, featuring a long neck, spotted coat, and slender legs. The giraffe's coat is light-colored with a pattern of brown spots and patches. The giraffe is standing calmly, gazing forward. The image is a stylized, simplified representation, possibly for an icon or a visual aid. The art style is cartoonish with clean lines and flat colors.

A cartoon of a goat standing sideways facing left. The goat has a pleasant expression with eyes looking forward. Its body is colored in light beige with some shading to suggest a three-dimensional form, and its hooves are a darker gray. The goat has prominent horns curved back slightly.

A stylized goldfish predominantly orange with details suggesting scales and fins. The fish has a cartoonish appearance with a prominent eye and a slight smile, and its fins and tail are depicted with lines indicating movement or flow. The background is plain white.

The illustration depicts a side profile of a gorilla walking on all fours. It has a large body with a hunched back and is in shades of gray with a lighter gray face. The face features a simple design with eyes, nose, and a slight smile. The gorilla appears peaceful and calm. The style of the illustration is cartoonish, with clean lines and a simplified form.

A simplified image of a grasshopper in profile, rendered in shades of brown with outlining to define its body segments, legs, antennae, and eyes. The grasshopper is positioned with its body horizontal to the ground, with its legs bent as if prepared to hop or at rest.

A stylized depiction of a grasshopper in profile. The grasshopper is green with darker green stripes running along the length of its body and legs. It has long antennae, and both the body and the wings are visible. The image has a cartoon-like quality with clear outlines and a flat color fill.

A green iguana in profile, clinging to a tan color branch with its claws. It has a primarily green body with a slightly darker green stripe pattern along its back and sides, a small crest of scales running from the back of its head along its spine. Its face is turned slightly towards the viewer, displaying its round eye and rounded snout.

A simplified cartoon-style drawing of a guinea pig with a white body and beige and black coloration on its face and ears. The guinea pig is shown in a side profile view with its eyes, a small pink nose, and a short tail visible.

A cartoon-style hamster which is mainly tan and white, with a white belly and facial area. Its eyes are simple black dots, and it has a small pink nose. The hamster has short, rounded ears on the top of its head and appears to be gazing forward. Its feet are not detailed, blending into the round shape of its body.

A cartoon style hedgehog in a side profile view. It has a brown body covered with spines, and features darker markings along its back. Its face is tan with a lighter color, and it has a small black eye and a pointy snout. The hedgehog has four small, dark brown feet and seems to be in a static pose.

The illustration depicts a stylized representation of a plant with three bright red-pinkish flowers, each featuring a prominent yellow center. Two of the flowers are fully open and one is partially open, resembling a bud. The flowers are attached to a green stem with a pair of green leaves protruding from the stem. The image has a cartoonish or graphic appearance.

A stylized illustration of three pink hibiscus flowers. Each flower has five large pink petals, a prominent yellow stamen in the center, and is accented with black outlines. The blossoms are accompanied by several green leaves with visible veins, also outlined in black for definition.

A cartoon hippopotamus in a side profile. The hippo is colored in shades of gray with a slightly darker top and lighter underside. It has small eyes, ears, and nostrils. The skin has folds and creaces for texture and darker patches on its back, which might be shading or natural skin variations. The style is simple and child-friendly.

A side profile of a stylized, black and white spotted cow is visible. The cow is standing with all four legs visible, its pink udder is shown, and its head is turned slightly toward the viewer with a calm expression and ears sticking out to the sides. The illustration is minimal and lacks detailed textures or background elements.

A simple illustration of a standing horse facing left, with a brown body, darker brown mane and tail, and black hooves. The horse is drawn in a flat, cartoonish style. The character "말", which translates to 'horse' in Korean, is present. The background is plain and white.
A simple illustration of a standing brown horse with a darker brown mane and tail, facing towards the left. The style is flat and cartoonish.

A simple black and white illustration of a bird, resembles a hummingbird, in flight with its wings mid-flap and its tail fanned out. The visual is stylized focusing on the silhouette of the bird. The background is plain.

A stylized, cartoon-like drawing of a hyena in profile standing on all four legs. It has a light brown coat with darker brown spots. The hyena has rounded ears, a snout that is lighter in color, and a relatively short tail.

The illustration depicts a stylized, cartoon-like figure of a person standing upright wearing a long-sleeve teal shirt and dark blue pants. To the left of the person, there's a horizontal red arrow pointing towards them. The text "가까워요" translates to "closer" in Korean.

name_en: I want to go to the zoo
description_brief: The illustration depicts a stylized car driving on a road with an exhaust cloud coming out from the back. Above and to the right of the car is a rectangular sign displaying Korean text "동물원" with a red arrow pointing to the right, indicating the direction to a zoo.

name_en: I want to receive a rose bouquet
description_brief: A simplified, cartoon-style image divided into two parts. On the left side, there's a bouquet of red roses with green leaves inside a white vase tied with a pink ribbon. On the right side, a smiling cartoon woman with black hair who is pointing upwards. The woman is wearing a pink top with a visible collar. Both elements are on a white background.
A translucent blue, dome-shaped jellyfish with ruffled edges and tentacles that vary in length. The tentacles show a gradient from light blue to white, providing a sense of translucency.

The illustration depicts a stylized representation of a dog standing in side profile. It has a curled tail, pointy ears, and a collar around its neck. The coloration is primarily tan with a dark colored collar and a white patch on its belly.

A stylized drawing of an adult kangaroo with a baby kangaroo in its pouch. Both kangaroos appear smiling; adult kangaroo is standing upright on its hind legs with a long tail providing balance, and seems to be waving with one of its front paws. The dominant color of the illustration is brown.

A cartoon koala, colored in shades of grey with white highlights in its large ears, clings to a brown tree branch. It has a large, black nose and appears content and relaxed. The bottom of the image suggests green foliage, hinting at the koala's natural habitat of eucalyptus trees.

A simple, stylized illustration of a ladybug with a red, round body with black dots, a clear division line indicating the separate wing covers, and a small black section at the top for the head and antenna area. The design is symmetrical.

A stylized yellow big cat with black spots, similar to a leopard or jaguar, is standing in profile, facing to the left. Its defining characteristics like the spotted pattern and feline shape are clear.

The illustration shows two white flowers, each with five petals and a cluster of orange stamens at the center. They are connected by a brown stem with four green leaves. The image has outlines delineating the shapes and a small amount of shading to suggest dimension.

A stylized lion is depicted lying down. It's in a simplified form, with a solid light brown body and slightly darker mane. Its facial features include two small ears, a pair of eyes, a nose, and a slightly open mouth. The tail is visible, looped at the tip, and the lion is shown in a side profile facing left.

A simple, stylized padlock depicted in shades of grey with a keyhole in the center. To the right of the padlock is a speech bubble containing the word "LOCK" in uppercase letters. The background is plain white. The image represents an object related to security.

An image of a beetle with a long, oval-shaped body in brown color. It has two large, black spots on the upper half of its back, six legs with the rear ones being larger and pronounced, and two long antennae extending outward from its head. The form and features are stylized.

A stylized image of two lotus flowers floating on water with their green leaves. One flower is fully bloomed with multiple white petals and a yellow center, and the other is smaller and partially obscured by the larger leaf. The water is represented in a simple blue shape that surrounds the flowers and leaves. This image represents the concept of "수련," which is the Korean word for "lotus." The lotus flowers and leaves are set against a white background.

Illustration features three lotus flowers at different stages of blooming, set against a simple backdrop. On the left, there is a bud about to bloom; in the center, there is a lotus flower partially open, revealing its yellow center; and on the right, there is a fully bloomed lotus flower. There are two prominently displayed lotus leaves beneath the flowers, one overlapping the other, with a few wavy lines suggesting water beneath them. Primary colors are pink for the lotus petals, green for the leaves, and blue for the water.

A simple cartoon illustration of a fish with a streamlined body. The fish is predominantly colored in shades of blue and white, with a black outline defining its shape. It has a yellow and black eye, a small mouth, a dorsal fin on the top, pectoral fins on the sides, and a tail fin at the back. The fish's belly is white, transitioning to blue along its back and sides.

A simple, stylized green tree on the left and a wooden chair on the right. Between the two, there is a red curved arrow pointing from the tree to the chair, implying the transformation of the tree into the wooden chair. The overall image suggests that the chair is made of wood from the tree, fitting the theme "(나무로)-만들어요," which translates to "made of wood" in Korean.

A stylized branch of a magnolia tree with several white magnolia flowers in various stages of bloom, one of which is fully open, revealing a yellow center. The leaves are simple, elongated, and of a dark green color.

A stylized bloom with purple and pink petals. The center of the flower features a white area with a fringe of yellow and a small dark purple or brown detail, resembling the flower's stamen and pistil. The bloom rests on a backdrop of two green leaves.

A cartoon-style image of a flying brown duck. The duck is in profile, facing left with a long neck, an orange-yellow bill, and matching orange-yellow webbed feet extended behind it. The wing is raised mid-flap, and the duck's body is streamlined for flight. The background is plain and white.

A simplified representation of a red maple tree, depicted with a brown trunk and branches with a bright red canopy. Two red maple leaves with prominent points, positioned separately from the tree. One larger leaf has its stem pointed upwards, while the other smaller leaf has its stem directed downwards.

A cartoon image of a brown animal, a simplified representation of a shrew. The animal depicted has a streamlined body with a pointed snout, small limbs, a seemingly short tail, and no visible ears. The fur texture is implied with a few lines on the body, and the creature is colored in a uniform brown shade except for the black detailing on the nose and eyes.
A cartoon monkey with brown fur, a lighter brown or beige face and belly, and a neutral facial expression is sitting on a yellow-brown tree branch.

A stylized mosquito with a segmented body, a larger grey segment and a smaller brown one that appears to be the head, with a prominent proboscis extending forward. It has six thin, black legs and two elongated, transparent wings one of which has a noticeable red patch. The style of the drawing is more representational than detailed or realistic.

A stylized representation of a moth. It features a front view of the moth with its wings closed vertically. The wings are colored in shades of beige with darker brown and gray vertical stripes. Two large, round, black eyes with white highlights are noticeable. The body of the moth between the wings is a solid brown color, tapering to a point at the bottom. The overall shape is symmetrical.

Two stylized, cartoon-like plants. A tree with a simple brown trunk and a round, fluffy-looking yellow canopy with red, oval-shaped fruits at the ends of branch lines on the left. A branch with three pairs of green leaves and four elongated, red, tapered fruits hanging from it on the right. The background is white.
A grayscale image of a mouse in profile, facing to the right. It has a rounded body with noticeable ears and a long thin tail. The image is simple and flat with no apparent shading or texture.

A stylized drawing of a fish with a slender body, a tapered head and tail, colored primarily in shades of gray. It has a yellow eye with a black pupil, a white belly, and yellow fins. The fins include a dorsal fin on the back, pectoral fins on the sides, an anal fin on the bottom near the tail, and a caudal (tail) fin. The image has a cartoonish appearance with bold outlines and flat colors.

An illustration shows a universal 'No' or prohibition sign, which consists of a red circle with a diagonal line. The background of the circle is white, and the red border is thick. This symbol is a general symbol for indicating that something is not allowed or prohibited.

A cartoon-style octopus with a rounded body and a simplistic face, featuring two large, circular, yellow eyes with small black pupils. The octopus has eight tentacles, each adorned with small, suction cup-like details. The color scheme of the octopus is pinkish-brown, with the suction cups being a darker shade. The background is white, and the drawing has a bold, black outline.

A stylized plant with three prominent orange flowers that appear to be lilies due to their trumpet-like shape. Each flower has six petals with outward-curving tips and a set of long, protruding stamens with red anther at the ends. The flowers are attached to a central green stalk with a few simple green leaves positioned oppositely along the stem.

The illustration depicts an orangutan standing on all fours, with its long arms reaching down towards the ground and its legs slightly bent. The face of the orangutan is drawn with prominent features such as a large mouth, flared nostrils, and deep-set eyes. The style of the drawing is simple and cartoon-like.
An ostrich with a long neck and legs, its body is primarily black with some white feather accents on its wings. It is standing in a side profile, looking to the left, with one leg slightly raised.

A cartoon-style drawing of an otter lying on its back in a relaxed position, with one paw over its chest and the other resting by its side. The otter has a round face with a prominent whiskered snout, small ears, and its eyes are closed as if content or asleep.

An owl with a predominantly brown body, lighter, white-speckled plumage on its chest, large round yellow eyes with black pupils, and a small hooked beak, facing to its right. The owl is drawn in a simplified, cartoonish style.

A stylized version of a panda in a side profile facing to the right with black-and-white coloring. The panda's design is simplified with minimal details, using clean lines and solid shapes, a small circular eye, a nose, and a subtle smile.

The image is an illustration of a colorful parrot with a predominantly bright red plumage, blue tips on its wings, and a green patch on the bottom part of the wings. It has a large, curved, white and black beak, and its eyes are ringed with white. It looks thoughtful or perhaps curious. The bird is perched on a brown branch.

The illustration features a stylized tree with a single brown trunk and a rounded green canopy adorned with delicate purple flowers. To the right of the tree, there is a cluster of flowers with purple petals, prominent stamens, and green leaves. The image conveys the concept of the "오동나무," known in English as the Paulownia tree.

A stylized, cartoonish representation of a peacock which is predominantly blue with a yellow beak and yellow spots on its chest. It has a small green crown-like detail on its head. The tail feathers are elongated and green with red spots circled by yellow, suggesting the eye-like patterns often found on peacock feathers. It's standing in profile, facing left with a slight upward tilt to its head.

A stylized representation of a fruiting tree and a piece of fruit. A simple green tree with a brown trunk is depicted with five yellow fruits attached. On the right, there's a larger depiction of a yellow fruit with a green leaf attached, showing the inside, including the core and seeds. The artwork has a cartoon-like quality with bold outlines and bright colors.

An illustration of a pelican standing in an upright position. The pelican has a large, long beak with a pouch underneath, white plumage, a short tail, and sturdy, orange, webbed feet. Its eyes are simple, with a friendly expression. The style of the drawing is cartoonish and simplified, with clean lines and minimal shading.

A penguin standing upright with a black back and flippers, a white belly extending up to its face, a distinctive yellow patch on the side of its head near the neck, a black beak, and pale yellowish feet. The image appears to be a simplified depiction or icon of a penguin.

A stylized drawing depicting a green tree with orange fruits hanging from its branches, alongside two orange fruits on the ground with green tops. The tree has a simple brown trunk and a rounded green canopy with visible fruit. The oranges on the ground have a small green leaf on top.

A simple line drawing of a pet bowl. The bowl is wide and shallow, typical of a food dish used for domestic animals like dogs or cats. The image is grayscale and digitally rendered with uniform coloring and clear outlines. No food or additional details are present within or around the pet bowl.

A simple, cartoon-style drawing of a café storefront with a yellow upper section and white lower section. There is a sign with Korean text "애견카페" (which translates to "pet café" or "dog café") and an image of a dog's face.  Below the sign are three windows with a door in the center. The building is enclosed by a short fence along the bottom edge.

A stylized, flat design of a brown pet food bag. It features a cartoon-like drawing of a dog's face with drooping ears and a neutral expression. Korean characters in the center, "사료", translate to "feed" or "pet food". The bag appears to be sealed with a patterned border design at the top and bottom. To the right, there's a small, dangling tag or label.

A flat illustration of a green building façade with a signboard on the top featuring Korean text "애견 미용실" or "Pet Grooming Salon", and an image of a dog's face. Below the signboard are two white doors with black circular handles. The bottom part of the illustration displays a short gray fence section on each side of the doors.

A simple, flat drawing of a gray petri dish with a blue rim. Inside the petri dish is an irregularly shaped yellow blob, which likely represents a colony or sample of some biological material. The background is white.

A cartoon image of a dog and a cat sitting side by side. The dog appears to be a young, medium-sized pup with a round body, floppy ears, and a wagging tail, colored light brown. The cat is a slim, alert feline with pointed ears, whiskers, and a long tail, colored white with grey markings. Both animals are facing forward with neutral or calm expressions. This image represents the concept of "애완동물" which translates to "pets" in English.

A stylized yellow flower with a large center and five petals, with two green leaves. There is a hand reaching out towards it, appearing to be in a plucking or picking motion. The hand is wearing a white sleeve.

A stylized cartoon representation of a pig featuring a round body, a prominent head with two large, round eyes, and a snout with two circular nostrils. The pig has pointed ears and four visible legs with pink hooves. The overall color scheme is a light tan or beige with pink accents on the ears, snout, and feet.

The illustration shows a side-on view of a gray pigeon with some darker shading on the wings and tail. The pigeon's beak is small and closed, and its pink feet have clearly separated toes. The bird's eye is depicted with a small black pupil. The image has a white background.

A stylized tree with a brown trunk and green foliage. The tree branches out asymmetrically and the leaves are outlined in a darker green. The tree is drawn in a cartoonish or childlike manner, with a thick black outline.

A simple, grey cube placed on top of an open, brown cardboard box. Above the cube, there is a red arrow pointing downwards. The image represents the concept of placing an object into a container or a box, corresponding to the Korean word "넣어요," meaning "put in" or "place in."

A stylized drawing of a young tree, with a basic trunk and a rounded canopy of green leaves, planted in the soil, which is a brown horizontal strip. A shovel with a metal spade and a wooden handle is stuck in the ground to the right of the tree with its blade slightly buried. The background of the illustration is white, and the drawing has black outlines.

A stylized scene where a person is planting a tree. The person is bending over with a shovel digging into the ground near the base of a young tree with a visible trunk and a full, green leafy canopy. The person is dressed in a teal top and blue pants.

A simple black and white line drawing of a bear in side profile standing on all four legs, with a round body, a slightly protruding rear, short tail, and its head is turned slightly upwards. The illustration has minimal detail, just focusing on the outline of the bear. There are no background elements or additional details.

An illustration of three stylized fish standing upright in a vertical position, colored in shades of beige and brown, with large yellow eyes, fin details, and a tail. They are drawn side by side. The image symbolizes the concept of "명태," the Korean word for "pollock."

A stylized depiction of a praying mantis primarily in green with black outline details. The mantis has a triangular head with large compound eyes and long antennae, and its forelegs are raised in a typical praying position. Its body is elongated with a distinct thorax and abdomen, and it stands on its remaining four legs. The style is cartoonish and minimalistic.

A stylized drawing of a dog's face from the front view directly below a syringe. The dog has simple facial features with two large floppy ears, eyes, and a nose. Above the dog, the syringe is depicted horizontally with its needle pointing downwards, releasing a single drop. The syringe barrel appears to be filled with a pink substance. It appears that the syringe is about to administer a vaccination or treatment to the dog.

A stylized tree with a green leafy canopy and a brown trunk and branches. To the right of the tree, there is a pair of garden shears with green handles, positioned as if they are about to prune or trim the tree. The image symbolizes the act of "pruning a tree."

The illustration features a stylized cartoon pufferfish in brown color with lighter undersides, and white spots across its back. The fish has one large, prominent eye, a small mouth, and relatively small fins compared to its round body. Its tail and pectoral fins are darker brown. The fish's body does not appear inflated.

The illustration depicts a cartoon-style fish with a gray body, which is lighter on the underside, and defined scales. It has prominent, dark-edged fins and a tail, large yellow eyes with black pupils, and a small closed mouth. There are no additional details or background elements in the image. The image represents the Korean word "물고기 (mulgogi)," which means "fish."

A cartoon illustration of a small, light brown puppy. The puppy has a round body, short tail, large, droopy ears, a black nose, and big, round, black eyes. It is sitting down and appears to look directly at the viewer.

A stylized purple-colored creature that resembles a slug is depicted in the image. It has a friendly expression with a smile, an elongated body with a prominent head, a rounded midsection, and a tapered tail. The body has irregular darker purple patterns that resemble natural textures or markings. It’s resting on a flat base with ruffled edges.

name_en: Putting a flower in a vase
description_brief: A simple line drawing includes a human hand holding a yellow flower with a green stem and leaves. The flower is being positioned above a white vase as implied by the red curved arrow, suggesting the action of placing the flower into the vase. The background is plain white.

A simple, cartoon-style image depicting a flower and a vase. A small, blue vase with water in it is on the left side. To the right of the vase, there's a curved red arrow pointing towards the vase and a hand holding a large yellow flower with six petals, a green stem with leaves. The hand is depicted wearing a white sleeve. The overall image suggests the flower is going to be placed in the vase.

A stylized bird with a predominantly brown body featuring darker brown spots. It has an elongated tail detailed with a pattern of alternating light and dark brown sections, a gray head with a red wattle hanging from the beak area, a black cap-like marking on the top of its head, yellow beak, red details around the eye and on the wattle, and yellow legs with large, simple feet.

An illustration of a side profile of a rabbit sitting on its hind legs with front paws touching the ground. It has white fur with light beige coloring around the edges, long upright ears pink inside, a short tail, simple eyes with minimal detailing, and a small brown nose. The rabbit is against a white backdrop.
A cartoon-style illustration of a raccoon in profile view facing to the right. It has brown fur with a characteristic black mask around its eyes and black stripes on its bushy tail.

A stylized bird that resembles a crane. It has a long neck and long legs, colored primarily white with black on the wingtips and tail. The bird has a yellow beak and legs, with a distinctive red patch around the eyes. The overall stance of the bird is upright.

A stylized image of a rhinoceros facing to the left in profile. The rhino has two prominent horns on its snout, pointed ears, and a raised tail. Its body is robust and its legs are stout, indicating a strong build. The rhino is depicted in a gray color scheme.

The illustration depicts a rhinoceros beetle, viewed from underneath. It has a large body segmented into two main parts: the thorax and the abdomen. The beetle has six legs with pronounced joints and claws at the tips. There is a prominent horn extending upward on its head. The color is primarily a dark brown, with a lighter brown marking that runs down the center of its back, forming a symmetrical pattern.

An illustration depicts a branch from a flowering plant with multiple pink blossoms. Each flower has five petals and is accompanied by small green leaves. This image could represent a species of flowering tree or shrub, such as cherry blossoms, which are often associated with the term "철쭉" (rhododendron) in Korean.

name_en: Rose of Sharon (National flower of South Korea)
description_brief: A stylized plant with a prominent pink bulb-like flower at the center. The flower has a few pink petals that are partially bloomed. Several green leaves with smooth edges surround the flower, giving the plant a lush look. The leaves curve gently outward and downward.
Three stylized red roses with green stems and leaves are presented in full bloom, grouped closely together to resemble a bouquet or cluster.

The illustration depicts two sea cucumbers, one on top of the other. The top sea cucumber is shaded in grey with a wrinkled texture, and the one beneath is colored in beige with a similar texture. Both sea cucumbers have an elongated shape with slightly tapered ends. The style of the image is cartoonish with bold outlines.

A stylized representation of a purple rose, with one fully bloomed flower with visible yellow stamens at the center and one partially opened bud. Below the flowers, there is a cluster of green leaves. Reminiscent of a cartoon or a clip art style.

A stylized representation of a sea urchin consisting of a spherical shape with numerous thin, sharp, and elongated spikes radiating outward. The color scheme is primarily red with black linework defining the spikes and adding texture.

The image depicts a stylized seagull in mid-flight with a white body, gray shading on the tips of its wings and tail, and yellow webbed feet and beak. The bird is shown from a side profile view, flying towards the left with its wings spread and slightly raised, suggesting movement.

A cartoon seal with a plump body, colored in shades of gray. It is in a sitting position, with one flipper raised as if waving. The seal has whiskers, small dark eyes, a hint of a smile, and few lighter spots on the skin. The rear flippers are extended behind.

A cartoon illustration of a seashell. The shell is lying on its side, with a bulbous, rounded shape and a gray color palette with shades of light and dark. There's a large opening with a yellow rim on one end and the body of the shell slightly tapers towards the opposite side where smaller, spiral-shaped details are visible.

The illustration depicts a stylized funeral wreath with a pair of white cloth-covered triangular shapes at the center, surrounded by green pine branches fanning out in multiple layers. There is a large ribbon at the top of the triangular shapes, with a red arrow pointing towards the wreath on the left side. The image includes some Korean text on the white fabric.

A cartoon of a shaggy dog with a predominantly gray coat and lighter shading on the underbelly, a small area around its nose. Its muzzle is slightly open, revealing a pink tongue, and it has a round brown nose. The dog's ears are floppy and covered with similar shaggy fur as its body. The eyes are not detailed and the outline and inner details of the dog are defined by clean black lines.

The illustration depicts a stylized side view of a shark. The shark is colored in shades of gray with a simple line art design. It has a prominent dorsal fin, pointed snout, represented eye with a yellow circle and a black dot, gills indicated with lines on the side of its body, and an angular tail fin.

A simplified, stylized illustration of a shark shaded in greyscale. The shark is portrayed in profile, swimming to the right, with a streamlined body, visible fins, a pointed nose, and a gill slit. This image captures elements typical of a shark in a minimalistic manner.

The illustration depicts a simple cartoon representation of a beige sheep with a slightly darker beige face and legs, small black eyes, a tiny black nose, and two curved horns. It has a tuft of fluffy beige wool atop its head and its four legs are standing straight and sturdy. The sheep's body appears to be soft and rounded.

A group of three orange shrimps, depicted in a simplistic, cartoonish style, aligned diagonally and facing the left. Each shrimp has a segmented body with a curved shape, long antennae, and a tail fan. The legs and swimmerets are indicated by simple lines, and the illustration is against a plain white background.

The illustration features a stylized image of a tree with a straight brown trunk and a round, bushy canopy in a yellowish-orange color, suggesting autumn foliage. There are also two separate leaves in the same yellowish-orange color, each with a distinct outline and visible veins on slender brown stalks.

A stylized cartoon of a dog sitting down. Above the dog, a large hand with its index finger pointing down at the dog and a downward-pointing red arrow. The symbol "앉아" which means "sit down" in Korean, specifically used as a command for animals like dogs, is also part of the illustration.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a skunk facing to the right. It features a head, body, four legs, large, bushy tail with prominent stripes, a small hair tuft, and a small, rounded snout. The style is simple with clean lines and minimal detailing.

An illustration of a snail, depicted as having a sizeable, coiled shell with a pattern of striations and spots. Its body is pale in color, with protruding eyestalks and a long, trail-following foot. The snail is shown in profile view, with its antennas erect and the shell oriented upward and slightly to the rear.
