Near the person's hand, there is a stylized speech bubble containing three stars of varying sizes. The image contains the word "멋져요" (which means "cool" or "great" in Korean). The character is drawn with minimal detail and is wearing a teal shirt and blue pants.

A simplified representation of a bakery. It features the front view of a store with a striped yellow and green awning. Above the awning, there is the Korean word "빵집," which means "bakery." On the storefront facade, there's a large image of a loaf of brown bread on the left and a door on the right that appears to be grey with a small, dark window.

An illustration of a stylized balcony. It shows a sliding glass door with a grey frame leading out to the balcony which is enclosed by a grey railing with yellow accents at the base of the vertical bars. The perspective is head-on.

A simplified representation of a bank including a debit or credit card, a stack of green currency bills in various values, and two silver coins. This suggests monetary transactions or financial services typically provided by a bank.

name_en: Bathhouse Soup (This label is based on a common confusion between the meaning of a bathhouse, which is “목욕탕” and a place that offers soups or stews due to the depiction of the steaming bowl.)
description_brief: A simplified, stylized building resembling a small shop or kiosk. On top of the building, there is a large billboard displaying an icon of a steaming bowl. The steam is indicated by three curved lines rising from the bowl. The building has a grey facade with two doors on the lower half and three square elements on the upper half. The image could represent a restaurant or food stand offering hot food.

A simple and stylized front view illustration of a toilet featuring the bowl, the seat with the seat cover up, and the flush tank behind it. The toilet is in light blue with darker shades for the seat and inner rim. It represents the Korean word "화장실," which means "bathroom" or "restroom."

The illustration displays a stylized representation of a person with a round head, short black hair, and a broad, smiling expression. They wear a teal-colored shirt with a round neckline. The character seems to convey an approachable, friendly demeanor, representing the concept of being "honest," which is the meaning of "솔직해요" in Korean.

An illustration depicts a canned beverage with a green body and a silver top and bottom, featuring a pull tab on top. This image represents the word "음료" in Korean, which translates to "beverage" in English.

A stylized character with arms raised above its head, an expression of excitement or celebration. The character's mouth is wide open, with a round, red shape presumably as an open mouth or a surprised expression. The character wears a teal-colored top.

The illustration depicts a predominantly blue bird in flight, with a lighter blue underbelly and wings detailed with darker blue scalloped patterns. The bird's beak is red, its feet are yellow and its wings are outspread as if gliding to the right side of the image, conveying a sense of motion. The bird appears to be a stylized, cartoon representation.
A black pennant-shaped flag with a tapered end at the bottom, featuring four white Chinese characters written vertically.

A stylized character blowing a large, blue bubble of gum. The character has a round head with a black dot for an eye and a red circle for an open mouth from which the bubble is emerging. The character is dressed in a long-sleeved green top, and the arms are depicted with simple lines hanging down by the sides. There are curved black lines indicating movement or air around the figure. The background is white.

A cartoon-like illustration of a boat with a turquoise-colored hull and a white superstructure, including a small cabin with three visible windows and a small green structure on top. The illustration has bold black outlines and uses a flat color fill.

A simplified, cartoon-style illustration of a building, possibly representing a library or bookstore. It has a light grey facade with a central blue door featuring glass panels. The roof is white and extends beyond the walls on both sides. Resting on top of the roof at an angle are two books, one red and one yellow, each with a white label on the spine. The illustration is associated with the word "서점," which translates to "bookstore" or "library" in Korean.

The illustration depicts four stylized human characters lined up side by side. From left to right: The first figure wears a turquoise and orange jacket, shorts, and a yellow cap, facing left. The second figure is wearing a pink jacket, a grey skirt, and a yellow cap, also facing left. The third figure is wearing a turquoise and orange jacket, shorts, and a yellow cap, facing right. The fourth figure is wearing a pink jacket, a grey skirt, and a yellow cap, facing right. The characters' faces are blank. All are standing straight with their arms at their sides. The background is white.

A stylized character with straight black hair and a troubled or fatigued expression. The character is wearing a white mask over the nose and mouth, which has green loops around the ears. The mask also displays a small detail that looks like a metallic nose clip at the top. The character's complexion is light.

An illustrated character wearing a respiratory mask with a circular filter and a white shirt. The character is surrounded by two red, fluffy-looking clouds, one on each side, possibly symbolizing pollution or allergens. A squiggly line above the character's head suggests distress or discomfort.

The illustration features a stylized depiction of a seated Buddha with a serene expression, placed against a gold-toned circular background. To the right of the Buddha image is a large, bold, Hangul character "불", which is also in a matching gold tone.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a green bus with a blue stripe running horizontally along the lower half, black wheels, and lighter blue doors. The image is flat with no shading or perspective effects.

A stylized cartoon character which is a young boy with a cheerful expression, wearing a simple, short-sleeved shirt, short, spiky hair, and blush marks on his cheeks. The boy is raising his hand to wave, indicating a gesture of greeting or farewell. The text "빠이빠이" translates to "bye bye" in English.

An illustration features an orange taxi with black wheels and a taxi sign on top with "SEOUL HYBRID TAXI" written on the side. On the right, there's a simplified graphic of a person's face in profile view, accompanied by a large, curved orange shape representing a telephone receiver angled as though it is being held to the face's ear.

name_en: Can I call if there is a problem?
description_brief: An illustration of a stylized person with a neutral expression forms a phone gesture near their face. They are wearing a teal-colored top. Above their head is a red question mark, indicating confusion or the need for communication.

name_en: Can I have a conversation with you?
description_brief: The illustration features two cartoon-style human figures. On the left, a person with a neutral expression is wearing a grey shirt. On the right, a person is smiling, wearing a teal shirt, and making a thumbs-up gesture with their right hand. Above the head of the figure on the right is a red question mark.

The illustration depicts an orange beverage can viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The pull tab on top of the can is in the open position, suggesting it is open or ready to be opened. The can has a cylindrical shape, typical for soda or beer cans. There are no visible branding or additional text.

A simplified, cartoon-style depiction of a person wearing black clothing with a white clerical collar, likely representing a priest or clergy member. To the right of the person stands a stylized building that represents a church, identified by its large cross on top and a steeple with a pointed, red roof.

An illustration depicts a simple, stylized flame with three layers: an outermost layer colored dark pink or magenta, a lighter pink layer, and a small yellow portion at the center. The flame has thick black outlines.

A stylized character's head that appears to be a combination of a human and a bird. The character has yellow hair with a blue hairpiece or hat on top. It wears round, orange-rimmed glasses and has a beak-like nose. The character is also shown with what looks like earmuffs or the sides of a pilot's cap. The overall style is cartoonish and playful.

A cartoon character of a cheerful boy with brown hair, wearing a white short-sleeve shirt, brown shorts, and blue boots. The boy is smiling, raising a large yellow pom-pom in his right hand enthusiastically, and appears to be walking or stepping forward with a spring in his step.

A simplified, cartoon-style figure of a person wearing a white robe with pink stoles, with crosses on them. On the right side of the image is a brown cross with a darker outline. Both elements together represent the Christian religion.

An illustration that shows a plastic water bottle with a blue cap on the left, and a rectangular bed complete with pillows and a thin blanket on the right. The bed has a visible headboard and seems to be viewed from a perspective showing the pillows atop the mattress. Both items are outlined in black in a simple, cartoon-like style.
A yellow dustpan and a broom with a brown handle and black bristles. The dustpan appears to the left of the broom. Both items are depicted in a cartoonish style.

The illustration depicts a yellow t-shirt and a pair of blue jeans. The t-shirt is shown from the front view, with short sleeves and a simple round neck. The jeans are displayed from the front as well, showing a waistband with belt loops and a fly. There are no details indicating pockets or branding.

An illustration of an artist's palette with various colors of paint. It features blobs of paint in yellow, green, red, white, and brown. A paintbrush with a brown handle is resting on the edge of the palette, with its bristles coated in brown paint. The overall drawing has a cartoonish appearance.

An orangutan with shaggy brown fur is looking at a large, bright yellow flower with a green stem and leaves. The orangutan is standing in an upright position, as if curious or examining the flower. The image is styled in a simple, cartoonish manner with bold outlines and flat colors.
A cartoon illustration of a party popper, depicted as a conical object with red and white diagonal stripes, and colorful streamers, stars, and confetti shooting out from one end.

A cartoon-style character with a cheerful expression holding a green gift wrapped with a ribbon. The character has short, spiky hair and is wearing a plain white T-shirt. Above the character, to the left side, is a speech bubble with three ellipsis dots. The image conveys a sense of offering congratulations or presenting a gift. There is a Korean phrase "축하해요" (chukhahaeyo), meaning "Congratulations."

The illustration shows a character in graduation attire, smiling and seemingly pleased. To the right, there are three short lines that suggest motion, possibly indicating a nod or acknowledgment from the character. On the bottom right, there is a close-up depiction of two hands clapping together, implying applause. The overall image conveys a message of congratulations or celebration, likely related to an academic achievement.

An illustration features a bride and groom standing side by side. The bride on the left is wearing a white bridal gown and veil, holding a bouquet of flowers, while the groom on the right is dressed in a black suit with a white shirt and black tie. In the foreground, there are two hands clapping, suggesting applause or congratulation. The overall image symbolizes a wedding scene.

A green, open book icon is at the center, encapsulated within a red circular arrow pointing clockwise. This design suggests a concept related to continuous learning, educational processes, or the cycle of knowledge sharing, symbolizing "수업공통", which translates to "classroom common" or "common lesson" from Korean.

A simplified representation of the Earth depicted as a globe with the continents shown in green and the oceans in blue. A magnifying glass is overlaid on the globe, suggesting examination or close inspection. It implies searching, exploring, or discovering something on a global scale.

A cartoon image of a girl with light brown hair wearing a headband. She has a cheerful expression and is holding a plush teddy bear in front of her with both hands. The teddy bear has a content expression. Stars are depicted around the bear, suggesting that it is a cherished or sparkling clean object.

A cartoon image of an adult male figure waving his right hand, dressed in a brown sweater over a collar shirt, gray trousers, and brown shoes. His hair is gray, suggesting he may be middle-aged or senior. He appears to be standing straight. The character is associate with the Korean word "아빠" (appa), meaning "dad" or "father".

The image features two logos of South Korean corporations. The upper logo consists of six rectangles with different colors and the text 'HYUNDAI' written in large white uppercase letters. The bottom logo is the word 'LOTTE' written in large red uppercase letters with a thin black outline.

A simplistic cartoon of a person with a neutral expression. The individual is wearing a teal shirt and has their hands open in front of them in a gesture indicating questioning or uncertainty. Above the character's head is a red question mark, emphasizing the theme of inquiry or confusion. The character is under a Korean phrase "동의하세오" (do you agree?).

A simple red question mark with a bold outline centered on a plain white background. The question mark has a curled top, a straight vertical line, and a dot at the bottom. This symbol represents inquiry, curiosity, or the need for information.
A grid of pale-yellow square panels arranged neatly in rows and columns against a white background. The squares are plain colored tiles, creating a simple, uniform pattern.

A stylized character with a simple smiling facial expression. The character has a visible head and upper torso, is wearing a teal shirt, and has short black hair. The character is making a hand gesture with the right hand suggesting motion or waving. The phrase "신경쓰지마세요" which translates to "Don't worry about it" or "Never mind" in Korean is likely associated with this gesture.

The illustration depicts a spoon on the left and a pair of chopsticks on the right, both outlined in black with a yellow fill, against a white background. The spoon has an oval-shaped end and a long handle, while the chopsticks are two identical slim, long rods. This visual signifies "eating" or "mealtime," corresponding with the Korean phrase "식사하기" which translates to "to eat" or "mealtime."

A gray rectangular card with a stylized spoon on the left, chopsticks in the middle, and a small round dish on the right. All of which are colored in an orange hue. This image represents dining or a meal, suitable as a visual symbol for the Korean word "외식" which translates to "eating out" or "dining out."

An elevator illustration with closed gray doors and an elevator indicator panel with a red display above. On the right side, there's an elevator control panel with two red-lit buttons. The background is plain white.

A cartoon-style illustration of a red emergency siren with a grey base and a yellow speech bubble to its right containing three ellipses (...), potentially suggesting an alarm or an alert. It's associated with the Korean phrase "긴급어" that translates to "emergency" or "urgent."

A red emergency siren or alarm is depicted, with concentric circles or waves in the center suggesting sound emitting from it. The siren has a curved, dome-like top, and is mounted on a grey base. It is outlined in black and there are dashed lines around it implying that it is actively sending out a signal or alarm.

An illustration shows four simple, cartoon-style facial expressions arranged in a grid pattern. Each face is round with simple black hair, eyes, and a mouth. The first facial expression has a smile, representing happiness. The second face has a flat mouth with the corners turned down slightly, signifying sadness or disappointment. The third face has downturned eyebrows and a frown, indicating anger or frustration. And the last face has one tear coming from one eye, including a sad mouth, implying sadness or sorrow. The images represent a range of basic emotions or moods, corresponding to the Korean term "기분감정" which means "feeling" or "emotion."
A boy is jumping in the air with his arms up and a big smile. He is wearing a green shirt and blue pants, and there are musical notes and stars around him.

Two animated characters symbolizing the Korean word "연예인" (entertainer/celebrity). The character on the left is wearing a yellow top with a red star and a pink skirt, with black hair in pigtails, striking a pose. The character on the right is wearing a pink top with a purple collar and a dark purple skirt, has black hair in a single bun, and is holding a microphone. Both characters appear cheerful.

A simple, stylized gray building facade with multiple windows. At the ground level of the building, there is a set of double doors. A large red arrow is pointing towards the doors, indicating an entrance or direction. The arrow is coming from the right side of the image and pointing left. Image symbolizes the concept of an "entrance" or "entryway".

An illustration depicts an eraser, colored pink on top with a light grey body. A dark grey, curly line appears below the eraser, resembling the remnants or shavings that result from erasing something. The imagery suggests the concept of deletion, removal, or correction which corresponds to the Korean term "지움" ('ji-um'), translating to 'erasure' or 'deletion' in English.

Two hands giving a thumbs up against a plain background, thumbs extended upward indicating approval, agreement, or a job well done. The gesture is associated with positivity or affirmation. The illustration is simple and graphic.

The illustration features a traditional black and white paneled soccer ball on the left and three hand weights or dumbbells with grey and black handles and green circular ends stacked behind it on the right. This suggests a variety of physical activities, which correlates with the Korean word "운동" (undong), meaning "exercise" or "sport."

A simplified, cartoon-like illustration of a person walking in side profile, showing one leg in front of the other as if taking a step. The person has a round head with a single dot for the eye, wearing a teal long-sleeve top and navy blue pants. Their right arm is extended forward with the hand pointing in the direction they're moving towards, while the left arm is drawn back in a natural walking pose.

A stylized representation of a family of four standing side by side. From left to right, there is a father in a long-sleeve gray shirt with a yellow V-neck collar and blue pants, a daughter in a pink short-sleeve top and red shorts with pink shoes, a son in a teal long-sleeve shirt and blue pants, and a mother in a yellow long-sleeve top, an orange skirt and purple shoes.

An illustration of a stack of magazines or documents, with the top one featuring a cover with "SUCCESS" written at the top and the date "MARCH 3 2011". It has a stylized drawing of a person with a mustache, wearing a blue suit with a tie, crossing their arms and standing confidently. The remainder of the cover contains various unspecified blocks and lines suggesting text or graphics.

A stylized cartoon character from the chest up. The character is smiling broadly with a row of white teeth visible and has simple black dots for eyes. They have a round head with short, neat hair. The character is wearing a long-sleeved teal shirt, and their arms are folded in front of them. The character appears cheerful and content along with the Korean phrase "씩씩해요" (which could mean 'I'm happy' or 'feeling great').

A simple cartoon-style drawing of a person with a displeased facial expression. The character has a flat mouth turned downwards at the corners, the eyebrows are drawn downwards, giving an impression of dissatisfaction. The person has a black hairstyle and is wearing a teal-colored shirt. The focus of the image is on the face, the torso is cropped, and the background is plain white.

name_en: Feet Placed on the Wheelchair Footrest
description_brief: An illustration of a manual wheelchair viewed from a side angle. A red arrow is pointing downward onto the footplate, indicating that an object is being placed on it. There is a small blue rectangle resting atop the wheelchair's footplate.

A stylized, cartoon-like character with a confident and cheerful expression. The character is a male figure with a tuft of hair sticking up, raising both fists conveying enthusiasm or determination. He is wearing a simple short-sleeved t-shirt. His facial expression includes a smile and blush marks on his cheeks, enhancing a sense of vigor and positivity.

Two stylized flowers with a central circular shape and petals arranged around it. The left flower has a yellow center with white petals, and the right one has an orange center with white petals. Both flowers have green leaves and stems.

A line art illustration of a dining setup with a circular plate in the center, a fork to the left side of the plate, and a knife to the right side. Both the fork and the knife are placed at an angle that suggests a typical formal dining placement.

A stylized orange and white scooter on the left and a set of eating utensils on the right, which includes a spoon and a pair of chopsticks. These symbols represent food delivery, with the scooter symbolizing the transportation for delivery and the utensils representing eating or the food service.
A simplistic red arrow pointing upwards with a classic arrowhead at the top and a straight line as the shaft, displayed on a white background.

Two cartoon-style boys smiling and holding hands, standing upright and facing forward. The boy on the left has spiky orange hair and is wearing a white t-shirt with brown shorts and grey shoes. The boy on the right has brown hair, is dressed in a grey t-shirt, teal shorts, and dark blue shoes. Their expressions are happy and friendly.

Three adjacent boxes are aligned horizontally, each containing a different Korean word. They appear in a sequence, indicated by a red arrow pointing to the right. The words inside the boxes, from left to right, are "과거," "현재," and "미래." The last box with the word "미래" has a red background, distinguishing it from the other two boxes, which have white backgrounds. The red arrow above the sequence seems to emphasize the word "미래."

The image features a set of illustrated icons. At the top, there are two origami-like figures: one shaped like an open box in orange and the other appears to be a smaller diamond-shaped piece in yellow and green. Below, there are three hand icons arranged side by side. The first hand is in a fist position, the middle hand is pointing with its index finger, and the third hand is in a "peace" or "victory" sign with the index and middle fingers extended. The overall image represents the concept of "game."

Simple blue illustration of a fuel pump with a square screen on the upper part, a small nozzle and hose protruding from the right side, and a black fuel drop icon with a card reader or control pad below it on the left side.

name_en: Give it to me from the left or right side.
description_brief: Two simple, cartoon-style human figures stand next to each other. The figure on the left is upright, facing forward, wearing a long-sleeve grey top with black pants. The figure on the right, in a green long-sleeve top and blue pants, points to their own left side. Both figures have short hair and lack gender characteristics. The Korean text "제왼쪽또는오른쪽에서주세요" translates to "Please give it to me from the left or right side."

A stylized, simple drawing of a human hand giving a thumbs up. The thumb is extended upwards, while the rest of the fingers appear curled into the palm. Small lines near the thumb indicate movement or emphasis. The hand is colored in a flesh tone and outlined in black, with white space for the background.
A line drawing of a hand with fingers together and the palm facing the viewer holds two rectangular, cracker-like objects with small dots, suggestive of a snack or food item.

Illustration of two cartoon children, a girl and a boy, smiling with their heads close together. The girl is wearing a pink V-neck shirt, and her right hand is raised in a thumbs-up gesture. The boy is wearing a white tee and also sports a wide smile. The Korean phrase "잘했어요" (jalhaesseoyo), meaning "Good job" or "Well done," is provided.

A person with one arm raised is smiling and appears to be waving. Behind the individual is a night sky with a dark background, a crescent moon, and three stars. The phrase "잘자요" (jaljayo), meaning "good night" in Korean, is part of the image.

A cartoonish illustration of a smiling person with a round head, dot eyes, a straight-line mouth, and no discernible gender characteristics. They are wearing a teal long-sleeve shirt and blue pants, with their hands clasped together in front. To the left, there's a square window with two panes, showing a night sky with a crescent moon and three stars. The window is open inward, suggesting an indoor perspective.

The illustration shows two open hands with their palms facing outwards and slightly angled towards each other. Above the hands, there are two curved lines suggesting motion or waving. The image represents the Korean phrase "잘가" which translates to "Goodbye" or "Go well".

A simple, cartoon-style illustration of a person who is smiling and waving their right hand, shown with motion lines indicating movement. The character has a round head with two dots for eyes and a curved line for a mouth. They are wearing a long-sleeved teal shirt, blue pants, and dark shoes. There is a greeting "안녕히가세요" in Korean, meaning "Goodbye" or "Farewell".

A simplified, stylized character is shown from the waist up, smiling. They have a round head with two dots for eyes and a simple curved line for a mouth. The character is wearing a long-sleeved teal shirt and blue pants. Their hands are clasped together in front of them.

The illustration shows a human hand performing a pinched gesture, as if holding something small between the thumb and index finger. Just below the fingers is a stylized flame or a seed icon enclosed within a dashed circle which has a dark pink outer layer, a lighter inner layer, and a yellow core. The background is plain white.

An image featuring three icons: a gold eagle or bird with a blue and red center, five vertical bars in shades of blue and aquamarine with Korean text "관공서," and an abstract form resembling a fountain with blue droplets over a representation of a scale.
A cartoon-style illustration of a green grasshopper with striping details, two long antennae, and six legs. Its oversized wings are yellow with pink spots.

An illustration showcasing two stylized figures facing each other, raising their hands with a small double wave symbol between their hands indicating a greeting gesture. The figures have round heads, straight bodies, and limbs without detailed features, wearing long-sleeve shirts in teal color and blue pants against a plain white background.

The illustration features a human ear, a star, and a pair of red lips with a lipstick. A dashed line connects the ear to the star. The visuals combined seem to represent the concept of listening and then speaking or responding.

Two cartoon-style male figures facing the viewer, one with a smile and the other with a neutral expression. A large red question mark is between them. Below the question mark are two dashed outline boxes, suggesting a space for a missing element or an answer to a question. The overall image conveys the idea of guessing, questioning, or identifying something unknown.

A simple, cartoon-like illustration of a magician's top hat with a burst of colorful shapes, representing magic. Three curved lines in yellow, red, and black, and various confetti-like shapes are scattered around. Above the hat, the word "기타" is written in red Hangul, indicating that the illustration is related to the Korean word "기타," which translates to "other" or "etcetera" in English. The background is plain white.

An illustration featuring two stylized figures. The figure on the left is a girl with black hair styled in a single braid, wearing a pink top and a purple skirt. She stands with her hands clasped together in front of her. The figure on the right is a boy with short hair, dressed in a gray top and black pants. He is stepping forward with one hand extended towards the girl's shoulder. Both figures have neutral facial expressions. They are standing against a plain white background.

Two animated characters, smiling and facing the viewer. The character on the left is clapping their hands together and the one on the right is holding a birthday cake with a lit candle on top. The image conveys a sense of celebration associated with a birthday, with a phrase "생일축하해" meaning "Happy Birthday" in Korean.

Two cartoon characters. A female character with short orange hair, wearing a pink top, smiling and clapping her hands. A male character with brown hair and a white T-shirt, holding a birthday cake with one lit candle, smiling as he presents the cake to the female character. Both characters have rosy cheeks, expressing a birthday celebration or well-wishing scenario.

name_en: Happy New Year and Receive Lots of Luck
description_brief: Two cartoon-style figures dressed in traditional Korean hanbok are shown. The figure on the left, appearing male, is sitting down, hands on knees, and is wearing a colorful top with various colored stripes and a darker pair of pants. There is a round medallion-like object hanging from a ribbon around his neck. The figure on the right is female, also sitting with two buns on top of her head, wears a hanbok with a white top featuring colorful sleeve accents and a large red skirt. Both figures have minimal facial features with the background remaining plain white.

A stylized figure with a smiling face and short hair, wearing a teal long-sleeved shirt, and holding up their fists in a celebratory manner. Above the figure's head is a small red triangle pointing downward. The overall tone of the image is cheerful.

A stylized person with a simple, smiling face and a bare upper body. Next to the person is an oversized yellow syringe with an orange plunger and a needle pointing towards the person's arm, suggesting a vaccination or medical injection. The graphic symbolizes health care or medical intervention. It correlates with the Korean word "건강" (geongang), meaning "health."

An icon with a white plus sign at the center, set against a teal circular background with a white, elliptical ring running across the circumference of the circle. This symbol is commonly recognized as a symbol for health services or a medical facility.
A classic red heart shape with a three-dimensional appearance due to lighter red shading and highlights. It is commonly recognized as a symbol of love and affection.

A stylized illustration of a traditional telephone handset in a peach or light pink color. Above the handset, on the right side, there are several curved lines symbolizing sound waves or signal transmission emanating from the earpiece of the handset. The image represents audio communication or a phone call.

A simple illustration of a cartoon character, a young male smiling and bowing slightly at the waist. The character has spiky brown hair, wears a white short-sleeved shirt, brown shorts, and blue shoes. The bow accompanies the phrase "안녕하세요" (annyeonghaseyo), which means "hello" in Korean.

A cartoon character of a cheerful person with brown hair pointing to their open left hand with their right index finger. There is a dashed circular shape on the left hand. The character is wearing a short-sleeved shirt and seems to be presenting the dashed circle.

Three common household appliances: a washing machine colored in shades of gray with some blue and black, a gray double-door model refrigerator with darker shading for the handles and separation, and a small orange and yellow vacuum cleaner with a long, black, squiggly hose that ends with a gray floor nozzle. The illustration represents the Korean phrase "가전제품," translating to "home appliances."

An illustration featuring two stylized characters. On the left is an elderly figure with grey hair, wearing a sweater with a shirt and tie underneath, and on the right is a younger person with short hair and a green shirt. Above the figures is a red, inverted triangle. The concept represented is respect for elders, as indicated by "존대" which in Korean means "honorific".

A cartoon character with both arms raised high in the air, symbolizing excitement or celebration. The character has a friendly appearance, with a wide smile, rosy cheeks, and a tuft of hair on top of its head. The character is wearing a white shirt and is in a cheerful and victorious pose. The character is associated with the expression "만세" ("Mansae") in Korean, often used to express joy or hooray.

A simplified representation of a hospital. There is a rectangular building with multiple windows, and a prominent cross on the top center. At the entrance of the building, there are a set of doors. The building is primarily white, the medical cross is red, and the windows and doors are shades of blue and purple.

A two-story house with a brown exterior and a triangular roof. The house has a central front door and six windows symmetrically placed on both floors, represented with a cross indicating panes. In front of the house, there is a white picket fence with pointed tops.

name_en: How did you spend your vacation?
description_brief: An illustration of a sun symbol, a building with a clock and rows of windows depicting a school, and a lifebuoy. A flat rectangular surface displays the Korean word "방학" (bang-hak), meaning "vacation" or "school break". A large red question mark is on the far right. The scene seems to question the status of the school during the vacation period.

name_en: How did you spend your weekend?
description_brief: A calendar showing the days 1 through 7, with the 6th and 7th highlighted in red and the word "주말" (weekend) written across these days. A question mark, and a simplified depiction of a person with a smiling face, wearing a green shirt, and appearing to look at the calendar. The elements symbolically represent the question "How did you spend your weekend?" which is translated from the Korean phrase "주말은어떻게보냈어요".

On the left side, a simple, round wall clock with its hands indicating a time. On the right side, a cartoon character raising one hand to point at the clock, and above their head is a red question mark, indicating curiosity or inquiry. The phrase "얼마나 오래 걸려요?" translates to "How long will it take?" which aligns with the imagery presented.

A cartoon figure with a smiling face, looking at a calendar suspended in the air. The figure is raising one hand towards the calendar that shows a grid resembling a month layout, with one date highlighted in yellow. Above the calendar, there's a red question mark. The overall image conveys a question about time, duration, or when something will occur, aligning with the Korean phrase "얼마나오래걸려요?" meaning "How long will it take?" in English.

A red question mark above two coins that are lying on top of two banknotes, one of the coins has a "100" denomination visible. The banknotes are pink and yellow. This visual symbolizes the question "How much is it?" as reflected in the Korean phrase "얼마예요?"

name_en: How Often Do You Do It?
description_brief: A stylized illustration of a person with short hair, wearing a green shirt, pointing to a calendar with some dates highlighted in yellow. Above the calendar, there is a red question mark. The person is depicted with a smile. The image represents a question about dates or scheduling, along with the Korean phrase "얼마나 자주해요?" meaning "How often do you do it?" or "How often does it happen?".

name_en: How Often Do You Do It?
description_brief: A cartoon person with a smile, pointing upwards toward three clocks, all set to different times. Above the person's head is a red question mark. This visual aid represents the question "What time is it?" or "How much time has passed?" The phrase "얼마나 자주해요?" is also included.

The image contains a simple illustration of a smiling cartoon face with a black outline, simple eyes, and a curved line for a mouth. There is a speech bubble connected to the face, containing a red question mark followed by Korean text "살", implying a question about age.

Two cartoon characters are depicted. On the left, a character is smiling and raising both arms in the air, wearing formal attire with a tie. A building resembling a school is in the background. On the right, another character appears with a question mark above their head, indicating confusion or curiosity.

The illustration shows a spiral-bound desk calendar open to a page that includes the numbers 1-7, representing a week. The numbers 6 and 7 are highlighted, indicating a weekend, and the word "WEEKEND" is written underneath these numbers in bold letters. A large red question mark is placed above the calendar.

A red question mark in the center of a white triangular background with a thin black outline. The image conveys a sense of inquiry, questioning, or the need for information. The meaning of the Korean phrase "어떻게" (eotteoke) translates to "how" or "in what way" in English.

name_en: I also want to get married
description_brief: An illustration shows three cartoon-style figures. On the left, a figure wearing a white bridal gown and veil, holding a small bouquet of yellow flowers. Next to this figure stands another figure in a black suit and bow tie. A separate figure on their right with a raised arm points at the couple, suggesting they want to be married as well. All characters have smiling facial expressions.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person standing with one hand placed over their chest. The person is smiling, looking directly at the viewer, has short hair and is wearing a long-sleeved teal shirt. Below the image, there is Korean text that reads "나는 OO살 이에요.", which translates to "I am __ years old" in English. The blank space "OO" is meant for filling in with a specific age.

A cartoon image of a boy with a smile, short brown hair, pointed ears, and wearing a white T-shirt. One hand is pointing towards himself. Next to the boy is Korean text "00살", meant to be a placeholder for age. The illustration correlates to the expression, "I am __ years old", with the blank fillable with age. The image is designed to help Korean language learners express their age.

An illustration shows a rectangular shape representing a wall or barrier on the left side, seen from an angled view. On the right, there's a yellow battery-like object with two terminals and Korean letters "반" written on it, symbolizing "half." Korean text, "나는 00반 이에요," which translates to "I am in class 00," is placed below the images.

A stylized drawing of a person with black hair standing to the right, wearing a long-sleeved green top and blue pants. To the left of the person, the South Korean flag is displayed with its white background, central Taegeuk or yin-yang symbol in red and blue, and four black trigrams at the corners. The illustration conveys the idea of a Korean person or the Korean nationality.

A simple illustration of a person lying face down, stretched out horizontally across an implied surface. The character has a teal top, blue pants, and is drawn in a minimalist style with a round head and closed eyes. They appear motionless and flat, as if they have fallen or are resting on the ground.

name_en: I ate well / Thank you for the meal
description_brief: A cartoon character with a contented expression, smiling with closed eyes. They have their hands pressed together in front of them, suggesting satisfaction or gratitude. In front of the character, there are two dishes: one is a bowl of rice and the other a plate with sushi or some kind of rolled food. The image can symbolize satisfaction from eating or readiness to eat, matching the Korean phrase "잘 먹었습니다" which translates to "I ate well" or "Thank you for the meal".

A simplified illustration of a two-story educational building with a gray facade and a pink roof. It has symmetrically placed blue windows and a centered entrance with steps leading up to a single door. Above the entrance, there is a sign with a clock icon. At the bottom of the image, Korean text reads, "저는 OO학교에 다녀요," which translates to "I go to OO school" in English.

A simple cartoon figure of a person with a neutral expression and a slight frown, short hair, and wearing a teal top. The person has a big red "X" superimposed across their torso. The "X" signifies prohibition, denial, or something not being allowed, and corresponds with the Korean phrase "저는 그렇게 할 수 없어요," which translates to "I can't do that".

The illustration depicts a stylized person with a puzzled expression, with their hand raised near their ear. They have a question mark on their chest, symbolizing confusion. To the left, there is an icon of a speaker with sound waves emanating from it. The phrase "잘 안 들려요", which translates to "I can't hear you well" in Korean, is also displayed.

A cartoon character, joyful with wide open eyes and a big smile, has spiked hair. The character's hand rests on their hip with the other spread out, wearing a white, short-sleeved shirt with a dashed outline around the torso. A speech bubble with three dots, suggesting a conversation, emanates from the character.

A simplified character with a neutral expression standing behind a sign. The sign has a large, red "X" mark on it, which commonly represents "no," "incorrect," or "not allowed." This visual is intended to convey a negative response or the concept of rejection.

Two cartoon figures standing beside each other. The figure on the left has a spiky hairdo, a white shirt, brown shorts, dark blue shoes, and is depicted with a cloud of red scribbles to their left indicating anger or annoyance. The figure on the right has neat hair, a white shirt, light blue pants, and green books or folders tucked under their right arm. Both characters appear to be children or young adults, facing toward the right, with expressions neutral but tilted downwards slightly, suggesting upset or disapproval. The phrase "미워요" in Korean is also present, meaning "I dislike you" or "I hate you".

A cartoon character with a puzzled expression, short, spiky hair, and wearing a short-sleeved, white shirt. To the right of the character's head, there is a large, red question mark. The illustration likely symbolizes the phrase "I don't know" or "몰라요" in Korean.

A simplified, cartoon-style human figure with a neutral expression, arms outstretched to the sides, palms facing upwards. Above the figure's head is a red question mark. The figure wears a teal-colored long-sleeve shirt and blue pants. The image corresponds to the phrase "모르겠어요," which translates to "I don't know" in English.

An illustration of a person wearing a teal top standing behind an information desk with a sign "i" at the center. This person is shrugging with both arms outstretched to the side, palms facing up. Above each of their shoulders, there are red question marks, suggesting confusion or lack of knowledge. The Korean phrase "잘 모르겠어요" is also present.

name_en: I don't understand what you're saying.
description_brief: An iconographic representation of a person with a neutral expression and a large red question mark above their head. The character has a round head, black hair with a straight cut, and is wearing a teal-colored top. The image conveys the concept of confusion or seeking an explanation, aligning with the Korean phrase "무슨말인지잘모르겠어요," which translates to "I don't understand what you're saying."

A character with a neutral expression and a slight frown, wearing a teal shirt. Next to the character's head, there is a speech bubble with a red "X" across it, indicating a prohibition or the absence of speech.

name_en: I don't want to do it
description_brief: A cartoon character, a young boy with spiked hair, wearing a white t-shirt and brown shorts, has a disappointed or uninterested facial expression. Next to the character is a gray circle with an abstract design inside, crossed out by a large red "X" mark. The image can be related to the phrase "하고싶지않아요" in Korean, meaning "I don't want to do it."

name_en: I don't want to do that.
description_brief: A stylized figure with a neutral expression, holding up both hands in a stop or refusal gesture. The figure is wearing a teal top, and their hands are open and facing forward, as if to indicate a desire to halt an action or to communicate the message "I don't want to do that." The image also represents the Korean phrase "저는 그거 하고 싶지 않아요".

name_en: I don't want to eat anymore
description_brief: A cartoon character of a young boy with brown hair appears troubled or slightly distressed. He is holding his chest area with one hand, and there is a red dashed circle indicating discomfort or pain around his chest. On the right side of the illustration, there is a black circle with a white "X" inside it, conveying a potential message about not being able to eat due to discomfort or refusal.

A cartoon illustration of a person wrapped tightly from shoulders to ankles in a coil, possibly a blanket or padding, with only their head, hands, and feet visible. The person has a neutral expression and sports a small, red flower decoration on the side of their head.

Two cartoon-style figures standing side by side, smiling and gesturing a crossed arms handshake or fist bump. Both figures are wearing plain shirts and have similar cheerful facial expressions with raised eyebrows. One character has short, neatly combed hair while the other has slightly spikier hair. The image symbolizes companionship, agreement, or a greeting.

Two stylized figures facing each other, extending their right arms towards each other as if to shake hands. Lines indicate movement or interaction. The figure on the left is teal, the one on the right is gray. Both figures have a round head, dot for an eye, and a straight line for a mouth. The background is plain white.

A stylized figure with a neutral facial expression has its arms crossed over its chest, with a red "X" symbol over the crossed arms area, indicating negation or prohibition. Below the figure, there is a line of Korean text. The overall image conveys a concept similar to "I dislike something" or "I don't like something."

The upper body of a person with a neutral expression and a slight frown, short hair and a blue-green long-sleeved shirt. The character has red spots on their face, suggesting skin irritation or an allergic reaction. The person is holding onto their left arm with their right hand. The image could be interpreted as expressing an allergy or having an allergic reaction.

A circular, simple cartoon-style drawing of a human face with a sad, dissatisfied expression. The eyebrows are slightly angled downwards towards the center, and the mouth is turned downward in a frown. The cheeks have numerous small, brownish spots or dots, signifying blemishes or acne. The face is framed by straight black hair across the forehead, suggesting bangs, and the skin tone is a light color.

name_en: I have been to **00**, the geography was **00**
description_brief: A simplified, cartoon-style image of a person with a neutral expression pointing at an abstract shape resembling a map. The character has short hair and is wearing a green long-sleeve shirt. Above the abstract shape, a red question mark is floating, symbolizing inquiry or uncertainty.

A stylized humanoid figure with a round head, a straight body, and no visible arms. The figure has a small black dot for an eye and no other facial features. It wears a two-tone shirt, blue on the left and green on the right. Above the figure's head is a speech bubble containing a series of symbols: "@", "%", "#", "&", "#", "!", "&".

A cheerful cartoon of a person with short hair and a little tuft sticking up at the front. There is a speech bubble next to the person's head, indicating they are talking or thinking. The person is smiling, has a friendly face, and wears a round-neck T-shirt.

An illustration of a character's head with a neutral or slightly unhappy facial expression. To the right of the head, there is a speech bubble containing a simplified depiction of a green book and a yellow pencil with a pink eraser. The Korean phrase "숙제있어요" (sukje isseoyo), which translates to "There is homework" in English, is also present.

A stylized character with a broad smile, black hair, and a blue top, holding a yellow circular object with dashed outlines. Below the character is a line of Korean text reading "저는 OO을 좋아해요," which translates to "I like OO" in English, with "OO" serving as a placeholder.

A computer monitor displays two stylized figures standing on either side of a large red heart. Both figures appear to be facing each other. A hand graphic making an "OK" gesture is placed above and to the right of the monitor, paired with the text "ok!". The overall image suggests a positive endorsement or liking of drama.

A simple, cartoon-style figure of a person with a smiling face holding a white square board in front of them. On this board, there is a large red circle. The person has a round head, simple dots for eyes, a straight line for a mouth, and a short, straight haircut. The person's feet are visible below the board, depicted with blue shoes.

An illustration of a film reel and a hand making an "OK" gesture, symbolizing approval or positive sentiment towards movies. This corresponds with the accompanying text, which translates to "I like movies" in English.

A cartoon character of a young boy with brown hair, smiling and making an 'OK' hand gesture with his right hand. He is wearing a white T-shirt. To the left of the boy is a black musical note, and below it is the word "OK" in bold black letters. The image conveys a positive sentiment towards music, associated with the Korean phrase "나는 노래좋아해요" which translates to "I like music" or "I enjoy singing."

A cartoon-style figure with a neutral expression is singing into a microphone, depicted by a red circle for a mouth with a musical note. The character is wearing a green top and blue pants. On the right, there is a large hand making an 'OK' sign with the word "ok!" in red lowercase letters near it. The background is plain white. The overall impression is of a positive affirmation related to singing or music.

An illustration shows a fanned array of colored swatches or sheets, with each swatch having a distinct color. There are at least six visible swatches, with colors that appear to be purple, blue, green, lime green, yellow, and orange. At the bottom of the image, Korean text is present that translates to "I like the color ___." The viewer is supposed to insert their favorite color in the placeholder.

name_en: I like you / I like it
description_brief: A cartoon character with a contented, smiling face, hands pressed together near the face in a gesture that could suggest pleading or gratitude on the left side of the image. On the right, there's a large red heart symbol. The phrase "좋아해요" (joahae-yo) is also present, meaning "I like you" or "I like it" in Korean.

A simple, stylized red heart with a black outline against a white background. The heart is symmetrical with a smooth contour, and its color is bright red. The image could symbolize the Korean phrase "사랑해요" (saranghaeyo), which means "I love you" in English.

A stylized cartoon figure with a friendly face and a tuft of hair sticking up on top, holding a large red heart in front of its chest with both hands. The heart is almost as large as the character's upper body, symbolizing love or affection.

A stylized figure with a simple, smiling facial expression, black hair, wearing a teal shirt. They are holding their hands together over their chest with a pink heart between their hands. This image symbolizes affection, love, gratitude, or warmth.

A stylized representation of a person's face and upper shoulders, with black hair and bangs cut straight across the forehead, large round eyes, and a small oval mouth. The person is wearing a teal-colored top. The background is plain and white.

name_en: I see!/So, that's how it is!
description_brief: A stylized cartoon-like person with an exaggerated expression of surprise or realization. They have a wide, open-mouthed smile, raised eyebrows, short, spiky hair, and are dressed in a plain T-shirt. Next to the character's head is a large red exclamation mark. Sparkles near the character's folded arms suggest a sense of accomplishment or a 'eureka' moment. The image conveys enthusiasm and symbolizes a sudden insight.

A simplistic black and white illustration of a smiling face with two eyes, a wide smile, and short, straight hair or possibly bangs. Above the head is an exclamation mark, signifying realization or excitement. The image represents an "aha" moment or a sudden insight.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a young person with a cheerful expression, a tuft of hair sticking up, and wearing a plain white T-shirt. There are two curved red arrows pointing downwards, one near each ear, indicating either the act of listening or the direction of sound towards the ears. The image could symbolize understanding or listening, correlated to the Korean phrase "이해해요" (understood or I understand).

name_en: I use a tool (device) to translate
description_brief: The illustration shows a stylized tablet device with a blank, blue screen, tilted slightly to the right. On top of the tablet, there are angled lines with Korean Hangul characters coming out of the tablet's screen, colored yellow. The tablet has a simple design with a round button at the bottom and a black border around the screen.

A person standing alone in the middle of a room with a box-like perspective. The person is wearing a blue shirt and blue pants, and appears to have a neutral or slightly displeased expression on their face. The room, with walls, floor, and ceiling are depicted in shades of gray.

A stylized person on the right side with a few thought bubbles above their head. Inside the largest bubble, there is an image of a shopping cart with a prize ribbon or award badge with a number 1 on it, suggesting a top-rated or premium shopping item. The Korean phrase "사고싶은게있어요," which translates to "I want to buy something," is also depicted.

name_en: I want to do it again
description_brief: A stylized cartoon of a person in a teal top and blue pants, walking to the left with a large, red circular arrow surrounding them, pointing clockwise. The arrow suggests a motion or action that returns to the starting point, indicative of a cycle or repetition.

An illustration of a person's head with a neutral expression, near a speech bubble containing the image of a glass filled with a blue liquid, representing water. The image symbolizes someone expressing a need or desire for water. Above it is the Korean phrase "물먹고싶어요" which translates to "I want to drink water."

A cartoon character, a smiling person with spiky hair, pointing to a scene depicted in a window or picture frame. The frame shows a landscape with green hills and a bright sun partially above the horizon or hills, suggesting either sunrise or sunset. The window or picture frame has a pair of curtains drawn aside to fully reveal the view.

name_en: I want to go to the makeup room.
description_brief: A cartoon character with a concerned or uncomfortable facial expression. Above the character, there is a speech bubble divided in two colors—red on the left and blue on the right side. Inside the speech bubble are gender symbols: a white female figure on the red background and a white male figure on the blue background.

The image has a simple cartoon-style drawing of a character's head at the bottom with a neutral expression, looking upward. There's a thought bubble above the head. Inside the thought bubble, there are two stylized people hugging each other with big smiles on their faces; one is wearing a green shirt and the other a yellow shirt. This symbolizes a desire or thought of wanting to be with someone.

A cartoon character is sitting comfortably in an orange armchair, wearing a white t-shirt, brown shorts, and blue shoes. They have brown hair styled in a tuft on top and are smiling with eyes closed. The character is holding an open book in their lap. The image conveys a sense of relaxation and contentment.

A cartoon-style drawing of a person's head with a neutral to slightly happy facial expression. A thought bubble is connected to the head with a dotted line, inside which there is an eye looking at a green circular object. The overall image implies a desire to see or look at something.

A cloud-like thought bubble, with three smaller circles leading to a larger cloud shape. Within the large cloud, there is an image of a stylized eye looking down towards a green circle, highlighted by a red arrow pointing to the green circle from the eye. The phrase "을-보고싶어요," which can be translated to "I want to see" in English, appears in the image.

name_en: I want to talk about something else
description_brief: Two stylized figures standing opposite each other, representing a conversation. One figure has a speech bubble with a symbol of a crossed-out "X," and the other has a speech bubble with a symbol resembling an upward-facing triangle. Both figures are featureless except for small colored circles representing mouths and have distinct colored clothing.

name_en: I want to use the computer
description_brief: A simplified, cartoon-style illustration of a person, dressed in a long-sleeved green top, pointing to a desktop computer with a monitor, a tower case, and a mouse. The person appears cheerful. The background is plain and white.

name_en: I want to use the computer.
description_brief: The illustration shows a cartoon character of a young person pointing at a desktop computer with a mildly discontented facial expression. The desktop computer consists of a monitor and a tower unit. The majority of the image is in grayscale, and only the person's hair has a touch of brown.

name_en: I want to watch a movie
description_brief: A smiling, stylized cartoon character with a tuft of hair on the head, and simple facial features including two dots for eyes and a small line for a mouth. Above the character, there is a speech bubble which contains an image of a film reel, suggesting the character wants to watch or is talking about a movie. The film reel has five spokes and the tail of the film is visible, unraveling from the center.

A simple representation of a person's face with a neutral expression at the bottom of the image. Above the person, there is a thought bubble which contains a picture of a classic, old-fashioned television set with dials and an antenna. The image symbolizes that the person is thinking about watching television.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person wearing a green shirt with a concerned or worried expression on their face. The person is clenching their fists near their cheeks. Above the person's head are three small "thought" bubbles. This image appears to symbolize confusion, concern, or a state of being deep in thought. The corresponding Korean phrase "당황했어요" (danghwanghaesseoyo) means "I was flustered" or "I was confused."

name_en: I was glad to see you again.
description_brief: Three stylized figures with the two top ones are sitting on opposite sides looking at a hanging calendar, appearing to be marking or discussing dates. The third figure, located below the two, is facing forward with a neutral expression. The image represents planning, scheduling, or a meeting arrangement.

A simplified character, which appears to be a person, walking from left to right. The character has a round head, a green top with long sleeves, blue pants and carries a yellow backpack. To the left of the character, there is a stylized representation of a building with an orange roof and a grey base. A blue arrow points from the building to the character, implying movement away from the building.

A cartoon-style drawing of a smiling person with a speech bubble. Inside the speech bubble is a simplified representation of a school building. The person is wearing a teal shirt with a collar and tie, and blue pants. The character appears happy and seems to be signifying a phrase related to school.

A simplified, cartoon-style character with a smiling face, two dot eyes, and a curved mouth. The character has a round head with short hair, and is wearing a teal shirt. They are holding a classic, old-fashioned telephone handset to their ear with their right hand.

A cartoon character raising one hand with a cheerful expression and a simple design, characterized by a brown hair tuft, wide eyes, a broad smile, and rosy cheeks. The character is wearing a plain white shirt and appears to be volunteering or offering to do something by raising their hand energetically.

A stylized, flat design of a character with a smiling facial expression. The character is wearing a teal-colored, long sleeve shirt and has short hair. The person's arms are raised, with the hands open and palms facing forward, in a gesture suggesting a friendly willingness to try or volunteer for something. The text "한번해볼게요" in Korean which translates to "I will try it once" or "I will give it a go" is present.

name_en: I'll leave now/I'll go home now
description_brief: A simplified, stylized cartoon character of a person with a broad smile, wearing a teal top and blue bottoms. To the right of the person, there is a speech bubble that contains an image of a simple, orange house with a brown roof and a gray door. The character appears to be making a hand gesture with both hands clasped together in front of him. The phrase "이만-가볼게요" indicates the character's intention to head home.

An illustration depicts a stylized figure with red skin walking towards the right. The figure is wearing a blue pair of pants, a green jacket, and is carrying a yellow backpack. The character appears to have three lines above its head, symbolizing stress, urgency, or worry. There is a simple representation of a building, resembling a school or public building, in the background with multiple windows and a clock on the facade. The image suggests that the person is in a hurry, possibly late for a class or meeting at the building.

A stylized, simple drawing of a person with a neutral expression wearing a teal top. Above the person's head is a red, curved arrow pointing in a counterclockwise direction, indicating a sense of starting over or repeating an action.

name_en: I'll think about it when I have time
description_brief: A cartoon-style figure of a person with a round head, simple happy facial expression, two dots for eyes, and a curved line for a mouth, sporting a short, neat haircut. The figure is wearing a long-sleeved teal shirt and is pointing to a wristwatch on their left wrist with the index finger of their right hand. The design suggests the concept of time or the need to check the time.

A stylized figure with a simplistic human form is shown from the waist up, wearing a teal shirt and raising one hand to the side of their head with fingers spread apart. The character, having a neutral expression with a hint of a smile, and a round head with no discernible hair or detailed features, seems to be waving, signaling, or indicating they are listening.

An illustrated character has short, spiked hair, a frustrated or disappointed expression, and is wearing a basic white t-shirt. They have their arms crossed and there's a small cloud of what appears to be a sigh coming out of their mouth. The phrase "귀찮아요" ("gwichanjayo"), which means "I’m annoyed" or "I'm frustrated" in Korean, appears in the image.

A cartoon character with a neutral expression and spiky brown hair. A zigzag red line across the character's forehead symbolizes agitation or frustration. The character is also wearing a simple white t-shirt. Next to the character's head is an empty speech bubble with a jagged outline. The phrase "흥분했어요" indicates a feeling of annoyance or irritation.

Three cartoon-style characters are seen standing side by side. The character in the middle appears disheveled and distressed with a slight frown and eyebrows pointing downwards. Two leaves are falling around him. The characters on either side are looking in opposite directions, away from the center character, and have neutral expressions. The characters are wearing T-shirts and shorts in slightly different colors.

The image shows a simplified, flat design illustration of a person, with a neutral facial expression with closed eyes. This person has short, black hair and is wearing a teal-colored shirt. There is no background detail, and the image focuses solely on the head and shoulders of the illustrated figure. The overall simplicity of the design symbolizes tranquility or thoughtfulness. There's also a Korean phrase "심심해요" (sim-sim-hae-yo), typically meaning "I'm bored" or "It's boring."

A cartoon-style figure standing with a neutral expression, wearing a green long-sleeved shirt and blue pants. Black lines are drawn around the figure, simulating shivering or shaking, indicating that the person may be cold or experiencing chills. The background is white.

A cartoon-style illustration of a person with a bewildered expression, raised eyebrows, and a concerned mouth. Above the person's head is a large red question mark suggesting that the character is questioning something. The character may represent confusion, questions, or not understanding something. There's a Korean phrase "어려워요" meaning "It's difficult" or "I'm having difficulty".

A cartoon figure of a person with short, spiky hair is holding a pair of glasses up to their face. The person is smiling and has spirals where their eyes should be, suggesting dizziness or confusion. This character is wearing a simple, short-sleeved t-shirt. The spiraling eyes indicate a sense of "미쳤어," a Korean phrase meaning "crazy" or "insane."

A cartoon character with a saddened or crying expression, has spiky hair, wearing a simple white T-shirt, with two tears streaking down their face. The character's hands are positioned near their cheeks with the index fingers pointing upward. Their eyebrows are turned upwards. There are two red arrows pointing downwards towards the character's cheeks.

Two stylized icons, one of a neatly wrapped gift box with a bow on top, and another depicting an opened box with the top flaps standing upright and askew, with red lines above it. A red arrow points from the wrapped gift on the left towards the opened box on the right. The transition from a wrapped to an opened box suggests a concept of anticipation followed by disappointment, aligning with the phrase "실망했어요" meaning "I'm disappointed" in Korean.

A simplistic drawing of a person's face with a neutral to slightly annoyed expression. The face has two narrow, closed eyes, and a straight line for a mouth. Above the head, there is a scribble that resembles a tangled line or a messy knot, symbolizing confusion, a troubled mind, or a complex thought.

A cartoon character with a slight frown on his face, puffed cheeks, and a wavy line coming from his mouth. His arms are crossed, suggesting dissatisfaction or disapproval. Next to him is a crumpled, possibly used, piece of tissue or paper towel. To the left of the boy is a stack of five books of various colors. The boy has brown hair and he is wearing a simple white t-shirt and shorts. The image symbolizes studying or doing homework.

A simplistic representation of a person with a displeased or frustrated expression pointing at a playground slide. The person is wearing a green shirt and extending their right arm towards the slide, which is depicted with grey steps, a yellow middle section, and a red top against a white background.

A cartoon-style figure of a person with a smiling face, arms raised in a celebratory manner. The character is wearing a teal shirt and blue pants. Around the figure are various brightly colored flowers in orange, blue, pink, and yellow. The phrase "행복해요" which means "I'm happy" in Korean is present.

A stylized cartoon character, appearing happy, is jumping with legs apart and arms raised high. Each hand is holding a star, with additional stars in various sizes scattered around the person. Musical notes are floating in the air near the character, implying enjoyment of music. The character's facial expression is a simple, broad smile.

A stylized depiction of a person's head and shoulders. The person has a somber or upset expression with a single tear drop falling from one eye and the mouth is turned downward in a frown. The hair is short and black, and the individual is wearing a teal-colored shirt.

A stylized person appearing distressed due to heat, covering their forehead and with sweat droplets falling from their head. A simplified yellow sun with rays is next to the person, indicating a hot environment. The overall imagery communicates the concept of heat or feeling hot, which corresponds to the Korean phrase "더워요" (deo-weo-yo), meaning "It's hot."

A cartoon character of a young boy with a discontented or slightly pained expression. He has spiky brown hair and is wearing a white T-shirt and brown shorts. He is holding his stomach with both hands, and there are curved red dashed lines drawn around his belly. To the right of the boy, there are two wavy lines suggesting a sense of something emanating from the stomach region. The overall image conveys the concept of the boy experiencing hunger and corresponds to the phrase "배고파요" meaning "I'm hungry" in Korean.

A simple, cartoon-style illustration of a person running. The character has a round head with a small black dot for an eye, wearing a teal long-sleeved shirt, navy blue pants, and dark shoes. The person's arms and legs are positioned to show motion and there are curved lines behind the figure's head, suggesting movement or speed. The background is plain white.

A stylized representation of a person's head and upper shoulders. The person has a neutral facial expression with a straight, bowl-cut hairstyle, and is wearing a green shirt. Above the person's head, there's a thick, horizontal arrow pointing to the left. The background is plain white.

A cartoon-like person smiling, with short hair, wearing a teal top, and holding a vertically striped gift box with yellow and pink stripes and a purple ribbon. The depicted person appears happy and content. The image represents anticipation or excitement related to giving or receiving a gift, symbolizing feelings of excitement or pleasure. It aligns with the Korean phrase "기대돼요," meaning "I'm looking forward to it".

A stylized figure of a person standing at a fork in the road, facing three separate paths. The person is shown from the back, pondering which way to go. A red question mark is floating above the person's head. The figure appears to be confused or indecisive. The person is wearing a teal shirt and navy blue pants. The image is symbolic of the phrase "길을잃었어요," which in Korean means "I am lost" or "I have lost my way."

A directional signpost with two arrows pointing in opposite directions. The signpost is standing on a three-dimensional green triangular patch representing the ground. A red question mark is placed above and to the right of the signpost, indicating confusion or the need for a decision. The arrows contain red pointing tips.

The illustration features a cartoon-style character with a sad facial expression. Above the character's head, there's a speech bubble containing a crossed-out pencil. This depicts that the character finds something unamusing or boring. The illustration aligns with the phrase "재미없어요" meaning "It's not fun" or "I am not amused" in Korean.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person standing. The person is wearing a teal long-sleeved shirt and dark blue pants. The individual has their right arm raised, resting their hand on their forehead in a gesture that indicates discomfort or illness. There are also sweat droplets on the forehead. The character's facial expression is that of distress, with furrowed brows and an open, frowning mouth. The image symbolizes "I'm not feeling well".

A cartoon character with a sad expression, tears on the face, and eyebrows turned downwards in a frown. There are two clouds above and on both sides of the character, from which rain is falling. The text "우울해요" is present, translating to "I am sad" or "I am depressed" in English.

The illustration depicts a human-like facial expression with a worried or scared look. Above the face, there are two ghost-like figures with eyes and red cheeks, appearing to hover or float. The image symbolizes fear or the phrase "I'm scared" (무서워요) in Korean.

A stylized character with a simple, smiling facial expression, short black hair, holding their cheeks with both hands which have pinkish-red circles on them, indicating blushing or shyness. The character is wearing a teal-colored shirt with white collar details. The background is white, with the Korean text "부끄러워요" loosely translating to "I'm shy" or "I'm embarrassed" in English.

A cartoon character is depicted lying in bed with an orange blanket covering most of their body. They appear to be sick, with a pained facial expression, flushed cheeks, and three wavy lines above their forehead indicating a fever or sweating. They have brown hair. The image represents the Korean phrase "아파요" (apayo), which translates to "I'm sick" or "I'm in pain."

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person with a neutral expression, short black hair, wearing a long-sleeved, teal shirt and blue pants. The figure is standing upright with their arms straight down at the sides and black shoes on their feet. The background is plain white.

A cartoon character with a regretful or apologetic expression. The character has brown hair, wearing a simple white t-shirt. The character's eyebrows are angled upwards towards the center and the mouth is turned downward in a mild frown. Cheeks are tinted with a blush with hands held together in front of the character. The posture and facial expression align with the Korean phrase "미안합니다", which translates to "I'm sorry."

A simple cartoon-style drawing of a face with a neutral expression, black hair, and three sweat droplets on the right side. To the left of the face is a red, cloud-like speech bubble. The image symbolizes the Korean phrase "힘들어요," which translates to "It's hard" or "I'm struggling."

A stylized illustration of a young person with a surprised or shocked expression, short, spiky hair, wide open eyes, and a small 'o' shaped mouth. A surprised person with their mouth open and two exclamation marks next to their head.

A cartoon-style drawing of a person standing to the right, with short hair, a smiling face, and wearing a green long-sleeve shirt and blue pants. To the left, there is a piece of paper with a simple mathematical equation written on it ("1+1=2"), and a pencil lying on top of the paper, pointing diagonally upwards to the right. The overall image is designed for educational purposes or to convey a concept.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person sitting in an armchair, slouching with one hand resting on their cheek and elbow on the armrest. The person's facial expression appears tired or bored. They are wearing a teal top and blue pants. This fits the Korean phrase "피곤해요" (pigonyaeyo), which means "I'm tired."

A simplified cartoon-like illustration of a person, drawn with a straight body, shown from the waist up, with closed eyes. Three cartoon characters standing side by side. A simple, cartoon-style figure of a person with a sad or unwell facial expression. The figure is standing upright and facing forward, with a white bandage on their forehead. Two symbols side by side: a black letter "O" on the left, separated by a slanted black forward slash from a red letter "X" on the right. The symbols commonly represent "yes" and "no" respectively.

The figure on the right is in a gray top, extending their right hand with a thumbs-up gesture, signaling approval, agreement, or recognition. The image could symbolize positive interaction, agreement, or the phrase "nice to see you again".

On the right side, another individual with a raised hand is pointing at the stage, with a question mark above their hand.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person with a happy expression, dark hair, wearing a teal shirt, and blue pants. A red-outlined circle with a white background, inside of which there is a stylized image of a paper with the mathematical equation "1 + 1 = 2" written on it. This image may symbolize correctness or the concept of something being right.

A cartoon illustration of a cheerful young boy with spiky hair, raising his right thumb in a thumbs-up gesture, wearing a plain t-shirt and looking directly at the viewer. The phrase "재미있어요" meaning "It's fun" or "It's enjoyable" in Korean is fitting with the positive boy's expression.

An illustration with two figures, one inside a simplified form of a building with multiple windows and the other one outside, pointing towards the building.
