A simplistic, circular face with a displeased expression, displayed through two slanted eyebrows pointing inwards and a downturned mouth. There's a bandage on its cheek, suggesting an injury. Behind the face, two dashed lines represent motion or impact, suggesting the figure has been hit or is moving rapidly backwards.

A cartoon character with a simple, smiling face and short hair, wearing a teal long-sleeved shirt and is holding up both hands with palms facing up and the index fingers pointing outwards to each side. Above the character's head is a large red "X" mark. The visual is intended to represent confusion or the concept of questioning why something is not possible or allowed, with the Korean phrase "왜안돼나요", meaning "Why not?" or "Why can't I?".

A stylized cartoon character with a smiling face, short hair, wearing a long-sleeved teal shirt is holding up their right index finger to the side of their head. Above the character's head, there is a red "X" mark intertwined with a red question mark, symbolizing confusion or a query on the prohibition of something. There is a Korean phrase "왜 안돼나요?" (wae andoenayo?), which translates to "Why not?" or "Why can't I?" in English.

A cartoon character with a questioning expression. The character is a light-skinned male with brown hair, wearing a white t-shirt. His eyebrows are raised, and he has a slight frown, with arms are raised at his sides with palms facing upward. To the right of the character is a large red question mark. The given phrase "왜" in Korean is also present.

name_en: Will you pass me the telephone, please?
description_brief: The illustration depicts two stylized figures standing face to face. The figure on the left is extending an arm towards the phone receiver held in the right hand. The second figure is standing upright and appears to be watching the first figure. Both figures are drawn with simple lines and shapes, without any facial features except for dots as eyes. They are colored with distinct blocks of color for each part of their body and clothing.

A cartoon character with a cheerful expression, short, brown hair, wearing a white shirt. The character's eyes are closed, with a gentle smile, and the hands are pressed together in front of the face in a gesture associated with wishing, praying, or hoping for something. This could be a symbol for the sentiment of "hope it goes well" or "best wishes" as described by the Korean phrase "잘되길바래".

name_en: Would it be okay if I stop?
description_brief: A simplified, cartoon-like drawing of a person with a neutral expression, holding up a hand as if to indicate a pause or to ask for a moment. Above the person's head is a red question mark, suggesting that the person is questioning, uncertain, or in need of clarification.

name_en: Would you like to have a cup of tea?
description_brief: Two stylized characters sitting across from each other at a table. Each character has a round head and simple facial features. They both have a cup in front of them on the table, suggesting they are sharing a drink together. The phrase "차 한잔 마실래요?" ("Would you like to have a cup of tea?" or "Would you like to have a drink?") is there, conveying they are in a relaxed setting having a casual conversation.

name_en: Would you like to have dinner together?
description_brief: Two people seated opposite each other at a table, engaging in a meal or conversation. One of them has a plate in front of them with food and a bowl. The scene is framed by a window in the background showing a night sky with a crescent moon and stars. The image conveys a scene of two people spending time together during dinner.

A cheerful cartoon character with spiky hair, wearing a plain white t-shirt. They are holding up both hands with palms facing forward, indicating surprise or excitement. Above the character, there is the Korean word "와우", which translates to "wow", suggesting a feeling of amazement or excitement.
An illustration of a solid red circle with a slightly darker red border, set against a plain white background.

Two stylized figures facing each other against a white background. The figure on the right, clothed in a green shirt, is extending their right arm to point directly at the figure on the left, who is wearing a gray shirt. Above the figure on the left, there is a small red inverted triangle. The characters are drawn with simple lines and solid colors, with circular heads and black dots for eyes.

Two stylized figures facing each other against a white background. The figure on the left is grey with a simple black outline, featuring a round head with two dots for eyes and a straight line for a mouth. The figure on the right is teal, with a similar round head and facial features, but with an arm extended toward the first figure, pointing directly at them. Above the scene, there is a small red triangle pointing downward, towards the interaction between the two figures.

A cheerful cartoon character, a boy with a tuft of brown hair, smiling ears, and rosy cheeks is holding a large piece of paper or a card that features flower-like designs with various petals and patterns. Around him are four twinkling stars. The boy's expression and the stars align with the phrase "예뻐요" which means "pretty" in Korean.

A cheerful cartoon character making a gesture with both hands open and slightly raised. Next to the character is a speech bubble containing a red circle with a white center, possibly representing the Korean flag's central symbol.

Two stylized figures facing each other. The figure on the left is holding a stack of banknotes with "10000" written on the top note. There is a curved arrow pointing from the stack of money in the left figure's hands to the right figure, suggesting a transaction or transfer of money from one person to another. Both figures are depicted with simple lines and shapes, and are sitting down with their legs extended forward.
A flat, cartoonish illustration of a smiling person's face and upper torso. The character has short black hair, black dot eyes, and a red-tongued smile and is wearing a gray top.

name_en: Center for Disabled Rights and Policy Studies
description_brief: The image shows a stylized illustration of a multi-story building with rows of windows. At the top, there is a large rectangular sign with Korean text likely indicating the name or description of the building.

A simplistic representation with three main elements - a house-like figure with a brown roof and a stack of money inside labeled "10000," a red arrow pointing rightward, and a stylized figure of a person standing upright, wearing a teal shirt and dark pants. The image conveys the idea of financial resources or money moving from a house to a person.

name_en: Contact Support For Disabled Gold Star cellForRowAt
description_brief: A side-by-side illustration shows a building with a large billboard on top that displays Korean text on the left and a hand hovering over a braille display on the right. The building suggests an office or apartment building, and the braille display suggests tactile reading for the visually impaired. The images relate to accessibility and awareness for individuals with disabilities.

name_en: Contact the National Human Rights Commission
description_brief: Two separate images side by side. On the left, a simplified representation of a building with many windows and a door, and above the building is a sign with Korean text that reads "국가인권위원회" which translates to "National Human Rights Commission." On the right, an image of a telephone, viewed from above, with buttons for dialing numbers. It's a traditional landline phone with a handset placed on top of the base.

The illustration shows three stylized figures. On the left side is a figure seated in a wheelchair, representing a person with a physical disability. The figure in the wheelchair is facing forward and has a neutral expression. To the right, there are two standing figures close to each other, also facing forward, with neutral expressions. The image includes a phrase "저의말을계속무시해요" (continuously ignoring what I say).

A simplified, stylized drawing of a multi-story building with numerous square windows uniformly spaced across its facade. Above the building is a signboard with Korean text that reads "범죄피해자 지원센터," which translates to "Crime Victims Support Center." The building has a single prominent entrance at the base. The illustration is in black and white.

name_en: Designated Fund for Disaster Relief for the Disabled Building
description_brief: A black and white drawing of a multi-story building with a rectangular shape. It has evenly spaced windows distributed across multiple floors and a door centered on the ground floor. Above the building is a signboard with Korean text, which translates to "Designated Fund for Disaster Relief for the Disabled."

name_en: Did not press the pedestrian crossing button
description_brief: A pedestrian traffic light with a red signal at the top and a green signal at the bottom. The red signal has a stationary person icon, indicating "stop," and the green signal features a walking person icon, indicating "go." To the right of the traffic light, there is a large red "X" symbol.

A flat design of a document icon with several horizontal lines that indicate text. This document icon has a large red 'X' superimposed over it. Above the graphic, there are Korean characters that read "장애수당" which translates to "disability allowance". The image conveys the message of not receiving or being denied the disability allowance.

An illustration of a traditional rubber stamp with a black handle and base, depicted in the act of stamping onto a surface, leaving behind a red imprint of stylized or script-like characters. These characters might represent a signature or seal in a specific cultural context.

An illustration shows two stick figure characters. The character on the left is standing and pulling on the right hand of the character on the right, who is falling over with their feet up in the air. There is a stylized representation of a burst or explosion between their hands. The scene could depict one person causing another person to fall.

A black silhouette of a bare human footprint next to a red circle with a red ring around it. The red circle is positioned to the upper right of the footprint. This graphic might represent the concept of injury, problems related to walking, or a foot, with the red circle potentially symbolizing an alert or a warning.

Two stylized figures facing each other and shaking hands. The figure on the left wears a teal shirt and blue pants, while the figure on the right wears a gray shirt and black pants. Their faces consist of simple, blank circles with two dots for eyes. The handshake is depicted by the interlocking of their simplified hand shapes.

name_en: I Don't Know What To Do
description_brief: A character with a neutral or slightly concerned facial expression, shown from the waist up, wearing a teal long-sleeved shirt and raising both hands at shoulder height, palms facing up, suggesting confusion or uncertainty. A large red question mark is above the character's head, emphasizing the state of doubt or needing assistance.

An illustration showing two figures. On the left, a person in a wheelchair, wearing a blue top and black pants, and a stylized wheelchair with prominent wheels and a visible footrest. On the right, a person standing upright, wearing a grey top and darker grey pants, with their arms crossed over their chest. Both figures have a neutral expression and a minimalist design without detailed facial features. The image appears to be a graphic representation related to disabilities.

name_en: I Want to Consult with a Lawyer
description_brief: A cartoon drawing of a person from the waist up. The individual appears to be male, dressed in a dark blue suit with a light blue shirt and a patterned tie. He has black hair and is smiling, presenting an open and inviting gesture with his right hand extended outward. Above him, there is a speech bubble with the word “상담” written in it, which means "consultation" in Korean. The background is white.

A two-dimensional illustration of a person with a frown on their face. Above the person's head is a hand in a striking motion, with a star-shaped burst indicating the point of impact. The image appears to symbolize physical assault or an act of violence towards the individual depicted.

The illustration shows a simplified representation of a person from the shoulders up with black hair, dark circles under the eyes, and a bruise or discoloration on the left cheek. The person's expression is one of concern or discomfort, with a slightly downturned mouth. The character is wearing a green shirt. The overall tone of the image suggests a concept of injury or distress.

An illustration of a person with a frowning facial expression, short black hair, wearing a teal shirt, and raising their right hand to their head, specifically touching the temple area. A bright yellow starburst near the hand to indicate pain. The image conveys a sense of discomfort or ailment.

An illustration shows two stylized figures: a person in a wheelchair with a neutral or possibly displeased expression facing a standing person, who is looking straight ahead with a neutral expression. The illustration portrays the concept of "ignoring" in the context of disabilities.

Two stylized, cartoon-like human figures are standing side by side. On the left, there is an elderly figure holding a large stack of currency notes with "1000" written on the bands. A red arrow points from the elderly figure to the younger figure dressed in a teal shirt and blue pants, suggesting a transfer or offer of money.

A stylized grey figure with wide eyes and an open mouth expressing surprise or concern. To the right of the figure is a stack of currency bills with "10000" printed on the top bill. The image appears to represent someone who has lost money or is facing financial problems, conveying distress related to monetary loss.

A hand reaching into an open bifold wallet and taking out a banknote. The wallet appears to be on a surface, possibly indicating the action of someone picking up or stealing the wallet or money from it.

name_en: National Human Rights Commission of South Korea
description_brief: A stylized building with multiple windows, representing an institutional or office building. At the top of the building, there is a placard or sign that features Korean text "국가인권위원회," which translates to "National Human Rights Commission" in English.

A simple, solid black silhouette of a human footprint with the toes depicted by five circles descending in size from big to little. Positioned above the footprint to its right is a red "X" mark formed by two crossed lines.

A simple, flat design cartoon of a human figure standing upright with their arms hanging by their sides. The person has black hair, a neutral facial expression, is wearing a long-sleeved grey shirt, and black or dark grey pants. Above the figure, there is Korean text "가해자" which translates to "perpetrator" or "offender". The figure and text are against a plain white background.

name_en: Please call the Center for Human Rights in case of Disability Discrimination Issues
description_brief: An illustration of two distinct images side by side. On the left, a stylized building with multiple windows and a sign on top with Korean text. On the right, a visual representation of an open address book or contact list, showing rows of dots that could represent entries, with a spiral binding at the top and a thicker column of dots on the right page, possibly indicating a navigation or an index section.

A cartoon-style image with a person on the left with a neutral or slightly concerned facial expression, wearing a green top. On the right side, there is a large speech bubble that encloses a depiction of a friendly smiling police officer in blue uniform with a badge and a cap that has a gold emblem on it. The image includes a Korean phrase "경찰불러주세요," which translates to "Please call the police," representing the concept of calling or interacting with the police.

name_en: Please contact the Disability Crime Prevention Center
description_brief: The illustration depicts two icons. On the left, a simplified drawing of a building with multiple windows and a signboard on the top that displays Korean text. On the right, an icon of a traditional telephone receiver with a cord, indicating a means of communication. The illustration conveys the idea of contacting a support center.

An illustration of two icons side by side: a figure depicting a smiling police officer in blue uniform with a badge on the chest and cap. The other icon is an open book or report with a red cover and a grid of squares on the right page, representing text or data entries. The phrase "경찰서에신고해주세요", translating to "Please report to the police", suggests reporting an incident to the police.

name_en: Received Unfair Treatment Due to Disability
description_brief: The illustration depicts two scenes. On the left, an individual in a wheelchair with a red "X" above their head, indicating a wrong action. On the right, two individuals are standing and facing each other, engaging in a handshake with a red circle above their heads, suggesting a correct action. The illustration conveys a message about correct and wrong ways to treat individuals with disabilities.

An illustration depicts a stack of green banknotes with the number 10000 printed on the topmost note and two hands clasped together in a handshake. The handshake shows the thumbs and fingers of each hand interlocking.

Two illustrated figures. A person seated in a wheelchair, dressed in a green shirt and blue pants is on the left. Another person, gesturing with an outstretched arm pointing towards the person in the wheelchair, wearing a gray shirt and black pants, stands on the right. There's a speech bubble with a starburst shape between them.

Two simplified humanoid figures. The figure on the left is standing upright with a frown, wearing a green shirt and blue pants. The figure on the right is kicking towards the left figure's shin, wearing a gray shirt and grey pants. There is a yellow burst between the right figure's foot and the left figure's leg, indicating impact. The image represents an act of one person kicking another.

Two hands clasped together, appearing from the wrist up and are positioned one on top of the other, with the fingers of the top hand wrapped around the other hand indicating a firm grip or handshake. The color palette of flesh tones is used for the hands on a plain background. The image could symbolize agreement, partnership, or cooperation.

A flat-designed illustration of a human figure with a neutral expression, slight frown, short black hair, standing straight. The person is wearing a teal long-sleeve shirt, blue pants, and black shoes. Above the figure, there is text in Korean which reads "피해자," meaning "victim". The background is plain white.

name_en: Want to make a consultation reservation
description_brief: A cartoon-like image of an open pink appointment book or planner with a red binding and a grid of blank rectangles. One cell on the upper right corner is marked in red, indicating an appointment or important date. There's a stylized depiction of a phone cord at the bottom left corner. Above the illustration, the Korean text "상담예약" translates to "Consultation Reservation" in English.

A stylized building with the Korean word "은행" (translates to "bank") on the left side. In the center, a stack of banknotes with "10000" written on the top note. A red arrow points from the stack of money to a simplified figure of a person sitting in a chair, possibly a wheelchair, on the right side. The individual's head is turned to look at the money, suggesting a financial transaction.

A cartoon character with a straight, long black hair, a displeased facial expression, and arms crossed over the chest in an 'X' shape, wearing a pink top. The image likely represents a message of rejection, prohibition, or a boundary being set.

A stylized representation of a person's face with a neutral expression. Above the person's head, there is a speech bubble containing an image of a glass filled with blue liquid, indicating that the person is thinking or talking about wanting to drink something. The phrase "마시고싶어요" is present in the "Food" category.

A simple cartoon illustration of a face with a round outline and neutral skin tone. The face has a straight, black hairline representing short hair. The facial features include two small, black, downturned eyes and a small, curved, frowning mouth, conveying an unhappy look. The face is possibly an emoticon or emoji used to convey dissatisfaction or discontent, especially in the context of a special or customized food order.

A happy cartoon character with a circular head, two dots for eyes, a simple line for a mouth, and a short stroke for a nose. The character has short hair, is wearing a long-sleeved green shirt, and is pointing upwards at an orange fruit, likely a mandarin or tangerine, with a small leaf attached. Beside the unpeeled fruit is a peeled one, showcasing its segments. Above the character is text in Korean, "까주세요," which means "Please give me a sniff," or "Let me smell it." The background is plain white, and the style is flat with bold outlines and filled colors.

An illustration depicting a hand pointing to a page within an open menu. The right page has bold letters saying "MENU" with a list of items next to various numbers. The left page features the word "Coffee" at the top and a list of numbers alongside a vertical stack of lines, indicating a list of coffee options with corresponding prices. The hand is shown with a teal or green colored sleeve.

The illustration depicts a cartoon-styled image of a person's head with a pacifier in their mouth. Above the head, a speech bubble has a hand pointing to three circular objects that might represent food items or cookies. The image conveys a theme of "wanting to eat", as indicated by the Korean text.

A stylized illustration of a hand gesture associated with "a little bit" or "a small amount." The hand is shown with fingers close together, creating a small space between the thumb and the fingertips. A red dashed-line circle highlights the pinched area between the thumb and fingers, emphasizing the concept of measuring a small quantity.
Two stylized abalones with a brown-colored interior suggestive of a typical abalone's edible part, set within a gray, textured shell with a blue rim.

An illustration of four acorn-shaped objects in vibrant orange color, with a glossy surface and a pattern on the tops that suggests the texture of a nut's shell, likely representing acorn jelly, known as "Dotorimuk" in Korean. The image is on a plain white background.

A stylized depiction of a pair of tongs holding an ice cube above a glass half-filled with a yellow liquid. The ice cube is about to be dropped into the glass, representing the act of adding ice to a beverage. The tongs and ice cube are grey and white respectively, and the liquid in the glass is yellow.

The illustration depicts a hand gesture indicating something small or a pinch, often used in cooking. There is a red plus sign to the right of the fingers, suggesting the concept of adding more of something, reinforcing the word "더" which means "more" in Korean. The image symbolizes the idea of adding more food or ingredients.

An illustration depicts a small, open container that resembles a dish of food, with a red sauce being squeezed onto it from a red squeeze bottle held above it. The bottle does not have any distinctive brand markings. The food in the bowl appears to be an egg in the center with various other ingredients, potentially vegetables or garnishes, arranged circularly around it. The image represents the action of adding gochujang, a Korean red chili paste, to a dish.

An illustration that includes a bowl filled with what appears to be rice or some kind of grain, indicating a food item. Below the bowl, there is a label with Korean text "음식가치-싸요". To the right, there is a stylized representation of a person with a smiling face and wearing a teal or green shirt. The person has short hair and a simplistic facial design.

The illustration depicts four almond nuts, showing the characteristic teardrop shape with a central seam indicating the nut's texture. The almonds are colored in a light brown, with darker brown lines to provide contrast and detail.

A white, ceramic coffee cup filled with dark brown liquid, likely representing coffee. The cup is situated on a matching white saucer, with a slight shadow indicating the cup is resting on a surface. The handle of the cup is visible and positioned to the right side of the image, with a view from a slightly above angle. The brown color of the liquid has a slight ripple, suggesting a freshly poured or stirred beverage. The image has bold outlines accentuating the cup and its contents against the white background.

An illustration of a group of small fish tightly packed together with a slender body, a clear eye spot, and lines indicating fins and tails in shades of grey and white with black detailing. The image represents "멸치" which translates to "anchovies".

Two red apples, one whole and the other cut in half vertically, revealing the inside with seeds and core, are presented against a plain white background. The term "사과" is also present, which is Korean for "apple."

The illustration shows a jar of apple jam with a red label at the top and bottom, a beige label in the middle, and a graphic of a half apple with the core visible on the beige label. The jar has a gray lid.

A cylindrical container, resembling a juice carton or can, features a simple depiction of a red apple with a green leaf and a brown stem. The background of the carton is a light beige color, outlined with a thin black line. The lid of the container is not visible. The carton is labelled with Korean text "사과주스," which translates to "apple juice."

A simple cartoon of a person's face with a round head, black hair, and a smiling expression displaying a pink tongue. In the person's right hand, they are holding an ice cream cone with two scoops of ice cream, one atop the other. The ice cream cone is tilted towards the person's mouth. Colors are basic, with a beige skin tone, black for the hair, and pastel colors for the ice cream, which are blue and light turquoise. The image typically represents enjoyment of food, specifically sweet dessert like ice cream.

An illustration of a jar with a red label and a grey cap. On the label, there's an image of two apricot halves with a visible kernel inside one of the halves, suggesting the contents of the jar may be apricot-related, potentially jam or similar fruit preserve.

A stylized character with a round head, black hair, closed eyes, and a teal shirt. They are holding a yellow object, resembling a slice of cheese or nacho chip, close to their mouth as if they are eating it. The icon seems to represent the act of eating. The context "재채기나요" in the "Food" category is provided, though it usually refers to sneezing in Korean.

A single, whole, yellow Asian pear with a smooth, rounded surface and a single dark green leaf attached near the top. The pear's skin has a soft, matte finish, and it appears plump and ripe. It is set against a plain, unadorned background.

A white bowl with horizontal lines, possibly made of ceramic or porcelain. Inside the bowl, there is a yellowish dish that appears to involve some type of broth or sauce. Two items that resemble seed pods or perhaps some form of traditional dumplings or cooked fruit are submerged in this yellow liquid. The bowl is placed on a small plate or saucer, implying it might be served hot.
A blue baby bottle with a yellow nipple on top, featuring measurement markings on its side. The bottle's cap is of a darker color. It represents baby food or infant feeding equipment.
An illustration of several bananas connected at their stems, appearing ripe with a bright yellow color. They exhibit smooth textures and curved shapes.

An illustration depicting a yellow milk carton with the word "milk" written on it and a peeled banana image, suggesting a banana-flavored milk or a milk-banana combination product. The carton also has a white panel, which could be a space for branding or nutritional information.

The illustration features a pile of light brown grains, resembling rice, on the left, and two stalks of wheat with golden yellow ears on a background of linear black spikes, representing wheat stalks on the right. The wheat ears are detailed with individual kernels. "보리" is the Korean word for "barley," but the image may suggest grains in general, including rice and wheat.

An illustration of a glass filled with a brown-beige substance. It features a white line drawing of two cereal grain stalks at the center, suggesting a grain-based beverage. This symbol could be used to represent a grain-based drink like barley tea, known as "보리차" (boricha) in Korean.

The logo consists of the initials "BR" in large, bold font, above which is the full name spelled out in smaller letters: "baskin robbins". The "B" and the "R" are merged into a single graphic element, with the "B" in pink color and the "R" in blue. The rest of the text is also in blue. This logo represents a well-known ice cream chain that offers a variety of flavors.
An illustration of elongated, yellow bulbous roots with long, slender, green shoots or leaves extending from the top, representing spring onions or scallions.

The illustration depicts a stylized cow on a plain background, sectioned into various cuts commonly used for meat, with the section in question highlighted in red. The image is likely intended for educational purposes related to butchery or meat products.

The illustration depicts a stylized side profile of a cow with outlined segments to represent different cuts of beef. One of these segments, located around the cow's midsection, is highlighted in red.

A beer mug with a handle, filled with a golden yellow liquid which suggests beer. The mug is topped with a frothy white head that is spilling over the rim, indicating the beer is effervescent and freshly poured. The beer mug is set against a plain background, with the Korean word "맥주" (maekju) which translates to "beer" in English.
Two yellowish-tan vegetables with elongated bodies and multiple shoots or roots extending from one end. They appear to be radishes, likely representing the Korean radish, known as "무" (mu) in Korean.

Three beverage containers: two cans and one carton. The left can is red with a black horizontal stripe in the middle, the one behind is green with white stars. Both cans have a silver pull-tab at the top. On the right, there is a yellow-orange juice carton with a picture of a sliced citrus fruit and white stars around it. The carton has a white screw cap at the top. This image symbolizes "음료수," which translates to "beverage" in Korean.

The illustration depicts a bowl of bibimbap, a Korean mixed rice dish with ingredients like sliced vegetables of varying colors such as orange, green, and yellow, representing carrots, spinach, and yellow squash. There is a sunny side up egg in the center, with the yolk still intact. The bowl itself is simple and grey.

A white bowl filled with rice and topped with a few pieces of food, possibly vegetables and a piece of meat or fish. A gold pair of chopsticks resting across the bowl. A red curved arrow above the bowl indicating a mixing or stirring motion. This setup is associated with the Korean dish bibimbap.

A golden brown Korean mung bean pancake, known as "빈대떡" (bindaetteok), with specks of green from scallions or other vegetables, and bits of red from peppers or kimchi. The edges are irregular and the surface shows a slight sheen, suggesting the presence of oil used in cooking.

Three brown biscuits with a rugged, textured top on a white plate with a slight shadow underneath. The coloring suggests they might be chocolate flavored or made with brown ingredients such as whole wheat.

The illustration depicts a blender with a transparent pitcher on top containing a yellow-orange substance. The pitcher has a detachable lid. Below the pitcher is the grey base of the blender with a button for operating the machine.

The illustration depicts a person's bust with a neutral expression, mouth open, and three curved lines on the left side of the face representing breath or air moving. The person has short hair and is wearing a teal-colored shirt.

The illustration depicts three stylized blueberries grouped together. They have a primary purple color for the body and blueish accents to represent the calyx at the top. The background is plain white, focusing entirely on the blueberries.

A cartoon drawing of a plate filled with various food items. There are several slices of grilled meat, vegetables including lettuce, a reddish vegetable, and a leaf of perilla. There's also a thick yellow sauce or pickled radish, and a round orange item that could be a piece of kimchi or a persimmon. The plate itself is white.

An illustration of a plate filled with black oval-shaped items, resembling beans. The plate is oval or round with a slight rim. The image symbolizes "콩자반," a Korean side dish made of black beans, usually soybeans, cooked in soy sauce and sugar.

A cylindrical canned food item with the lid partially opened. The can displays a stylized image of a pineapple with crisscrossed lines and a green crown of leaves. The body of the can is primarily green with a camouflage pattern, and the metal of the can and the opened lid are depicted in gray. The image represents canned pineapple in the food category.

A cylindrical can with a pull-tab lid. It appears to be unopened with no visible brand markings or labels. The pull-tab is intact and the can's body has smooth, straight sides with a clear circular top and bottom.
The illustration shows a simplified depiction of a loaf of bread with a light brown crust, a pale beige interior, a rounded top, and a slight indentation along its side.
Three elongated, brown items representing loaves of bread, each with diagonal slash marks on their surfaces. The colors suggest a baked, crusty texture indicative of baguette or artisanal bread.

Three distinct logos, each representing a different restaurant chain. At the top, the "Bennigan's" logo in a script-like green font. In the middle, the "VIPS" logo in red, encapsulated within an elongated oval. Lastly, the word "OUTBACK" appears in robust, weathered red lettering.

An illustration of a classic fast-food meal consisting of a burger, a container of fries, and a beverage. The burger is depicted with two buns, a patty, lettuce, and a slice of cheese or tomato. An illustration shows three round, stylized fruits arranged side by side in slightly overlapping positions. They are colored dark red, bright red, and a light brown or beige. An illustration of three stylized fish aligned horizontally. They have grey scale-like bodies, yellow fins, and prominent eyes with a black iris and yellow ring. The fish appear three-dimensional due to some shading. The illustration represents the category of food.

A cartoon illustration of a fish depicted in a side profile view with its body horizontally oriented from left to right. The illustration depicts a stylized food stall with crossed silverware, a fork and a spoon, at the center. The illustration shows a large, shallow plate on the top and a smaller, deeper bowl on the bottom with a red arrow pointing downwards from the plate to the bowl, suggesting the action of stacking the plate atop the bowl.
An illustration of a fork with a gray handle and a small circular hole near the bottom. It has four rounded tines at the top and is presented against a plain white background.

An illustration of three pieces of nigiri sushi on a white plate. Each sushi has an orange slice of fish on top of small clumps of rice, with a small green accent indicating wasabi. The illustration has a cartoon or clip-art style.

An illustration of a frying pan containing two dumplings, likely representing the Korean dish "gunmandu". The pan has a long black handle and there are three red and yellow flame icons underneath, suggesting the dumplings are being cooked. The background is white.

An illustration of a fried egg lying on a frying pan. The pan is shown from an overhead perspective, with its handle extending to the left. The illustration displays a pile of golden-brown, crinkle-cut french fries. The background is clean, which keeps the focus entirely on the fries.

An illustration of three pieces of fried shrimp with a golden-brown, crumbed coating on a round white plate alongside a lemon wedge. The shrimp's tail ends are sticking out, revealing the orange-colored shell. The food item referred to as "튀김" or "twigim" in Korean, represents a variety of fried snacks.

A full glass of yellow smoothie with visible bubbles is shown, alongside a half slice of lemon with bright yellow rind and citrus segments. To the right is a kitchen blender with a white container, grey lid, set on an olive green base with a grey button. The overall image composition represents the theme of making and enjoying a fresh citrus or fruit smoothie.

A selection of various fresh fruits including a whole orange and its slice, a lemon and its half, strawberries, a whole kiwi and a kiwi slice, along with a small brown fruit. The fruits are arranged closely together, forming a colorful and vibrant composition with a focus on citrus fruits.

A stylized drawing of a frying pan from a bird's eye view. Inside the pan, there is a round object suggestive of an egg, with the yolk in the center. Below the frying pan, there are three small flame motifs, representing the heat source for cooking. The overall image represents frying an egg on a stovetop.

A simple, stylized image of a frying pan with a long handle. The pan appears to be shallow with a flat bottom, it is in shades of gray and the interior cooking surface is light gray or white, indicating an empty pan. This image represents cooking or kitchenware.

Two pieces of a green-colored food item, likely "개떡" (gaetteok), a type of Korean rice cake. The items are oval and slightly flattened, with a moist surface. A plate with a piece of grilled meat that has grill marks and a slab of butter melting on top. The meat is likely meant to represent "galbi," a Korean dish made with beef or pork ribs. The plate is circular, and the colors include brown, beige, white, and a hint of red-orange.

The illustration shows three items, resembling pieces of meat on the bone, associated with "galbi" or Korean barbecued ribs. Each piece has a bone with meat attached to it, depicted in a light brown for the bones and a darker brown for the grilled meat, giving a charred appearance.

A stylized, cartoon-like image of a hot, grilled piece of meat, possibly beef, with grill marks on it. The meat is resting on what appears to be a cutting board or serving platter. There are two curvy lines above the meat representing steam or heat, indicating that the meat is freshly cooked and still hot. The colors used suggest a well-cooked exterior with darker brown and black tones for the grill lines, and a lighter brown for the sauce or juices. The background is white.

An illustration features a dish called "galbijjim," a Korean braised short rib dish. On a white, round plate, there are tender-looking pieces of meat in a dark brown color. Accompanying the meat are round slices of carrots and round, off-white items that could be sliced roots, such as daikon radish or potatoes.

The illustration depicts a bowl of "galbitang," a Korean soup made with beef short ribs. The bowl is a classic, deep, round dish, typically made of ceramic or stoneware, in a dark gray color. Inside the bowl, there are pieces of meat that represent the beef short ribs, along with a visible sliced piece that looks like radish or some root vegetable. The coloring of the food shows yellowish and reddish tints, suggestive of cooked meat and vegetables.

Three long, cylindrical rice cakes, known as "garaetteok" in Korean, arranged neatly on a square plate or tray. The rice cakes are a pale beige color, suggesting they are made from non-glutinous rice.
The illustration depicts a bulb of garlic with one of its cloves separated and placed in front. The garlic is stylized with minimal detail, using soft, earthy tones to represent the papery skin.

Two stylized ginger roots on a plain background. The larger piece on the left has an elongated and bent shape, while the smaller piece to the right is a typical, lumpy knob of ginger. Both pieces are colored in shades of tan and brown.

A stylized human hand with the palm facing up and the fingers slightly curved. Above the hand is a speech bubble containing a red circle, an orange triangle, and a blue square. There are also dashed lines around these shapes in the speech bubble.

The illustration features a person holding up two bottles of sauce, one red and one yellow, with a small bowl containing a red sauce near the bottom left side. The bottles are labeled with horizontal lines suggesting text but no specific words are depicted. The phrase "소스주세요" meaning "Please give me the sauce" is included.

Two stylized figures standing opposite each other. The figure on the left is gray, while the figure on the right is green and blue. The figure on the right is holding a gift wrapped with a ribbon. A red arrow points from the left figure to the right figure, indicating a gift exchange. The Korean term "선물해요" is also included in the image.

A red chili pepper above a spoon with a dollop of red paste on it. A red arrow pointing downward from the pepper to the paste, indicating a transformation or progression from one item to the other. The image might represent the process of making gochujang, a Korean red chili paste, from red chili peppers.

A simplified and stylized image of a spiral-shaped object, likely representative of a rolled or coiled food item, such as Korean "gopchang". The colors are shades of pink and brown, suggestive of cooked meat, set against a plain, white background. It's suitable for a visual aid or icon in a food-related context.

The illustration shows a whole, round pizza with a golden crust, topped with ingredients including cheese, pieces of ham or pepperoni, olives, and possibly pineapple chunks. The pizza is pre-sliced into equal wedge-shaped portions, ready to be served. The background of the illustration is white.

An illustration of two hands with visible sleeves gripping opposite ends of a cylindrical object, signifying the action of holding or picking up. The object could represent a roll or a piece of food that requires both hands to handle. The background is plain and white.

The illustration shows a jar with a purple label and a depiction of a cluster of purple grapes with a green leaf on the label. The jar appears to be a container for grape jam or jelly, known as "포도잼" in Korean, which translates to "grape jam." The jar has a white lid. The overall design is simple and cartoonish.

The illustration shows a carton or box with an image of a bunch of grapes on it, suggesting it's a package for grape juice. The carton is light beige or cream color with a brown top and bottom. A purple bunch of grapes is depicted hanging from a brown stem. The Korean text "포도주스" meaning "grape juice" is also present.

An illustration depicts a bunch of purple grapes, tightly clustered together and attached to a brown stem. The overall shape of the bunch is somewhat ovular, tapering slightly toward the top. The word "포도" is also mentioned, which refers to "grapes" in Korean.

The illustration depicts a yellow chunk of Swiss-like cheese at the top and a red arrow pointing downward towards a pile of yellow dots, representing grated cheese. The image visually translates the Korean term "치즈가루," meaning "cheese powder" or "grated cheese."

Two green chili peppers with slight curves and rounded tips. They appear shiny, with visible stem segments at their tops. Each chili has a few lines indicating contours. A bunch of green grapes attached to a brown stem with two green leaves. The grapes are depicted in a cluster formation. The image has a cartoon-like style and uses flat colors without shading.

An illustration of a bunch of green onions, also known as scallions. It features several long green stalks with white bulbs at the bottom. The drawing is presented in a cartoonish style with outlined details.

A group of six green plums closely clustered together. The plums have a smooth, shiny appearance and a uniform green color with a small dark dot that represents the stem attachment point. The background is plain and white.

A white ceramic cup with a handle, filled with a green liquid that represents tea. There is a single green leaf floating on the surface of the tea. The cup is placed on a matching white saucer. The image could symbolize green tea or matcha tea, referred to as "녹차" (nokcha) in Korean.

A stylized illustration showing a grilled or barbecued meat garnished with green onion strips on a grill or pan. The food item has grill marks and red specks indicating spices or seasoning. Smoke is rising from the food, suggesting that it is freshly cooked and still hot. Below the food, there are three flame icons in yellow and red, representing heat or spiciness.

A cooked fish on a plate, presented whole, with golden-brown grilled or roasted skin. There are three diagonal cuts made on the side of the fish. Accompanying the fish is a wedge of lemon. The plate appears to be simple and white. This image symbolizes "생선구이" which translates to "grilled fish" in Korean and falls under the "Food" category.

A fish is being cooked in a shallow pan or pot that is placed on top of a red heat source, with heat waves or steam rising from it. The pan appears to be a traditional East Asian style of cookware. The fish is whole, with a yellowish color and black stripes, suggesting it could be a type of mackerel. The Korean word "구워요" which means "grilled" or "cooked" in the context of food, is also present.

An illustration featuring a contented person in a teal shirt, a pair of silver chopsticks, a spoon, a red question mark, and a sign with Korean text "점심" which translates to "lunch". The background of the image is plain white.

An illustration of a traditional Korean dish 된장찌개 (doenjang jjigae) or soybean paste stew. The image shows a brown earthenware bowl containing a reddish-brown stew with tofu, a green leafy vegetable, mushrooms, and possible pieces of meat or other vegetables.

An orange-yellow colored fruit with a characteristic bulging shape and a small green stem at the top. It has a slightly irregular surface. Three oval-shaped, light brown pastries with a textured surface, placed on a white plate with a gray shadow beneath. The pastries are of a uniform size and coloration and are arranged side by side. The image is a stylized representation of Korean sweets known as "한과" (hangwa).

The image depicts a two-section food container. The left side contains white rice, and the right side features three pieces of brown-colored food, possibly meat or fried items. The item is enclosed in a rectangular, yellow box. It's a simple, stylized illustration with bold outlines and limited detail.

A simplified, stylized illustration of a pink popsicle with a bite taken out of the top, revealing its white interior. The popsicle is mounted on a standard wooden stick and the overall shape of the bitten popsicle resembles the consonant "하" (ha) in the Korean alphabet, Hangul.

The illustration shows a glass filled with a yellow-colored liquid on the left, and on the right there is a character illustration of a smiling person with a simple facial expression, wearing a teal-colored shirt. The person is holding up their right index finger.

The image depicts a group of hazelnuts, with some still in their smooth brown shells and one that is cracked open, revealing the nut inside. The nuts vary in size and are gathered closely together against a white background.

The illustration shows two round, peach-like fruits. One of the fruits is whole with a visible seam and a shiny reddish skin with a touch of yellow. A clear glass cup filled with a vibrant green liquid, likely representing herbal tea or "herb tea". There is a light reflection on the surface of the cup. The illustration shows three slices of "호박전" (Hobakjeon), which is a Korean-style zucchini or squash pancake. name_en: Hoe Deopbap (Rice with Raw Fish Salad)
description_brief: A bowl of mixed salad made up of various leafy greens, shredded purple cabbage, thinly sliced pickled ginger and a sprinkle of orange fish roe. The salad is presented in a white spherical bowl, placed against a white background.

The illustration shows a glass jar of honey with a white lid and a yellow label with a honeycomb design, and a yellow handle for easy pouring. There is also a caricatured bee hovering close to the jar, implying its role in honey production. The image represents honey ("꿀" in Korean) and fits within the "Food" category.

A collection of Korean rice cake treats known as "tteok" (떡) in various colors: yellow, green, pink, white, and brown. The rice cakes are glossy and shaped into rounded, bite-sized pieces, arranged randomly against a plain white background. Each color likely represents a different flavor or variation of the rice cakes.

The illustration depicts two pieces of sliced food that resemble an oval shape with a white outer layer and a brown filling. This might be an abstract or simplified representation of Korean "호빵" (hopang), a type of filled bun, typically with a sweet red bean paste filling.

The illustration depicts a corn dog, with a golden-brown crispy coating with the stick protruding from the bottom, decorated with a zigzag line of red sauce across the top. The background is plain white.

A brown pot with steam or smoke coming out of it, indicating it is hot. There is a thermometer inserted into the pot, with the needle indicating a specific temperature range. The pot's rim shows two distinct layers, possibly indicating a lid or a double-layer structure. The pot's contents are not visible. The illustration symbolizes cooking, boiling food, or temperature control in food preparation.

A drawing of a hot sauce bottle featured in red color with a white label in the middle and a green cap on the left. On the right is a drawing of a red chili pepper. The two images are separated by a plus sign, signifying the addition of spicy heat to food.

A bottle of red sauce with a white label featuring a red chili pepper illustration is placed next to a small bowl filled with the same red sauce. The bottle is capped with a red lid. The sauce in the bowl has a smooth texture and a vibrant red color. The bowl is resting on a surface to the left of the bottle. It has a clean, cartoon-like style.
A cartoon-style illustration of a golden brown stack of pancakes with a piece cut out and melting yellow butter on top.

The illustration depicts a stack of five circular, beige-colored items resembling a type of Asian-style pancake. One of these items is placed separately in front, with steam lines rising from it, suggesting that it is freshly cooked and hot. The items showcase a smooth texture and have a slight golden brown filling visible on the top surface.

An illustration of a person with a cheerful expression wearing a chef's hat, dressed in a plain shirt. There is a red question mark top right of the character, possibly indicating a questioning or inquiry within a food-related setting.

A cartoon of a happy boy with spiky hair, smiling with closed eyes as if satisfied. He is holding an empty bowl with one hand, and a wisp of steam is rising from it, suggesting that he has finished eating something hot. His expression and the empty bowl convey the message that he enjoyed his meal and that he has eaten everything, which corresponds to the Korean phrase "다먹었어요," meaning "I ate it all" or "I have finished eating."

An illustration displays two separate images. On the left, a plate with a red cross mark over it indicating prohibition or the inability to eat something. On the right, a stylized representation of a person touching their chin with their hand, which may convey thoughtfulness or hesitation. Together these images denote the phrase "I can't eat that" and pertain to food and dietary restrictions or preferences.

A simple, round face with a white center and a black border. The eyes are two black dots with downturned, curved lines above them, and the mouth is a downward curved line. There are several small, orange dots on the cheeks representing a rash or allergic reaction. The overall illustration suggests that the subject is feeling unwell and symbolizes an allergy warning.

The illustration depicts a character in a chef's hat making an 'OK' hand gesture while wearing a white shirt. Next to this character there is the text "OK" in red capital letters. The chef's attire suggests culinary approval or readiness.

A cartoon character of a smiling young boy with short, spiky hair is holding a book or menu under his arm. There is a red plus sign to the right, and a dashed circle around the boy's mouth suggesting talking. Next to it is a Korean phrase "더먹고싶어요", which translates to "I want to eat more".

name_en: I want to eat something else
description_brief: The illustration features a mouth with a spoon containing a round food item, possibly a meatball. Above the spoon and mouth, there's a speech bubble containing a crossed-out circle linked with an arrow to a triangle. A Korean text "다른거먹고싶어요," which translates to "I want to eat something else," is provided.

name_en: I want to sit for a meal
description_brief: A simplified, cartoon-like image of a cheerful person seated at a table, wearing a long-sleeve green shirt and blue pants. To the right of the person is a circle containing a battery icon with a red low-charge indication. The Korean text "흡연석에앉고싶어요," translates to "I want to sit at a meal" or "I want to eat."

name_en: I want to sit in the non-smoking section
description_brief: A cartoon-style illustration of a person sitting at a table, smiling, with their hands resting on the table, wearing a green shirt and blue pants. Next to them, there's a circular "No Smoking" symbol. The image could imply a smoke-free dining area.

A simplified and stylized cartoon of a content person wearing a blue shirt with crossed arms in front of a large white bowl that is placed on a surface. This image symbolizes hunger, eating, or being ready to eat referencing the Korean word "배부르다" which means "to be full" or "satiated after eating".

A cartoon of a smiling child's face with brown hair and one cheek puffed out as if the child is sucking on something. Above the child's head, there are two illustrated candies, one is wrapped with a yellow and blue wrapping, and the other is unwrapped and pink. The illustration gives the impression of a child enjoying sweets.

A cartoon-style image of a person's head with a simple facial expression and a tongue sticking out slightly. Above the person's head is a thought bubble containing an image of a glass filled with an orange-colored liquid. The image is associated with the Korean phrase "목말라요" (mokmallayo), meaning "I'm thirsty".

A person with short hair and a neutral facial expression, wearing a teal-colored top. Above the person's head is a plate containing food, appearing to be a salad or dish with green leafy vegetables and red slices that could be meat or tomatoes.

An illustration of an ice cream popsicle with a pink-colored rectangular ice cream portion on a light brown stick. It has a flat, rounded top with straight sides and is set against a white background.

An illustration depicts a cake with a slice taken out, decorated with pink toppings, and an ice cream cone with a single scoop of pink ice cream. The two items are separated by a plus sign, suggesting a combination.

A glass containing a translucent orange beverage with two visible ice cubes and a black straw. On the rim of the glass, there is a slice of yellow citrus fruit, presumably a lemon. The image represents an iced drink, possibly iced tea or a citrus-infused water.

A clear glass filled with several ice cubes partially covered by water. The illustration represents cold water or a cold drink with ice. The concept corresponds to "얼음물" (eoreummul), meaning "iced water" in Korean.

An illustration depicts a plate with two orange spherical objects which resemble oranges or some other citrus fruits, with one of them only partially shown. The plate is in a simple, flat style with a light grey color and a slightly darker grey outline. The Korean text "부족해요" (bujokhaeyo), meaning "It's insufficient" or "I need more", is also present in the image.

name_en: Is there a table where you can eat in a wheelchair?
description_brief: The illustration features four main elements: a symbol of a wheelchair, an image of a table, a person with short hair wearing a teal shirt pointing upwards, and a large red question mark above this figure. The images are set against a plain white background.

A simplified, cartoonish face with a discontented expression, features a rounded shape with a pale complexion and black hair with a straight cut across the forehead. The eyebrows are arched downwards indicating a frown, the eyes are simple black lines, slanting downwards. The mouth is turned downward in a frown, and the tongue is sticking out slightly, colored pink. This image might be used to represent a negative reaction to food, aligning with the phrase "맛없어요" which, in Korean, means "It's not delicious" or "It doesn't taste good."

A cartoon character of a young person with a surprised expression holding an empty glass as if they have just finished drinking. The character's hair is brown and styled upward in the front and wearing a white t-shirt with a small blue detail that looks like a pocket on the left side of the chest. There are three lines emanating from the character's head indicating sudden realization or surprise. The character seems to be looking inside the empty glass. This image aligns with the word "흘렸어요" which means "spilled" in Korean.

A stylized cartoon character with a simple human face, black hair, dot-like eyes, and a small curved mouth. There are small triangles around mouth representing crumbs or a beard. The character is wearing a teal or greenish-blue shirt and biting into a piece of fried chicken. The keyword "바삭해요" in Korean is also present, meaning "crispy".

A stylized cartoon face of a person with a pleased expression and a smile showing a single, red tongue. The character has brown hair, round ears, and rosy cheeks. The image is associated with a positive reaction to food, corresponding to the Korean expression "맛있어요" (masisseoyo), which means "It's delicious."

A stylized round face with closed eyes and a straight, closed mouth that appears to be in a state of calm or satisfaction. The face has black hair. To the right of the face, there is a simple drawing of an open food item, possibly a dumpling, with three lines extending from it to indicate an aroma or heat. The image represents a sense of contentment or pleasure from eating.

A cartoon-style depiction of a person with a distressed expression, sweat on the forehead, and a flushed complexion. Next to the person is an image of a steaming hot cup of a beverage. This image symbolizes the Korean onomatopoeic expression "뜨거워요" (tteugeowoyo), which translates to "It's hot" in English.

A simple line drawing of a cube that appears to be melting or spilling its contents. The Korean phrase "농았어요" is associated with the cube, suggesting that it represents something food-related that melts or spills. The illustration uses a single color for the cube and spill, with a white background.

A cartoon-style image of a person's face with a surprised or shocked expression, mouth open in an "O" shape. Next to the face are two red chili peppers, symbolizing the Korean word "매워요" (maewoyo) which translates to "It's spicy". The image likely represents the sensation of eating something very spicy.

A bowl of spaghetti with red sauce resting on top of a brown table with sky blue paneling in the front. A silver spoon is inserted into the pasta, twirling some of the noodles around it. On the paneling, there is an icon resembling a spoon or a fork in a darker shade of blue. The text "이탈리안레스토랑", which translates to Italian restaurant from Korean is also present.

A graphic of a jar symbolizing a food item, likely a preserve or condiment. The jar is in yellow and brown tones, indicating it could be filled with honey or jam. It has a white lid with a draped white cloth tied around the neck, giving it a traditional or homemade appearance. The background is plain.

Illustration of a bowl of "Janchi Guksu," a Korean noodle dish. The bowl contains thin, wheat-based noodles in a clear broth, topped with thinly sliced cucumbers, carrots, dark green seaweed, and green onions.

A white plate with several pieces of a food item that resembles Korean Jangjorim. The pieces are beef slices and half sections of hard-boiled eggs. The beef slices are reddish-brown and feature striations suggestive of meat fibers. The eggs have a pale yellow yolk in the center with an off-white egg white surrounding it.

An illustration of a plate of noodles mixed with various vegetables such as green slices and orange circles. Chopsticks hold a section of the noodles. The plate is white, the noodles have a brownish color, and the chopsticks are a light tan or wooden color.

A graphic illustration showing a plate of food that appears to be a serving of "Japchae" alongside rice. The Japchae portion appears to be shiny brownish noodles, possibly coated with a sauce, intertwined with what could be slices of vegetables and perhaps strips of meat or mushrooms. There are leafy greens on the side of the plate. The rice is fluffy and white, garnished perhaps with sesame seeds or minced garlic. The plate itself is simple and white.

The cheese slices are in a fan-like arrangement and depicted with a slightly shiny texture, suggesting a soft or semi-soft consistency. There is a light shadow under the plate, giving a three-dimensional effect on a plain white background.

The illustration depicts two green, rectangular items with a series of parallel ridges and a folded end, resembling traditional Korean bamboo salt shakers known as "절편" or "jeolpyeon". There is a slight shadow effect to suggest dimensionality.

An illustration shows a white bowl containing "jjamppong" (짬뽕), a Korean spicy seafood noodle soup. The bowl contains a mixture of noodles, several pieces of seafood that could be shrimp or squid, vegetables, such as slices of mushrooms and green peas or beans, with a few dark, rectangular pieces that could be seaweed on top of the other ingredients. The soup's broth is reddish-orange.

An illustration of a bowl of noodle soup with a reddish-orange broth. The soup includes ingredients such as sliced mushrooms and green onions, served in a white bowl that is usually associated with Asian-style noodle dishes. The broth's color may suggest a robust and possibly spicy flavor.

The illustration depicts a traditional Korean dish, "jjigae" which is a stew. name_en: Need to Buy Ingredients at the Mart
description_brief: An illustration of a person with a shopping basket filled with food items - a fish and green vegetables. The person is smiling and pointing upwards with their right hand. The image conveys the concept of grocery shopping or buying ingredients at a supermarket.

The Nestlé brand name is visible at the top with the Nesquik logo featuring the Nesquik bunny character stirring a glass of chocolate milk with colorful Nesquik cereal balls bouncing into the glass. Korean characters are on the packaging, with a '400g' mark suggesting the content weight, and additional graphics and text likely providing product and nutritional information.

Directly below, connected by a red arrow, is a dashed outline of a gray circle. This symbolizes the replacement of the old with the new, indicating a new item on a menu or a product release.

A hand with the palm facing down and fingers together over a grey dotted circular background. There is a bold red “X” mark over the hand, indicating prohibition, associated with "no need" or "unnecessary" in the context of food. The Korean phrase "필요없어요" is also present, which translates to "not needed."

An illustration depicts a bowl of food which appears to be a Korean dish, "누룽지탕". The dish features scorched rice (누룽지) crispy rice pieces on top, slices of what could be meat or vegetable garnishes, and perhaps food submerged within that are not visible. The bowl itself is simple and white with a grey outline. The overall style of the illustration is cartoonish with clean lines and minimal shading.

The illustration includes two stylized cartoon octopuses; a light beige or pink one on the left, and a darker pink or reddish one on the right. Both are facing the viewer, with their heads centrally positioned and tentacles fanning out around their bodies. Their heads have visible shiny spots, and the tentacles seem to suggest motion or flexibility.

The octopus has two circular, simplistic eyes with yellow irises and black pupils, giving it a friendly or playful appearance. The image has a thick black outline around the octopus.

"낙지" is the Korean word for "octopus."
