The illustration depicts a slice of pizza with a plus sign above it, followed by a pair of differently colored leaves or toppings, one in orange and the other in green. The pizza slice has a visible crust, cheese, and a couple of oval-shaped slices as toppings. This image symbolically suggests adding extra toppings to a pizza slice.

A stylized illustration of a red, circular plate with a pair of chopsticks resting on top of it. The chopsticks are positioned at an oblique angle, with the tips pointing towards the center of the plate, which is indicated by a dashed circle. This illustration represents dining or food-related activity.

A drawing of a blender on the left side and images of a piece of cheese, a tomato, and an orange on the right side, arranged from left to right. There's a plus sign between the blender and the food items, indicating that these items are to be combined or added together.

An image shows a hot bowl of soup with several red-orange pieces floating in it and a spoon inside. There are three wavy lines above the bowl representing steam, and below are three yellow and red flame icons, symbolizing that the soup is cooked or heated.

A beige kettle with a turquoise lid and a black knob on top. Below the kettle, there are three simple flame icons, each consisting of an outer red flame shape and an inner yellow shape. The image could symbolize the process of boiling water or cooking, which connects to the Korean phrase "끓여주세요" (kkeul-yeo-juseyo), meaning "please boil it".

name_en: Please Clean Up The Fish Bones
description_brief: An illustration depicts a fish bone head on the left and tail on the right with two chopsticks positioned diagonally on top of it. Above the tail of the fishbone, there is a red curved arrow pointing upwards and to the right. The image also includes the Korean phrase "가시배주세요," which translates to "Please get rid of the fish bones" or "Please clean up the fish bones."

A person with a smiling face, wearing a teal shirt, is pointing upwards at a wooden tray with two bowls. One bowl is empty and tipped over, and the other has a utensil inside it. A curved red arrow points from the tipped-over bowl to the upright bowl, implying the action of moving something from one bowl to the other. The theme suggests the phrase "Please clear this up" in the context of food or dining.

A top view of a plate with food, overlaid by a crossed fork and knife. The plate appears to have a simple design. Abstract shapes suggesting food items, possibly including slices or chunks of food, with some small dots that may represent sauce or small food particles are present. The utensils are in the 'finished eating' position. The food items are depicted in orange and the utensils and plate in gray tones against a white background.

A round pizza with various toppings on the left side, and a simplified cartoon character with a neutral expression, giving a thumbs-up gesture on the right side. This person is wearing a teal-colored shirt and has short hair. There is a red arrow pointing from the pizza to the person, indicating the direction of delivery or transfer. The overall image suggests the concept of pizza delivery.

A stylized red scooter or moped from a side view. At the back, there's a space that represents a delivery box. A dashed circular line is drawn near the front, suggesting motion. The Korean text "빨리가져다주세요," translates to "Please deliver it quickly." This image suggests the concept of fast delivery.

A caricature of a person's face with two dots for eyes, a linear mouth, and short black hair is eating a piece of red food, possibly meat, with a bite taken out of it using two brown chopsticks. The background is plain white. The image may be signaling the act of eating or dining.

An illustration depicts two stylized figures. One on the left appears to be eating from a bowl, with puffs of aroma drifting from it. The other figure on the right is extending their arm towards the person eating, suggesting a recommendation or an offer. The figures lack detailed facial features, with simple circular heads and dots for eyes, drawing focus to the act of eating and offering food. The overall imagery appears to encourage eating.
A hand with fingers pinched together, picking up some thin, string-like items which appear to be some sort of food, possibly noodles or vegetables, from a plain white bowl.

A stylized image of an open menu with the word "Coffee" written on the left page along with a list of items with prices ranging from 4.5 to 8.5. The right page has the word "MENU" with a list of prices—8.5, 9.5, 7.5—and lines suggesting text for each price. A red question mark is present in the lower right corner, separating the open menu from the background.

A simple, stylized figure of a person with a round head and a broad smile, black dot eyes, wearing a teal top with long sleeves and blue pants. The person's arms are crossed in front with hands tucked into a brown belt or waistband. The image has a cartoon-like aesthetic.

A cartoon-style fish, oriented left to right and appearing whole and uncooked, with a series of small markings or spots along its body. It has a visible eye, mouth, and fins. Resting on top of the fish is a cleaver or large kitchen knife with a brownish handle and a silver blade, suggesting the preparation of food.

A stylized human figure with a smiling face, raising their right hand to catch or release a coin into a tipping jar or cup. Above the hand is a floating bottle with wine spilling out. The bottle is tipped over as if to pour into the tipping jar, suggesting a bar or restaurant setting. The image represents the act of giving a tip for good service. It connects to the Korean phrase "잘라주세요" ("jalrajuseyo") which in this context might be a play on words for giving a tip in the food service industry.

A stylized human figure with a neutral expression. Above the figure's head is a speech bubble containing an image of a hand making a pinching motion with the thumb and index finger close together. There is a red arrow pointing upwards within the speech bubble, starting at the fingertips. This visual represents the Korean phrase "조금만 주세요," which translates to "Please give me a little."

A stylized cartoon face with a neutral expression. Above the head is a speech bubble that contains an image of a bowl filled with round, green items, which could represent food like grapes or some other kind of fruit. The text "많이주세요" translates to "Please give me a lot" or "Please give more" in English.

An illustration of a pair of yellow chopsticks resting together with one chopstick crossed over the other, forming a narrow 'V' or an inverted 'A' shape. These chopsticks are contained within the outline of a speech bubble.

A stylized speech bubble encases a simple, illustrated piece of ice or an ice cube at its center. The ice cube is shaded with a light blue color and drawn with basic lines. The speech bubble has a dashed line forming a circular boundary around the ice cube. This icon suggests a conversation or a request involving ice in a food or beverage context.

The illustration presents a pair of cupped hands facing upwards, one on each side, with a red plus sign between them. The hands are drawn in a simplistic style with visible lines for fingers and thumbs. The overall image suggests an addition or offering.

A speech bubble in the shape of a comic book conversation symbol contains a graphical representation of a steaming mug, likely indicating a hot beverage like coffee or tea. This is likely a request for something warm or a beverage. The theme aligns with the "Food" category and the Korean phrase "따뜻한거주세요" suggests asking for a hot drink.

A stylized figure of a person with a smiling face, a round head, and a visible upper body. The person has a short, straight haircut, is wearing a long-sleeved green shirt, and is pointing upwards with the index finger. To the left of the figure, there are three cube-like shapes arranged in a way that resembles sugar cubes. The phrase "설탕주세요" (please give me sugar) is in Korean.

A speech bubble contains an image of a menu, which appears as a simple rectangle with a binding on the left side, like a booklet. On the cover of the menu, "메뉴판" is written in Korean, translating to "menu" in English.

A simplistic cartoon character with a neutral or slightly displeased expression. Above and to the right of the character's head is a speech bubble containing the image of a glass filled with water, suggesting that the character is asking for water. The term "물주세요" in Korean translates to "Please give me water."

name_en: Please hand me the menu flyer
description_brief: A speech bubble containing an image symbolizing a menu or a booklet with the Korean text "전단지" on the cover, which translates to "leaflet" or "flyer". The speech bubble indicates that the leaflet or flyer is the subject of conversation or focus. The entire image is a black and white line drawing.

An illustration depicts a microwave oven with its door open. Inside the microwave, there's a bowl that appears to contain food. A red arrow is pointing towards the bowl, indicating the action of placing it in the microwave. The microwave is shown in a three-dimensional perspective with a control panel on the right side.

A smiling person with a raised hand, pointing upwards. Next to the person is an image of a rice cooker with a visible control button. Inside the rice cooker is white rice, and on top is a wooden scoop partially submerged in the rice.
A simple drawing of a beige and blue packet with a jagged top edge, as if torn open. Inside the packet, a blue substance appears to be spilling out, with several blue droplets falling downwards.

A cartoon-like illustration of a woman with black hair and a smile. She is wearing a pink top, a long purple skirt, and a pale yellow apron. She is holding a white bowl in her left hand and a mixing spoon in her right hand, appearing to be preparing food.

A simple black and white image consisting of a crossed-out chili pepper. A diagonally placed pepper is partially overlapped by two thick lines forming an "X" shape, which typically suggests a request for food without spice or indicates that the food is not spicy.

An illustration features a bowl of soup or sauce on a stovetop with flames underneath. Above the bowl, a bottle with a depiction of a chili pepper and some green leaves is shown tilted, suggesting its contents are being poured into the bowl. The image corresponds with the Korean phrase "튀겨주세요," meaning "Please make it spicy".

The illustration depicts two bowls of different sizes, a small plate, and a set of chopsticks next to a spoon. Above the tableware, there is a curved red arrow pointing from the larger bowl to the smaller bowl, suggesting the action of moving something from one bowl to another.

A cylindrical object with a dotted circle above it, indicating motion or removal. A red upwards arrow is between the dotted circle and the cylindrical object. This visual is typically associated with a lid being removed from a container.

A green bottle, likely a soda or beer bottle, with a metal cap is depicted alongside a bottle opener with a wooden handle and metal head. The overall design is simple and cartoonish with a white background. The image might represent "따주세요" (ttajuseyo), which means "please open [the bottle]" in Korean.

A cartoon-style image composed of two main elements. On the top half, there is an image of a pizza with various toppings such as herbs or spinach, pepperoni or tomato, and green pepper or olives on melted cheese. The pizza is placed on a wooden-like surface.   In the lower half, there is a cartoon character with a minimalist smiling face and a tuft of hair, wearing a long-sleeved teal shirt and pointing upwards towards the pizza.

A stylized person with a simple smiling face, wearing a teal shirt, with their left arm raised and pointing upwards. Above the person's raised finger is an image of a whole fried chicken with a crispy golden-brown crust, served in an open box with green leafy garnish on the side. The illustration can be interpreted as a request for chicken.

name_en: Please Pass the Gochujang (Red Chili Paste)
description_brief: An illustration depicts a bowl of red sauce on the left side, possibly Gochujang, a Korean red chili paste. On the right, there's a drawing of a person with a smiley face, raising their right hand upwards, with short hair and a green long-sleeved top. The background is plain white.

A red bottle with a white label in the center and a black cap on top is depicted. There's a green neck label right below the cap. The bottle is accompanied by a red plus sign to the left, suggesting the addition of this item. This symbol is commonly associated with ketchup in the context of food.

name_en: Please Pass the Ssamjang (Korean BBQ Sauce)
description_brief: An illustration featuring two elements. On the left side, a plate of food with a red or brown sauce over it. On the right side, a happy cartoon character raising their right arm.

The illustration depicts two bowls on a tray, one of which is smaller than the other, with a spoon resting in the larger one. A bold red arrow curves from left to right, suggesting movement or passing the bowls. The color palette includes browns, red, white, and black for outlining.

A green vending machine with a glass front displays a selection of colorful beverage cans. Five cans are visible, each with a different color label (orange, green, red, blue, and yellow). A symbol representing a coin being inserted into a coin slot is displayed next to the vending machine, suggesting the operation process of purchasing a drink.

A simplified drawing of a pounding motion. A brown cylindrical object, likely a pestle, is at an angle over a grey rounded shape, symbolizing a mortar. An arrow pointing downwards towards the mortar indicates the direction of the pounding action, and a dotted line above the pestle suggests its upward movement path. The image conveys a repetitive action typically associated with grinding or crushing food ingredients.
An illustration showing one light blue cup being tilted and pouring an orange liquid into another cup. The drawing has a minimalist style with no detailed patterns or textures.

A hand holding a glass filled with blue liquid, tilted slightly towards an empty dashed-outline of a glass, suggesting the act of pouring. The background is white. The graphics use mainly blue for the liquid, grey for the hand, and black outlines for the glasses.

An old-fashioned rotary telephone with the handset on top is illustrated. Below the phone, there are three sets of question marks in a phone number format: "???-????-????. This symbol represents the concept of calling a restaurant or food service to inquire or place an order.

name_en: Please pull up a chair to the table.
description_brief: Two chairs on either side of a small table, with curved arrows above each chair indicating movement. The chairs and the table are yellow, and the arrows are red. All elements are outlined in black against a white background.

An illustration shows a simplified representation with a cylindrical shape at the bottom and a yellow dotted circular shape above it, separated by a red arrow pointing downwards. The arrow indicates a downward motion from the dotted circle into the cylinder. This symbol could indicate "put in" or "drop." The image is accompanied by the Korean phrase "넣어주세요" (please put in/drop/add).

name_en: Please put it in another container
description_brief: The illustration shows a simplified visual concept related to food sharing. On the left, a cup or glass contains two round objects suggesting cookies or buns. In the center, a red arrow points right. On the right side, a pair of chopsticks is picking up one round object, now positioned above a yellow bowl. The image could symbolize moving food from a personal container to a shared dish.

A stylized image of a yellow and orange megaphone pointing to the right with sound lines emanating from it, attached to a document resembling an open pamphlet or menu with rectangular shapes on both pages. The image symbolizes an announcement or attention directed towards the contents of the document, aligning with the Korean phrase "메뉴좀크게읽어주세요", which translates to "Please read the menu out loud".

A hand holding a can with the thumb and fingers wrapped around it. To the right of the can and slightly above, there's an arrow pointing towards an outlined, dotted rectangle. This seems to represent space where the can could be placed down or where another object could be located.

The illustration depicts a glass filled with a blue liquid and an ice tongs holding a single ice cube above the glass. A red curved arrow points from the ice tongs towards the glass. The Korean phrase "얼음빼주세요" is associated with the image, translating to "Please remove the ice" in English.
A tilted salt shaker colored blue, with salt grains spilling out from its open, dark-shaded top, suggesting a sprinkling action. The background is plain.

A cartoon-style image of a person with a cheerful expression pointing to a pot. Inside the pot, there are three eggs with distressed expressions, suggesting that they are being boiled. The pot is giving off steam, indicating that it is hot. The person is depicted in a side profile, with the arm extended toward the pot, and wearing a teal-colored shirt.

A coconut with the top part cut off to reveal the white flesh, indicated to be fresh by the presence of a green leaf. A small gray metallic spoon with a black handle is inserted into the coconut. The coconut has a brown husk with a textured detail suggesting its rough surface.

A simple line drawing of a cooking pot with two handles, presumably containing soup or some kind of liquid food. Above the pot, a salt shaker is tilted, suggesting that salt is being sprinkled into the pot. The image symbolizes the concept of seasoning, specifically adding salt.

The illustration depicts two canned beverages—one red and one green—and a carton with a citrus fruit design. A red curved arrow points downwards from the carton towards a shopping cart, indicating the motion of placing the item in the cart. The shopping cart is drawn in a simple style with metal lines and red elements on the wheels. The image is associated with grocery shopping, specifically selecting drinks.

A cartoon-style image of a person with a smiling face and a raised arm pointing upwards. To the left, there is a bowl with a spoon above it, and the spoon appears to be ladling out some food with various elements. Above the spoon and bowl, there's a curved arrow indicating movement. The overall image conveys an action associated with serving or offering food.

Two bowls: one on the left with what appears to be rice or small round items piled up, and the other on the right containing less of the same items. Between the two bowls, there's a red directional arrow pointing from the left bowl to the right bowl. Above the bowls, there are two chopsticks picking up one of the round items and transferring it from the left bowl to the right bowl. This visual is likely representing the action of serving or transferring food, corresponding to the phrase "더러주세요," which can be translated from Korean as "Please give me some more" or "Please serve it."

A simple, cartoon-style drawing of a human face with a cheerful expression, two dots for eyes, and a curved line for a smiling mouth. Above the face, there's a speech bubble that contains an image of a bowl labeled with the Korean text "1인분," which translates to "one serving". The image suggests a visual aid for indicating a single serving size in the context of food.

An illustration shows two halves of a wrapped or rolled food item, possibly sushi, on two separate plates. A curved arrow points from one half to the other, implying the action of passing food from one plate to another. The food item has a pinkish interior, encased in white, and is topped with a red topping. The plates are situated on a wooden surface.

An open booklet or menu with two pages visible, each featuring a prominent question mark. The text "메뉴판" is at the top of the left page, translating to "menu." The outline of the booklet is dashed, suggesting it might represent a template or an icon. The illustration could symbolize a request to see a menu or an indication that a menu needs to be provided.

The illustration shows a knife with a silver blade and a black handle, slicing through a carrot. The carrot appears to be cut into several round, orange slices with detailed texture on the surface indicating its inner structure. The background is plain white.

A stylized illustration of a squeezable tube of sauce with its cap pointing downwards. A few drops of sauce are coming out of the tube. The tube is colored red, with a white label in the center that has a black border, with no visible text. The cap is colored dark green or black.
An illustration consists of an orange circle and a green triangle with two red arrows pointing from the circle to the triangle. The background is white.
A human hand holding a cookie or biscuit with a large red "X" symbol over it, indicating prohibition or "not allowed." The illustration suggests refraining from eating cookies or similar food items.

A stylized image of an opened snack or chip bag with two arrows, one pointing upwards and the other pointing downwards. The opened end of the bag is at the top, indicated with a red, dashed line suggesting it has been torn open. The arrows suggest the action of opening the bag by pulling the top apart. The bag is golden yellow, and the arrows are solid red. The image represents the action of "tearing it open," which matches the phrase "보기 뜯어주세요", likely meaning "please tear open here" in Korean.

A hand placing a plate with three stuffed rolls or baked goods inside an open microwave. The microwave's controls, including dials or buttons for setting the time or power level, are visible. The image has bold outlines, typical of vector-style graphics.

name_en: Please warm it up for me
description_brief: A smiling person with a raised hand is shown pressing a button with a speech bubble showing the word "ON" above it. To the left of the person is a microwave oven with its door closed, with a thought bubble showing an image of three baked goods or rolls. This symbolizes that food is being heated or cooked inside the microwave.

A stylized image includes an imagery representation of a red, plump tomato with a green leaf and a faucet sticking out of its top and a cartoon figure of a person in a long-sleeve green shirt pointing at the tomato, smiling. The background of the illustration is plain white.

An illustration depicts a brownish liquid spill and a rectangular napkin partially covering the spill. The napkin features a dotted cross mark, suggesting it is for clean up. The image represents the concept "Please wipe it up" in a food or dining context, suggesting a minor drink or sauce spillage.

A glass containing a green liquid with three green spheres, possibly representing plums, floating in the center. The glass is not filled to the brim. This symbol appears to represent "매실차" (maesilcha), which is Korean plum tea.

A brown bottle with a beige cork and a white label with scribble-like markings on it, paired with a stemmed glass containing a purple-hued liquid, suggestive of grape-based wine. The objects are outlined in black and have a white background.

A stylized illustration of three fish standing upright in a side-by-side configuration with simplistic features including prominent eyes with large yellow pupils, and lines indicating gills and fins. Their bodies are slender and taper down to small brown tails or feet.

Two pomegranates: one whole and one cut in half to reveal the clusters of red, juicy seeds inside. The pomegranates are stylized with solid colors and simple lines. The color scheme includes shades of red for the fruit and seeds, with outlines in a darker hue to define the shapes.

An image of a citrus fruit similar to an orange, featuring one whole fruit and two halves. The whole fruit has a stem with a small green leaf attached. The insides of the halved fruit reveal a red or pinkish flesh. The fruit's skin is a yellow-orange color. The fruit is presented on a plain white background.

The illustration shows a cartoon representation of a piece of raw pork (sogogi in Korean) placed on a plate. The pork is depicted as a bright pink slab with white marbled fat detailing. There is a stylized cartoon pig's face on top of the pork with a cheerful expression, potentially as a representational mascot for pork-based dishes or products related to pork. The pig has a round nose. The artwork overall has bold outlines and is colored with a simple yet vibrant palette.

A stylized pig with its body segmented into different sections representing various cuts of pork. One section at the rear is colored red, drawing attention to that particular cut. The image is often used in butchery or culinary contexts to denote the parts of a pig used for food.

A stylized pig divided into sections with lines, indicating the different cuts of meat. The pig is in profile, facing right. A prominent red section is visible on the upper part of the pig's body. The pig has a small, triangular ear, dot for an eye, and a simple snout. The lines dividing the pig into sections are reminiscent of a butcher's chart.

A simplified, cartoon-like illustration of a pig divided into different sections or cuts of meat as seen in butcher charts. One section, highlighted in red, represents the "등심" cut, which translates to the loin area, a premium cut of pork. The pig is depicted in a profile view, facing to the left with lines indicating the partition of the various cuts.

A simple cartoon-style image of a pig's face superimposed on top of several stylized pieces of pink and white striped meat, which represent bacon. These meat pieces are arranged on a white plate with a slight gray outline to suggest depth. The pig's face is front-facing with features like two ears, two eyes, a snout with nostrils, and no visible mouth.

A stylized representation of a pork cut chart pig in a simplistic, cartoon-like drawing. The pig is primarily in a light pink color with a white background, and the outline and division lines are in a darker, contrasting color. The diagram reference to different cuts of meat such as the loin, belly and leg, and a label "목살" the Korean for pork neck or collar, indicating a specific cut of meat.

A cartoon image of a pig's face and a grilled steak on a plate. The steak is marked with crisscross grill lines and is accompanied by a slab of butter on top. There is also a small amount of juice or steak sauce on the plate. The image represents pork steak or grilled pork, aligning with the Korean term "돼지갈비" (dwaeji galbi), translating to "pork ribs." The pig's face symbolizes the source of the meat.

The image shows a stylized illustration of a pig divided into different sections, with one section highlighted in red. This represents the specific part of the pig where "갈매기살" (galmaegisal), or "skirt meat", is located. The pig is depicted in a simplistic and cartoonish manner, with lines indicating the various cuts of pork. It appears to be a diagram used for educational or informative purposes.

A simplified, cartoon-like drawing of a side view of a pig. The pig is beige with outlines that divide it into sections, representing different cuts of meat. One of the sections on the pig's back is highlighted in red to emphasize a specific part.

A cartoon-style happy human face with a speech bubble above it. Inside the speech bubble, there are four simple icons of cups or glasses arranged in a two-by-two grid with the Korean text "4인분" above them, which translates to "portion for four people". The design includes minimal facial features and uses colors such as black, white, and a touch of pink for the mouth.

The illustration depicts a vegetable peeler. It features an elongated handle with a slight bulge toward the lower end, merging into a flat, broader head housing a horizontal blade with a slot in it. It is recognizable as a kitchen tool used for peeling vegetables and fruits.

The illustration shows two images with a red arrow pointing downwards from the top image to the bottom. The top image features two brown, speckled objects that resemble potatoes. The bottom image depicts a circular pizza with various toppings, cut into segments, with one slice slightly separated from the rest. This suggests the concept of potatoes being transformed into a pizza, correlating with the phrase "포테이토피자" (potato pizza).

A tilted brown bottle pouring some yellow substance into a glass, which already contains the same yellow substance. The glass is depicted in a simple, transparent style, while the bottle has a narrower neck, indicating it may be a sauce bottle. The design is minimalistic with bold outlines and flat colors.

A clear glass filled with a liquid, with more liquid being poured into the glass from a bottle, causing a splash. The bottle is tilted at an angle with its spout directed towards the glass, creating a dynamic, splashing effect. The style could represent water or another transparent beverage.

A simplified depiction of a beige teapot with a blue lid and a black handle, tilted and pouring water into a light blue glass. The teapot has several small black dots representing holes just at the beginning of its spout. There are a few water droplets falling from the spout into the glass.

A pudding with a smooth and creamy look. The bottom layer is pale yellow, suggesting a vanilla or custard flavor, and the top layer is darker brown, indicating a caramel or similar glaze. The pudding has a traditional dome-like shape with a slight wobble. It is presented against a plain, light background.

A stylized drawing of a fish with a plump, rounded body that's light brown with a white underbelly and darker brown spots scattered across the upper half. This fish has a large, circular, yellow eye with a black pupil, simple darker shade fins, a tail, and a small curved mouth. It represents a type of fish known as "복어" in Korean, which translates to "pufferfish" or "blowfish" in English.

An illustration of a pair of golden brown chopsticks resting on a white dish, positioned in a crossed manner. Two red, curved arrows point outward from where the chopsticks intersect, symbolizing the action of pulling apart or opening the chopsticks. The background is plain white. This symbol often indicates the action one would take before using chopsticks to eat.

An illustration of two mushrooms, one larger and one smaller. The larger one has a brown cap with a crisscross pattern, and lighter beige stalks. The smaller one is identical in color but lacks the pattern on its cap. Both mushrooms have a simple cartoonish style with a two-dimensional appearance and a light shadow beneath them, indicating they are lying on a surface.

A stylized depiction of a single beige bone-in meat or steak piece held by a silver or grey line-drawn fork. Surrounding the meat are two crescent-shaped lines on both sides, indicating sizzling or heat waves. The background is white and the word "질겨요" is present, which translates to "quality". The symbol may indicate high-quality food or a quality dining experience.

A clear glass bowl filled with a yellowish substance, possibly a liquid or puree. Next to the bowl, there is a single slice of a light yellow fruit, possibly an apple or pear. The slice is placed on the surface, partially overlapping the bowl's base.

An image of a dish served in a white, oval-shaped bowl. The dish appears to be "Rabokki" which consists of "tteokbokki" (rice cakes) and "ramyeon" (instant noodles), covered in a spicy, red, gochujang-based sauce with sesame seeds sprinkled on top. The dish has a glossy, saucy texture.

An illustration of a bowl of soup, which represents a Korean dish known as "무쇠고기국" (moo-sae-gogi-guk) or "radish beef soup." The bowl is white and contains a clear broth with Korean radish slices, cooked beef pieces, and green onion slices floating within.

Two pieces of "무지개떡," Korean rainbow rice cake, are neatly stacked in layers of different pastel colors representing the rainbow. The layers from top to bottom show a variation of colors: white, yellow, pink, and green. The texture appears to be soft and chewy. The white background emphasizes the colorful aspects of the food.

A cartoon-like face with a round head, wide open eyes, a small nose, and a circular mouth. Above the head, there's a red exclamation mark implying surprise, realization, or emphasis. The image has primarily black outlines for face features, red for exclamation mark, and a white background.

A pair of open hands holding a round gift with a blue ribbon tied in a bow on top. The gift is in a box with white wrapping paper and the ribbon is styled in a cross shape with a looped bow in the center. The image represents the concept of "received a gift" in a food category context.
The illustration shows two red persimmons, one whole with a green leafy cap, and the other sliced open beside it.

A simple, stylized drawing of a glass filled with a blue liquid with a large white ice cube inside it. There are two small blue droplets depicted above the glass. The illustration has thick black outlines and a cartoonish look, with a white background.

A stylized cartoon illustration of a cow, sections of its body delineated to possibly indicate different cuts of beef, with one section prominently shaded in red. The cow is positioned in profile, facing to the left.

A stylified illustration of a cow divided into sections that represent different cuts of beef. A red-colored section highlights a specific area of the cow, representing a cut known as "ribeye" in English and "갈매기살" in Korean. The rest of the cow is outlined in brown with beige coloring.

A grayscale illustration of a steaming bowl of rice. The bowl is rounded with a visible rim and base. The rice inside is indicated with small curved lines to mimic the texture of grains, it fills the bowl to near the top. Above the bowl, there are three wavy lines representing steam.

A simple, stylized drawing of a bowl with a clear broth, tteok, which are Korean rice cakes, having an oval shape, and a mandu, a Korean dumpling that appears to be partially submerged in the liquid. A black and white image of a spatula with a flat, rectangular head that has several vertical slits through it. The handle is long, narrowing towards the end and is colored black.

An illustration of a bowl of hot, steaming food, likely a noodle dish. A cartoon-style drawing of a cheerful boy with a tuft of hair sticking up, wearing a simple t-shirt, and smiling with rosy cheeks. The illustration has a stylized pair of open lips with the tongue visible, colored in shades of pink. Beneath the lips, there is an illustration of a white vanilla flower with a creamy or yellowish center and has five petals arranged around the center, along with a green leaf or part of the stem. An illustration features a head of Napa cabbage with white and light green leaves and leafy ridges, paired with a green, slightly bumpy cucumber, and a bunch of bok choy with vibrant green leaf blades and lighter green stems. An illustration of a primarily blue vending machine in a simplified, cartoon-like style. It features a glass front with multiple rows and columns displaying empty slots. A cartoon-style fish colored in shades of blue with yellow fin and tail accents depicted as if it is leaping or jumping out of a body of water. The illustration shows a bowl of noodle soup, which appears to be pho, a traditional Vietnamese dish. A simplified, cartoon-style image of a person sitting at a table with a plate and a cup in front of them. The person is smiling, wearing a teal shirt and blue pants, with their hands on the table. Three bright red apples with green leaves aligned horizontally. Above the apples, there is a silver water tap or faucet positioned as if it could drip or pour water onto the center apple. A simple illustration of a water bottle with a transparent body, light blue horizontal stripes representing water levels, a darker blue label in the center, and a gray cap indicating it's closed. It also has the Korean word for water, "물".

A plastic water bottle, which is transparent with a blue label or wrapper around its center. There is a cap on top that seems to be tightly closed. The bottle is unopened and has horizontal ridges on the body for grip and structural integrity.

The image is an illustration of several crescent-shaped dumplings with pleated edges on a plate. The dumplings appear to be steamed, as indicated by the smooth and somewhat shiny surface. The plate is depicted from a slightly elevated perspective with no additional background detail.

An illustration features two stylized watermelons. One is whole, with dark green stripes on a lighter background, a curly stem and a leaf. The other has a triangular slice cut out, revealing the red interior with black seeds and showing the green rind.

A kitchen scale with a round plate on top for weighing food items. The body of the scale is a light gray color, and the round dial face has markings for weight measurement. It has a classic analog design, with a needle pointing to the current weight.

A plate with a grilled steak covered in a brown sauce. To the side of the steak, there are a few vegetables depicted, which include sliced carrots and green peas or Brussels sprouts. The dish is presented in a simple, cartoonish style.

A stylized person wearing a chef's hat, holding up a fork and a spoon, with a smile on their face. The image encapsulates the concept of choosing a meal or an ingredient to cook with.

An illustration of two cups side by side. The cup on the left contains green tea with a leaf design on the surface, while the cup on the right contains a dark brown liquid, likely coffee, with two coffee beans visible on its surface. A simple representation of a calendar with the top part colored in red, simulating the look of a classic wall calendar. A simplified graphic of a wheelchair placed next to a dining table with four plates. Above the wheelchair and table is a red question mark. The image seems to relate to the accessibility of dining facilities for individuals who use wheelchairs.

A cartoon character, appearing to be a chef with a white chef's hat, smiling and pointing to an empty plate floating to their upper left. A red question mark is centered above the plate. A stylized menu card with the word "MENU" at the top and several horizontal lines below, representing a list of food items. A hand is pointing to one of the lines on the menu, symbolizing the action of choosing an item. The overall image illustrates selecting or ordering food from a menu.

Two round shapes aligned horizontally. On the left is a cylindrical container with a flat lid, on the right, the same shape appears transformed into a gift with a decorative ribbon and bow on top. A red arrow points from the container on the left to the gift-wrapped container on the right, indicating the action of wrapping or packaging. An illustration of Korean traditional sweet "Yakgwa" (약과) on a white plate. Yakgwa appears as small, rounded, slightly flattened shapes with a glossy, reddish-brown glaze, indicative of their honey coating. They are closely packed on the plate.

name_en: Yangjangpi (Chinese-style noodles with vegetables and seafood)
description_brief: A colorful illustration of a dish on a plate with a central item, likely a protein source, and fan-like arrays of vegetables radiating outwards. The vegetables, depicted in alternating colors of green and orange, may be slices of cucumbers or zucchinis and carrots. The plate itself is circular with a slightly raised edge.

An illustration depicts a dish of fried chicken pieces with prominent drumsticks, accompanied by green lettuce and red round items, possibly tomatoes or assorted vegetables, all contained within a simple rectangular dish with a white base and a grey accent. It's rendered in a bold line art style, using a limited color palette.

The image depicts an unopened, small, and portable bottle filled with a white and creamy substance, likely yogurt. It has a narrow neck and wider base with a green foil cap. The label has red text and a red logo. The text is in Korean, and part of it translates to "yogurt" in English.

An illustration of a cup of soft pink colored yogurt with a portion of its lid peeled back and a wooden spoon positioned in front of the cup, ready for consumption. The cup has a simple design with a blue stripe near the top. The term "요거트" which translates to "yogurt" in Korean, is also mentioned.

An illustration of a plate of food that appears to be the Korean dish "열무김치" (yeolmu-kimchi). On the plate, there's a heap of green vegetables that resemble noodle-like strands or sliced leaves on a red-colored base. The vegetables are garnished with red specks. The plate is simple white with a slight rim.

An image featuring "유부초밥" (Yubuchobap), a Korean dish where seasoned rice is tucked inside a small pouch of fried tofu. The pouch is a light golden-brown color, cut open to reveal the white rice inside, seasoned with small, colorful specks. The tofu pouch with the rice filling is displayed in three pieces, with two pieces standing and one piece lying flat. The background is plain white.

An illustration depicts a bowl of traditional Korean cuisine, "육개장" (Yukgaejang). It features a reddish-brown broth filled with slices of beef and is topped with vegetables that resemble green onions and yellow strips that could be egg garnishes. The bowl is white, highlighting the colorful contents of the spicy beef soup.

An illustration of a traditional Korean meal called "yusanseulbap." It consists of a mound of white, fluffy rice at the center of the plate surrounded by various colorful side dishes which may include vegetables and protein. The side dishes are arranged neatly around the rice and the overall appearance is cartoon-like, using bold outlines and solid colors to represent the different components of the meal.

The image shows a box of cereal labeled "Zet" in both Korean text and English transliteration. There are cartoon characters that resemble chipmunks or squirrels, along with an image of a bowl of cereal with milk on the box. Colorful cereal pieces or possible representations of vitamins or minerals are at the bottom. The background is yellow with a gradient towards white, with notable red around the product name and a red banner in the upper right indicating recommended age: "12+" years. The size of the package is "400g".

An illustration of a pain scale with a cartoon-style face with a slight frown and furrowed brow at the top. The face corresponds to the Korean phrase "조금-아파요", meaning "a little - it hurts." Below is a horizontal scale with numbers from 1 to 5, each within a colored box of varying intensity, representing increasing levels of pain severity. A red triangle is pointing downwards towards the scale, indicating the level of pain. To the right of the scale, "불쾌감등급" translating to "discomfort level" or "pain rating," next to squares showing the corresponding colors for the numbers 1 through 5.

A simple representation of a human abdomen, featuring a flesh-toned background. There are two small circles near the top for nipples. A dotted line circle is in the center, representing the belly button area, with a solid red triangle pointing to it, possibly indicating a focus on or issue with the abdominal area.

An illustration of a human belly on a light beige square background. The belly has a small red arrow pointing in a clockwise circular motion around the navel, accompanied by a dashed line circular path. Above the central symbol is a small, curved line suggestive of the lower part of the belly, with two small dots symmetrical above it, likely representing nipples. The image appears to represent a concept related to abdominal health.

An illustration depicting a stylized representation of the abdominal muscles, enclosed within a rounded square border. The image primarily consists of a graphical depiction of the rectus abdominis, showing the muscle's vertical definition and the horizontal lines that segment the muscles, giving a "six-pack" appearance. The color palette used is minimal; shades of peach or skin tone for the background and black for the outline and details of the muscles.

A stylized person from the waist up, with a red face covered in spots or a rash, looking troubled or unwell. They are holding up both hands in a stopping gesture. To the right, there is a large image of an open capsule pill, half orange and half white, revealing many smaller spheres inside. The image may symbolize an allergic reaction or a warning about medication side effects.

A simplified character with a smile, wearing a teal top, sitting behind a table with an orange front panel. On the table, there is a bowl, which appears to be empty, and a spoon next to it. The character seems content and is likely representing the act of eating or having just finished a meal. Below the image, there are Korean characters "식후" written, which translate to "after a meal." The overall image suggests a theme related to eating habits, meal completion, or post-dining activities in the context of health.

A simplified, stylized graphic of a person's upper torso and head with a neutral facial expression and their mouth open, showing a red-colored tongue. To the left side of the person, there is a symbol that resembles a medical cross (a plus sign) inside a square. The medical cross is teal or light blue. It might be used to represent healthcare or medical attention, particularly related to ENT (ear, nose, and throat).
The image features a round wall clock with a blue rim, its right half colored in red and showing an afternoon time, and a stylized orange sun with triangular rays, indicating a sunny afternoon.

A stylized human foot from the side view, angled slightly upwards. The foot is depicted with five toes. There are dashed lines drawn around the ankle area. Adjacent to the heel of the foot, there is a small, solid red triangle pointing towards the dashed lines.

An illustration depicts a human foot from a side perspective. The foot appears to be in a relaxed position. There is a dotted circle around the ankle area, with a red, triangular arrow pointing counter-clockwise suggesting rotation or movement at the ankle joint. This graphic is typical of symbols used to indicate exercises or movements for health, like ankle rotation exercises.

A simple flat design of a person and medication. The person with a neutral expression, flushed cheek and a few lines indicating discomfort, wears a teal-colored shirt and has short hair. Next to the figure, there is an image of two capsule pills, one split in half. The term "항생제" refers to "antibiotics" in Korean, suggesting a healthcare context involving antibiotics or medicine.

A computer monitor displays the Korean script "예약접수" (translated as "appointment reception" or "reservation acceptance"), signifying it's used for scheduling appointments. Below the monitor, there's a hand extending from the right side, with index finger poised to press a button or interact with a digital interface, depicting the action of making an appointment. The graphic has a simplified, icon-like quality.

A stylized human arm flexed at the elbow, with the forearm and biceps prominently shown to create a 'V' shape, representing strength or muscle, associated with the concept of health or physical fitness. The arm is outlined in black and is colored with a flesh tone.

The illustration depicts a medicine package and a strip of pills. The package has Korean text "아스피린 100mg" which translates to "Aspirin 100mg" in English, indicating the type and dosage of the medicine. Below the text, there are iconographic elements that suggest the presence of pills within the package. Adjacent to the package is a blister pack containing visible round pills. The blister pack is partially overlapped by the package, showing a total of twelve circular pills.

An illustration of an asthma inhaler. The inhaler has a dark blue body with a lighter blue dose counter window on its side and a gray top. A puff of medication, indicated by three white curved lines, is being released from the mouthpiece.

The illustration depicts a simplified cartoon-style drawing of a person viewed from the back, from the shoulders up. The person has brown hair. The back is highlighted by a dashed red line that encloses it, with a red play-shaped arrow pointing towards the lower back on the right side.

The illustration features a posterior view of a human torso without arms and head, presumably representing a person's back. There is a vertical black line indicating the spine and a red band around the lower back area suggesting discomfort or a targeted treatment area. The red color could imply back pain or a lumbar issue.

The image shows a stylized illustration of an adhesive bandage with a central, rectangular, tan or beige-colored pad. Surrounding the pad, the bandage has a flesh-toned background with small, round dots at the ends indicating the adhesive parts. It represents first aid, medical care, or health-related items.

A simple cartoon-style representation of a person's face that is round with two dots for eyes, a simple line for a mouth, and a straight line for hair. An adhesive bandage is on the left side of the face, covering the cheek area. A red arrow points directly at the bandage.

The illustration shows a single bed with a white frame and a plain green blanket. It has a single rounded pillow with orange and yellow stripes. The image seems to depict themes related to health, rest, or accommodation.

A simply drawn character with a smiling face and short hair, is wearing a green shirt. The character is sitting behind a table, holding a spoon to their mouth as if they are eating. In front of them is a bowl filled with what appears to be rice. Below the image is the Korean text "식전," which translates to "before eating" or "pre-meal" in English.

A three-dimensional, L-shaped object in white with a red-colored inner surface visible at the upper, rear portion. There's a simplified, inverted red triangle with a dashed circular outline around it, suspended above this red area, suggesting movement or a location point. The image represents abstract ideas.

A simplified representation of a person's midsection. The individual is wearing a white top and brown pants. A red dashed circle around the belly button area, with a red arrow pointing directly at the center of this circled area. The graphic represents abdominal pain or some kind of stomach issue.

A flat design of a human hand with a simple cut on the palm. Two droplets of blood are splashing out to the right side of the image. The hand is facing with the palm to the viewer and fingers pointed upwards. This image could symbolize injury, bleeding, or the need for first aid related to a cut on the hand.

A stylized representation of a blood bag used for blood donations or transfusions. The bag is red with a green label in the center, and a tube attached to the bottom that extends to the right side with a pointed end. This image could represent health concepts related to medicine, donation, blood transfusion, or healthcare services.

A stylized representation of a syringe with a red liquid inside is positioned above a representation of a person's arm with a drop of blood near the needle, suggesting that blood is being drawn or an injection is being given. The illustration is bright and clear, appearing to be a symbol or icon related to medical procedures such as vaccination or blood tests.

A cartoon-like figure of a person with a straight, unsmiling mouth and closed eyes, standing with arms crossed tightly over the chest. There are three wavy lines emanating from the body on either side, indicating shivering or a feeling of being cold. The character is wearing a teal top and navy blue pants. The overall image conveys a sense of physical discomfort.

A simple illustration of a digital thermometer. The thermometer is primarily pink with a red button near the wider end. The tip, where the temperature sensor is located, appears in white and transitions to a red color, possibly indicating it is ready for use or showing a temperature reading.

The illustration depicts a person standing on a scale. The scale's display is in kilograms (KG). The individual is facing away from the viewer, seems calm, and is casually dressed. This image symbolizes weight measurement or "body weight."

A stylized illustration of a human brain viewed from the side. It has a simplified design with curved lines indicating the brain's sulci and gyri, creating a pattern of folds and crevices. The coloring is in shades of pink and beige.

A stylized cartoon image of a person from the shoulders up, with a round head, a single dot for an eye, a small curve representing the nose, short black hair, and a teal or greenish-blue shirt. The individual's mouth is open with two puffs of air coming out, indicating that they might be breathing out forcefully, coughing, or blowing on something.

A simplified representation of a human bone structure, focused on a single bone. In the middle of the bone, there is a red starburst-like shape, which suggests a point of impact, injury, or pain. The bone appears to be a long bone, possibly a femur or tibia. The image typically symbolizes a fracture or a bone injury.

A pair of open hands held up and facing toward the viewer, as if offering something. In the center of the hands is a rectangular piece of paper with its top right corner folded down. The overall image conveys the idea of someone offering information, related to a theme of health.

A cartoon character smiling and holding a giant tooth with his left hand. A red arrow originates from the character's mouth and curves towards the tooth, symbolizing the act of brushing or caring for teeth. The overall theme of the image relates to oral health and the importance of dental hygiene.

A stylized drawing of a single step or platform in red, with a white outline for a three-dimensional look. At the top edge of the step, there is a small red triangle pointing downwards with a dotted circle around it, indicating a potential hazard or point of interest. This symbol represents caution for stepping down or a change in elevation.

A simple illustration of a tooth in light pink, with red areas indicating spots of concern, possibly decay or disease. The tooth is cartoonish and shows a visible crown and root, with natural grooves and contours typical of a molar. The illustration represents dental health or issues.

An illustration shows a stylized graphic of a smiling mouth with teeth. One tooth in the lower row is highlighted in yellow, indicating a problem. Above this tooth, there is a small red downward-facing triangle, possibly indicating an area of concern. The image symbolizes dental health or a dental issue.

The illustration depicts a stylized representation of a human smile showing a set of upper teeth enclosed within a lip-shaped border. One front tooth is highlighted with dotted lines and a small red triangle pointing downwards, possibly indicating a missing or damaged tooth. The graphic may relate to dental health.

A stylized representation of a hand checking the pulse on a wrist. There are three horizontal red lines on the wrist underneath the fingers, indicating the location where the pulse is being felt. The drawing is predominantly in black with red for the pulse indication.

A stylized character representing a doctor in a white lab coat, shirt with tie, and blue trousers, standing on the left. Around the doctor's neck is a stethoscope. To the right, there is a large, red, circular shape with a dotted outline, possibly symbolizing a virus or healthcare concept. A red arrow points from the doctor towards the circular shape.

A stylized representation of a card with a flesh-toned background and rounded corners. In the center, there's a red, triangular play button icon pointing to the right, enclosed within a dashed circular outline. On the lower part of the card, to the left, there's a small 'x' mark. The symbol "가슴" refers to "chest" or "heart" in Korean. The play button could be related to heart health or chest-related content.

An illustration of a person's head and shoulders with a neutral skin tone, black hair, and a slight frown on their face. They have multiple circular spots or lesions on their face and shoulders, suggestive of some sort of skin condition. The symbol "수두," which translates to "chickenpox" in Korean, is also present in the image.

The right bottle contains a yellow liquid and has a red downward arrow above it, suggesting this is the one to be used. Both bottles have measurement indicators on the surface and are capped with white lids. The image likely conveys a message related to following specific medication instructions.

A graphic or stylized representation of the Korean character "원" (won), which is red on a white background. The character is composed of a circular shape at the top followed by a combination of horizontal and vertical lines beneath. The character is related to health.

A simplified representation of a human nose drawn in a cartoonish style. The nose is flesh-toned, oriented in a vertical position, indicating a profile view. A red drop, representing blood, is dripping from one nostril, suggesting a nosebleed.

A stylized representation of a human face with a drop coming from the nose, indicating a runny nose. Next to the face, there are two capsule pills depicted, one half orange, half clear with small spheres inside, and the other half yellow, half clear. The image symbolizes "감기약" which translates to "cold medicine" in Korean. It suggests treatment or medication for cold symptoms.

A stylized human figure with a focus on the abdominal area, where a simplified representation of the large intestine is visible showing a reddish-orange circle around a section of it, indicating a problem area. The figure is outlined in black with a neutral or flesh tone fill. The image appears to represent "대장암," which translates to "colorectal cancer" in English.

A stylized depiction of a person's head and shoulders. The character has a cartoon-like appearance with a rounded head, short black hair, and is wearing a teal-colored shirt. The figure's face shows a clear sign of illness, with a large teardrop-shaped drop hanging from the nose, representing nasal discharge. The character's eyes appear half-closed and fatigued, while the eyebrows are slightly angled upwards towards the center, suggesting discomfort. The image corresponds to the Korean word "감기," which means "cold" referring to the common cold.

A simplified figure is seated on a toilet with an oversized, round red face with a discontent or uncomfortable expression. The figure is wearing a turquoise top and blue pants that are pulled down to mid-thigh. The concept of difficulty or discomfort while using the bathroom is conveyed, which could be related to a health condition like constipation.

name_en: Covering Mouth When Coughing or Sneezing

The person has a simple design, with black hair, a round head, and a face with two dots for eyes and lines for whiskers. The person is wearing a teal-colored top, and the background is white. The image symbolizes the concept of hygiene or health precaution.
The illustration depicts a pair of crutches with padded tops for underarm support and lower shafts that taper to a single tip at the bottom.

A pair of crutches supporting a leg wearing a blue pant and a grey shoe. There are two orange straps on the crutches that seem to encircle the leg. The top part of the crutches is hidden by a grey rectangle, implying that the crutches continue off the visible area of the illustration.

An illustration of a stack of currency notes bound together and a couple of coins. The topmost currency note has "10000" printed on it, and its design is in two shades of green. There are three coins overlapping each other with "100" and "10" inscribed on them, in grey, orange, and gold. The image symbolizes money or financial resources.

The illustration shows two hands facing upwards, holding an open cardboard box between them. There's a red arrow pointing upwards to the right of the box. The hands are in a cupped position, as if presenting or lifting the box.

A stylized semi-circular representation of a smiling mouth with white and even teeth visible within a healthy pink gumline. Overlaid on the teeth is a small round mirror on a handle, positioned towards the front teeth, implying an examination or inspection.
