name_en: I Need to Go to the Bathroom Urgently
description_brief: The illustration shows a person appearing worried or sad with short hair, wearing a green long-sleeved shirt and blue pants, and clenching their hands. Three sweat or tear droplets are near the head. To the left of the person is a large orange rectangle with a box containing Korean text "화장실", translating to "bathroom". The image conveys a sense of urgency related to the bathroom, aligning with the Korean word "급해요", which means "urgent" or "hurry".

An overturned white, cylindrical cup with blue liquid, presumably water, spilling out onto a brown, flat, horizontal surface. The liquid forms a puddle around the base of the cup. The background is plain white. The style of the illustration is cartoonish with black outlines defining the shapes.

A simplified stylized face of a person eating. The face is a circle with black hair, two dot eyes, and a straight-line mouth. The person appears to be holding a lollipop or some sort of round, pink-colored treat on a stick, which is placed at the mouth as if they are about to eat it. This image relates to "먹고싶어요," which means "I want to eat" in Korean.

A stylized drawing of a person standing next to a playground structure. The person has a round head and a smiling face, wearing a green long sleeve top and blue pants, extending an arm towards the playground equipment. The playground equipment consists of a slide in orange and a swing set in green, affixed to a brown support structure. The image suggests leisure, playfulness, and activities associated with children or family environments.

A cartoon character, appearing as a young child with a sleepy or tired expression, is standing next to a bed. The child has short brown hair, is wearing a white t-shirt, and brown shorts. The bed to the right of the child has a headboard, mattress, and a pillow at the top, covered with an orange bedspread. The overall image conveys a theme related to sleep or bedtime.

A single human hand with a pointing index finger. The hand is shown with a beige skin tone for the hand itself and a solid teal color for the sleeve or garment covering the wrist and lower arm. The background is white. The index finger is raised and pointing upwards.

A simplified, cartoon-style figure of a person is shown, wearing a teal-colored long-sleeved top and blue pants, hands clasped in front of them, which may possibly indicate they are in a school uniform. Next to the person is a speech bubble containing a drawing of a building, possibly a schoolhouse. This assumption is suggested by the flag on top of the building and the associated Korean text "학교-다녀오겠습니다", which translates to "I will go to school".

name_en: I will take care of you
description_brief: The illustration depicts a figure with a smiling face, short hair, and wearing a green shirt. The character has both hands placed over the heart area, possibly depicting love or satisfaction. There is a speech bubble containing a yellow smiling face to the right of the character's head, suggesting happiness or contentment. The overall feel of the image is cheerful and positive.

A flat, stylized image of a human hand facing forward, with the fingers together and the thumb slightly apart. A bold red "X" mark is to the right of the hand. Both are set against a plain white background, possibly indicating "stop," "no," or a prohibition.

Illustration of a person with a discontented facial expression, closed eyes, a straight-line mouth, raised arms with palms facing outward suggesting refusal. They are wearing a short-sleeve turquoise shirt and navy blue pants. The background is solid black, contrasting with the figure's lighter skin tone. The character symbolizes annoyance, objection, or the desire for stoppage. The image represents the Korean term "깜깜해요" meaning "it's dark."

A stylized character with a displeased or frustrated facial expression. The character has black hair, one side of which is long and flowing. Their eyes are squinted, brows are furrowed, and the mouth is turned downward in an unhappy or annoyed frown. Three short lines are drawn above the character's head, suggesting irritation or annoyance. The character is wearing a simple orange shirt.

A simple cartoon of a person with a smiling face and black hair, wearing a teal shirt and raising their index finger, possibly indicating a point or an idea. Behind the character, there are educational elements including the letters "A B C" and a simple math equation "2 X 1 = 2". The background is plain white.

A cartoon-style drawing of a person standing with their arms crossed over their chest, displaying a displeased or angry facial expression. They are wearing a long-sleeve teal shirt and blue pants. The overall posture suggests annoyance or a defensive attitude. This could visually represent the Korean phrase "말려요", interpreted as a person showing frustration or disapproval in a domestic setting.

A simple, cartoon-style drawing of a person with a smile on their face. The individual has a round head, dot eyes, a straight line for a mouth, no discernible hair, and wearing a long-sleeve teal shirt. Their arms are spread out horizontally from their sides, appearing as if they are offering a hug or gesture of welcome. The background is plain and white.

A simplistic representation of a person standing with an exaggerated expression of surprise or shock. They are wearing a teal long-sleeved shirt and blue pants. There are lines near the person's right hand, emanating from the empty pocket, indicating something is missing.

A cartoon character of a child with short brown hair, smiling, wearing a short-sleeved white t-shirt and brown shorts, sitting on a bench. A red curved arrow points downwards, suggesting the action of sitting down. The image symbolizes the concept of sitting or the phrase "sit down".

name_en: I'm soaked (or) I'm drenched (or) I'm sweating
description_brief: A cartoon of a young girl with a cheerful expression. She has a ponytail on the side of her head, secured with a blue hairband. The girl is wearing a white T-shirt with a pink heart in the center. There's a red triangular play symbol pointing towards the girl from the right side.

name_en: I'm sorry, but the Korean text "얇아요" seems incorrect and cannot be translated. Could you please check the labeling again?
description_brief: An illustration of a yellow book titled "BOOK" on its cover. The book is closed, displaying its spine and pages on the side. A red triangular arrowhead is pointing to the book from the right, it's connected to a circular dotted line indicating motion or direction toward the book. The background is plain white.

A pair of light blue infant or toddler pants with white bands at the waist and leg openings, and each featuring a bear face on the front. One is partially folded, laying toward the left, and the other is positioned upright with the waistband facing upward.

A simple colored illustration of an iron used for pressing clothes. The body is orange with a light gray soleplate at the bottom and a darker gray area at the rear end, possibly, where the cord would be attached. The handle of the iron is white with a circular knob on top that could indicate the temperature control settings.

A modern electric clothes iron placed on top of a piece of fabric. The iron has a flat metal bottom and a thick, curved handle with a brown top. Its main body is white with a red and a yellow indicator light. There is a small puff of steam emitting from the front top side of the iron, indicating that it's in use.
A simple line drawing of an unfolded and standing ironing board. There is a single piece of clothing, which appears to be a pink towel or small cloth, draped over the edge. The background is plain.

Four separate icons arranged horizontally. From left to right: a pair of vertical lines, a simplified human face with dots for eyes and a straight line for a mouth, a similar face with a curved line for a mouth, and a square divided into four smaller squares. Above the icons is a larger circular graphic of a stylized Earth showing green landmasses and blue water. To the right of the Earth is a red question mark, symbolizing inquiry or search for information. The theme is questioning how something may be applicable or used worldwide.

A stylized representation of a person shielding their eyes from the sun. They are shown from the waist up, wearing a green shirt and using their right hand to cover their eyes from the bright sunlight. To the right of the person is a yellow sun with rays. The image conveys the idea of a person struggling to see in bright light, which matches the Korean phrase "눈부셔요" ("nunbusyeoyo") meaning "It's dazzling" or "It's too bright."

A pot on the stove with flames underneath it, it is steaming. On the right, there is a person depicted from the chest upwards, wearing a green shirt. The person is looking at the pot with a frowning facial expression and has one arm extended forward with the hand positioned as if resting on a surface. The image contains a Korean phrase "뜨거워요" (tteugeowoyo), which translates to "It's hot". The image represents this phrase through the visual cues of the hot pot and the person's concerned expression.
A simple, stylized teal t-shirt with a depicted tear on its left side. Around the tear, there is a dashed circular outline that emphasizes the damage and a small pink arrow pointing at the tear.

A glass with a stem is filled with orange juice. A slice of lemon (or possibly orange) is wedged onto the rim of the glass as garnish. The juice is bright yellow, and the glass is outlined in black with a light blue hint at the top. The lemon slice has a light yellow color with a darker yellow border.

A simple illustration of a full-sized, wired computer keyboard in a horizontal layout with a uniform array of rectangular keys. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of gray and blue, and the background is white.

A simple kitchen scene with a light brown counter on the left, featuring a sink with a single faucet and a cooking pot on a stovetop. To the right of the counter is a gray two-door refrigerator with a vertical division, indicating the separation of the fridge and freezer sections. The illustration represents the concept of a kitchen, home, or domestic environment.

A simple rectangular tissue box with one tissue partially pulled out. The box has a visible opening at the top for dispensing tissues. The tissue that is pulled out is crumpled, indicating that it has been used or is ready for use.

A clenched hand with the knuckles facing forward, seemingly in the act of knocking. A star-like burst shape to the left of the fist represents the action of knocking. The background is a solid, flat orange color, and the hand is outlined in a bold line. The phrase "두드려요(노크해요)" translates to "Knock, please" in English.

A stylized illustration of a traditional Korean knot, also known as "Maedeup". It consists of a horizontal strap with two symmetrical loops forming at the center, from which two ends extend downwards, resembling a ribbon or bow. The color scheme is composed of a teal or sea green for the knot and a contrasting white for the background.

A stylized illustration of a traditional Korean overcoat, known as "durumagi," and a single traditional Korean shoe. The overcoat is depicted with three visible buttons and a high collar, and the shoe is colored in a bright orange-yellow hue, appearing as a side profile of a high-ankled shoe. Both items are illustrated without any background and are separated from each other within the image frame.

The illustration shows a simple ladder with blue side rails and light blue rungs, depicted in a vertical position with the rungs evenly spaced. The ladder has a flat, two-dimensional appearance with outlines and minimal shading. It resembles an icon or a symbol that could be used in a visual aid or infographic.

The illustration shows two circles with black outlines. The larger circle is on the left side, filled with a solid red color, and the smaller circle is on the right side, filled with a shade of gray. There is a considerable amount of space between the two circles.

The illustration depicts a front-loading washing machine with a round window on the front panel. Through the washing machine window, we can see a stylized representation of clothing or laundry being agitated in water, with bubbles or foam at the top and a water splash indicating motion. Below the window, there are three round control buttons or indicator lights: two red and one orange. The rest of the washing machine is depicted in gray, and the image has a white background.

An illustration depicts a front-loading washing machine with its door open. Inside the drum, there are suds or foam, suggesting that the washing machine is in use or ready for use. The machine has two control buttons or indicator lights below the door and a simple control panel with a knob at the top right. The image conveys the concept of laundry or doing the wash.

The illustration depicts a blue plastic bottle with a pink label showing three white wavy lines, implying a fabric softening or cleaning liquid inside. The bottle's cap is yellow, and it has a handle on top, typical for containers dispensing laundry-related products.

A simple, flat illustration of a front-loading washing machine. The machine is white with a clear circular front door showing clothes in pastel shades of pink and beige. The right side has a control panel with various buttons and a dial indicating different wash settings. Two curved lines on each side symbolize vibration or movement, indicating that it is operating.

A pair of hands with teal sleeves are placing a white, round plate onto a grey flat surface. There's a shadow under the plate, and the hands are in a gentle, open-palmed position on either side of the plate.

A stylized icon of a camera in a flat design style. It features a large central lens colored blue, a red triangular shape above the lens, a small rectangle to the left of the lens, and a small circle towards the upper right corner of the camera body. The overall shape of the camera is a rounded rectangle, primarily colored in shades of gray with black outlines.
A cartoon-like image of a person wearing a chef's hat, smiling and holding up a fork in the left hand and a spoon in the right hand. The character is wearing a plain, long sleeve shirt.

name_en: Let's do a hair tie up
description_brief: An illustration of a young animated character with a cheerful expression. The character has curly, fluffy hair and rosy cheeks, and is wearing a white shirt. Both hands are raised and placed behind the head, creating a relaxed or casual attitude. The overall mood of the image is light-hearted and positive.

A simplified, cartoon-like drawing of a person's head with a round face and a content smile. Above the character is a speech bubble containing colorful shapes—a pink cube, a yellow cone, an orange sphere on top of a green cube—suggesting that the person is thinking or talking about playing with these objects. The objects are easily distinguishable against a white background.

A cartoon-style image of a person with a short haircut and wearing a teal-colored, long-sleeved top, reading an open book. The background is plain white, focusing attention on the reading activity. The visual suggests a theme of learning, studying, or enjoying literature.

A cartoon-style drawing of a young girl with orange hair, wearing a headband and a white T-shirt with a pink heart. She is smiling and holding up a hairbrush to the side of her face as if it were a microphone.

The illustration shows a simple, stylized depiction of a ceiling lamp. The lamp has a grey, cone-shaped shade with a flat bottom, from which a round yellow light bulb is visible. The light bulb emits yellow rays downwards. The lamp and bulb are outlined with a thin black line, and they are suspended from a simple black line that represents the cord or fixture attaching it to the ceiling.

A simple, grayscale image of a light bulb. The light bulb has a rounded shape, a screw base at the top, and a transparent glass envelope with the filament inside. The image is two-dimensional with slight shading. The light bulb is not emitting light in this illustration.

An illustration of a stylized human hand with a green sleeve, picking up or moving a circular shape with a triangle inside it. There's a curved red arrow that suggests the circular shape is being rotated. To the right is another similar circular shape with a triangle inside it, stationary and separate from the action implied by the hand and arrow. This image appears to represent some form of sorting or organizing action.
The illustration depicts a bright red lipstick partially extended from a black tube with a silver band near the middle and a detached cap next to the base. The style is clean and cartoonish.

Illustration of a simple, stylized face with a neutral expression and a plain, rounded haircut. To the left of the face is a hand with all five fingers extended, separated by a small gap. Sound waves radiate from the hand, suggesting the act of hearing. This image represents the concept of listening, associated with the Korean word "들어요" (deureoyo), meaning "listen" or "hear".
A cartoon-style male figure is standing upright. He has short hair, a smiling face and is wearing a long-sleeved green shirt with a pink collar peeking out, blue pants, and black shoes.

A cartoon-style image of a standing woman who is smiling. She has shoulder-length black hair and is wearing a long-sleeve, mint green button-up shirt with a pink collar, a knee-length blue skirt, and dark grey shoes.

An illustration of two separate circles: a large grey one on the left and a smaller red one on the right, both centered vertically on a plain white background. The larger circle is approximately three to four times the diameter of the smaller circle. This image potentially symbolizes a concept or relationship between two entities.

A stylized depiction of a person with a broad, happy smile. The character has a simplistic design with a round head, short hair, and is wearing a teal shirt. The most noticeable feature is the wide, open-mouthed grin that conveys joy or laughter against a plain white background.

An illustration of a minimalist living room with a large window with curtains, a framed picture or television on the left, a rectangular rug and a single sofa on the right. The drawing style uses clean lines and a limited color palette, with the rug being depicted in orange.
An illustration of a pair of long gray pants with a brown waistband that includes belt loops and a center button, possibly representing clothing or apparel generally worn at home.
The illustration depicts a simple, long-sleeved turquoise shirt with a rounded neckline and black outline. There are no additional details or patterns.

A stylized illustration of a lotion bottle primarily white with a prominent yellow label in the center, which has a squiggly line and three horizontal lines. The cap of the bottle is slightly ajar, and there are two small drops above it, implying that it is either open or in use. There is a light grey outline surrounding the bottle against the white background.

An illustration featuring a green cucumber, a beige squash, and a yellow five-petaled flower. The cucumber and squash are depicted side by side, both resembling their real-life shapes. The flower, positioned to the right of the vegetables, has a simple design with a small star-shaped center. The images symbolize the Korean word "수세미" (susemi), which refers to a type of scrubber made from the fibers of the luffa plant. The items are isolated on a plain white background.

An illustration of two nail polish bottles and brushes, one with pink nail polish and the other with yellow nail polish. Each bottle has a silver band around the neck, and the brushes have black handles. The image background is white.

An illustration depicts two characters standing side by side. On the left, a figure in a white bridal gown with a veil is holding a bouquet of yellow flowers. On the right, a figure is dressed in a black suit with a bow tie. Both characters are depicted in a simple, cartoonish style and are smiling.

The illustration depicts a bust of an elderly woman with short, wavy grey hair, smiling. She's wearing a yellow long-sleeve sweater with a pink collar and pink cuffs. The background is white. The image could symbolize a grandmother or an elderly female relative, relating to the term "외할머니" (maternal grandmother).

A cartoonish drawing of a young boy with brown hair and a side-swept tuft. He is smiling broadly, revealing his teeth, and has rosy cheeks. He is wearing a white T-shirt and pointing to himself with his right hand thumb, giving a thumbs-up gesture. His expression and gesture suggest a positive attitude and could be interpreted as introducing or identifying himself.

A stylized sun at the top with rays emanating from it, a rice bowl to the left, and a set of eating utensils to the right consisting of a spoon and a pair of chopsticks. The sun is yellow, the bowl is gray, and the eating utensils are black lines against a white background. The image signifies a mealtime or dining concept.

A simple drawing of a slightly tilted tube, possibly of cream or ointment, with the cap end pointed towards the bottom right corner. The cap is on, with a small amount of green substance visible at the opening, indicating it is slightly squeezed. The tube is gray, and the cap is white. The illustration is against a plain white background.

The illustration features a pair of navy blue swim trunks with a white leaf pattern and a drawstring at the waist. Below, there is a pair of red and white flip-flops. The Korean term "남자수영복" (namjasuyeongbok) is used, meaning "men's swimwear."

A microwave oven in a horizontal layout, with a large window on the front through which the interior is partially visible. There's a control panel with various buttons and a non-active digital display on the right side. The microwave oven is colored in hues of grey and teal with shading.
The illustration depicts a rectangular mirror with a thin brown or beige frame and a reflective blue surface with a lighter shade of blue showing a reflection or glare. It is hanging from a loop.
A pair of knitted gloves in a yellowish-tan color with ribbed cuffs and a pattern of small dashes across the main part. The gloves are connected by a string or yarn.

Two stylized figures holding hands, likely representing a mother and child. The figure on the left appears feminine, with short hair, wearing a pink top, while the figure on the right appears more childlike, shorter in stature, and wearing a green top. Above the figures is an equal sign, indicating that the two figures are linked or equivalent in some context related to the category of "Home, family, relatives."

A simple representation of a breakfast scene. A stylized sun on the left indicates it is morning. In the center, there is a bowl, and to its right are a spoon and two chopsticks vertically aligned. The colors used are yellow for the sun and grey for the bowl and utensils, with black outlines. The image represents morning routines, breakfast, or the concept of starting a day.

A smiling female character with black, short, curly hair. She is wearing a long-sleeved yellow top, a green knee-length skirt, and black shoes. Around her neck is a white collar. The style of the drawing is designed for easy recognition as a visual aid for representing "mother" in Korean, "숙모". The background is plain white.

The illustration depicts a cartoon-style woman. She has shoulder-length black hair, is smiling, and is standing upright. She is wearing a long-sleeved orange shirt and grey pants with dark grey or black shoes.

An illustrated character representing an elderly woman with gray hair styled in a short haircut and a content smile. She is wearing a long-sleeved cream-colored shirt, a purple scarf, a green skirt, and orange shoes. The character is standing upright, facing forward. The style of the drawing is intended for a visual aid or iconography.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person standing to the right of a brown door, pushing it open, with a big red arrow pointing left to indicate the movement. The person appears to be male with a round head, no distinguishable features on the face, and a stick figure-like body. He is wearing a green long-sleeved shirt and blue pants.

A cartoonish illustration of a snail viewed from the side with a sizable, coiled shell with visible striations and darker spots. The snail's body is visible, showing its muscular foot. Antennae-like structures extend from the front side of the snail, which is on the right-hand side of the image. To the left of the snail, there is a red arrow pointing to the left. Below the snail, three curved lines indicate motion or the trail typically left behind by a snail as it moves.

A single green sock with a hole at the toe area through which a human toe is poking out. The sock is depicted on a foot and lower part of a leg, and there are short lines around the hole suggesting motion or attention to the hole.

The illustration depicts a stylized yellow identification tag or nameplate with four circular indentations arranged horizontally across its lower half. Above these circles is the number "20138." The tag is equipped with a metallic silver clip attached to its top, enabling it to be fastened onto an item or clothing.
A beige or light brown rectangular tissue box with a single white tissue partially pulled out from the top. The tissue has small dots on it, implying a pattern or texture.

A cartoon-style image of a smiling person with shoulder-length light brown hair. The person is depicted from the chest up, wearing a white T-shirt with a large, chunky necklace. There is a red arrow pointing to the person's neck area, with the Korean word "목걸이," translating to "necklace".
An illustration depicts a plain, solid colored necktie in light pink color with a pale grey knot.

The illustration depicts an open newspaper icon with several columns of text, represented by vertical lines of varying lengths. Some blocks, likely indicating pictures or different sections, are scattered across the layout. The icon is a stylized representation of a print newspaper, commonly associated with news, information, and reading material.

An illustration depicts a thick, right-pointing red arrow, outlined with a black border. The arrowhead is triangular with a sharp point, and the tail is straight rectangle. It indicates direction or signifies moving on to the next item or step in a sequence.

A stylized person with a smiling face, wearing a green long-sleeved shirt, holding a white plate or dish in their outstretched right arm. There is another plate laid on a surface with a red "X" mark over it, suggesting it is not an option or is to be disregarded. The overall image symbolizes offering an alternative or a different option within a home or family setting.

Two cartoon boys standing side by side, smiling and facing the viewer. The boy on the left has spiky hair and is wearing a white shirt with brown shorts. The boy on the right has a side-part hairstyle and is wearing a light blue shirt with darker shorts. There's a red play button or triangular icon pointing towards them from the left side.

A cartoon of a young boy and a girl holding hands. The boy is on the left, wearing a light grey T-shirt and teal shorts, with a playful smile on his face. The girl is on the right, wearing a white T-shirt, a blue skirt, and a white headband, also smiling. They both have rosy cheeks and are standing upright. There is a small, red, play button-like triangle on the left side of the illustration.

A female figure with a cartoon-like appearance, broad smile, shoulder length light brown or blond hair with a headband. She wears a long-sleeved orange shirt, bright pink pants and simple green flat shoes. The character has a straight-on view with a simple black outline and a white background.

The illustration depicts two cartoon-like figures, a girl and a boy, standing side by side and holding hands. The girl is slightly taller, has long hair, a white T-shirt with a heart design, and red shoes with hearts. The boy has short hair, a happy facial expression, a light blue T-shirt, darker blue shorts, and blue shoes. A red triangular play button is pointing towards them from the left. The image could represent the Korean term "누나엄니," which translates to "older sister".

An illustration of two stylized characters, an adult woman wearing an orange top, pink trousers, and green shoes, and a younger child with a grey top and blue shorts. Both characters have black hair, simple facial features and stand straight facing forward. A red arrow pointing downwards towards the woman signifies that the symbol refers to the adult female figure.

An illustration of a traditional Korean heating system known as an "ondol" or "gudeul". The image includes a large grey bowl-shaped object with white wavy lines at the top, standing on a brown circular base with darker brown elliptical patterns. On the right side of the platform, there's a small pink arrow pointing towards it, indicating heat direction. The image symbolizes a form of warmth or heating, consistent with the traditional Korean ondol heating concept.

A simple, stylized image of a purple dress with short sleeves and a gray collar. The dress has detail at the waist and two visible white buttons on the front, near the waistline. The design uses bold outlines to define the shape of the dress. It could represent clothing or women's fashion.

The illustration depicts a one-piece, bright pink swimsuit. It has a simple, sleeveless design with thin straps. The outline and detailing are done in black, with a scoop neckline and standard leg openings. The swimsuit is set against a plain white background.

An illustration of a traditional Korean earthenware pot called an "onggi", which is grey and white, with an open lid and a label. A red upwards arrow is coming out of the pot's open lid, suggesting the meaning of opening or uncovering something.

The illustration depicts a pair of hands with rolled-up shirt sleeves reaching for three cubes or blocks that are placed in a row on a flat surface. The hands appear to be in the process of organizing or rearranging the cubes. The overall image symbolizes the act of tidying up or organizing, with the Korean word "정리해요".

An illustration of a family of four standing side by side and holding hands. From left to right, a young boy with brown hair, wearing a white shirt and brown pants. Next to him is an older man with gray hair wearing a brown sweater and gray pants. Beside him is a woman with brown hair, dressed in a pink blouse and black skirt. On the far right is a young girl with long brown hair, a blue headband, white shirt with a red heart design, and blue skirt with red shoes. The image represents the concept of "우리가족" in Korean, which translates to "our family."

The illustration shows three stylized human figures standing side by side in black and white, with the figure on the right wearing a red top. There is a red downwards arrow pointing towards the figure in red, indicating a selection or focus on this figure. The background of the image is white.
A pair of oven mitts in a cartoonish style. The mitts have a quilted design for heat protection. The cuffs of the mitts have a ribbed texture. The color scheme mainly features yellow and beige.

An illustration features a pair of blue overalls with straps and a front bib pocket. The overalls are outlined in dark blue with lighter blue for the fill color, including details such as the waistband, seams, pockets, and the front bib with a rectangular pocket. The image is centered against a plain, white background.

A stylized cartoon boy happily standing with his feet together. He has spiky brown hair and is dressed in a white t-shirt and brown shorts, with blue shoes. Below him is a horizontal line, and underneath that line, on the right-hand side, is a red downward-pointing triangle.

A pair of hands interacting with a purple backpack. One hand is unzipping the front pocket and the other is placing or retrieving an orange book from the main compartment. The scene illustrates a common daily life activity.
A set of pajamas consisting of a long-sleeved button-up shirt and matching pants in a light blue color with darker blue outlines. The image represents the concept of sleepwear or nightwear.

An illustration of two pairs of underpants. The top pair is light gray with a blue tag on the front and a darker gray elastic waistband. The bottom pair is peach or light orange colored with a small white bow in the center and a scalloped edge along the waistband. They are set against a plain background.
An illustration of a pair of blue pants with a button depicted on the waistband, against a plain white background.

A cylindrical roll with a visible hollow core, and a sheet hanging down with a perforated line. The edge of the sheet is jagged, suggesting it has been torn off a previous sheet. The illustration is in a line art style without any color.

A simple vector illustration of a roll of paper towels. The roll is standing vertically with the inner cardboard tube visible from the top, and to the right, a section of paper towel is unfurled horizontally, revealing the dotted lines for tearing off a sheet. The illustration is outlined in black with light grey color inside, set on a white background.

The illustration depicts a man and a woman standing next to each other in front of a door. They are both smiling and in a welcoming posture. The man is wearing a grey long-sleeved shirt and grey pants with brown shoes, while the woman is wearing a pink long-sleeved top, a purple skirt, and blue shoes. The background is white. The image could symbolize parents or homeowners, related to the concept of "부모님방" in Korean, meaning "parents' room."
A simple black and white line drawing of a rectangular perfume bottle with rounded corners, a narrow neck, a flat squared cap, and liquid in the lower part indicated by a shaded area.

A character with a friendly, smiling face with curly black hair, simple black dotted eyes, and a small curved line for a mouth. The person is depicted from the shoulders up, wearing a light yellow shirt with a white collar. The illustration has a white background.

The illustration shows a light brown pet collar with a metallic buckle and holes for size adjustment. It features a rectangular, silver-colored tag with squiggly lines, possibly representing a name or engraving. The collar is typically worn by domestic animals such as dogs or cats.

A stylized yellow flower with five petals, a central white circle, and two green leaves on its stem. The image could symbolize "putting something away" or "placing an item in its designated spot."

The person is smiling and pointing upwards with their right hand towards a wooden shelf on the wall. Above the shelf, there is a dotted outline of a square, suggesting the placement of an object. A curved red arrow points to the space below the shelf, indicating the action of bringing something down or placing something on the shelf. The graphic represents the Korean phrase "내려주세요," which translates to "Please put it down" or "Please lower it".

The image is reminiscent of a piracy symbol or a poison warning due to the crossed bones, and the money element may be indicative of financial danger or a decrease in wealth.

This image could symbolize nostalgia, retro technology, video recording, playback, or the concept of rewinding or looking back in time.

The image symbolizes a situation or concept related to accessibility issues or safety concerns for wheelchair users.

A green-colored banknote with a black outline and a numerical value "10000" printed in bold. There is a portrait of an individual on the right. Two rectangular icons representing receipts or tickets. Both icons have a yellow background with red and black text and details. A stylized image of a pair of socks resting on top of a rectangular object with Korean text on it, "지정토". A simplified, cartoon-style image of a detective character on a grey background within a stylized document icon. An open book with a silhouette of a person's head on the left page and a large red question mark on the right page. The person appears to be holding a magnifying glass. This image symbolizes questioning, investigation, or searching for information.

The image represents a book with a two-tone cover divided into a light yellow top and a gray bottom. The yellow section displays Korean text "사전", translating to "dictionary". The simplistic style indicates the book's thickness with visible page layers on the side. The book is standing upright against a plain white background.

The illustration depicts a fuel pump at a service station with two shades of blue with a silver nozzle and a black handle. On the front panel, there is a large yellow rectangle with the Korean word "경유" (diesel).

A wooden door in a vertical orientation features a symbol in the center. The symbol is a circle split into two equal halves: the left half is red and the right half is blue. A white icon of a person seated in a wheelchair is superimposed over both colors in the center of the circle. There's also a round doorknob on the right side of the door.

On the right side, there's a space for a photo with a simple graphic of a smiling person's face and a blue border. A bold red "X" symbol at the top, often used to indicate prohibition or negativity. The illustration is of an orange and white card labeled "CARD" at the top. The middle orange section has the Korean text "할인카드" which translates to "discount card." A simplified, stylized drawing of a building with three main sections. The central part is slightly taller than the two sides, and each section features multiple windows arranged in a grid pattern. Above the building, there are Korean characters "구청" which refer to a district office or a local municipal office in South Korea.

name_en: Do you have it in another color?
description_brief: The illustration depicts a cartoon-style scenario with a T-shirt with a red X across it on the left, and a different colored T-shirt without any mark next to it. Above these two T-shirts, there is a red question mark. On the right side of the image, there's a smiling person pointing upwards. The phrase "다른색깔있어요" in Korean, which translates to "Do you have it in another color?" is also part of the illustration.

An illustration of a traditional East Asian personal name seal, commonly known as a "dojang" in Korean, with the handle facing to the left and the stamp surface facing the viewer. The stamp surface has two characters embossed on it with red ink residue around. Below and to the right there's a smaller imprint of the same characters which is the stamp's mark. The seal has a light brown handle and a round, red stamp surface where the characters are displayed in white.

An upright book with a cover that's segmented into three horizontal sections. The top section is white, the middle section is a light yellow hue with the Korean text "국내소설" written in black, which translates to "domestic novel," and the bottom section is a pale gray. The binding of the book is visible, with lines suggesting the pages within.

A stylized illustration of a person's face and hand. The face has simple features: two dots for eyes and a straight line for the mouth, while the hand, with four visible fingers, is covering the mouth. A circle with a dashed line is drawn on the cheek area. The phrase "먹기-싫어요" which translates to "I don't want to eat" or "I feel sick" in Korean, is included.

An illustration depicting a set of double doors colored in a shade of orange with a darker frame. Each door has a circular window at the top with numbers indicating "01" and "02", suggesting they're part of a larger set of doors. Below the windows, there are gray doorknobs with a keyhole, and attached to each are pink key tassels.

An illustration of a rectangular paper with a folded corner, creating a page curl at the bottom right. Inside the rectangle is Korean text "도화지," which translates to "sketch paper" or "drawing paper". The drawing consists of only black lines on a white background.

The illustration depicts a driver's license and a car. On the left side, there is a representation of a driver's license, featuring a portrait of a smiling individual with short hair wearing a suit and tie. The license includes text, which appears to be the driver's personal information and possibly the classification of the license. On the right side is a stylized grey car viewed from the side. The background is plain, accentuating the two main elements. The entire illustration is encapsulated within a frame.

A simple line drawing of a car in a side profile view, with large, puffy clouds coming out from the car's exhaust, indicating the emission of pollutants or exhaust gases. The car and clouds are outlined in black against a white background. The illustration symbolizes vehicle pollution or environmental concerns related to automobiles.

A stylized, simple image of a smiling person with straight black hair and a white shirt. They are holding a pair of chopsticks, with which they are picking up noodles from a bowl containing ramen or a similar type of soup. The background is white and the graphic elements are primarily outlined in black, with the noodles and broth in shades of yellow and orange, respectively. The image represents eating or enjoying a meal. The Korean text "염색해요" translates to "I dye (my hair)."

The illustration features a simplified representation of a storefront with the inscription "E-MART" on a yellow signboard. The building depicted is grey with multiple window panes, suggesting a commercial business front.

A simplistic illustration of an orange book with its spine facing the viewer. On the front cover of the book, the word "ECONOMY" is written in capital letters centered within a white rectangle. The cover has a darker orange rectangle along the binding edge, and the spine appears to be a lighter shade of orange.

The image depicts an upright book with its cover divided into two sections; the upper section colored pale yellow and the lower section in light gray. There is Korean text on the yellow section that reads "경제학," which translates to "Economics". The book's spine and multiple pages are visible, indicating a relatively thick volume. The background is white and the image symbolizes an economics textbook.

The image depicts an abstract, stylized figure with a bold, blue, ribbon-like shape that forms a loop at the top and two larger loops on the sides, resembling a simplified figure with open arms. Above the central loop sits a small, round, teal-colored shape that represents the head. The term "교육청" (meaning 'educational office' in Korean) is related to the image.
The image displays a simple illustration of an eggplant with a deep purple body and a green top. The shapes and lines are smooth and cartoonish, without intricate detailing.
The illustration shows two eggs. On the left, there is a hot fried egg with the yolk in the center. On the right, there is a whole egg with a light brown shell.

A simple illustration of a closed book with a vibrant pink cover. On the cover, there are Korean characters "영어사전" which mean "English dictionary." The book is oriented with the spine on the left, indicating the front cover is visible, and the background is plain white.

The illustration depicts a stylized animated character giving a thumbs-up with their right hand. The character is smiling, appears happy and confident. They have short hair, prominent ears, and are wearing a basic t-shirt. The style of the drawing is cartoon-like, with clean lines and a friendly appearance.
A diagonally oriented yellow wooden pencil with a pointed graphite tip and two darker yellow bands near the tip. Next to the pencil is a typical block eraser with a blue paper sleeve around one half.

An illustration of a green book standing upright. On the cover, there are two stylized pink flowers with five petals each and a white center. Above the flowers is a white rectangle with the Korean text "수필집," translating as "essay collection." The book has a black outline, suggesting a bold, cartoonish aesthetic, and it is possibly associated with literature, education, or leisure reading.

The illustration shows the acronym "EUR," which is written in bold, black, uppercase letters against a white background. This acronym is used to denote the Euro, the official currency of the eurozone in the European Union. It has a clear and straightforward appearance suitable for a visual symbol indicating currency or related financial contexts.

Two hands holding an object resembling a banknote or a check. The banknote has a currency symbol that appears to represent the South Korean won (₩) followed by three zeros. Above the banknote, there is a red downward-pointing arrow, which could symbolize a decrease in value or expenditure. The image suggests the concept of spending money or making a payment.

name_en: Expiration Date - When Is It Until?
description_brief: A grey 3D cube with a magnifying glass focused on one of its surfaces. Inside the magnifying glass is Korean text that reads "유통기한 2012.12.25.8시," which translates to "Expiration date 2012.12.25.8AM" in English. The magnifying glass has a yellow rim and a brown handle.

A simplified, symbolic depiction of a person extinguishing a candle with a snuffer. The snuffer is stylized as a pair of pliers or scissors with a blue handle on the right side grasping the candle wick, with a downward-facing red arrow showing the motion towards the small flame on top of the candle. The candle is in a container with a clear outline showing the wax inside, and a single drop of wax is dripping down the side. The combination of elements represents the action of "putting out" or "extinguishing" a candle.

A simplified representation of a high-rise building with several windows, out of which smoke and flames are visible. To the right, there is a red fire engine, characterized by its distinct shape and the emergency lights on top. There is a dashed line that curves towards the building, indicating the movement of water being sprayed from the fire truck to extinguish the fire.

The logo of "FamilyMart," a convenience store chain. The logo features the store's name in stylized blue lettering with a green horizontal bar above and a blue one below the name. The logo is set against a plain white background.

A red square with rounded corners containing two rectangles side by side against a white outline, representing an entry or a gate. On the left is Korean text within a circle, indicating "빠른운행," meaning "Express Operation" or "Fast Track." On the right, the text reads "느린운행," signifying "Slow Operation" or "Regular Track." The image suggests a visual distinction between express and regular services.

A simplified, flat icon of a fax machine with a paper feed tray at the top, a digital screen highlighted in yellow, a numeric keypad, a series of operational buttons in various colors, and a handset on the left side. The icon is linear with minimal coloring, primarily in black, blue, red, and yellow, against a white background.

A simplified, flat-style depiction of a grey building facade with rows of windows. To the left of the building, there is a red square sign with a black 'W' symbol that mimics the look of a currency symbol. The sign appears to be attached or adjacent to the building.

The illustration shows a yellow rectangular paper or card that represents a receipt, invoice, or bill with Korean text at the top that reads "수수료". Below the text are several blank red lines and columns. To the right of the paper, there is a table with empty cells. In front of the paper, there are three coins overlapped, with numerical values "10", "10", and "100" visible, and the currency symbol '₩'. The coins are colored gold and grey, with the "100" coin being the largest and grey.

The illustration depicts a simplified representation of a 50,000 South Korean won banknote. On the right side, there's a portrait of a woman with a traditional hairstyle. The left side features a vertical bar with numbers and the numeric value "50000" is displayed in two places. The background color is mainly a gold or tan shade with patterns. Korean text translating to "Bank of Korea" and "fifty thousand won" is written on the right side, and a letter code (AB 000001 C) typically signifying a banknote's serial number is included.

A stylized human hand is pointing upward with its index finger, which has a rectangle resting on it, depicting a banknote with the number "10000" printed on it. Above the money, a downward-pointing arrow suggests the act of acquiring or earning money. This visually represents the Korean phrase "돈을찾아요," which means "to find or earn money."

An illustration depicts a fire station with a sign "119" above the building. The building is gray, two-story with windows on the upper floor. In the garage bay, there is a red fire truck with the number "119" on its side, equipped with a ladder on top.

Three towels or cloths, each a different color: one is yellow, the second is green, and the third is pink. They are displayed side by side with a slight overlap, positioned in a fan-like arrangement, showing their folded edges from an aerial perspective. Each towel appears to be neatly folded with cleanly defined corners.

An illustration featuring a person in a chef's hat standing behind a food stall with an orange and white striped awning. On the right side of the image, there's a customer depicted as moving towards the stall. The background is plain white. The image seems to represent a food-related transaction or activity.

A stylized graphic resembling a wing made of layered, curved lines. The upper portion of the design consists of lines in different shades of blue, while the lower section has lines in varying shades of red. Below this graphic is bold text that reads "KEB".

The illustration shows a simple representation of a book standing upright with its spine facing the viewer. The spine of the book is divided into three horizontal sections with the top and bottom in gray and the middle in yellow. Written in Hangul on the yellow section is the text "외국소설," which translates to "foreign novel" or "foreign fiction."

An illustration depicts a keypad with numbers from 1 to 9 arranged in a grid. The number 5 is highlighted in red with a large red question mark over it. Two Korean words, "정상" and "확인", are placed at the bottom and Korean text, "비밀번호를 잊어버렸어요" is displayed above the keypad. This symbolizes the concept of forgetting a password.

An illustration depicts a human hand holding a stack of cash with the number "1000" visible on the top bill. Overlaid on the image is a large red 'X', denoting the prohibition or negation of what is depicted, suggesting that payment is not required or something is free of charge. The Korean word "무료" (muryo), which translates to "free of charge" or "complimentary", is part of this image.

A stylized illustration of a book in vertical orientation with the spine visible on the left side. The cover of the book is primarily blue, and there is a title area at the top with Korean text. The text on the book reads "불어사전," which translates to "French dictionary."
A simple drawing of a fried egg with a yellow yolk in the center, on a flat surface or plate. The term "달걀", which represents "egg" in Korean, is used, suggesting a visual representation of an egg.

An illustration of a gas pump nozzle inserted into a fuel tank, which is stylized to represent a car's fueling point. The pump handle is on the left with a drop of fuel coming out of the nozzle. There is a line that leads to a circular element with an arrow pointing towards the center. There is an icon of a fuel canister with an "X" on it, placed below the pump handle. The icon is depicting the concept of refueling a vehicle.

A stylized, cartoonish character grinning broadly and holding up a notepad or sign. The sign displays a monetary symbol resembling a "W" with two horizontal lines through it. The character has a tuft of hair sticking up on the top of their head and is shown from the chest upward. The character's expression and posture suggest a positive attitude about financial matters.

A line art illustration of a gas pump with a rectangular body, a square-like window at the top, and a lower part that features a small rectangle and a drop icon indicating fuel. A fuel nozzle attached to a hose loops back into the body of the pump.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person holding a fuel pump nozzle. The person is wearing a red cap, an orange shirt with a collar, and blue pants. They are standing upright and smiling, looking directly at the viewer. The image represents services related to fuel or gasoline.

An illustration of a smiling person from the chest up, wearing a green shirt. In front of the person are two flat objects: a banknote with '100' written on it, and a yellow-bordered rectangle with the Korean text "용돈", which translates to "pocket money" or "allowance" in English.

An illustration of a stylized girl with two black ponytails, a pleasant expression, two dots for eyes and a curved line for a smile. Above her head, there is a pink T-shirt graphic, suggesting the concept of "size" as it relates to clothing for a girl. The overall design indicates "girls' sizes" in the context of daily life and social activities.

A hand with the index finger pointing towards a speech bubble. Inside the speech bubble, there is a crossed-out circle with a red arrow pointing towards a yellow triangle, symbolizing a request or the action of switching from one thing to another. It conveys the message "give me another one" or "I would like something different."

A stylized scenario with a representation of a storefront with an orange and brown awning over a green base, and a simplistically drawn figure of a person with dark hair, wearing a blue top, black pants, and walking to the right. A curved red arrow connects the store and the figure, indicating movement from the store to another location.

A simple cartoon-style drawing of a person standing upright, dressed in a long-sleeve turquoise shirt and blue pants. Their arms are crossed in front of them at waist level, with hands resting on the opposite forearms. The shoes are black.

A simple illustration of a green bell pepper. The bell pepper is depicted with a solid green color and outlined in black. It showcases the distinct shape of a bell pepper with three lobes bulging outwards and a small stem at the top. The illustration is flat with no shading or textural details.

The illustration depicts a person standing and smiling, waving their right hand. The person has short hair, is wearing a red top with a name tag, blue shorts, and dark shoes. This image represents friendly social interaction or greeting behavior.

An illustration of a salon or barber shop setting. A figure with short hair is seated in a salon chair. To the right stands another figure holding a pair of scissors in the right hand. Both characters have simple, cartoonish facial features. The standing figure is wearing a short-sleeved pink top, a white apron, and a knee-length skirt, while the seated figure is dressed in a short-sleeved shirt and pants.
A pair of teal or light blue shorts with a darker blue waistband. The shorts have pockets denoted by lines, and there is a simple button indicated at the waist.

A stylized hamburger with two brown buns, a layer representing a beef patty, a yellow layer that appears to be cheese, and a green layer that may represent lettuce. The image is simplified and uses flat colors.

An illustration featuring the Korean text "하나은행," with a stylized symbol above it. The symbol is a green-colored abstract figure that resembles a person with outstretched arms and a red circle representing the head. The figure is tilted to the right, appearing in action. The text is black, with a modern sans-serif font. The image likely represents the logo of "하나은행" (Hana Bank).

An illustration of a traditional Korean paper door, known as "Hanji door," depicted in a brownish-yellow color with a vertical seam down the middle, indicating two panels. A black circular door pull is on one side, and the top of the door is adorned with a decorative white and black strip.

A cartoon-style drawing of three people standing side by side. From left to right, there is a female figure with a short haircut, wearing a long-sleeve shirt and a knee-length skirt. Next to her stands a taller male figure, with short hair, wearing a long-sleeve sweater and pants. Lastly, a shorter male figure, likely a child, with short hair, wearing a short-sleeve shirt and shorts. Each figure has a slight smile. The image symbolizes "세대주," which can be interpreted as "head of household" or "primary household member".

The illustration depicts a stylized representation of an ondol, a traditional Korean underfloor heating system. It features a stone or brick platform with a water container on top. Above the container, there are three wavy lines suggesting heat emanating from the water. This image likely symbolizes the concept of a heated floor or the act of warming up a space.

A simplistic representation of a building with the label "Homeplus" on top. The building has a rectangular shape with a flat roof. It displays the name "Homeplus" in bold, red letters over a white background with a red border. There are two levels of the building shown, with six square windows evenly spaced across each level and a central door on the ground floor. The illustration likely represents a chain of retail stores or a shopping venue.

A simple, cartoon-style representation of a long-haired person wearing a pink long-sleeve top, a purple skirt and dark colored shoes. Above this person's head there is an icon consisting of three wavy lines emanating from a common point. This is possibly a representation of a pleasant smell or warmth, relating to the concept of "여택," which is 'hometainment' in Korean.
The image centers on the letters "HKD" in a bold, black font on a white background. There are no additional graphics or decorations in the image.

A square, tiled bathtub filled with water, viewed from a side angle. Above the tub, there are three red curved lines with a circular motion representing steam or heat emanating from the hot water. The image is a stylized representation of a hot bath or "온탕" in Korean.

name_en: How Long Can It Be Refrigerated?

The bottom part of the container is labeled with a "M" and a question mark before the letter "M", suggesting an inquiry or unknown regarding the object's content or function. The container is depicted in a minimalistic style with gray shading for depth and dimension, on a plain white background.

Two images, with the top one being a simple line drawing of a clock with its hands indicating approximately 10:10, and the bottom one depicting a film reel. The Korean phrase "몇시간동안해요", which translates to "How long does it take?" in English, is included.

The illustration depicts a red question mark on the left, an illustration of a right hand with red dashed lines circling the wrist in the upper right corner, and two banknotes with Korean won (₩) currency symbols followed by four zeros each below these symbols, indicating an unspecified amount of money. This could suggest questions about financial expenses due to a wrist injury.

An illustration of a piece of paper with "1장" written on it. Beside the paper, there is a stack of two coins on top of a green arrow pointing right, followed by a red question mark, suggesting a question about the cost or value of "one sheet/page." This represents a question about the price for a single piece of paper or document.
A simple graphic with a black "0%" and a bold red plus sign to its right, set against a white background. The image conveys the concept of '0% interest' or 'no additional percentage'.

An image contains three elements: a stack of currency bills on the left with the number "10000" visible, a red cross or plus sign in the center, and three coins on the right, with numbers "100" and "10" displayed on them. These elements suggest financial transactions, savings, or budgeting activities.

A blank white paper sheet standing upright on the left side. On the right, there are two coins lying on top of what appears to be two green banknotes. Above the money, there is a red question mark, indicating inquiry or confusion about the money. The illustration suggests a theme related to financial transactions, budgeting, or possibly the cost of an item or service. The phrase "한장에얼마에요" which translates to "How much is it per sheet?" is included.

A flat illustration of a person holding a large piece of paper or a document. The stylized character has a round head, a gentle smile, short hair, and is wearing a teal-colored top. Their left hand is pointing to a specific line on the paper.

A simplified image of a thick book with a grey and beige cover. The cover has Korean text on it, which reads "인문학", translating to "Humanities" in English. The visual representation suggests the concept of studying or knowledge within the humanities discipline. There is subtle shading on the spine and the pages to give a sense of depth to the book.

A logo of a rectangular design split into two equal parts, with the left side teal and the right side yellow. The word "HYUNDAI" is written in capital letters, in a bold, sans-serif font, across the center of the rectangle, over both colored halves. The lettering is black.

An illustration with a red circle at the top and a simple representation of a smiling person's face below. The face features two dots for eyes, a small curved line for the mouth, and a straight line across the top depicting a person with short hair and a cheerful expression.

The illustration shows a stylized person with a neutral or slightly displeased facial expression pointing to a T-shirt. Above the T-shirt, there is a red "X" mark, indicating prohibition or disapproval. The overall image suggests that the person is expressing a negative sentiment towards the T-shirt.

A stylized face with a neutral to slightly displeased expression. The face has two black dot eyes with a furrowed expression and a straight, thin mouth. The character has black hair on top of the head. To the left side of the face, there are chopsticks directed towards the mouth, with a small, red dashed circle indicating motion or the path towards the mouth. The background is plain and white. The phrase "먹기싫어요" (meokgi silheoyo), translating to "I don't want to eat," is present in the image.

The illustration features a graphic of a brown wallet with credit cards or identification cards inside it. Below, there is a red "X" mark, along with a simplistic illustration of a person, with a neutral expression, pointing or gesturing upwards with their right hand. The person is wearing a teal-colored long-sleeve shirt. The overall image conveys the concept of losing or missing a wallet, potentially indicating the action of reporting or searching for a lost wallet.

A cartoon character who appears to be a cheerful young boy with brown hair, smiling. There's a speech bubble coming out from his side which contains a simple drawing of a blue square. He is wearing a white t-shirt with dashed red lines around the bottom.

A stylized human hand with palm facing up. On the hand are three coins, two of them are marked "100" and one in the center is marked "500". Below the hand, there is Korean text "돈 필요해요" which translates to "I need money" in English. This visual represents the concept of needing money.

name_en: I want to cut my hair
description_brief: A simplified, cartoon-style representation of a person with a round face, a smiling expression, featuring dot eyes and a simple line for a mouth. The person has black hair styled in a short, straight cut above the forehead. They are wearing a yellow top with a rounded collar over a gray base. The image conveys a friendly and approachable appearance.

name_en: I want to get a haircut
description_brief: A stylized character with a smiling facial expression. The character is wearing a helmet with a transparent visor, and their hair, depicted in brown with orange highlights, is visible underneath. The character is also wearing a garment with a grey collar over a pink shirt. The depiction is simple and graphic.

name_en: I Want To Print In Color
description_brief: A simple illustration of a color printer, with the main body being gray and the paper tray in an open position. A single sheet of paper is emerging from the printer, with three colored circles—yellow, blue, and red—visible on the sheet, representing printed colors.

name_en: I Want to Proceed with the Plan
description_brief: Three simplified, cartoon-like figures stand in a row. The left figure is raising their right arm to point forwards, while the middle and right figures stand with their arms by their sides. All three figures have a minimalistic design, with no facial features except for a simple line to represent closed eyes, and they're all wearing long-sleeve shirts and pants in a matching color scheme. The overall image conveys the idea of someone wanting to move forward.

name_en: I want to see it again
description_brief: A circular icon with an arrow curving counterclockwise, symbolizing repetition or replay. Inside the circular arrow, there is a central play button icon represented by a rightward-facing triangle. The color scheme includes a red arrow outline with a blue central circle that houses the white play symbol. The icon represents the idea of "다시보고싶어요," translating to "I want to see it again."

An illustration showing two open eyes looking upwards towards a speech bubble. Inside the speech bubble, there is a hand pointing to three dotted outlines of circles. The style uses a black outline for the drawings with the exception of the dotted circles, which are red.

name_en: I Want to Travel the World
description_brief: Two animated characters, one wearing a teal shirt and the other wearing a gray shirt, looking down at a large, open map that they appear to be holding between them. The map is a simplified representation, showing landmasses with dotted lines possibly indicating a travel route or connected locations. The characters are depicted with simple facial features, conveying a sense of neutrality or contentment. The background is plain white.

A cartoon of a smiling person pressing a large, round button. The person has short, brown hair and is wearing a white T-shirt and brown pants. Their right hand is extended, pushing the button, which appears to vibrate. At the top right of the image, there is a red circle with a white "X" mark inside it.

A stylized person smiling and raising their right thumb up, wearing a green long-sleeve shirt. Next to the character, there's a T-shirt icon in a lighter shade of green. Above the person, there is a red circle representing correct choice or confirmation.
