description_brief: The illustration features a cute cartoon piggy bank, a calendar page with a large red question mark, and a small stack of three golden coins. The piggy bank is pink with featured details like eyes, nostrils, and ears. The calendar page appears to be flipped to show its back side. The background is plain white. The image is intended to convey concepts related to savings, financial planning, and financial uncertainty.

A simple graphic of a paper with text lines and bullet points, some of which are checked off in red. To the right of the paper is a large red question mark, indicating uncertainty, a need for information, or a questionnaire to be filled out.

name_en: Where is my certificate and gold?
description_brief: A stylized person with a smile, raising their right arm to point at a large ticket or receipt. The ticket has two sections; the left side is yellow with blank rectangles, and the right side is salmon-colored with the acronym "OCR" and the number "400051" at the top. Below this are several horizontal lines suggestive of text fields. The ticket appears to be perforated along a vertical line near the "OCR" section, suggesting it may be torn or separated along this line. The illustration represents someone presenting or indicating a document or voucher.

A black and white icon of a computer monitor. On the screen of the monitor, there is an open book graphic with a magnifying glass focused on the text "BOOK." Above the monitor, there is Hangul text "어디에요?" which translates to "Where is it?". The icon represents the concept of searching for a book.

A simple representation of a fitting room featuring a square with the words "FITTING ROOM" at the top. Inside the square, a drawing of a door is seen on the left side and a red clothing hanger along with a large red question mark on the right. The imagery suggests a spot for trying on clothes. The question mark might imply inquiry or the need for assistance.

name_en: Where is the community center/social welfare center?
description_brief: An illustration of a stylized person on the right side, with raised arm pointing towards the upper left corner. Above the person, there is a red question mark. On the upper left side, a large building with multiple windows and Korean signage reading "주민센터" and "사회복지관" which translates to "Community Center" and "Social Welfare Center" respectively. The image suggests the person is looking for these locations.

A cartoon-like person in a green top is smiling, pointing upwards to their right with one hand, and has a speech bubble with a question mark above their head. Behind the person is a bookshelf filled with books, to the right side. The image conveys a sense of inquiry or seeking information.

A stylized, black-and-white illustration of a bookshelf with various books arranged on its shelves. Above the bookshelf, there's Korean text that reads "어디예요?" which translates to "Where is it?" in English. There is also a blank space with "OO코너" written underneath, implying a placeholder where a specific location or name might be inserted.

The illustration features a pair of grey double doors that are closed with simple black handles. To the right of these doors is a large, red question mark. The image suggests a question concerning the location of an entrance.

A stylized illustration of a shopping cart in a dashed line style with a red question mark above it. The shopping cart symbolizes commerce or shopping, while the question mark suggests confusion, uncertainty, or a need for assistance related to shopping.

An illustration features a pair of grey doors, above which there’s a rectangular sign with a yellow background and black borders that reads "매장입구" in Korean letters, translating to "store entrance." To the right side of the doors, a prominent red question mark is depicted, suggesting uncertainty or the act of searching for the store entrance. The image has a white background.

An illustration depicts a person standing next to a water cooler. The water cooler has a blue water bottle on top of a white dispenser. The person, who appears happy and is smiling, is raising their right hand pointing towards the water cooler. The person has short hair, is wearing a long-sleeved green shirt, and has a cartoon-like appearance.

name_en: Where Should I Hang This Coat?
description_brief: A simple line drawing of a square representing a room with a door. To the right of the room, there is a coat hanger with one item of clothing on it outside the room. A large, red question mark, also functioning as an arrow, points from the hanger to the door, suggesting motion or direction. The image conveys a sense of inquiry or decision-making related to placing the clothing into the room.

The illustration contains two main elements on a plain background. On the left, there is a simple line drawing that represents a pair of chopsticks holding a circular object outlined by a dotted line. On the right side, there is a large red question mark. The symbolism appears to relate to the concept of sight or vision in daily life.

A simplified representation of an open gate or doorway, divided into four numbered sections. The gates are labeled "1관" on the left and "2관" on the right, which translates to "Hall 1" and "Hall 2" or "Pavilion 1" and "Pavilion 2" in Korean. In the center, where the two sides of the gate meet, there's a large red question mark. The image seems to symbolize a choice or decision point between two options or paths. It symbolizes uncertainty or the need to make a decision.

Two columns of elevator buttons with numbers indicating floors from basement levels B2 and B1 to floor 10. On the right side, there is a large red question mark. This illustration represents the concept of "Which floor is it?" in Korean.

A film strip or frame with a white background featuring two identical silhouetted head profiles facing each other on either side of a central red question mark. The head profiles are gray and have a neutral, generic human shape without facial features. The entire image is bordered by what appears to be the perforations of a film strip.

An illustration contains Hangul characters that read "주인공?" which translates to "Protagonist?" or "Main character?" in English. To the right of the text, there is a red question mark. The text and question mark are presented on a plain white background.

name_en: Will you register for Internet banking?
description_brief: A computer monitor displaying an image of a bank card and an open banknote booklet with Korean won currency denominations (₩1,000 and ₩10,000) visible. The image represents the concept of online or internet banking services.

A simple, black-on-white icon features the Korean character "원" (won), which is the currency unit of South Korea, depicted in a bold and stylized manner. The symbol has two distinct horizontal strokes through a "W" like shape. The background is plain white and the icon is surrounded by a light grey border. This icon is commonly associated with monetary transactions or financial topics in Korean daily life and social activities.

The illustration depicts two banknotes and three coins symbolizing money. The banknotes appear to have the South Korean won (₩) symbol, and the denominations on them contain zeroes. The coins have a numeric value of 100 written on them, indicating South Korean currency.

A line drawing of a circular object with a hole in the center, resembling a large bead, spool, or a simplified representation of a traditional Korean brass coin. The object has a cylindrical sidewall and a curved indentation on one side. The illustration is simple, with no shading or textural details.

Graphical text in a stylized font with Korean characters "우리은행" in blue color. Accompanying the text on the left side is a blue icon that appears to represent a stylized image of a bank or a financial institution, featuring an abstract depiction of a coin or the sun over a horizon, all enclosed in a partial circular shape resembling the letter "C" turned on its side. The overall image suggests it is a logo or branding for a bank or financial service named "우리은행".

A stylized representation of a book standing upright with the cover divided into two sections - the upper section is yellow, lower section is grey. The text "문제집," which translates to "workbook," is written in black on the yellow section. The spine of the book is visible in a darker shade, and several lines on the side of the book represent pages.
The black letters "XL" in a bold, sans-serif typeface against a white background, possibly representing "extra large" size designation in products.
Black text "XS" on a white background in uppercase with a bold, modern sans-serif typeface, used to represent the extra small size in clothing or other products.

The image shows the letters "XXL" in a bold, capital letter, sans-serif font. The letters are in black on a white background. The "XXL" typically represents an extra-extra-large size in clothing or other products.

A logo composed of the letters "YP BOOKS" in a sans-serif, grey font. Above the letters, there is a graphic symbol with three abstract shapes resembling petals or leaves, colored in blue, green, and yellow. Below the English letters "YP BOOKS" is the Korean text "영풍문고" in a matching grey font. Likely represents a brand or entity associated with books or literature.

A hand is pointing to a document titled "취학통지서" in Korean, which translates to "School Enrollment Notification" in English. The hand appears to be a right hand with the thumb touching the center of the paper. There are a couple of lines on the document suggesting text or content below the title.

name_en: Arrived at the Postnatal Care Center
description_brief: A simplified representation of a woman standing in the doorway of a building with the Korean text "산후조리원" above, which translates to "postnatal care center". The woman is holding a baby in her arms and is smiling. Both the woman and the baby are depicted in a cartoonish style with minimal details. The building façade has several small square windows. The image conveys the concept of a woman and her newborn baby at a facility designed for the care and recovery of mothers after childbirth.

The illustration depicts a simple cartoon image of a baby. The baby appears bald on top with a band of hair around the sides and back of the head, and is standing upright. The baby has a pacifier in its mouth and is wearing a white diaper. The word "아기" meaning "baby" in Korean is also featured.

A stylized image of a pregnant woman standing to the right of a storefront. The storefront has a sign in Korean that reads "아기용품점," which translates to "baby supplies store." The storefront has a pink and white striped awning and two closed doors with circular handles. The woman, with black hair and wearing a pink dress along with blue shoes, is facing the shop. Her belly is visibly enlarged, indicating pregnancy. She has one hand on her belly.

A stylized figure of a person wearing traditional Korean attire, known as hanbok. The attire consists of a short jacket with long sleeves (jeogori) in a light green color, and a full-length, high-waisted wrap-around skirt (chima) in red with white decorative details near the hem. The figure has simple facial features with black hair in a bun-like style with two pins. The figure is also holding their hands together in front. This image represents a bride ("신부") in Korean culture.

A flat design illustration of an adult in a green long-sleeve shirt holding a calm baby. The baby is holding a white round object, possibly a toy or pacifier. Next to them is a document with the Korean text "양육권", translating to "custody", followed by several lines suggesting text below.

An open Korean traditional jewelry box with decorative flower blossoms at the center. On the right side, there's a yellow traditional Korean pouch (bokjumeoni) with a tied red ribbon with pink edges. In the background, there are layers of document or paper outlines. Above the image, there's Korean text "혼수," which translates to "dowry." The image context relates to Korean culture, particularly in the context of marriage.

A stylized drawing of a dress with a short-sleeved top and a long skirt portion. There is a colored band at the waist, separating the top from the skirt. The skirt has three circular details at the bottom, which could be decorative elements or buttons. The dress is in a flat, minimalistic style, representing clothing or fashion in contexts like marriage, childbirth, or child-rearing. The color scheme consists of a primary color for the dress, with a contrasting color for the waistband and detail elements.

An illustration of a person standing upright and smiling, wearing traditional Korean attire, hanbok, with a light blue jeogori decorated with simple patterns around the collar and cuffs and dark blue pants. The person's hands are gently crossed in front, holding onto a fabric or an item that matches the color of the jeogori. The individual has black hair. The illustration is presented in a minimalistic, cartoon-like style using solid colors and bold outlines.

An illustration featuring two figures—a man and a woman—dressed in wedding attire. The male figure is wearing a dark suit and tie while the female figure is dressed in a white bridal gown and veil, holding a small bouquet of yellow flowers. Above them is a circular outline. Below the couple, there's a large, stylized drawing of an airplane.

A cartoon-like depiction of a young child standing upright and facing forward. The child has short hair, a smiling face, and is dressed in a long-sleeved teal shirt, blue shorts, and dark-colored shoes. The design is minimalistic with clear lines and solid colors. The image symbolizes youth or childhood in the context of marriage, childbirth, and child-rearing.
A simple, stylized house with a brown roof, beige walls, and a white door with a black doorknob. Above the house, there is Korean text "시대" which can be translated as "marriage".

A simple representation of a house with a brown roof, an orange facade, and a white door with a round doorknob. Above the house image, there is Korean text "친정" which translates as "parental home" or "one's parents' house." The visual encapsulates a concept associated with the family home or where one's parents live.

An illustration depicting two figures, a couple, standing behind a table laden with food. The person on the left is dressed in a blue traditional outfit with their hands crossed over their chest holding a pouch. The person on the right is wearing a green and red traditional outfit, also with their hands crossed and holding a pouch. A large roasted chicken or duck in the center of the table, flanked by two large piles of what could be rice cakes or another type of traditional food, one pile on each side of the bird. The table appears to be set for a ceremony or celebration, potentially symbolizing a traditional Korean pyebaek ceremony.

The illustration shows a rectangular document with Korean text that translates to "childcare support application" in English. Below the document, there are two hands with the palms facing up, suggesting an act of offering or requesting. The overall image represents a request for childcare support.

A simplistic stylized design with a house and a smiling person standing next to it. The house is a brown structure with an orange roof and a white door. To the house's right is a young person, represented with a round head, dots for eyes, a line for a mouth, and a straight line for the body. The figure is wearing a green shirt and blue shorts. Above the image is Korean text that reads "어린이집보내요," which translates to "send (a child) to daycare", indicating the illustration is related to child care services.

A simplified representation of a grey suit with a black-collar detail, black lapels, and a single black button in the center, along with a pair of matching grey trousers. The illustration uses flat colors and is done in a stylized, iconographic manner without any background.

name_en: Want to Make a Postnatal Care Center Reservation
description_brief: An illustration showing a building with multiple windows, labeled "산후조리원" (postnatal care center). Above it is a red question mark. On the right side, there is a clock pointing at around ten minutes to two, with the word "예약" (reservation) above it. The image represents scheduling an appointment with a postnatal care center.

name_en: We ask you to host our wedding ceremony
description_brief: Three figures against a white background. On the left, there is a figure holding a microphone. In the middle and right of the image are two figures standing next to each other, one is wearing a black suit while the other is dressed in a white gown with a veil and holding a bouquet. The image is accompanied by the Korean text "결혼식사회부탁드립니다" which translates to "We ask you to host our wedding ceremony."

An illustration featuring two cartoon figures side by side. On the left, a figure representing a man is dressed in a formal black suit and bow tie. On the right, the figure depicting a woman is adorned in a traditional white wedding dress with a belt and a veil. They both have simple, smiling faces. The image symbolizes a wedding ceremony.

A simplified depiction of a bride and groom standing next to a tiered wedding cake. The groom is dressed in a black suit with a white shirt and a black tie. The bride, wearing a pink wedding dress with white trim and a floral headband. The wedding cake between them has three tiers, adorned with red dots, and a single red candle on top.

An illustration of a traditional Korean wedding ceremony. There are three figures, an older woman dressed in a hanbok in the center, a man dressed in a dark suit-like attire to the left, and a bride in a white wedding hanbok to the right. The figures are possibly an officiant or an elder relative, and a couple. This appears to be an icon or a symbol representing a Korean wedding ceremony.

A black and white line drawing of a multi-story building with the Korean text "예식장" (wedding hall) written above it. The building has a large number of windows arranged evenly across three floors, with a prominent archway entrance at the center of the ground floor.

The illustration depicts a simplified representation of a bride and groom standing side by side next to a camera. The groom is wearing a black suit with a tie, while the bride is in a white wedding gown with a veil and holding a bouquet of flowers. To their right is a stylized camera, indicating the concept of wedding photography. The image symbolizes wedding photography and fits within the category of marriage and related events.

A stylized character holding a microphone, surrounded by a vibrant display of colorful balloons in shades of blue, pink, yellow, and red. The character is smiling and wearing a blue outfit with a tie. Additionally, festive confetti or decoration elements are visible around the balloons.

name_en: When is the expected delivery date?
description_brief: A pregnant woman, in a side profile showing her belly, is standing to the left. She has long black hair, is wearing a pink dress, and appears to be cradling her belly with both hands. To the right of the woman is a calendar with the text "출산예정일", translating to "due date". Above the calendar is a large red question mark.

name_en: Where do I send the celebration money?
description_brief: An illustration depicts a light brown envelope slightly open to reveal a stack of South Korean 50,000 won banknotes inside. Above the envelope, there's Korean text “축의금어디서내요” which translates to "Where do I send the celebration money?" The overall image represents a gift of money given during significant events in Korean culture.

A simplified world map outline with only the continent of Africa highlighted in yellow. The rest of the continents are in black lines without any fill. The countries within Africa are not delineated. The focal point is Africa standing out in the center of the image.

A simplified, outline map of the world with the continents depicted. North and South America are highlighted in yellow, distinguishing them from the other continents. The remaining continents are only outlined with no fill color. There are no country borders or other geographic details present within the individual continents.

A simple outline of the world map with the continents clearly depicted. There is a stylized, highlighted shape that appears to represent Antarctica in the bottom left corner, filled in with a yellow color. This highlighted portion represents the Korean word "남극" (namgeuk), meaning "Antarctica".
A simplified world map with Asia highlighted in yellow. The map outlines are in black, and the rest of the world is not colored, only defined by their black outlines.

A simplified, grey outline of the continent of Australia positioned above a flag. The flag consists of a dark blue background with the Union Jack in the upper left corner and a large white seven-pointed star below it, directly under the Union Jack. To the right, there is a constellation of white stars, one large seven-pointed star and four smaller seven-pointed stars along with one small five-pointed star forming the Southern Cross constellation.

A grey outline of the map of Canada, including its distinctive geography with multiple inlets and islands, particularly in the northern Arctic region. Below the map, there is an image of the Canadian flag, which consists of two vertical red stripes on either end and a white square in the middle bearing a red maple leaf. The flag is a simplified depiction with flat colors.

A simple grey outline map of China is on the left. On the right, an image of the national flag of China, featuring a red field with five yellow stars in the top-left corner. The word "중국", which translates to China in Korean, is also present.

A simplified world map with the continental outlines in black and Europe highlighted in yellow. The other continents and landmasses are not colored and are just outlined. The illustration is more symbolic than an accurate cartographic representation.

An illustration showing a simple, grey outline of France's mainland territorial shape on the left and a rectangle split into three vertical stripes colored blue, white, and red on the right, representing the national flag of France.
An outline of Germany's map in gray next to its flag, which has three horizontal stripes in black, red, and yellow from top to bottom. The background of the illustration is white.

A smiling person rides atop an airplane, appearing cheerful and waving. There is a document with lines of text and what seems to be an official seal or ribbon, indicating an award or certificate of achievement above the airplane to the left. The text "유학 가요," which translates to "going to study abroad" in Korean, is also visible in the image. The overall image conveys a sense of accomplishment and international travel for educational purposes.

An illustration of a flag with three horizontal stripes; top stripe in saffron color, middle stripe in white with a navy blue wheel with 24 spokes called the Ashoka Chakra, and the bottom stripe in dark green. This is the national flag of India.

A simplified, stylized world map with the outlines of the continents drawn in black. The continent of Asia, particularly the Indian subcontinent, is highlighted in blue. The rest of the continents are not colored and are left white.

The illustration shows the flag of Italy, a vertical tricolor consisting of three equal vertical bands of green, white, and red from left to right with the green band on the hoist side. There are no emblems or other details on the flag.

The illustration depicts a simple outline of the Japanese archipelago, consisting of four main islands and some smaller ones, alongside the national flag of Japan, with a white background and a central red circle. The term "일본" is Korean for Japan.

The national flag of Mexico, a vertical tricolor of green, white, and red, with the national coat of arms centered in the white band. The coat of arms depicts an eagle perched on a prickly pear cactus, devouring a snake, set against a background comprising wreaths of oak and laurel leaves.

A simplified world map with the continents outlined in black, and the region representing North America highlighted in yellow. The map does not include country borders or geographic details and is centered on a universal Mercator-like projection with emphasis on North America.

An outline map of the Korean peninsula in grayscale, including both the southern and northern parts, shown as a single landmass. On the right, a flag of North Korea, featuring a central red band, bordered by narrower white bands above and below, with a blue stripe at the top and bottom. Within the central red band, there's a white disk with a red star. The elements symbolize North Korea.

A simple, stylized outline of a world map with the continents displayed. The Korean peninsula, which stands for North Korea, is highlighted in yellow. The rest of the map is in black and white. The map does not have any other labels or detailed geographical features. The highlighted area in yellow is on the far, right side of the image.

An outlined illustration of a world map with Oceania, comprising Australia, New Zealand, and the numerous islands of the Pacific Ocean, highlighted in yellow. The rest of the continents are depicted in outline without any highlights.

A stylized world map with the continents outlined in black. The Pacific Ocean is highlighted in a blue color, drawing attention to this area. The rest of the continents and oceans are uncolored, maintaining the white background of the image. The map has distorted proportions that focus on the Pacific region.

The image showcases a simplified outline of the Philippine archipelago on the left side. On the right side, it depicts the flag of the Philippines, which consists of two horizontal bands of blue and red, a white equilateral triangle at the left containing a golden-yellow sun with eight rays and three five-pointed stars in each corner of the triangle.

An illustration shows a simplified black line drawing of the Korean Peninsula on the left and a colored drawing of the South Korean flag, the Taegukgi, on the right. The flag features a white background with a central red and blue yin and yang symbol, called the Taeguk, and four black trigrams positioned at each corner of the flag.
A flag with three horizontal stripes: white on top, blue in the middle, and red at the bottom, which is the national flag of Russia.

A simplified map of the world with the continents outlined. The region representing South America is highlighted with color, differentiating it from the rest of the uncolored continents. The term "남아메리카," which translates to "South America" from Korean is represented. The rest of the continents - North America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Oceania are outlined but not colored. There are no country borders or additional details—just the basic continental shapes.

The national flag of Spain consists of three horizontal bands of color: a wide central band of yellow which is double the height of each of the red bands above and below it. On the yellow band towards the hoist side, there is an ornate coat of arms featuring a shield adorned with a number of different heraldic symbols, including castles, lions, and chains. The shield is flanked by two columns, and it is topped by a royal crown. The columns are wrapped with banners displaying the motto "PLUS ULTRA."

An abstract gray-colored outline of a geographic shape on the left. On the right, a rectangular flag with five horizontal stripes of alternating colors: red, white, blue, white, and red, from top to bottom, with the blue stripe being thicker. The color pattern is characteristic of the national flag of Thailand. The Korean text "태극" is accompanying the image.
The illustration shows a grey line drawing of the geographic outline of Great Britain and a colored square featuring the Union Jack, the flag of the United Kingdom.

An uncolored outline of the geographical shape of the United States. An image of the US flag, or the "Stars and Stripes," with its thirteen horizontal stripes alternating red and white, and a blue rectangle in the canton bearing fifty white stars arranged in nine offset horizontal rows.
A flag with a red background and a large, centered, five-pointed yellow star. The flag represents the country of Vietnam.

A black line drawing of a world map on a white background, focused on the outline of the continents. On the left-hand side of the map, there is a specific highlighting in blue color that covers a portion of a continent's outline, which resembles the western coast of South America, including countries like Chile and Peru. The highlighting is a thick blue line following the coastal contour.

Illustration of three figures standing side by side. A male figure in the center, wearing a teal shirt and blue pants. Two female figures on either side, one in a pink dress and another in a yellow shirt and skirt. Above each female figure's head is a red heart, indicating romantic feelings towards the male. Characters are facing forward, with the male smiling and the females looking towards the male with neutral expressions. This might symbolize a love triangle.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person with short hair and a smiling face. The person is wearing a long-sleeved teal shirt and is extending the left arm outward with the index finger pointing outward. Around the fingertips, there are three curved lines suggesting movement or pointing. The background is plain and white. The image appears to represent a pointer gesture indicating "attention" or "pointing something out." The phrase "유의해요" is represented in the image.

A cartoon-style representation of a person's upper body, shown with a neutral expression, short hair and wearing a teal-colored shirt. A large red arrow points to the right. The Korean word "아까" (romanized as "akkga"), which translates to "a while ago", is present above the arrow.

The illustration depicts a person on the left with a neutral expression, short hair, wearing a teal shirt. On the right, there is a vertical bar graph with five bars. These bars are colored from top to bottom as red, pink, orange, light orange, and yellow. The image symbolizes "능력" (capability or ability) in the "Others" category.

The image depicts the international symbol of access, featuring a stylized white figure seated in a wheelchair, which is shown in profile view and appears to be in motion with small lines indicating movement at the rear wheel. The figure and the wheelchair are positioned inside a circle. The entire symbol, including the circle, figure, and wheelchair, is outlined in green.

A simplified, cartoon-style character is standing and facing forward. The character has a round head with two dots for eyes and a straight line for the mouth, creating a neutral expression. The person is wearing a long-sleeved teal shirt and dark blue pants. One arm is raised higher than the other, with a curved red arrow close to the lower arm, symbolizing movement or an action such as lifting the arm. The image is designed to convey the concept of motion or action ("동작" in Korean).
The illustration features two square outlines separated by a red plus sign centered between them, on a white background. The image resembles a simple mathematical addition equation.

An illustration of a building with multiple windows. A sign with Korean text, translating to "admission ticket" or "entry ticket" in English, is placed below the building. A red arrow points upwards from the sign towards the building's entrance.

Simple illustration with two parallel lines connected by two yellow dots, one at each end. The upper line is straight while the lower one curves downwards before swooping up into an red upwards-pointing arrow on the right-hand side. The illustration likely symbolizes the concept of "다시," which translates to "again" in Korean.

The illustration depicts a variety of alcoholic beverages. From left to right, there is a frothy beer in a mug, a green bottle (possibly beer or soju), a brown bottle (possibly a different type of alcohol), a wine glass filled with red wine, and a small bowl that could contain a traditional Korean liquor.

A simple, flat design featuring a square with rounded corners outlined by a dotted line. Inside this square are twelve circles arranged in a 3x4 grid, each circle has a solid outline. The background is white, and the lines and dots are in black and red, respectively.

A cartoon-style drawing of a person sitting on steps or a platform. The person has a content expression with a small smile and is wearing a teal or green shirt, blue pants, and gray shoes. The steps are colored in a beige or light brown shade. The individual is sitting comfortably with their hands placed on their knees on a white background.

Two figures standing side by side. On the left is a figure dressed in traditional Korean attire, specifically a hanbok, with a jeogori (jacket), baji (pants), and a black gat, which is a traditional Korean hat. The figure is also holding a closed fan or a small item in the left hand. On the right is a figure wearing contemporary clothing, including a teal-colored long-sleeve shirt and blue pants. Above the two figures, there is a red, inverted triangle pointing downwards.

An illustration depicts a man and a woman standing in front of a table set for a traditional Korean ancestral ritual, "제사" (Jesa). The table holds two symmetrical stacks of food items and a small pagoda-like structure with a hanging scroll that features Korean script. The table is covered with a light brown cloth. The man is in a grey suit and the woman in a white dress with a knee-length skirt.

A simplified illustration of a calendar with numbers on them. The calendar has a green tab and displays the number "1". In front of this are two detached pages overlapping each other, showing the numbers "2" and "3" respectively, with the number "3" being the most prominent. A fourth page, slightly detached from the others, displays the number "4". The numbers are in bold. This image could symbolize counting, dates, sequencing, or time passing.

An illustration of three stylized human figures standing side by side. The left figure is wearing a long-sleeve gray top and light brown pants, the middle figure is dressed in a short-sleeve blue top and gray pants, and the third one is in a short-sleeve green top and dark gray shorts. They are all smiling. Above the figures, there is Korean text "모습," which translates to "appearance" or "form". The figures are enclosed within a dotted pink border on a white background.

name_en: I'm borrowing a Gat (Korean traditional hat)
description_brief: A character viewed from behind with a round, black head, wearing a teal shirt and blue pants, with hands clasped behind at the lower back. To the left of the character's head, there is a light blue speech bubble that contains a white silhouette of a traditional Korean gat (horsehair hat). Next to the right side of the character's head, there are three small black ellipses, representing the character talking or thinking about the hat. The image represents a person thinking or talking about a traditional Korean hat.

A stylized figure standing upright with a round head, no discernible facial features, wearing a long-sleeved green top and dark pants. The figure's arms are outstretched forward, holding an orange square object that is radiating lines. This could represent a person receiving an alert or notification.

A stylized person with a simple, smiling face, short hair, and wearing a teal shirt. Above and to the right of the person's head, there is a thought bubble composed of dashed lines, implying that the person is thinking or daydreaming. The thought bubble is empty.

A cartoon-style person falling downwards, with a red arrow above them pointing down. The person's arms are outstretched and one leg is bent at the knee, suggesting motion. Below the person is an outline of an oval shape. The character is wearing a teal top and blue pants. They have a round head with a facial expression of surprise or concern.

A stylized character with a concerned or sad facial expression, standing with their hands together. To the left of the character, there is a speech bubble containing an icon of a nearly empty battery. Above and to the right side of the character, there are two small leaf-like shapes, possibly indicating a sigh or a feeling of exhaustion. The character is wearing a teal or green long-sleeve shirt and blue pants. The illustration represents someone feeling tired or drained, similar to a low battery.

The illustration features a stylized representation of a face or possibly a mask in orange and white. The lower half of the face has a white piece with red dashed lines, suggesting a mouth covered by a tape or a bandage. Lines are emanating from the covering, indicating movement, force, or sound. The image gives the impression of speech being prohibited or someone being gagged.

A small house with a simple design and an orange roof, a green car with a grey trailer, and a joyfully expressing person in a wheelchair raising arms and smiling, wearing a blue shirt with grey pants, against a plain white background.

An illustration of a person with a neutral or slightly displeased facial expression. The person has short hair, is wearing a teal-colored long-sleeved shirt, and has their arms crossed in front of them.

The illustration features a stylized character wearing a teal or green shirt, with black hair, small dot eyes, and a round open mouth. The character's arms are crossed in front, and there is a puff of white air or cloud coming from their mouth, indicating they are sighing or exhaling heavily.

A stylized representation of a person from the waist up, with a short haircut, rounded red cheeks, placing both hands on their cheeks. They have a surprised or shocked expression with wide-open mouth and large oval eyes directed straight ahead. There are two simple lines curling at the end above the head, possibly indicating confusion. The person is wearing a teal-colored top with short sleeves, and the background is plain white.

A cartoon-style boy standing between two tall, vertical rectangles that give the appearance of walls. The boy has a troubled, slightly sad expression on his face, and his posture is submissive, with his head slightly down and hands together in front of him. The rectangles create a narrow space around the boy, suggesting a tight or confined environment.

The illustration shows a person from the waist up with a neutral expression. They have short black hair and are wearing a long-sleeved, gray shirt. They are gesturing with their right hand, placing their index finger to their temple.

A character with a neutral or slightly unsettled facial expression, covering their ears with both hands. The character has short, straight hair and is wearing a teal or turquoise shirt. The background is plain white.

A simple cartoon-styled face with a sad or disappointed expression, brown hair and eyebrows, downturned eyes, and a turned downward mouth. The face is a lighter shade, with simple lines indicating details, and additional marks on cheeks which might be interpreted as freckles. The face aligns with the phrase "못생겼어요" (mot saeng-gyeoss-eoyo), which means "I'm ugly" or "unattractive" in Korean.

A stylized figure with a simplified facial expression, short tidy hair and a neutral smile. They are wearing a teal long-sleeve shirt and holding an open book or pamphlet in their left hand. The figure's right index finger is raised in a gesture that suggests they are making a point or have an idea. Above the figure's raised finger, there is a red exclamation mark, which represents surprise, attention, or an important statement. The background is plain white. The overall style is cartoonish.

The illustration features a young cartoon character smiling and pointing upwards with their right hand's index finger. A brightly lit yellow light bulb with glow lines is to the left side of the character's head. The character is wearing a short-sleeved shirt, and their left arm is resting at their side. The color palette includes shades of yellow, red, brown, and white.

A simple, stylized illustration of a person from the shoulders up. The figure has a round head, black hair, two dots for eyes, and a curved line for a smile, creating a friendly appearance. The person is wearing a long-sleeved teal-colored shirt. Above the illustration, there is Korean text "만약에" written in black on a plain white background.

A stylized, cartoonish figure of a person with a neutral facial expression, short haircut, and a green long-sleeved shirt. They are raising their right hand slightly with their palm open, as if gesturing or presenting something. To the right of the figure is a large red question mark. Above the figure, there is text in Korean script "왜나하면" which translates to "If you ask why" or "Why, if you ask".

Two characters facing each other. The character on the left, wearing a teal shirt, has a displeased or dismissive expression and is gesturing a 'stop' or 'talk to the hand' sign towards the second character. The second character, wearing a grey shirt, faces the first character but shows no particular emotion. The image conveys the concept of ignoring someone or signaling disinterest or refusal to engage.

A stylized hand pointing to the right. The hand is depicted with a simple line drawing with minimal detail and is colored in a flesh tone, with the cuff area of the sleeve in teal. Above the hand, there is text in the Korean script which translates to "right away" or "immediately" in English. The background of the image is white.

A simple, stylized cartoon of a person from the shoulders up in side profile view. The person has a round head, a small smile, a short, straight haircut, and is wearing a grey garment. There's a dotted outline of a circle with two arrow lines emanating from the person's eye area towards the circle, indicating focus or vision towards the circle. The background is white.

A simple horizontal line with two open circles at both ends, symbolizing a range or spectrum. At the midpoint of this line, there is a highlighted solid circle, indicating a central point or median. Above this midpoint circle, a red inverted triangle acts as an arrow or pointer that emphasizes the "middle" position. This graphic represents the concept of "middle" or being "in-between" within a continuum or range.

Two stylized figures standing side by side, separated by a red arrow pointing from the left figure to the right one. The left figure is wearing traditional Korean attire, known as a hanbok, with a teal top and navy blue bottom and has their hands folded in front of them. The right figure is wearing a casual long-sleeve top in green and navy blue pants, and both figures have a neutral expression with a small, friendly smile and simple, rounded features. The illustration symbolizes a transition between traditional Korean dress and modern clothing.

A stylized person with a simple smiling face, wearing a green top. To the right of the person is an image of money, both coins and a banknote. The coins are denoted with "100" and the banknote with "1000," suggesting a currency transaction. A curved red arrow points towards the person, indicating movement of the money towards them. The overall image represents the concept of income or receiving payment.

A red arrow pointing to the right toward a vertical series of squares resembling a bar chart. There's a progression of five levels of squares, with each level containing a different number of squares - one empty square, followed by two filled light yellow squares, three vibrant yellow squares, four orange squares, and two dark red squares at the top. The arrangement suggests an increasing trend or growth and is labeled with the Korean term "증가해요," meaning "increase."

A series of geometric shapes aligned horizontally: a small red triangle, three overlapping circles—green, yellow, and blue—, and a standalone blue circle on the far right. The overlapping section where the green and yellow circles combine appears to create a new color. A white arrow points rightward from the center yellow circle to the standalone blue circle.

An illustration of four stylized cartoon faces featuring two circular eyes, a curved smile line, eyebrows, and black hairline. They are surrounded by solid circular outlines. Three of them are aligned at the top, while the fourth one is below them and highlighted with a red dashed square border.

The image shows a symbol commonly associated with information, depicted as a capitalized letter "i" in red. The "i" is encircled by a red ring. Below the symbol, there is Korean text that reads "안내," which translates to "Information" or "Guide" in English.

A stylized character with a simplified facial representation is featured. The character has a neutral expression, is wearing a grey shirt, and is making a "thinking" gesture by placing their index finger to their temple. There are white gear-like shapes inside a transparent section on the character's head, symbolizing the inner workings or thoughts. A small red triangle, like a party hat or alert symbol, is in the upper right corner above the character's head. The illustration conveys the concept of thinking, cognition, or mental processing.

The illustration shows two stacks of bricks. On the left, there is a neat stack of six grey blocks. On the right, there is an uneven stack of eight orange blocks that leans to the right with a red downward-pointing triangle above it. The background is plain white.

The illustration depicts two figures in blue uniforms and caps, interacting with a large appliance resembling a washing machine or dryer. The figure on the left is touching a button or dial on the appliance, the figure on the right is kneeling and seems to be working on or examining the lower part of the appliance. There is a prominent circular door or window on the front of the appliance.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a house with a pitched roof and a platform base. The house is outlined with a dashed line made up of small red dots, suggesting construction or outlining a pattern. There is a solid red triangle pointing downwards at the center of the house's facade, just below the peak of the roof. The outline is in black with a plain white background.

A cartoon-style character from the waist up with a smiling face, short hair, wearing a teal or green shirt and holding a magnifying glass in their left hand. The magnifying glass overlaps a white rectangle outlined with a dashed red line. Likely represents the concept of "조사해요," which means "to investigate" or "to examine" in Korean.

An illustration presents a stylized depiction of a building on the left side and a line chart with two data points on the right side. At the bottom right, in front of the building, there is a large stack of currency bills, marked with the number '10000.' The overall image appears to symbolize financial investment or economic growth.

The illustration depicts a portrait-orientated tablet associated with the word "아이패드" (iPad in Korean). The screen displays a grid of colorful square icons, with three rows and four columns featuring various colors like blue, green, orange, and grey. The device has a round button at the bottom, a camera at the top, and interface elements like signal strength and battery icons at the top of the screen.

A simple, cartoon-style drawing of an island in the middle of the water. The island has a sandy shore at its base, a small green hill in the center and a single palm tree on top of the hill. The water surrounding is depicted in blue with calm waves. The sky above the island contains two fluffy white clouds.

A red arrow pointing downward towards a gray, 3D cube that appears to be shaking or vibrating. Below the cube is a straight, horizontal line, and there are three small, wavy lines on each side of the cube, suggesting motion or instability.

A yellow balloon being popped by a pin. The balloon is on the left side, partially deflated with the air rushing out, while the right side shows the sharp point of the pin and a small explosion or burst mark in red color. There are also a few motion lines indicating the quick movement of the pin towards the balloon.

A bright yellow circle, representing the sun or a light source, with white highlights at the center. Surrounding it are various starburst shapes and smaller stars in black outlines with yellow accents, indicating radiance from the central figure. The background is plain white.

The illustration features a white swan with an orange and black beak, depicted as if it's swimming or resting. Next to the swan is a large, cut diamond, sparkling with light reflected off its many facets. Surrounding both the swan and the diamond are small yellow stars. The Korean phrase "아름다워요," which translates to "It's beautiful" in English is also present.

The illustration shows two brown branches snapped in the middle with a cracking or splitting effect and some leaves on the left branch. The background is solid white, and the Korean phrase "부러졌어요," which translates to "It's broken," is also featured.

A red crosshair or reticle symbol composed of a vertical and a horizontal arrow pointing in all four directions over a background filled with numerous scattered black dots of various sizes. The crosshair contrasts against the black dots and the white background.

A stylized person with a round face, dot eyes, and a straight line for a mouth, covering their mouth with hands in shock or surprise, as indicated by lines radiating from the head. The person is wearing a teal-colored, long-sleeved shirt. Below the person is an image of an orange-brown bug, resembling a cockroach. The background is white.

A cartoon-style representation of a person with a neutral expression and short hair, wearing a teal-colored top, has arms extended to either side. Below the figure, there is a horizontal row of five different shapes in various colors: a red circle, a yellow square, a blue star, a white triangle, and a pink diamond. They represent the concept of diversity or variety, aligning with the Korean phrase "다양해요" (dayanghaeyo), which means "it's diverse" or "there are various types."

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person lifting a heavy-looking orange box. The person has a straight black hairline, wearing a teal shirt and navy-blue pants. The character is slightly bent over to the right side, with three lines drawn on each side of the box, indicating its heaviness, and also has three curved lines near the head indicating exertion or frustration. The background is white.

Two simple shapes on a white background: a small, horizontal rectangle outlined in black with a white interior, and a larger, vertical rectangle filled with a solid green color. Above the green rectangle, there is a small red triangle pointing downward. The green rectangle is larger than the white horizontal rectangle, indicating a comparison in size or height. The red triangle is at the top of the green rectangle.

A simple, stylized house outline with a brown roof and an orange-brown border. Inside the house outline is a pendant light fixture, depicted with a white dome shade, hanging from the ceiling of the house. The background within the house outline is a dark gray color.
A cartoon-like drawing of a pair of blue jeans, featuring red patches on both knees and yellow dashed lines running vertically down the legs, possibly representing seams or creases.

The illustration depicts a typical judge's gavel. The gavel consists of two parts: the handle and the head, suggesting a wooden construction. It's positioned as if it has been set down beside a small, round disk called a sounding block. The colors used are a mix of light and dark browns, giving an impression of natural wood.

An illustration of a wooden gavel lying on a striking block, indicative of a judge's tool used in courtrooms. Behind the gavel, there's an emblem or badge-like design with a decorative border. The emblem-like design has a central blank space. The color scheme includes brown for the gavel and base, a deep blue for the central portion of the emblem, and yellow for the emblem’s border.

A stylized figure of a person leaping or jumping from a blue to a yellow area, possibly representing different surfaces or environments. The figure is depicted in mid-jump with one leg extended forward, the other bent as if pushing off, and wearing a green top with blue pants. Small dots trail behind the foot that is pushing off, suggesting motion or the kicking up of sand or dirt.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a smiling person standing inside a doorway. The person is wearing a teal shirt, blue pants, and black shoes. There is a vertical line on the right and a horizontal line on top, representing the door frame. To the left of the person, there is a dotted curved line that suggests motion. The background is plain white.

The image shows a simple line drawing of a key. The key has a round bow at the top, a straight shaft leading to a series of notches that form the bit. The drawing is outlined in black with a white background.

A simplified, cartoon-style image of a person performing a kicking motion in a profile view. The character has a circular head and a single dot representing an eye, and is dressed in a long-sleeve teal shirt and navy blue pants. The background is plain white.

Two stylized figures representing a man and a woman are engaging in an affectionate kiss. The man, with eyes closed, is wearing a light gray shirt. The woman, with her eyes closed and wearing a pink top, has black hair styled in a ponytail. Their expressions suggest contentment and tenderness. The background is plain white. This image symbolizes a kiss, referred to as "뽀뽀" in Korean.

A stylized cartoon of a person with a smiling face and short hair, wearing a green top. There is a speech bubble containing the text "한국어," which signifies the Korean language. Above the character, the same text "한국어" is written in larger font size. The background is white.

Two identical-looking, smiling cartoon characters with black hair and green shirts, stand close to each other, one character's arm is around the other's shoulder. On the right side, there is an outline of a geographical shape representing the Korean Peninsula. The overall image conveys a message of unity or solidarity related to the Korean concept of "민족," meaning "ethnic group" or "people/nation."

An outline map of the Korean peninsula, including both South and North Korea, without geographical details, cities, or borders. The northern part is shaded in grey, while the southern part is in lime green. There are no texts, legends, or symbols on the map.

A pizza with pepperoni, green bell peppers, and possibly mushrooms or olives toppings on a golden-brown crust. The pizza is placed on a round wooden board with the letter "L" in uppercase, bold font to its right. The illustration style is cartoon-like with bold outlines and flat colors.

Two stylized car icons side by side. The car on the top is larger, colored orange, with visible windows and what appears to be door lines. The car on the bottom is smaller, in a gray outline with fewer details, lacking windows or other features. To the right of the two cars, there's a red play button-like triangle pointing to the right. The concept symbolizes the comparison of size, as indicated by the term "대형" which refers to "large size" in Korean.

A stylized, cartoon-like image of a person from the chest up with a smiling face. The character has a round head, dots for eyes, a line for a mouth, and a short haircut. The person is wearing a green top. There's a red arrow to the right of the character's head that points to the right. Above the arrow, the Korean characters "나중에" are displayed, which translates to "later".

A stylized image of a closed brown book with the spine and edges outlined in black. On the front cover, there is an emblem featuring a stylized rosette design with a blue inner portion and yellow petals. Within the blue area, there is a white square containing the Hangul character "법" which translates to "law" or "method". The design suggests it might represent legal texts, regulations, or methodologies.

An illustration depicts a closed book with a blue cover, that has a golden badge or emblem on the front, with Korean characters inside and a wooden gavel laying with the head on a round, wooden base, which appears to be in a striking motion or just at rest after use. The overall image represents law, justice, or legal authority.

A cartoon character lying flat on their back with their eyes closed, as if sleeping or resting. The character has brown hair, is wearing a white top with short sleeves and blue pants. Above the character's head is a stylized halo, implying they are dreaming, in a peaceful state, or represent an angelic or pure aspect. The character lies on a minimalist grey platform or bed without any visible bedding, with a plain white background.

A simple, stylized black and white drawing of a multi-story building with a grid of windows uniformly distributed over its façade, and a rectangular doorway at the base. Above the building, there are Korean characters "임대," which translates to "rent" or "lease," indicating that the building is available for rent.

A simple representation of a person standing behind an orange podium, smiling, wearing a suit, making an open gesture with one hand. A speech bubble with three dots indicates speaking or communication. The person's gender is neutral. The image is centered with a white background, indicating public speaking or lecturing. The Korean word "강의" (lecture or class) is also present.

Illustration of three animated characters standing side by side. The middle character is gesturing to the character on its right with its hand. All characters have oversized heads, dot-like eyes, straight line mouths. The central character is wearing a teal shirt and blue pants, while the other two characters are dressed in gray outfits. The style lacks detailed facial expressions or body language.

The illustration depicts a cartoon-styled character dancing with a cheerful expression, in mid-dance move, with one arm raised and the other extended to the side. The legs are in a dynamic pose suggesting movement. To the left of the character, there are two musical notes. The phrase "춤춰요" which is Korean for "dance" is also included.

The image displays a stylized illustration of a person holding a magnifying glass up to their face, with a neutral or emotionless expression. The person is dressed in a long-sleeve turquoise shirt. The magnifying glass appears to be magnifying the area around one of the person's eyes. The background is white, with clean, bold strokes for outlines and details.

The illustration depicts two cartoon characters. The character on the left has brown hair and a disheartened expression, wearing a grey t-shirt. The character on the right has brown hair styled upwards and displays a mischievous grin with one red cheek. He is wearing a white t-shirt and has his left hand on the other character's shoulder, while his right hand is raised with the thumb pointing upwards. The image potentially symbolizes teasing or joking behavior.

A horizontal arrow that starts with a solid red circle on the left and extends towards the right, ending in a classic arrowhead. The shaft of the arrow is in a grey or light color. The red circle symbolizes a beginning point and the arrow indicates direction or movement away from that point.

Two animated characters facing each other with an empty speech bubble between them, suggesting a conversation. Each character has a casual, friendly appearance with stylized hair and simple clothing. The image represents a dialogue or conversation between two individuals.

A cartoon-style character with a simple smiling face, short hair, wearing a headband with a knot on the side, dressed in a teal long-sleeved shirt, and raising both fists to chest level. The overall expression gives a sense of motivation or encouragement. The text "노력해요" translates to "Let's try hard" or "effort" in Korean.

A stylized, cartoon-like image of a person with a simple, smiling face and short hair, wearing a teal-colored long-sleeved shirt. On the left side near the person, there is a red exclamation mark. The person is holding their left bicep with their right hand, and there is a yellow starburst symbol over the bicep. The image conveys a sense of strength, achievement, or a "leveling up" concept.

A text layout consisting of three lines of Korean text. Each line has a phrase "레벨" ("Level" in English) followed by a sequentially ordered number from 1 to 3. The text is in black, bold, clear sans-serif typeface on a plain white background.

A stylized representation of a person with a neutral-smiling expression, black hair, two dots for eyes, and a line for a mouth, wearing a teal shirt. Beside the person's head is a solid black speech bubble, symbolizing communication or speech.

A stylized image of a pregnant woman in profile with long, black hair, wearing a pink dress. The outline of her belly is clear, and within it, there is a drawing of a small fetus in a curled position, indicating the baby inside her womb. Her face is represented by a simple, featureless circle. The Korean word "생명" (saengmyeong) meaning "life" is also present.

A cartoon-style character with a round face, a calm expression, and short black hair, wearing a teal shirt. A cone-shaped beam of yellow light projects from the top of the character's head, illuminating several large yellow dots that appear to float in the surrounding darkness. The character and the background are bordered by a gray frame.

An illustration of a hand in a thumbs-up position with a cord or string, indicated by a dotted line, tied in a bow below the thumb. The bow and the dotted lines suggest a decorative, possibly gift-related theme.

Three coin purses are aligned from left to right. Above them is a large red arrow pointing to the right. The first coin purse on the left contains two coins: one marked "100" and the other marked "10". The middle purse also contains two coins marked "100" and "10". The purse on the right contains a single coin marked "100". Each purse is outlined with a dotted red border and has a clasp at the top. The image seems to depict a concept related to counting, spending, or saving money.

The illustration features a character from the waist up, framed within a square border. The character has black hair, with bangs, and is smiling. They're wearing a teal long-sleeved shirt. Their hands are placed on their head, with palms open and fingers extending upwards as if they are emphasizing or trying to remember something. The background is plain white and there's a solid grey line that creates a sort of counter or barrier across the bottom section of the square frame, behind which the character is standing.

Two stylized figures representing people. The figure on the left is smiling, has its hand raised to its ear, suggesting listening. The figure on the right, dressed in professional attire, is facing the other figure and appears to be speaking, with a speech bubble containing three dots to the right of its head, indicating conversation. The scene suggests a scenario where one person is talking and the other is attentively listening.

A simplistic interior scene featuring a flat-screen TV mounted on the wall, a minimalist couch with cushions, a rectangular rug in the center of the room, and window curtains in the background. The upper part of the illustration is colored in a shade of tan, suggesting a ceiling. The illustration is within a square frame and has a two-dimensional perspective.
A red padlock with a silver or grey key inserted into its keyhole. The key appears to be in the unlocked position, as it is turned to the side parallel to the padlock.

A stylized image of a woman wearing a pink shirt and holding a baby, who appears to be wrapped in a white cloth and holding a bottle. Both figures are in a flat, cartoon-like style against a white background.

An illustration of a stylized human eye. The eye has a prominent black eyebrow above it that is curved and thick. The eye has a bold black outline, with an iris in grey tones and a large black pupil in the center. The inner corner of the eye has a pinkish hue, suggesting the presence of a tear duct. The white part of the eye, or sclera, is visible around the iris and pupil. The eyelashes are not shown in this image.

A stylized figure of a person standing upright is facing towards the left. To the right of the person's head, there's a curved arrow pointing downwards, suggesting a motion of looking back or turning around. The person is depicted with a neutral expression, without detailed facial features. The design suggests the action or instruction "turn around" or "look back."

A transparent box containing a tan-colored purse with a yellow clasp and a purple handle. Next to the purse, there's a notepad with text and a blue pencil atop it. The items are neatly arranged in the box, on a white background.

Two stylized figures are standing side by side. The figure on the left is raising its right hand above its head, dressed in a teal shirt and blue pants. The figure on the right is standing with arms by its side and is wearing a gray shirt and dark gray or black pants. Both have simplistic facial features with neutral expressions. The background is plain white.

Two buildings, on the left is a larger two-story building with six windows evenly arranged in two rows and a pair of doors. On the right is a smaller version of the building, with a similar facade but slightly reduced in size. Above and between the two buildings, there's a downward-pointing red triangle. The image may be illustrating a concept of "downsizing" or "smaller". The Korean Hangul characters "낮은" (meaning "lower") also present.

A simplified, linear graphic of a postbox with a rectangular body and a rounded top, mounted on a single central stand. It has the word "POST" displayed on its front, along with an icon representing communication or message delivery, consisting of an envelope with lines suggesting movement or transmission. There are two small rectangular slots on top, presumably for inserting mail. At the top, there are Korean characters "우편" which translate to "mail". The design uses black lines on a white background.

The illustration shows a stylized house with a peach-colored facade and a brown gabled roof. It has one window divided into four panes and a single gray door at the center. In front of the house, there is a low gray fence with brick pillars at either end and a circular object, possibly a doorbell or intercom, in the center of the fence. To the right of the house and fence is a red triangular play button. The image might be a symbol for "door" or "entrance."

A rectangle with rounded corners outlined by a dashed red line. Inside this rectangle, there are eight yellow circles arranged in an evenly distributed three-by-three grid with the center position empty. Outside the rectangle, to the left, there are three vertically placed black circles. The background of the illustration is white.

A stylized character with a determined expression, wearing a turquoise long-sleeved shirt and a white headband. The character is raising the right fist in the air, while the left hand is clenched and held close to the body, against a plain white background.

A hand with a pointed index finger is aiming downwards towards two boxes. One box is filled with solid gray color and the other is an outline of a box with no fill. The illustration represents a choice or selection between two options. The text "선택해요" which means "choose" or "select" in Korean is also present.

A stylized figure of a person standing upright, wearing a green shirt and blue pants. To the right of the figure, there is a male gender symbol—a circle with an arrow pointing upwards. The symbol and the figure are both depicted in a minimalistic style with bold outlines and flat colors. The image represents the concept of "male".

A stylized drawing of a medium-sized dog standing in profile, facing to the right with its tail up and head raised, possibly with a fluffy coat. Above the dog, in large block letters, is the text "마리", which is Korean. The dog is primarily gray with black outlines, on a white background.

An illustration showing two people, one wearing a green top and blue pants and the other in a green top and a red skirt, standing in front of two tables filled with round, yellow objects. Above the tables, there's a traditional Asian-style roof, indicating a market or street fair setting. It's drawn in a simple, cartoonish style.

Two cartoon individuals, one male and one female, sitting at separate stalls under a shared sign with Korean text saying "00가게" or "00 Store." The male character is behind a stall with three bowls, possibly a food vendor, and the female character is behind a stall with items that resemble jars or bottles, possibly a vendor of goods. Each stall has a small stack of containers or boxes, possibly representing stock or packaging. The image represents a marketplace or vendor stalls.

A stylized round icon of a human face. The top half of the face has black hair with a curved line suggesting the hairline, and a dot for an eye. The bottom half of the icon includes a white face mask covering the nose and mouth, with lines indicating the folds and edges. The rest of the face is flesh-toned.

A simplistic, stylized layout of a room against a white background. A portion of the layout is highlighted with a solid yellow color. Inside this highlighted area, the Korean characters "안방" are written in black script, which translates to "master bedroom". The rest of the layout includes outlines suggesting doors and possible furniture.

A stylized octagonal container with a green top and brown sides. Inside the container, there are several stick-like items with red tips, resembling matchsticks. The matchsticks are oriented in different directions, indicating a random arrangement.

name_en: Please Put It in the Bin
description_brief: A cartoon-like drawing of a person with a neutral expression and short hair, wearing a short-sleeved, green top. In front of the person is a grey cylindrical object that looks like a trash bin. A large red arrow with a curved shaft is pointing downward into the trash bin, indicating the action of discarding something into it.

Two stylized figures: one is sitting on a bench to the left, and the other is standing to the right. A curved arrow pointing upward from the sitting figure to the standing figure suggests the motion of standing up. Both figures have minimalistic features, with dots for eyes and lines for mouths and simplistic bodies. They're wearing long-sleeve shirts and pants, with different shades of green for the shirts.

Two stylized characters divided by a vertical line, both facing forward but depicted from different angles. The one on the left is shown from the front, smiling, with straight black hair, wearing a grey shirt, and having a yellow shape on each side of their head. The one on the right is depicted from the back, with just the backside of their head and the yellow shapes visible. There's a curved red arrow pointing from the character on the left to the character on the right, implying a turning or rotation movement. The characters are partially obscured by a yellow wall or barrier at the bottom.

A simplified, cartoon-style figure of a person knocking on a door. The person is standing, one hand raised and formed into a fist, with a small star shape near the fist indicating knocking. The figure has a round head with eyes and a straight line for a mouth, wearing a long-sleeved shirt and trousers. The door is brown, upright with a round doorknob.

A simple line drawing of a pair of needle-nose pliers. The pliers have long, thin gripping jaws, a pivot point where the two handles are connected, and elongated handles which curve inward at the ends. The drawing is black and white against a white background.

A cartoon figure wearing a red beret-style hat and a green long-sleeved shirt with a white collar. The character is smiling and posed as if writing or drawing with a black pen or pencil on a piece of paper that rests on a brown surface or table in front of them. The character represents a poet, writer, or artist, and "시인" means "poet" in Korean.

A cartoon-style hand, dressed in a green shirt or jacket, is pointing downward with the index finger towards a dashed outline of a rectangle. The background is white which makes the hand and the dashed rectangle stand out clearly.

A cartoon-style character with a round head, a single dot for an eye, and a straight line for a mouth extending their right arm to point at three red, dashed-line circles on the left side of the image. A flat, two-dimensional image of a building facade with a sign at the top displaying Korean characters "파출소," translated as "police box." Directly beneath the badge is a representation of double doors, likely the entrance to the police box, with two circular handles on them. The doors are white, and the wall around them is light grey.

A simplified depiction of a person with short hair wearing a gray top and a badge clipped to their chest featuring a similar design to the one above them. In the background, there is a gray building with several windows. Above the building, there is a stylized golden bird emblem with outstretched wings and a circular symbol in the center containing a red dot. The overall style of the illustration is cartoonish.

A stand-up signboard with a white background and a black border. The signboard displays Korean characters "투표소" which means "polling place" or "voting station". It has a gray footing and is supported by two wooden legs.

An illustration of a smiling figure with raised hands, appearing happy and excited, being the focal point or center of attention within a group of silhouetted figures. These figures are possibly cheering or applauding. There are small yellow diamond-shaped sparkles around the central figure, suggesting a celebration, success, popularity, or possibly fame. The image conveys the theme of popularity or being the center of attention.

A stylized figure of a person wearing a green top and blue pants, pouring contents out of a container at an angle, spilling several small round objects onto the ground. A stylized person with a simple, friendly facial expression, round head, two dots for eyes, a straight line for a mouth, short hair, and a green, long-sleeved shirt.
