The character has long black hair and is wearing a pink blouse or jacket over a white shirt. The figure's left hand holds a book or notebook with a blue cover, and the right hand is raised holding a brown pencil or pointing stick.

A cartoon character that appears to represent a teacher giving a presentation. The character stands to the left of a green chalkboard, smiling and pointing at the board. They are wearing an orange sweater with a white collar shirt underneath. An unidentifiable white object sits on a ledge just below the board.

A cartoon-style figure, representing a technician or mechanic, is standing upright with one hand on their hip and the other hand raised, holding an orange wrench. He is smiling, wearing a brown uniform with pants that have a side pocket. The character has dark hair with a hint of gray, suggesting age or experience. Their facial expression conveys confidence and friendliness.

An illustration of a person standing behind a podium, with a friendly expression, short hair, and wearing a business suit. To the figure's right, there is a piece of paper with the number "1" displayed, perhaps indicating a ranking or priority. The podium is colored orange with no additional context provided. The image might symbolize a speaker at a number one position or a leader in a competition or ranking.

An open book with a brownish cover. On the right page of the book, there are three pink cartoon-styled piglets with happy expressions. The text on the left page is in Korean, "아기돼지 삼형제," translating to "Three Little Pigs." The background of both pages is a lighter shade.

The illustration depicts a cartoon-like figure representing a tour guide. They have shoulder-length black hair and a friendly smile. They are wearing a blue short-sleeved shirt and a lanyard around their neck with a badge reading "GUIDE". They're holding a small blue flag in their raised left hand.

A cartoon figure of a tour guide with a smiling face, wearing a hat and an orange shirt. He has a camera around his neck and he is holding up a yellow flag with the word "tour" written on it in black letters.

A simplified, cartoon-style human figure shown from the waist up, holding a small flag aloft with the right hand and smiling. The character wears a blue t-shirt and a badge or ID card around the neck with the word "GUIDE". The image represents a tour guide or similar guiding service personnel.

A caricatured man, with distinctively Asian features, is playing a traditional stringed instrument laid across his lap. The figure is bald with a long white mustache and goatee, showing focus or discontent on his face. He is wearing a mustard-yellow traditional garment with dark accents and patches. The instrument appears to be a type of zither, possibly a gayageum or geomungo, traditional Korean stringed instruments. The figure is seated, though his lower body is not visible.

An illustration of a person with short black hair, sitting at a desk, smiling and holding a pencil over a piece of paper. The individual is wearing a blue long-sleeved shirt. Above the person, there's text that reads "APPLE" with a red arrow pointing toward the word "사과," representing the translation of the word "apple".

A simplified, stylized drawing of a person from the chest up. The person has a broad smile, round eyes, and is depicted with a simple round head and no hair detail. They are wearing a white shirt with a collar, a dark tie, and a pocket is visible on the left side of the shirt. Above the person are two speech bubbles, with the left containing the word "APPLE" in English, and the right shows the Korean word for "apple," 사과. An arrow points from the English word to its Korean translation, symbolizing translation. This appears to represent the occupation of a translator or interpreter in Korean, which is "통역가."

An illustration of a group of five young males posing side by side against a neutral background, styled in various fashionable outfits, jackets, collared shirts, a white suit jacket and a black turtleneck. They have different hairstyles, and some of them are wearing accessories such as a necklace and a patterned shirt. The image possibly represents a boy band or a group of modern young men, aligned with the concept of "동방신기".

A simplified illustration of a person, representing a professor or teacher, is holding a pointer and a book or folder. They are smiling and wearing a suit with a shirt and tie. The background features a simplified representation of an educational building resembling a school or university, with windows, a central door, and a clock above the entrance.

A cartoon-style illustration of a person with short black hair and a smiling face, wearing a pink shirt, playing a violin. The violin, strings, f-holes, bridge, and bow are drawn in a relatively detailed manner. The character is in the position of playing the instrument.

An illustration depicts a cartoon-like figure, possibly a teacher or educator, smiling and holding an open book with its left hand and a large pencil with the right. The figure is dressed in a light gray long-sleeved shirt with a dark gray collar, with a shoulder bag strap crossing the torso. The figure is set against a plain white background.

A simplified cartoon-style human character with a smiling face, short hair, and a blue top. The character is in front of a stylized representation of a computer interface or web browser window, with buttons and content placeholders, indicating tabs, navigation arrows, and website content areas in yellow and orange. Below the character is a depiction of a keyboard, implying that the character is engaged in working on the website or managing web-related tasks.

A simplified illustration of three people. In the background, a male and female figure dressed in traditional Western wedding attire, both with happy expressions. In the foreground, a person representing a wedding planner is sitting at a desk, holding a pen in the right hand, and gesturing with an open left hand, wearing a shirt and tie. The desk implies a planning or consultation situation. All characters are depicted in a flat, minimalistic style.

An illustration of a character seated at a desk with a computer monitor, wearing a suit with a tie, and smiling. A backpack is visible on the chair behind them. Above the character's head, there is a red question mark. To the right, there's an analog wall clock showing a time with the hour hand pointing between numbers and the minute hand at twelve. The image conveys the concept of someone having a question related to time management or scheduling.

Two cartoon figures: on the left, a person in a suit standing in front of a building with multiple windows and on the right, a person, pointing upwards with a question mark above their head. The image implies a scenario where someone is seeking information or asking for directions.

A cartoon character with a happy expression, carrying a bundle of sticks or logs on their back. The character appears to be a young boy with a headband, short hair and a white T-shirt. There are trees in the background that contribute to the forestry or woodcutting theme of the image. The image symbolizes "woodcutter" or activities related to cutting and gathering wood.

A simplified representation of a figure, presumably a man in a suit, with a smile and a raised arm, pointing towards a stylized multi-story building with rows of windows. The figure is depicted with a round head, no detailed facial features except for dots for eyes and a line for a smile, standing to the right of the building.

A cartoon character of a person at a desk with a computer display. The person is wearing a gray suit with a tie, raising one arm in the air as if celebrating or showing determination. The character has a simple, smiling face and appears to be sitting on a red chair behind the desk. There are a few lines around the raised hand to indicate motion or excitement.

An illustration featuring a character wearing a business suit sitting at a desk with a computer monitor in front of them. A red backpack is visible on the back of their chair. A circular clock with its hands indicating a time (roughly 10:10) is on the upper right-hand side of the image, with a red-colored frame. The background is plain white.

A cartoon character of a young boy with spiky orange hair, smiling and wearing a green superhero costume with a red undershirt, pants, and a cape. The costume implies a futuristic or sci-fi theme. Small images of stars, a stylized planet with a ring, and a comet surround the character, indicating a space or cosmic theme. The boy is standing in a confident pose.

The illustration depicts a person wearing traditional Korean attire, "hanbok", seated, facing the viewer, and holding a flagpole with the South Korean flag over both hands resting on the lap. The hanbok is white, with long, wide sleeves and a neatly tied bow on the chest. The person's hair is pulled back neatly, and they have a calm, resolute expression. The background is plain and light.

The illustration depicts a figure with a simple, smiling face and a bald head, dressed in a plain grey robe. The figure is holding a brownish-golden bowl with both hands in front of them. The bowl could symbolize alms or begging bowl often associated with Buddhist monks.

A simplified representation of a person praying. The person has short black hair, closed eyes, and a serene expression. They are wearing a teal-colored top, with the hands pressed together near the chest in a traditional prayer gesture. The background is plain white.

The illustration depicts a stylized angel with curly hair, a pair of wings, a halo above its head, and dressed in a simple, flowing garment. It is in a flying pose with one leg extended backward, suggesting movement. The drawing is rendered in a simple black outline with minimal shading, giving it a cartoonish look.

An illustration showing four different symbols related to religion and spiritual activities. A Christian cross in the top left corner, a traditional Korean "buk" drum with a drumstick and a question mark in the top right corner, a string of prayer beads commonly used in various religions in the bottom left, and a cartoonish figure of a person pointing upwards in the bottom right. The figure has a simple and friendly appearance with a short haircut and is wearing a teal-colored long-sleeve shirt.

The illustration shows a person with a simple, content facial expression, depicted from the shoulders up. They have short hair and are wearing a teal top. With eyes gently closed and hands pressed together in a prayer-like gesture, they have a string of beads wrapped around their hands. The image represents a meditative or spiritual practice consistent with certain East Asian traditions.

An illustration of a gray book with a yellow outline for a highlighted effect. On the book's cover, there is a golden-brown cross symbol. Above the cross, there is a rectangular label with Korean characters "성경", translating to "Bible" in English. The characters are written in black against a white background. The book represents a Bible.

The illustration depicts two figures, one standing and the other kneeling. The standing figure, dressed in white with a cross symbol on a sash, appears to be performing a blessing or ritual. The kneeling figure is shown in a respectful posture, possibly receiving the blessings. Both characters are depicted in a simple, stylized manner with minimal details and flat colors.

name_en: Bosalmnim (Polite term for Buddha or Buddhist deity)
description_brief: A standing female figure with a pleasant expression is depicted. She has curly, shoulder-length hair and is wearing a long-sleeved dress in shades of pink or purple with two visible buttons on the chest. Her hands are gently clasped together in front of her, placed against a plain white background.

A single hand bound by a thick, beige-colored rope, wrapped several times around the wrist and lower part of the hand, with both ends of the rope dangling loosely. The hand is positioned vertically with the fingers closed together pointing upwards. The background is plain. The rope appears to be tightly wrapped, restraining the movement of the hand, which may symbolize bondage or lack of freedom.

A simplified, cartoon-style figure of a person wearing a blue suit with a tie, a white shirt, and dark blue pants. The person has a round head with a simple, smiling face and a small circular badge on the left side of their jacket. On the right of the figure, there is a brown cross with a simplified design, commonly associated with Christian symbolism. Both the figure and the cross are depicted against a plain white background.

A seated Buddha figure in a meditation pose with a nimbus or halo around the head. The Buddha is draped in simple monastic robes and appears to be in a peaceful, contemplative state. On either side of the Buddha, there are two candles in candle holders. The background is plain. The image conveys a sense of tranquility and represents Buddhist religious practices and iconography.

A stylized traditional Korean building, likely a temple, with a blue roof, beige structure, white window panes, and a golden fish-shaped wind vane on the roof. Above the building are two musical notes. The theme is religious and spiritual activities represented by "찬불가," which means Buddhist hymn or chant in Korean.

An illustration depicts a person with a bald head, seated on a yellow cushion, legs folded underneath, wearing a grey robe, meditating or praying. They're holding a prayer beads, with three wavy lines emanating outward to their right, which may symbolize sound vibrations associated with meditation.

A simplistic, cartoon-like figure is shown standing upright with a round head, two dots for eyes and a curved line for a mouth for a placid expression. The character appears gender-neutral and is wearing a long-sleeved, knee-length robe or tunic with two buttons on the front. The figure's hands are positioned together at the front, at the lower abdomen level. The character's feet are the same color as its apparel. The image appears to represent a concept related to "비구니", a term associated with Buddhist nuns in Korean context.

The illustration depicts a traditional East Asian-style building, maybe a temple or a place of worship, associated with the concept of "사찰" (sachal), meaning "Buddhist temple" in Korean. The building has a gently sloping roof with blue tiles and upturned eaves. The façade is a warm beige tone with white-trimmed grid-pattern windows, suggesting paper or translucent material. A wind chime or decorative fish-shaped ornament is hanging from the left corner of the roof. The structure is on a raised foundation with steps leading up to the entrance.

An illustration depicts a golden Buddha statue sitting in a meditative pose with a serene expression and one hand raised in a symbolic gesture, next to a person kneeling on a cushion with their hands clasped. This scenario represents a scene of worship or meditation.

The illustration depicts a white candle with a lit flame at the top. The flame has an orange interior and a red outline, suggesting a flickering effect. The body of the candle is cylindrical, with a droplet of wax melting and dribbling down one side. The background is plain and unadorned.

Image of six identical, simplified figures wearing white robes with gray collars, arranged in two rows, seated behind a brown partition. Figures have round, simple faces with black dots for eyes and straight-line mouths. The background is plain white.

An illustration with three main elements: two musical notes on the left, a smiling person wearing a white robe and a pink sash in the center, and a brown cross on the right. These symbols may collectively represent a Christian religious service or choir.

The illustration shows four figures in white robes and pink vestments, resembling a choir. They appear to be singing, indicated by musical notes above two of their heads. A music stand with a conductor's baton pointing upwards is placed in front of them. They have simple, happy facial expressions.

A simple illustration of a beige or light brown cross with a slight 3D effect has darker lines indicating shadow on the right side and bottom. The cross is vertical with a longer descending vertical arm and a shorter horizontal bar across its upper third. It is recognized as a symbol of Christianity.

A female figure standing upright and facing forward. She has short, curly hair and a pleasant smile, dressed in a long-sleeved, knee-length dress with a darker long cardigan or coat. She holds a book with a cross on its cover in her left arm, suggesting it's a religious text, likely a Bible. Her gentle demeanor and modest attire imply that she embodies a religious woman or a layperson engaged in Christian faith activities.

An illustration featuring a green church building with multiple rectangular windows, a central entrance, and a steeple topped by a cross, resembling a decorated tree. To the right of the church, a Christmas tree, green with a brown trunk, decorated with colorful ornaments and red garlands. The image symbolizes the celebration of Christmas within a Christian religious context.

A simplified, stylized representation of a church building, symmetric with two sections on each side having multiple square windows. The center has a taller section with a pointed roof topped by a cross, symbolizing Christianity. The central roof segment is colored pink, and the cross is gold or yellow, standing out against the rest of the structure, which is grey. There is an arched doorway at the base of the central section.

The illustration depicts a stylized representation of a church with a central tower capped with a pointed green roof and a Christian cross at the top. The body of the church is rectangular with a green gabled roof and multiple visible windows. The building is primarily brown with the roofs in green, and the cross is a darker shade. The image could be used to represent Christian religious activities or places of worship. The Korean term "교회" (gyohoe) also appears which translates to "church" in English.

A black and white illustration depicting a page divided into two sections. The top section displays two Korean characters, "주보". Below the text consists of two columns filled with horizontal lines, representing text, and two rectangles, suggesting images or figures. It appears to be a stylized representation of a printed church bulletin or newsletter.

The illustration shows three individuals seated side by side, with simplified, round faces, basic facial features and hands pressed together, wearing what appears to be white robes. They are situated under an arch-like structure with crosses on each side featuring Korean text. This is set against a plain white background. The scene suggests a Christian religious concept or practice.

A cartoon-style illustration of a person with black hair and a smiling face wearing a yellow shirt with a white collar, a green skirt, and gray shoes. Next to the person is a brown cross. The person appears to be a woman, and the cross suggests a Christian religious symbol, likely related to the term "자매님," a Korean term for a fellow female member of a church community.

A simplified, cartoon-style figure of a person appears to be a Christian clergy member, standing upright, facing forward, with a slight smile. He is depicted wearing a dark suit with a clerical collar. The figure is holding a book, potentially a Bible, with a prominent yellow cross on the cover. The overall image depicts a religious figure associated with Christianity.

An illustration depicts three animated characters sitting behind a wooden counter, with their hands clasped together. They are wearing gray robes and have cheerful expressions with closed eyes and small smiles. There's an arch-shaped signboard above them with the Korean text "종강예배", meaning "Last Lecture Worship" or "Closing Worship". The image suggests a Christian religious or spiritual gathering.

An illustration depicts a religious scene with two figures. On the left is the figure of Jesus Christ with a halo around the head, a long white robe with red markings on the wrists, and outstretched arms in a gesture. To the right is a person kneeling with their hands pressed together in prayer. The kneeling figure is dressed in a green top and blue pants.

An illustration shows a stylized storefront or booth with a sign that reads "달란트시장" in Korean. The storefront has a brown counter and a blue and white striped awning. To the right of the booth, there are three stacked gold-colored coins, suggesting the exchange of money or goods.

Three stylized, simplified figures appear to be engaged in a religious or spiritual practice. They are wearing light colored robes with a darker sash or belt, and are bald. Above them, Korean text reads "법회," which translates to "Dharma assembly." The figures are positioned behind what seems to be a low barrier or table, and all share calm expressions. The illustration is contained within a rectangular frame.

An illustration of a person with closed eyes and hands held together in a gesture of prayer. There's a stylized depiction of a church with a central steeple bearing a cross on top with multiple windows and a prominent entrance in the background. The background is adorned with stars, suggesting that it could be nighttime, which aligns with the concept of "새벽기도" (early morning prayer). The overall image conveys a sense of calm and devotion.

An illustration depicts a nest made from intertwining twigs with four vibrant, decorated eggs inside. The eggs are adorned with polka dots in various colors: pink with white dots, green with white dots, yellow with white dots, and blue with white dots. In the center of the nest, overlapping two of the eggs, is a circular icon with a white background and a red border. Inside the icon, there is a single black character which appears to be of East Asian script.

A character is seated in a meditate pose on a yellow cushion. The figure is sitting cross-legged, with hands resting on the lap, wearing a blue top, and appears to be serene. They have a gentle smile on their face and eyes are closed. The background is plain white. There are two Korean characters to the right of the figure, "나무아미타불."

The illustration depicts a cartoon-style person with long black hair and a smiling face. They are wearing a pink cardigan over a white top, paired with a knee-length pink skirt. They are holding a black book with a gold Christian cross on its cover in their left arm and wearing black shoes.

A cartoonish illustration of a smiling figure with curly black hair, wearing a yellow top, green skirt, and gray shoes. They are holding a book with a cross on the cover, suggesting it is a religious text. The character could be symbolizing "권사님," a female lay church official in a Korean church context.

A simple black and white line drawing of a standing figure that appears to represent a feminine deity or a spiritual entity. The figure is depicted with long, flowing robes and shoulder-length hair. The character in the drawing has one arm slightly extended, possibly suggesting a gesture of blessing or welcome.

An illustration depicts two figures separated by a vertical line, suggesting a confessional setting. On the left side, a figure is sitting with a slightly slanted posture and facing forward. On the right side, another figure is seated, facing the left, representing the listener. Both are contained within their respective brown booths. The style of the image is simple and cartoonish.

An illustration shows a simplified representation of a church with a green roof, and a cross on the steeple. On the right, there's a character wearing blue pants, a green shirt, and black hair, walking right while holding a book with a cross, suggesting a Bible. Above the church are stars, implying nighttime. The overall imagery hints at the concept of someone attending an early morning prayer service at a church. Above, the phrase "새벽기도가요" is written, translating to "dawn prayer meeting".

A figure, likely male, walking towards the left, holding a book with a cross on the cover. The person has a green top and blue pants. In the background, there's a structure with a cross and the words "기도원" (prayer house) above the entrance. The image conveys the concept of a person going to a place of prayer or worship.

A stylized figure of a person reaching out to hang or touch a round, pink lantern with yellow accents. The lantern is one of a row of five identical lanterns suspended from two black lines. The figure is shown in profile, appearing to interact with the lantern using a teal tube or stick.

The illustration symbolizes the Christian concept of the Holy Trinity with three characters. Each character has a halo and stylized wings, dressed in white robes. The central character stands slightly behind and above the two flanking figures, possibly indicating importance or leadership. Each figure holds a long pink staff and they are all smiling appearing benevolent.

Three cheerful cartoon-style figures with angelic features. Each figure is adorned with a halo above their head and a pair of white wings attached to their back. They are dressed in simple, long white robes and simple sandals. The central angel is holding hands with the two angels on either side, creating a sense of unity or camaraderie. The figures are gender-neutral, smiling, and have simplistic facial features. The background is plain white.

An illustration of a book with a black cover and a yellow-edged border. On the cover is Korean text "보훈성가" which translates to "Hymn Book". There are two musical notes, an eighth note and a quarter note, floating to the right of the book. The visual implies the book is related to singing hymns.

A closed book with a gray cover and a yellow bookmark ribbon peeking out from the bottom. On the cover, there's a white label with the Korean text "찬송가," suggesting that it is a hymn book. To the right of the book, there are two musical notes, one eighth note and one quarter note. The image represents a hymn book used in religious contexts for singing hymns.

name_en: I Attend Church (My Religion is Christianity)
description_brief: An illustration features a simple drawing of a church with a green roof, cross on top, and multiple windows. To the right of the church stands a smiling female figure with long hair, wearing a pink jacket and a pink skirt, holding a black book with a cross on it, which likely represents a Bible. The overall image symbolizes a person's affiliation with Christianity and their participation in church activities.

A simplified drawing of a church with a cross on top of the steeple. A figure of a person walking towards the church is depicted holding a book with a cross on it, likely representing a Bible. The person is dressed in a long-sleeve shirt and pants. The image corresponds to the Korean phrase "저는-교회에-다녀요" (I go to church).

A simple, cartoon-style drawing of a church with a central section that has a tall, pointed spire topped with a cross and numerous windows. The church has a classic architectural design with a red roof on the spire. To the right of the church, there's a figure of a person dressed casually in a teal shirt and blue pants, walking towards the church, and carrying a book with a cross on the cover.

There are two main elements in the image. On the left side, there is a symbol composed of three gold-colored lines, suggesting an abstract depiction of a person or a character. On the right side, there's a cartoonish figure with closed eyes and a peaceful expression standing with their hands pressed together in front of their chest. The figure has a teal shirt, blue pants, and a round head.

name_en: I want to join the youth department
description_brief: An illustration featuring a smiling person, pointing upwards with their right hand to a large poster or document on the wall. The person has short hair and is wearing a teal long-sleeved top. The poster has the title "청년부가입신청서" written in Korean, which translates to "Youth Department Membership Application." Below the title, there are multiple lines of text, indicating the details or fields that would be filled out in the membership form. The person is pointing to the application form.

name_en: I Want to Receive a Blessing
description_brief: An illustration depicts three stylized figures in a scene of religious or spiritual ceremony. The central figure, wearing a long garment with a scarf around the neck, places a hand on the head of a kneeling figure to the left. Another figure is on the right, standing, smiling, and pointing up with one hand. The image suggests a religious ceremony involving blessings or ordinations.

The illustration shows a stylized person holding up a book with the cover marked with the word "성경" which translates to "Bible". The person is smiling and pointing to the yellow-outlined book with a black cover. The figure is wearing a teal long-sleeved shirt and has a simplistic, cartoonish appearance with a smile. The background is plain white. This could symbolize religious study, sharing a religious text, or promoting religious education based on the Bible.

name_en: I'd like to enroll for the summer bible school.
description_brief: A cartoon figure, dressed in a long-sleeved teal shirt, is pointing upwards to a document or sign hanging on the wall. The figure has short hair and a smiling face. The document or sign has multiple lines of text, and the top line is slightly larger, indicating a title or heading. Korean characters are on top of the sign. The background is plain white.

The illustration depicts a figure associated with depictions of Jesus Christ in Western art. He is shown standing with a forward lean, suggesting a walking motion, with long, wavy brown hair and a beard. He is dressed in a white robe with a draped, sash-like garment over the shoulder. The drawing style is cartoon-like, with line art defining the figure's outline in a stylized manner.

A simplified representation of Jesus Christ on the cross with a halo around his head, his arms outstretched and wearing a cloth around his waist. The cross is a simple, straight-edged brown design. The figure is primarily in a beige tone and the cloth in a pale shade of green or brown. This image represents the crucifixion of Jesus.

A cartoon-style image of a bald, smiling person dressed as a Buddhist monk, wearing a gray robe with a darker gray undergarment and a brown sash draped over the left shoulder. The figure has simple facial features and stands with hands together, giving an impression of calmness or reverence against a plain white background.

name_en: Let's go to the temple on Buddha's birthday
description_brief: A stylized drawing of an entrance to a Korean traditional building resembling a temple. The building has a curved blue roof with two-tiered, upturned edges and latticed windows. Two pink lanterns with fringe detailing hang from the roof. Above the entrance is a signboard with the Korean text "부처님-오신-날에-절에-가요" which translates to "Let's go to the temple on Buddha's birthday." There is a bold red arrow pointing towards the left side of the image.

name_en: Lighting candles in the Buddha Hall
description_brief: A golden Buddha statue in a meditative pose with a radiant, yellow halo around its head. The statue is positioned on a platform made of stylized tan bricks. On either side of Buddha, there is a white candle with a red flame; each candle is held by a gray candlestick. The candles appear to be lighting the scene, with lines symbolizing brightness emanating from the flames. The background is plain white.

A stylized illustration of a figure associated with Christian iconography, representing Jesus Christ. The figure is depicted with arms outstretched, palms facing forward, and is wearing a long, flowing robe. The character has a serene expression and long hair with a full beard.

The illustration depicts a simplified representation of a person kneeling in prayer. The individual appears to be male, shown in a profile view, with hands pressed together. He is wearing a long-sleeve blue top and darker blue pants. A cross and a yellow beam of light shines from it onto the person, highlighting the prayer symbolically representing a connection to the divine. The background is plain white. The illustration aims to symbolically represent a Christian prayer, corresponding to the Korean term "주기도문" (Lord's Prayer).

A golden Buddha statue sitting in a meditative pose with a halo around the head. In front of the Buddha, there are two wooden stands, each holding a different item of offering. On the left stand, there is a bright red apple, and on the right stand, there are three items—a green fruit, a white round item, and another small indistinct item. The background is plain. The expression "공양해요," which means "making an offering" in Korean, is shown.

An illustration of six cartoon-style characters sitting in pews, suggesting a setting of a religious service. The front row depicts three characters with their eyes closed and hands together in a prayer-like position, wearing different colored clothes—pink, gray, and yellow. Three more characters are visible from the shoulders up in the background. The figures have simple facial features. The background is plain white, while the pews are colored brown. The image symbolizes a group of people engaged in a religious service or mass.

A church building with a prominent spire and a cross. The church has multiple windows and an arched entrance door. To the right of the church, there is a circular wall clock showing a certain time. The combination of a church and a clock suggests the concept of "미사시간" which translates to "mass time" or "service time" in English.

The illustration depicts a hand with its palm facing forward, fingers closed together and pointing upwards in a gesture of prayer, with a green sleeve cuff. Next to it is a figure with shoulder-length hair and wearing long, flowing robes, standing with a gentle, peaceful expression. Both elements are set against a plain, white background.

An illustration depicts a person sitting cross-legged on a yellow cushion. The individual appears calm with their eyes closed, wearing a teal shirt and blue pants. Their hands are gently resting on their lap in a posture suggestive of meditation or prayer. The background is plain white, and the image graphically represents the Korean phrase "참선해요," meaning "meditate".

The illustration depicts a simplified character representing prayer or meditation within a religious or spiritual context. The character has a neutral expression with closed eyes, suggesting a state of peace or reflection. Above the character's head is a halo. The character is wearing a teal top and is positioned behind a partial barrier, which could imply a podium, altar, or desk.

Four figures sitting in two rows, two in the front and two in the back, on yellow cushions. They are dressed in gray robes with darker gray trim, have simple smiling faces with dots for eyes and a curved line for a smile. All of them have their hands together in front of them in a prayer or greeting gesture. The illustration suggests a scene of peacefulness or meditation.

name_en: I did it (Or) I've done it
description_brief: A happy, cartoon-style boy with raised hands, as if celebrating or cheering. He has short brown hair and is wearing a short-sleeved shirt and shorts. Next to him is a stack of colorful books. The image suggests academic achievement or the joy of learning.

A stylized hand reaching down towards a flat, rectangular object outlined with a dashed red line. At the center of the object is a large black X symbol. The overall image suggests the concept of "not bringing" something, or "it is not allowed."

The illustration features a piece of paper with lines of text and a diagram depicting a pie chart. To the right of the paper, there's a large, red question mark, indicating confusion or a lack of understanding about the content on the paper. The overall design uses a limited color palette, mainly red and black outlines on a white background.

A simplified, cartoon-like figure of a person with a smiling face wearing a teal shirt and has short, dark hair. The person is making a heart shape above their head with both hands. The image has a white background and uses a simple, clear line art style. The image might symbolize liking or enjoying something, indicated by the term "좋아해요" which means "I like you" or "I like it" in Korean.
A hand with a pointing finger touching a red question mark. The image suggests the theme of asking a question, seeking information, or expressing curiosity. The background is simple and plain.
An illustration shows a mathematical equation "1 + 1 =" followed by a red incorrect mark (a cross), signifying an error.

A pair of stylized, human lips that are slightly parted, colored in red. The inside of the mouth is visible, showing the upper and lower teeth and a pink tongue. To the right side of the lips, there are three jagged lines indicating sound or vibration.

A stylized human face with closed eyes and a neutral expression, covering their mouth with their right hand. Three yellow triangles project outward from the mouth, symbolizing coughing or sneezing. The image is associated with the Korean phrase "사라들렸어요", indicating a cough or sneeze.

The illustration features a stylized person with a neutral and slightly displeased facial expression, pointing to an open door. The door is half-open, and there is a yellow arrow pointing from the door to the right, indicating movement or the direction to exit. The person is wearing a teal top. The background is plain white.

name_en: I Won't Rush Toward the Future
description_brief: A cartoon young boy who appears worried or troubled, with sweat drops near his face, gesturing as if raising a hand to ask something or to express a concern. Next to him, there is a graphical representation of a clock with a red "X" superimposed on it and a triangular red area, located within the clock. The triangular section includes the Korean word "미래" which translates to "future." The image suggests a concept related to time, specifically indicating an issue or a negative connotation with the future.

A simple, cartoon-style drawing of a person with their arms raised above their head, wearing a teal top and showing a concerned or slightly frustrated facial expression, on a plain white background. The image could symbolize someone raising their hand, possibly indicating a need for assistance or a desire to ask a question.
A simple cartoon-like drawing of a smiling face with black hair and a headband that appears to be flipping up on one side. The character has a wide, joyful smile and rosy cheeks.

A cartoon-style drawing showing a school building with multiple windows and a clock on the top and a large red "X" mark next to it. On the right-hand side stands a male figure with a sad facial expression, wearing a suit with a tie. The image conveys a sense of rejection or a negative outcome.

A simple drawing of a burning match. The matchstick is brown with a red and yellow flame at the tip. Next to the matchstick is a gray tube-like structure that represents a tube of glue standing upright, with the glue cap on top. The image is on a plain white background. The image represents the phrase "lighting a candle" or "starting a fire."

A light brown easel with a painting on it. The painting depicts a stylized figure with wings, resembling an angel or a person in costume, arms outstretched, set against a sky blue background with two fluffy white clouds.

Three squares in a horizontal row with the middle square colored orange, and the two squares on either side gray. Above the middle square, there is a red upside-down triangle pointing downwards towards the orange square. The image symbolizes the concept of "middle" or "center".

A stylized character resembling a young female wearing a Native American costume. She has a feather in her hair, a headband with a geometric design, a fringed dress with patterned decorations on the hem and neckline, and patterned bands on her arms and legs. Her hair is long and straight, and she has a simple, smiling face. The entire image is black and white in a clear, simple line-art style.

A simple black and white line drawing of a human figure. The figure is standing upright, facing forward and depicted smiling. He is wearing a crown-like headpiece and a necklace or collar with a decorative pattern. He is dressed in a long-sleeved shirt and long pants with patterned bands at the cuffs, waist, and bottom of the pants.

A stylized blue book with a cover featuring a graphic of an industrial factory scene. The cover includes Korean text "공업", indicating industry, within a white rectangle. The book has a bold, black outline. The symbol signifies industrial education or subjects.

Five yellow round smiling face icons, two of these icons are solid and fully colored in, while the other three are outlined with a dashed line and not filled in, suggesting incompleteness. This image can symbolize "insufficient" or "incomplete," correlating with the Korean phrase "부족해요" which means "insufficient" in English.

The illustration is a Venn diagram with two overlapping circles, labeled "A" on the left, and "B" on the right. The overlapping area is shaded, representing the intersection between sets A and B. Above the diagram, the symbol "∩" is placed between "A" and "B".

The illustration features Korean text "철" with its English translation "IRON" below it, a simple line drawing of a vintage-looking iron with a cord and plug, and a simplified, side-view drawing of a car with clearly defined wheels, doors, and windows. The image represents the concept of "iron" in a teaching or learning context.

The illustration features a green object resembling a geographical outline on the left side. On the bottom right, there are two traditional ink pens with pointed tips lying parallel to each other. Above the pens, there is a gray flask or beaker with a round body and a long neck, with two small handles on either side of its wide base. The image suggests items associated with academia or learning.

A simple 2D illustration of a trapezoid with a light gray fill and a black outline. The trapezoid is wider at the top and narrows down towards the bottom, resembling an inverted keystone or a perspective drawing of a door or corridor on a white background. The shape could be interpreted as an abstract representation of an "isosceles trapezoid" in the context of geometry.

The illustration shows two circles—one solid and one dashed. The solid circle is below and to the left of the dashed one, with a curved yellow arrow pointing downwards towards the solid circle. The dashed circle is at the end of a vertical line. This could symbolize something that has dropped or fallen, corresponding to the Korean phrase "떨어졌어요".
A red hash (#) symbol with a thick outline, placed against a plain white background, likely used to represent the concept of "다라요" from the school category.

Two animated characters that appear to be young boys, both smiling and standing. The boy on the left has spiky brown hair, wearing a white t-shirt with a small emblem on the chest, brown shorts, and shoes, waving with his left hand. The boy on the right has short brown hair, a light gray t-shirt, teal shorts, and shoes.

Two cylinders of different sizes are displayed. There is a taller cylinder on the left, a shorter one on the right, and a red chevron pointing from the larger to the smaller cylinder, indicating a decrease in size. The overall theme suggests a concept of comparison or measuring related to size or volume.

A red question mark at the top of the image and a simple black-and-white line drawing of a geometric shape at the bottom. The geometric shape is a right-angled triangle with a dotted hypotenuse, suggesting a visual representation used for teaching mathematical concepts.

The illustration depicts a bowl of food, likely noodles or a similar dish, garnished with green toppings that could be herbs or sliced vegetables. The bowl is white with a simple design, and the contents are drawn with wavy lines to represent the noodles. The colors are primarily shades of brown for the noodles and green for the toppings, all against a white background.

An illustration of a dish of rice topped with a red-brown sauce dotted with green vegetables, and finished with two cube-shaped yellow toppings. It is served on a simple white plate with a slightly elevated rim. The style is cartoonish, with bold outlines and a colorful presentation.

name_en: Jangdokdae (Traditional Korean Fermented Food Pot Storage Area)
description_brief: A brown earthenware pot known as "jangdok" in Korean, traditionally used to store fermented foods. It has a rounded body, a lid, appears medium-sized, has a light reflection on top indicating a smooth surface, and some dot patterns suggesting texture.

A caricature of a person with a smiling face wearing a traditional black hat, resembling a gat, superimposed on the shape of the red-colored Korean peninsula. The image attempts to connect Joseon era iconography with the region.

A simple stick figure of a person with a smile on their face, arms extended to the sides, and legs together, positioned above an upward-pointing arrow. The figure appears to be in mid-jump above the arrow, which symbolizes the action of jumping or "점프하다."

An illustration of a stylized representation of a weighing scale. Above the scale, the letters "kg" are prominently displayed, indicating kilogram. The scale is a simplified drawing of a classic, round-top balance scale with a gray base and a dial in the center. The dial has an orange indicator needle pointing to a position suggesting it is at rest or zero. The image is a symbol for weight measurement related to the school category.

The letters "km" in bold black font, symbolizing the unit for kilometer, are featured in the illustration. Below the letters, a red inverted triangle points downwards, highlighting a measure on a curved ruler with black measurement markings. This visual signifies the concept of distance measurement.

The illustration depicts a person standing partially submerged in water up to the waist, smiling, wearing a sleeveless top and pants, and holding a large circular symbol with Korean characters on it. There are two simple house structures in the background, resting above the waterline. The image style is a simplified, cartoon-like drawing with bold outlines and flat colors.

A cartoon-style character wearing a hard hat and work overalls is smiling and holding a bundle of logs in one arm. There are stylized green mountains or hills in the background indicating an outdoor or forest setting. The Korean words "산림청" indicate an association with forestry or forest management, in South Korea.

A simplified map of South Korea, with provinces marked by lines but not labeled. The map is white with black outlines against a pale orange grid background. The map includes both the mainland part of South Korea and the island of Jeju to the south. It focuses solely on the outline of the country and its internal administrative divisions.

The illustration depicts a traditional Korean brazier called a "화로" (hwaro). It includes a round metal container on short legs with a circular rim around the top. Inside, there are burning coals with red centers, and a metal poker with a wooden handle is inserted into them. This brazier is typically used for heating spaces or cooking.

An illustration of a book with a blue cover featuring an orange representation of the Korean peninsula with cracks throughout its landmass, depicting the division between North and South Korea. Above the peninsula is the Korean text "한국지리," which translates to "Geography of Korea." The book is upright with visible, shaded spine, giving a three-dimensional appearance.

A simple line drawing of an open book with lines suggesting text on its pages. Above the book, there are Korean characters "가나다," representing the first three letters of the Korean alphabet (Hangul). The illustration is primarily black lines on a white background.

The illustration depicts a graphic of a person wearing a traditional Korean raincoat, boots, and smiling. The raincoat is brown and the boots are unspecified color. There are several blue water droplets around the figure suggesting rain. The background is plain and white.

A flat illustration of an easel with a painting depicting a landscape scene featuring two green mountains and a blue winding river under a sky with two white clouds. The easel is in light brown color, and the canvas is outlined with thin black lines.

An illustration shows a pair of hands engaging with a sheet of paper marked with horizontal lines of text and labeled "언어영역" at the top, meaning "language section" in Korean. The left hand is holding the paper steady and the right hand holds a pen, poised to write. Both hands have cuffs that suggest the wearer is wearing a formal or school uniform. The background is plain.

A cartoon-style image of a young boy running to the right with a determined expression. He has spiky brown hair and is wearing a short-sleeved white shirt, brown shorts, and blue shoes. Behind him is a simple blue circular clock with the clock hands pointing at approximately 10:10. The hands and the top part of the clock are colored red.

A two-dimensional circle with horizontal red lines across its width, outlined in black. There are four black labeled angles around the circle: two labeled with "90°" at the top and bottom, and two with "0°" at the left and right sides. It appears to be a diagram possibly for educational purposes.

A stylized image of a gavel and a sound block on a gray-background document or book. At the top of the document is a label box with Korean text, "법과사회," which translates to "Law and Society" in English. The entire image is outlined with a thin black line with a white background surrounding the symbol. The illustration represents legal studies or a law-related subject in a school or educational context.

A simple classroom setting with a teacher's podium at the center. A bold red arrow is pointed downwards at the podium. There is a wide, dark teal colored chalkboard stretching across the width of the background. To the right of the podium, on the board's surface, is a small pile of books, colored in shades of blue and purple.

An illustration depicts a person in business attire standing behind an orange podium, delivering a speech or presentation. Three silhouettes of heads, signifying an audience, are facing the speaker. The background is white.

The illustration depicts a person standing behind a podium, shown from the waist up, smiling, and appears to be giving a presentation or lecture. The person is dressed in a business attire featuring a light-colored shirt with a darker jacket. The podium is a simple, unadorned design with a flat top and a solid front panel, rendered in a shade of orange or light brown.

An illustration with two separate images side by side. On the left, there is an image of a podium with a microphone on top, behind which are two large windows with light blue curtains. On the right side is a character with black hair, a friendly expression, and wearing a light grey suit, dark grey tie, and white shirt.

A simple geometric illustration consisting of a dotted arc line creating a semicircle at the top, a solid horizontal line below it, and a large, solid grey rectangle with straight edges and rounded corners underneath. The overall structure may symbolize a visual representation of the Korean word '길이' ('length' or 'distance' in English).

An illustration shows two cartoon characters playing a sport. One character is signaling with one hand raised, wearing a white shirt and green shorts. The other character is holding a ball, wearing a white shirt and grey shorts, and has a happy expression. In the foreground, there is a larger character with a worried expression and hands clasped together under the chin on a simple beige or light brown background. The image appears to symbolize a desire or hesitation to join others in a sports setting.

name_en: Let's go to the sports field
description_brief: A simple cartoon-style drawing of a person pointing towards an open window. Through the window, two figures are playing soccer in a field or sports area. There is a red arrow pointing left, indicating movement or direction towards the window or the activity seen through it. The design corresponds to a visual cue or sign.

A line drawing of a playground. On the left, there's a slide structure with a ladder leading to a platform and a straight slide. In the middle, a person is standing and smiling in a stylized manner. On the right side, there's a swing set with two swings. The image is black lines on a white background, representing the concept of "play outside" in a school setting.

A stylized side view of a ball flying over a volleyball net. The net is partially visible running horizontally across the image. Three curved lines underneath suggest movement or the area of play. The ball is drawn with two curved lines suggesting its motion. The background color is light brown, resembling sand, hinting at a beach volleyball scene.

A clean blue surface of a desk with a single closed book or notebook lying on top. The desk is brown, indicating it might be made of wood, and has at least one visible leg. Sparkles around the desk suggest that the surface is shiny, possibly freshly cleaned.

An illustration features a person sitting at a desk reading a book, with a small stack of books on the desk and a bookshelf filled with books on the left. A clock is above the whole scene. The entire image is encased within a border that suggests it's a room, possibly a library or reading room. The image is labeled with a Korean word "도서실" which refers to a library or reading room within a school context.

A clear, round glass light bulb with a glowing filament inside and a metal base that appears to be brass or gold in color. The bulb has a slight shine on the glass. It represents an idea or inspiration in the context of "School" or "Education."

An illustration of an avocado cut in half, with the seed visible at the center. The avocado has a dark green outer layer, lighter green layer, and a yellow layer before the brown seed. The illustration is depicted on a plain white background.

A simple horizontal line with a circle at each end, appearing to represent a straight path or connection between the two circles. It symbolizes concepts such as a connection, link, bond, or a straight route between two points.

An image displays a mathematical problem written in Korean. At the top, it reads "1차 함수." Below, there is a linear equation, "y = ax + b," and two conditions that give specific values to y when x is 1 and when x is 3. At the bottom, the question asks for the sum of a + b. The image suggests a math problem aimed at finding the values of the coefficients a and b in the linear equation based on the given conditions, and then calculating their sum.
An illustration shows a pair of stylized, slightly parted, red lips with black outlines.

The image shows a simple illustration of a liquid spill with an irregular-shaped puddle on a white background. Above the puddle, there are two words—one in Hangul, "액체," and one in English, "LIQUID." The illustration is meant to represent the concept of a liquid.

An orange-cover book with a white rectangular label where the Korean characters "문학" (literature) are written in black text. The book is shown in a simplified, stylized manner, with the spine visible on the left side and the pages depicted in white on the bottom edge. It appears to be closed. The overall style of the image is two-dimensional and cartoonish.

Three stylized highlighter pens in vertical orientation with tips facing upwards. The first highlighter is pink with a black cap, the second is white with a black cap, and the third is blue with a melting effect on its lower half, also topped with a black cap. The third highlighter gives the impression of being used with wet ink. The image represents school or office supplies.

A grid of six yellow lockers in two columns and three rows. Each locker has a black outline, a white rectangular label slot at the top, and a black circular knob in the center. It is designed as a clear graphical representation of school lockers.

A graphic representation of a sphere with meridian lines. The sphere is encircled by a bold black outline, and it contains numerous vertical red lines which represent the meridians. Labels indicating 0° and 90° are placed at four points where the meridian lines intersect with an equatorial line.

A stylized red bag with a gathered top, tied off by a yellow cord with a bow. On the front of the bag, there are yellow and black Chinese characters. The bag appears to bulge slightly, indicating that it is full.

A simple illustration of a horseshoe magnet in a classic U-shape with two different colors. The left side of the magnet is red with the letter "N" for north, and the right side is blue with the letter "S" for south. The background is plain white.

The illustration features a simplified representation of a magnet. It consists of a rectangle divided into a blue half on the left, labeled with a black "S," and a red half on the right, labeled with a black "N," symbolizing the south and north poles of a magnet, respectively. Above the rectangle, there's a red triangle pointing downward, indicating the direction of the magnetic attraction.

A rectangular horizontal bar, split into two equal sections. The left half is light blue with a capital letter "S", and the right half is red with a capital letter "N". Above this, there is a small, red, inverted triangle pointing downwards. The image symbolizes a magnet demonstrating magnetic polarity.

The illustration depicts a colorful, semi-liquid substance spilled on a surface. Above the spill, there is a depiction of a motion trail with a burst or explosion mark, suggesting that the substance has been dropped or flung onto the surface. This implies the representation of a mess or accident.

An illustration showing a red apple, a blender with brown contents possibly representing apple puree or juice, and a clear glass with a yellow liquid, possibly apple juice. A pink arrow points from the blender to the glass, indicating the transformation or movement from one form to the other. The image symbolizes the process of making juice from fruit.

Two cartoon-style male characters that appear to be young boys, smiling and holding hands. One boy has his hair styled with a prominent upward tuft, and is wearing a short-sleeved shirt and shorts. The other boy has neat, parted hair, and is dressed similarly, but in a different color. There's a small red cursor or play button style triangle pointing towards them from the right side.

A simplistic outline of a world map drawn on a grid background with beige squares. The map illustrates the continents in a minimal, line-drawn style without any country borders, names, or other geographical features. The continents are positioned roughly where they would be in relation to each other on a traditional flat world map projection.

An illustration of three upright cylindrical objects resembling markers or colored pens, aligned diagonally on a white background. Each cylinder is filled with a different color: white, blue, and pink from left to right. They are representative of school supplies or drawing tools, associated with the Korean word "분필," meaning "chalk."

A stylized yellow school bus with black outlines. There are three smiling faces visible through the windows of the bus, suggesting students being transported. The characters are drawn with basic lines and circles, representing children on a school bus. The overall design communicates the concept of students traveling by bus.
The illustration shows three math addition problems:  1. 1 + 1 =  2. 8 + 4 =  3. 3 + 9 =   All against a white background, resembling a simple math exercise.

An illustration features a pair of yellow compasses with its legs angled apart, one leg appears to have a pencil or drawing implement attached. Below the compasses, is a ruler displayed horizontally showing increments. Above the ruler are numerals "1 2 3" in black, placed centrally in a large font. These elements represent the subject of mathematics in school-related context. The background is white.

The illustration depicts a person in a suit smiling and standing at a podium in front of a chalkboard with Korean text "수학경시대회" or "Mathematics Competition". There are three silhouettes in the foreground representing an audience or students facing the presenter and the board. The color palette is primarily green for the chalkboard, brown for the podium, black and gray for the figures on a white background.

A flat style illustration depicting a test-taking scenario. There is Hangul text that reads "수학능력시험," which translates to "Mathematics Proficiency Test" in English. A hand is shown holding a pencil and filling out a multiple-choice answer sheet, placed over a sheet with text symbolizing a written exam. The pencil is marking one of the circles in a vertical column of circles on the answer sheet. The sleeves of the hand are green, while the fill-in circles are yellow, and the background is white.

A pair of hands completing a document titled "수리영역," which translates to "Mathematics Section." One hand is holding a pen, filling out or marking answers on the paper, while the other hand is holding the paper steady. There are blank spaces, probably for the student's personal information. A rectangular calculator with buttons is next to the document.

The illustration shows a straight line with a two-headed arrow beneath it, indicating measurement or the concept of length, and a ruler marked with numbers from 1 to 9, signifying units of measurement. Each number is evenly spaced, suggesting a standard scale. The image represents the concept of measurement.

Two cartoon-style figures standing next to each other, representing a student and teacher or older student. The student wears a teal blazer, white shirt, dark tie, dark pants and shoes. The taller figure is in a light gray blazer, white shirt, dark tie, gray pants and shoes. Both characters are smiling, facing forward, and wearing similar badges or pins on their blazers.

A stylized letter "m" in black at the top, representing the unit of measure "meter." Below the "m" is a graphic that resembles a ruler, depicted in black and white, with graduations and numbers indicating measurement increments. Centered above the ruler is a red downward-pointing triangle that aligns with the middle of the ruler, indicating a specific measurement. A dashed arch line connects the peak of the triangle with the ruler.

A simple microscope is illustrated, equipped with a viewing tube, an objective lens near the specimen stage, focusing knobs, and a base for stability. It has a color palette of various shades of gray, black, and white.

The illustration depicts a smiling female figure wearing a blue shirt with a collar and a school uniform vest. Behind her is a grey school building with a row of windows on each of its two floors and an entrance in the center. There is a clock on top of the school.

An illustration of a hand holding a pen and marking a checkbox on a paper labeled "중간고사," which translates to "midterm exam". The paper appears to be a test or questionnaire with multiple-choice questions. The image conveys the concept of taking a midterm exam.

The letters "mm" in a large, bold, black font centered at the top, below them is a graphic representation of a ruler marked with millimeter increments. A red inverted triangle points at one of the millimeter marks on the ruler, possibly indicating a specific measurement. The background is plain white.

name_en: Modern History of South Korean Military
description_brief: A stylized image of a green book standing upright with its spine facing to the left. The cover of the book features a white rectangular label with black borders, with the Korean text "한국군현대사" on it, which translates to "Modern History of South Korean Military". The book's pages are visible on the right side showing a layered look with gray shading. The outline and details of the book are delineated with black lines against the plain white background.

A cartoon illustration of a young boy with a raised right hand, as if waving or volunteering to answer a question. He has a short, spiky hairstyle, a friendly expression with a slight smile, and is wearing a white t-shirt with a yellow name tag on his left arm with the Korean characters "반장," which translates to "class president" or "monitor."

A stylized depiction of the word "GOD" where the "O" is replaced with a graphical symbol of a crescent moon. Each letter, including the crescent moon, is outlined with thin black lines and the interior of each shape is white. The crescent moon could be associated with night or divinity.

An illustration depicts a book with a yellowish-orange cover. On the front cover, there is a white rectangular label with the Korean characters "도덕" written in black. The book is slightly open, showing the spine and implying thickness to the volume. The image symbolizes "Morality" (도덕) under the "School" category.
A simple, black outlined multiplication (times) symbol, consisting of two crossed lines forming an "X" shape. It's frequently associated with mathematical operations, specifically multiplication.

A series of simple multiplication equations written in black on a white background, vertically aligned and represent the beginning of the multiplication table for the number two. The equations shown are "2 x 1 = 2," "2 x 2 = 4," and "2 x 3 = 6." There is a colon (:) at the bottom indicating that the sequence continues.

A black and white icon representing a pair of musical notes connected with a beam. On the left, there is a single eighth note with its stem pointing downwards. On the right, connected by a beam at the top, there is a beamed group of three smaller notes on a staff, with the staff lines running horizontally through the note heads. These smaller notes resemble sixteenth notes.

A simplified, stylized representation of a piano keyboard. On the top portion of the image, there's a series of small squares that could represent control buttons or lights, with one larger circle that might symbolize a speaker or a power indicator. The keyboard itself is displayed with white and black keys, resembling the standard layout of a piano.

Three cartoon children, two boys and a girl, holding hands and smiling. The boy in the center is wearing a white T-shirt and blue shorts. The boy on his left has brown hair and is wearing a grey T-shirt and navy-blue shorts. The girl on his right has long hair held by a band, a white T-shirt with a red heart in the center, and a skirt. They all have white socks and shoes, with the girl's shoes having a red detail that matches the heart on her shirt.

Two cartoon-style male figures standing side by side. The figure on the left has black hair, wearing a teal long-sleeved shirt with blue trousers, smiling with his right hand over his chest. The figure on the right has black hair, wearing a light grey long-sleeved shirt with grey trousers, smiling with both hands by his sides. The background is plain white.

The illustration depicts a name tag designed with a portrait orientation and a yellow border. The central area of the tag displays the Korean text "이름," translating to "name." Above the nameplate section, there's an orange-brown strap suggesting the tag can be attached to clothing. The top corners of the tag have rounded edges, and the strap appears to be secured with clips or buttons that are blue and gray. These features suggest that the tag is used for identification purposes in an educational setting.
The image contains a plain gray square inside a border that resembles a picture frame or a placeholder.

The image displays "1 < x < 3" inequality and a mathematical sequence "x + 1 - x + 3 - 6 > 0," which simplifies down to "-2 > 0," a false statement. Additionally, there's a Korean text in the bottom right corner that translates to "No solution." The image suggests that the original constraints for x lead to a contradiction, indicating there is no solution within the designated interval.

A graphic representation of a hand with the palm facing up and the fingers together pointing to the right. On the palm, there is a yellow circle with a thick black border, and inside the circle is a large black "X" symbol. The image conveys a message of "no," "absent," or "not available".
A line-drawing illustration of a vertically oriented spiral notebook, with visible spiral binding on the left side and horizontal lines across each page, indicating ruled lines for writing.
A bold, black numeral "1" against a white background, designed with a straight vertical line and a small horizontal line at the top. The style is plain and unembellished.
The image shows the number "10", depicted with a bold black "1" followed by a bold black "0", against a plain white background. The font is sans-serif.
The image displays the number 12 in a bold, black font on a white background. The digits are aligned next to each other.
The number 13 in bold black font on a white background. The number is depicted in a plain, sans-serif typeface.
A simple black and white illustration featuring the number 16 in bold, sans-serif font. Both numerals are black on a white background.

The number "18" is depicted in black on a white background. The numerals are in a bold, sans-serif font, with the "1" positioned to the left of the "8". The "1" is a straight vertical line, while the "8" consists of two circles stacked vertically, joining in the middle to form the number.
The illustration shows the number "19" in a bold sans-serif font. The numbers are in black color against a white background.
A bold, black numeral "2" centered on a white background, depicted in a sans-serif typeface.

The numeral "20" in bold, black font on a plain white background. The numbers are depicted in a clear, sans-serif typeface. The "2" is composed of a straight vertical line at the bottom and a curved line at the top, while the "0" is represented as an oval loop.

The illustration shows the number "22" in a bold, sans-serif font. The digits are black on a white background. The "2" characters have a consistent thickness throughout, without any serifs, and feature curved tops with straight horizontal lines at the bottom.
