An illustration shows a USB flash drive with a metallic connector and gold-colored contact strips. It is partially sheathed in a gray housing that has "USB" printed on it. A simple white cable protrudes from the end of the housing. The background is plain white.

A simplified graphic of a car on the left side, including the body, windows, and wheels. To the right of the car, there's a document icon with text written in Korean script. The text appears to be a title or heading, possibly indicative of a car registration document or a certificate related to automotive services. The overall design is monochromatic.

A stylized image of an orange tow truck towing a gray car. The tow truck has a prominent boom and hook connected to the rear of the car, indicating the car is being transported or assisted by the tow truck. The scene is depicted against a plain white background, with both vehicles shown in profile view.

A stylized representation of a car in a side profile view with a grey body and black wheels with grey hubs. There is a yellow detail on the driver's side door, and a yellow lock symbol with an unlocked shackle above the car's roof. The keyhole in the lock is black, indicating its status as unlocked. The image symbolizes vehicle services related to unlocking or providing access.

A stylized square icon with a blue background and a black outline. Centrally placed on the icon is a large play button symbol, consisting of a right-pointing triangle within a lighter blue circle. There is a representation of a progress bar or slider at the bottom of the square, common for video or volume control.

The illustration represents media control buttons. A large blue circle with a white play triangle pointing to the right in the center, a smaller gray circle with two vertical lines indicating "pause" function to its left, and another gray circle with a small white square symbolizing the "stop" function to its right. These symbols are aligned horizontally and interconnected, suggesting a simplified control interface for multimedia playback.

A simplistic line drawing of a car on the right side of the image in profile, facing left with a classic, rounded body style. To the left of the car, there is a square sign with a capital letter "W" depicted three times, vertically aligned and overlapping. The car appears to be grey and the lines outlining the sign and the car are in black.

Two distinct icons placed side by side. On the left, a document icon with multiple horizontal lines and the Korean word "보증서" (warranty or guarantee certificate) at the top. On the right side of the document icon, a stylized icon of a car, depicted with clear outlines, wheels, and windows. The visual style is consistent across both icons, utilizing a clean, minimalist line art design.

A stylized drawing of a blue bottle with a large, horizontal yellow label running across the center, featuring a thin white stripe in the middle. The cap of the bottle is grey, with bold black outlines defining the bottle and its features.

name_en: What floor is the A/S Center on?
description_brief: The image is a simple illustration featuring two main elements. On the left is a building labeled "A/S Center". The building has a window grid pattern and a central entrance. On the right is a stylized graphic of a flight of stairs with a question mark on the side, indicating uncertainty or inquiry about accessibility or the location of the center.

A simple, stylized illustration of a manual wheelchair. The wheelchair has two large wheels with multiple spokes on either side, two small wheels at the front, a basic seat and backrest, along with footrests hanging below the seat. The illustration is in grayscale with a slight perspective, showing the left side of the wheelchair more prominently.

A symbol composed of a wheelchair with a large, prominent "X" colored in red superimposed on the left side of the wheelchair. The wheelchair is stylized with an oversized wheel that has segmented spokes, resembling a vehicle's alloy wheel, and a smaller back wheel that's barely visible. The overall design appears to represent a prohibition or restriction. The Korean text "바퀴가안움직여요," translates to "The wheel does not move" or "The wheel is not moving."

A stylized graphic of a single wheelchair wheel. It features a black handle attached near the axle and a small red triangle, possibly indicating a reflector, on the handle. The wheel is gray and black with white sections that imply a spoke design. The background is white.

The illustration depicts a symbol for wheelchair assistance or accessibility services. It includes a vertical sign with Korean Hangul characters "휠체어보관," meaning "wheelchair storage," a simplified graphic representation of a wheelchair, and a large red arrow pointing from the text to the wheelchair, indicating the direction to wheelchair storage or assistance location.

name_en: Where is the Autonomous Car Service Center?
description_brief: A simplified representation of a building with numerous windows, which could symbolize an office or service center. Above the building, there is a sign with Korean text that translates to "Self-driving Car Service Center," and a large question mark to the right of the building. The overall imagery suggests an inquiry about the whereabouts of a self-driving car service center.

A simple line drawing of a multi-story service center building with the sign "A/S센터." There is a red question mark to the right side of the building, suggesting inquiry, assistance, or information related to customer service activities. The drawing uses black lines for the building and text, and red for the question mark.

A stylized representation of a car windshield with windshield wipers. The image appears to be flat and iconographic, with a white border outlining the windshield and the base of the wipers. The wipers are shown in a resting position on a blue-tinted glass, indicating they are not in use. This type of icon could typically be used to represent services related to car care.

The illustration shows two animated figures running on a track. The character in the foreground is wearing a green top and blue shorts, and the character behind is wearing a grey top with black shorts. There are two visible lanes on the orange track, and the figures appear to be in motion. Above the scene is the label "100미터," translating to "100 meters," referring to the 100-meter dash event in track and field sports.

A simple illustration featuring two runners on a track. There's a text at the top reading "200미터" (200 meters). The track appears as a horizontal rectangle filled with a light orange and there are two white lines parallel to each other on it. Two stylized figures, one in a blue tank top and dark shorts, the other in a light gray tank top and darker gray shorts, are running side by side. They are depicted in mid-stride, with one leg extended forward and arms positioned as if in motion. The image conveys a sense of motion and athletic competition associated with a 200-meter race.

Two animated characters running on an orange track with white lane lines. The character in the foreground is wearing a green tank top and blue shorts, and the character in the background is wearing a grey tank top and black shorts. The text "400미터" is displayed above the runners, signifying the distance of 400 meters. The background is plain white.

A simplified, cartoon-style depiction of an archer in profile view with a headband, pulling back the string of a large bow with one hand, the other hand holding the bow outstretched. The image represents the sport of archery ("양궁" in Korean).

A stylized depiction of a bow and arrow, with the bow appearing as a classic recurve bow with a curved design and a central grip, and the arrow placed horizontally across it. The design features shades of brown and black with white accents against a white background, symbolizing archery in the context of sports.

The illustration depicts a stylized figure of an athlete with a simple human form, round, smiling face, and no detailed features. They are wearing a headband and a sleeveless athletic jersey with the number "1" on the front. The color scheme consists of a teal blue top, a dark blue headband, and simple black lines to outline the body and facial features.

A cheerful cartoon character playing badminton. The character is depicted with a raised badminton racket in one hand, ready to strike a shuttlecock, which is shown in flight towards the left side of the image. The character is wearing a short-sleeved shirt, shorts, and sports shoes. The stance and expression convey a sense of action and enjoyment.

A stylized, cartoon-like figure of a person performing on a balance beam, known as "평균대" in Korean. The person is standing with arms extended horizontally to the sides for balance. The figure is wearing a teal or green sleeveless top, white pants, and shoes; a simple, happy facial expression is visible. The balance beam is represented in a simplified form, showing a flat top supporting the person's feet, with a narrow support connecting to the ground.

The illustration features a wooden baseball bat oriented diagonally and a baseball depicted in mid-air, which is white with the traditional red stitching. Above and to the left of the bat, there's a baseball depicted as if it's in motion. The illustration represents the sport of baseball, which is what "야구" (yagu) refers to in Korean.

A cartoon-like drawing of a smiling person with short hair, preparing to shoot a basketball. The character is in a dynamic pose, with one arm extended towards a basketball hoop and backboard. The basketball hoop has a net and the backboard is rectangular with a small square box drawn in the center above the hoop. The illustration is colored with shades of orange, white, gray, and a bit of black outline.

A simplified basketball court is depicted as a rectangular surface with a mid-court line. There are circle symbols indicating the positions of the basketball hoops and a smaller circle representing the basketball at the center. Semi-circular markings near each hoop indicate the key areas. The court is primarily orange, with white lines and hoop positions, and a blue dot representing the basketball.

A stylized representation of a basketball court with an orange background. Two white lines stretching from top to bottom represent the center court and the free-throw lanes. There are semi-circular lines at the top and bottom, indicating the three-point arcs. Within each of these arcs, two white circles signify the free-throw circles. Four smaller blue circles represent players or positions on the court, with two placed near the bottom semi-circle (in the offensive zone) and two near the center line.

A simplified, cartoon-style figure of a person dribbling a basketball. The character is shown in side profile, in motion with one arm extended downward, bouncing the basketball. The person is wearing a sleeveless top, shorts, and sneakers, which suggests an athletic outfit suitable for playing basketball. The color palette includes shades of green, orange, blue, and black.

A stylized figure lying on a grey bench, performing a barbell bench press. The figure has a round head and a simplified body in blue clothing, with a teal barbell extended above the chest on a plain white background.

An illustration depicts two stylized figures representing skiing and shooting. On the left, a figure in winter attire stands on skis and holds ski poles. On the right, a figure aims a rifle. A plus sign between the two figures indicates a combination of the two activities, suggesting the sport of biathlon.

A flat illustration of a bicycle with a red frame in a diamond design and black wheels with black spokes. The bicycle's saddle is brown and the handlebars are red. The term "자전거" refers to a bicycle in Korean.

The illustration depicts a stylized, elongated, and aerodynamic bobsled on a white background. It features four teal elements representing the heads of the bobsled team members positioned in line. The front of the sled has a small emblem with a circular design in red, blue, and white colors. The runners or blades are implied by the shape of the sled's base.

The illustration depicts a stylized figure engaged in boxing. The figure wears blue boxing gloves, a teal or green sleeveless top, and dark blue shorts. The boxer also has on white shoes and a blue headguard. The individual is shown in profile, with one glove extended forward as if in the middle of a punch, and the other glove held close to the face in a defensive posture.

A simplified, cartoon-like figure of a person engaged in boxing. The figure is wearing boxing gloves, a turquoise sleeveless top, navy-blue shorts, and white shoes. They have orange hair and are wearing protective headgear. The figure's face is unseen as it is facing towards the side. The image symbolically represents the sport of boxing.

A bronze colored medal with two Asian characters inscribed on its face. The medal has a ribbon with red, yellow, and green stripes. The medal is associated with a third-place finish in competitions or sports events. The Korean word "동메달" or "bronze medal" matches the description of the medal.

The illustration shows a simplified, top-view representation of a canoe within a bordered square. The canoe is positioned horizontally and is outlined in black with a yellow center. On each side of the canoe, there are four pairs of paddle-like shapes, representing the oars, which are white with black handles. The background is light blue. This image symbolizes canoeing in a sports context.

The illustration depicts a cheerful female cheerleader. She is smiling broadly, her tied hair is in a ponytail, and she's wearing a pink top with the number "7" on it, along with a white skirt, knee-high socks, and sporty shoes. She is holding yellow pom-poms and her posture suggests that she is cheering or dancing with one leg bent and slightly raised behind her.

Five interlocking rings colored blue, yellow, black, green, and red, symbolizing the Olympic Games. Below the rings, there is a ribbon banner containing Korean text that reads "폐막식," which translates to "Closing Ceremony." The image symbolizes the closing ceremony of a sports event.

On a green field, there is a soccer goal with a net, and a goalkeeper standing in front of it, ready to defend. The goalkeeper is smiling and wearing a grey shirt. On the right, a player is standing next to a corner flag holding a soccer ball, preparing to take a corner kick. The player is wearing a blue shirt and dark shorts. The scene is presented in a cartoonish style.

A simplified cartoon-style image of an individual engaging in cross-country skiing. The person is depicted with a smiling face and is wearing a sleeveless top and shorts, along with long socks or leg coverings. They are equipped with two ski poles and a single ski attached to one foot. The background includes a curved line that indicates a snowy hill or mountain slope, setting the context for a winter sport scene.

The illustration features a simplified representation of a curling target, known as the "house," and a curling stone. The house is composed of concentric circles with alternating colors blue and white, with the center circle being red. The circles are divided by a black cross, which separates the house into four quadrants. A curling stone is depicted near the bottom right of the image, it is grey with a black handle on the top, detailed with an orange element indicating the grip area.

A stylized figure with a cartoon-like appearance wears a teal shirt and expresses surprise with an open circle mouth. It has a starburst shape near its head, indicating impact, and holds up one hand in a halting gesture. The overall impression suggests caution or warning of potential danger or risk.

A simplified figure of a person diving off a diving board into a pool. The figure's body is outstretched with the hands in front and the feet pointed. The diving board is on the right as an elevated horizontal platform extending over the water, which is a blue rectangle at the bottom, suggesting a swimming pool.

An illustration of a person from the back, depicted playing basketball. The person is shown with arms raised, shooting a basketball into a hoop with backboard and a red rim. The basketball appears to be halfway through the hoop, indicating a successful shot. The backdrop is clear and unadorned.

A classic black and white paneled soccer ball is on the left side, and a pair of inline roller skates with grey boots, green and yellow highlights, and black wheels lined up in a row on the right side. The image suggests sports activities that involve ball games and skating.

A cartoon character with eyes closed, appearing to be frustrated or exhausted. The character is wearing a turquoise top and is lying down on a flat surface with their head resting on one arm. Above the character, there is a speech bubble illustrating their thought, which contains a picture of a person lying in bed, implying that the character is thinking of resting or sleeping.

Two stylized figures engaged in a fencing duel, wearing protective helmets with darkened face masks. They are dressed in standard fencing attire. The figures are in dynamic poses that suggest movement, with one leg extended forward as if lunging. Each fencer holds a fencing foil, one of the foils extended toward the other competitor. This icon represents the sport of fencing.

A simplified character with a bun hairstyle figure skating. The character is wearing a sleeveless yellow top, white shorts, long criss-cross patterned socks up to the thighs and ice skates. The figure's arms are extended outwards and one leg is lifted behind, suggesting movement on ice. The backdrop is a light blue rectangle representing the ice rink.

An illustration of a tournament bracket with a single rectangle at the top indicating the final match. Two lines extend to two larger rectangles representing the semi-final matches. The colors used are black for the lines and rectangles, and the semi-final rectangles are filled in red.

name_en: First Half of the Soccer Match (10:06)
description_brief: A simplified, stylized representation of three soccer players on a green field. The player in the center, in a gray shirt and black shorts, appears to be in forward motion, with one foot extended towards a black and white paneled soccer ball. To the right is a player in a teal shirt and black shorts, running towards the ball. On the left is another player in a gray shirt and black shorts shown in motion, appearing to be chasing the ball or supporting the central player. Above the scene is the text "전반 10:06," indicating the first half of a soccer match with a time of 10 minutes and 6 seconds.

A stylized figure representing an American football player. The character is standing straight, with hands joined together in front of it at waist level. The player is wearing a helmet with a facemask, shoulder pads, and knee-high boots. The color scheme primarily consists of a violet or purple hue accentuated with white and gray where protective gear is illustrated. The image represents the sport, "풋볼 (야구)" in Korean, which translates to "football."

The illustration features three stylized figures depicted in a running motion across a three-lane track. The leading figure is wearing a gray tank top and shorts, followed by a figure in a green tank top and blue shorts, and lastly another in gray. The figures are designed with a thick black outline. The overall image represents a footrace or running event.

The simple, flat illustration depicts a stylized American football in brown with white laces, implying it is tightly gripped by a human hand and angled to the left. The football slightly overlaps a vertical white line. In the top right corner, there is a red "X" mark. The image may suggest a concept related to American football, specifically, an element of play being disallowed or a mistake.

A cartoon-style illustration of a soccer scene. A figure in a blue top and black shorts is prepared for a free kick with a soccer ball in a green field. This player is facing a goal with four other players in gray tops and black shorts acting as defenders, standing in front of a soccer goal with a white net. The action is taking place on a soccer pitch. The characters have minimalistic features with simple lines and dots.

A simplified and stylized cartoon character with black hair, engaged in swimming while wearing blue swimwear. The character's pose suggests a freestyle or front crawl swimming technique. The background is a solid blue color, which reinforces the swimming theme. The image is enclosed within a thin black border.

Four cartoon-style figures standing side by side, holding hands. There are two females and two males. Each figure has a different colored top: yellow for the first female, teal for the first male, green for the second male, and pink for the second female. The first female has orange shorts, the first male has blue pants, the second male has red shorts, and the second female has pink shorts. All figures are wearing shoes in colors that match their outfits. The background is white.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a soccer goalkeeper standing in front of a goalpost. The goalkeeper is wearing a long-sleeve teal shirt, blue shorts, and black shoes, with black hair and a smile. They have their arms outstretched to the sides and are standing with slightly bent knees in a ready stance. The goalpost is white with a black net, placed on a green background suggestive of a soccer field.

The illustration shows a gold medal with a ribbon. The medal is circular with a golden yellow finish and features a symbol or character at its center. The ribbon attached to the medal has stripes in different colors—red, green, yellow—running vertically down its length. The ribbon loop appears to be red at its uppermost section where it meets the medal. The character inscribed on the medal resembles East Asian script. The overall image symbolizes achievement or victory.

A cartoon character of a young boy with a cheerful expression, standing on a patch of green grass. He is wearing a white shirt and brown shorts, with shoes suitable for sports activities. The character is holding a golf club in both hands, positioning the club head near a golf ball, preparing to take a swing.

A simple, stylized figure is performing on gymnastic rings. The figure has a broad smile, two dots for eyes, straight black hair, a sleeveless teal top, and white pants. The gymnastic apparatus consists of two rings suspended on straight lines from a horizontal bar against a plain white background.

A stylized human hand gesture, with the hand oriented vertically. The thumb is extended upwards and the index finger extended forwards, creating a right angle. The rest of the fingers are folded into the palm. There are simple rectangles representing the cuffs of a shirt or a jacket at the wrist area.

A simplified, cartoon-like figure of a person performing a hammer throw. The person is shown mid-action, holding a wire connected to the hammer, which appears as a large, circular weight at the end of the wire. The character is wearing a short-sleeve shirt, shorts, and shoes. The athlete is captured mid-swing with the hammer extended out to one side.

A simplified representation of a handball game with three stylized figures: two players in matching shirts and shorts on either side of a central ball and a goalkeeper standing in the center of a handball goal. The entire scene is set on a handball court.

A cartoon-style illustration of a person performing a high jump. The character is in a backwards and upwards motion over a bar without dislodging it. They have their back arched and their legs trailing over the bar with their head and hands crossed. They are wearing a teal top, purple shorts, and grey shoes. A thick, cushioned mat is below the bar for a safe landing. The vertical posts supporting the bar are visible on each side, with the left post intersecting the border of the image.

A simplified, cartoon-style illustration of a person performing the high jump in athletics. The athlete is depicted in the motion of arching over the high jump bar, in the descent phase of the jump. The athlete is wearing a blue top, black shorts, and black shoes and has a light skin tone. There's a mat illustrated below the bar for landing. The background is white.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person in profile, moving towards the left. They have short hair, are wearing a sleeveless top in green, shorts in blue, and shoes in black. The person's arms and legs are in motion. This symbol typically represents walking, hiking, or trekking.

Two stylized figures playing hockey. They are dressed in sports attire, which includes blue tops, dark blue shorts, and white shoes. One figure is chasing a white ball with a hockey stick, while the other seems ready to intercept or engage in play. They are on a green field, suggesting a grassy surface suitable for field hockey.

The image illustrates a baseball scenario with a partial baseball diamond, home plate, a dotted line indicating the trajectory of a baseball, a stylized baseball, a simplified representation of a baseball bat, and an abstract figure that appears to have swung the bat. The solid green field is in the background.

A simplified, stylized figure of a person riding a light brown horse with a darker mane and tail. The rider is sitting upright, facing to the left of the image, holding the horse's reins. They are wearing a black helmet, a teal shirt, black pants, and the horse has a purple saddle. The image appears to be associated with the sport of horseback riding or equestrian activities.

The image shows a smiling cartoon character, a young boy with short, spiky hair. He is wearing a short-sleeve t-shirt and pants, and is standing with his legs slightly apart and hands raised to his shoulders, palms facing forward. Around his waist is a spinning hula hoop, depicted in motion with a couple of motion lines.

An illustration of a person performing the track and field sport of hurdling. The figure is mid-stride in the air, with one leg extended forward over a hurdle and the other kicking back. The person is wearing a teal top, blue shorts, and is depicted without facial features except for a single dot for an eye. There are two hurdles visible: one that the runner is currently clearing and another one in the background.

Two cartoon-style characters are depicted in an illustration. One character is skiing downhill on a white slope with grey mountain lines and a small blue icy patch. This character is in motion, wears a teal top, grey pants, and has black hair. Another character is standing on flat ground, wearing a plain green shirt, and pointing towards the skier with a smile.

A cartoon character with a disappointed or exhausted expression, having messy brown hair, droopy eyes, and downturned eyebrows. There are two squiggly lines coming out from each side of the character's head, indicating distress or fatigue. The character's mouth is open with a downturned curve and there is a trickle of sweat coming from one corner of the mouth. The character is wearing a simple white T-shirt. The overall appearance suggests that the character might be tired or defeated.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of an ice hockey player dressed in blue protective gear including a helmet, gloves, shoulder pads, shin guards, and skates. The hockey player is holding a hockey stick with a puck on the ice near the stick, standing on an ice rink. There is a white border outlining the entire image.
The illustration displays a single ice skate with a white boot, black laces, an orange heel counter, and a grey blade attached to the bottom.

An illustration of an inline skate. The boot part of the skate is predominantly yellow with some blue highlights, particularly around the ankle area. The skate has a black frame attached to the bottom, containing a row of small, gray wheels that are aligned in a straight line.

A stylized, cartoon-like figure engaged in the sport of javelin throw. The figure is shown in a dynamic pose, with one arm extended forward holding a long, straight object (the javelin) at an angle upwards and behind its body, while in a striding position. The character is wearing a short-sleeved shirt and shorts.

An illustration of two stylized, simplified figures engaged in a judo throw. The figure in a white judo uniform is executing a throw, lifting and flipping the figure in a blue uniform over their shoulder and hip. The figure being thrown appears suspended in mid-air, with their legs extended and their body horizontal to the ground, indicating motion. The image symbolizes the martial art and sport of "유도" (judo).

The illustration depicts a cartoon character of a young boy rope skipping or jump roping. He has a cheerful expression on his face, with spiky hair and wearing a short-sleeved t-shirt with shorts and a pair of sneakers. He is shown mid-jump and holding the jump rope's handles firmly. The rope is forming a large arc above and in front of him.

A stylized image of a person performing a long jump. The figure is shown mid-air above a dotted arc trajectory. The character is wearing a teal shirt, navy shorts, and black shoes. The arms are extended forward and the legs are bent, poised for landing. Below the figure is a beige bar representing the ground or jumping platform.

An illustration of two cartoon-style figures engaged in running on a track with two lanes. The figure on the left is wearing a green top and blue shorts, while the figure on the right is wearing a gray top and black shorts. Above them is Korean text "오래달리기," which translates to "long-distance running." The overall image is indicative of the sport of long-distance running and endurance running.

Two stylized figures are running on a track. The figure in the foreground is wearing a blue tank top and navy shorts, while the other one is in a gray shirt and lighter gray shorts. They are on a track with two parallel lines on an orange ground. Above the figures, there's Hangul text that translates to "long-distance running".

Two cartoon-style figures represent athletes in different sports. On the left, a figure in a green and blue tank top and orange shorts, with a basketball resting on its knee. On the right, another figure in a blue and white striped shirt and a blue cap, holding a green and yellow baseball glove. Above the two figures is a ribbon banner with Korean text "본선", translating to "finals" or "main event". The illustration is related to the main competition or final round in the sports context.

A cartoon character with brown hair tied with a white headband, wearing a white T-shirt, brown shorts, and blue running shoes, running to the left with an expression of determination on their face. On the right side of the image, the number "42.195 KM" is displayed, representing the official distance of a marathon.

A simplified illustration of a soccer field. There are various lines and markers representing different zones of the field, such as the center circle, goal box, and penalty areas. Eleven circular icons on the field depict players, with three orange ones representing the forwards and eight white ones representing the midfielders and defenders. The arrangement shows a specific team formation.

A simplified baseball diamond with one figure standing to the right side. The figure is wearing a blue and gray uniform, a cap, and holds a baseball bat. In the background, there's a large red triangular flag pointing to the right, placed near the top of the baseball diamond. The scene is enclosed within a green border.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person wearing a teal top with a dark neckline, an identification badge, dark blue pants, and black shoes. The person has short black hair and is smiling. A music stand with a yellow piece of paper or sheet music is in front of the person. Above the person, there are two musical notes, suggesting involvement in music. Korean text "동해물과" is in the upper right corner, possibly referring to the start of the South Korean national anthem.
An illustration of an Olympic torch with a gray and black handle. The top has a bowl shape where a flame is burning, using shades of red and yellow to represent fire.

The image displays the Olympic Rings, a symbol associated with the Olympic Games. There are five interlocking rings of different colors on a white background. From left to right, the colors are blue, yellow, black, green, and red. The rings are arranged in two rows with the first row consisting of three rings (blue, black, red) and the second row beneath the first, offset to the sides, consists of two rings (yellow, green). This symbol represents the union of the five continents and the meeting of athletes from around the world at the Olympic Games.

The illustration shows five interlocking rings in the colors of blue, yellow, black, green, and red, in that order from left to right. Below the rings, there is a ribbon banner with the Korean Hangul characters "개막식" inscribed on it. This term translates to "opening ceremony." The background is white.

A stylized character that appears to represent an umpire or referee in the sport of baseball from the chest up, with a stern expression, a blue uniform with a white circular detail, a thick black beard and mustache, and a black baseball cap. The character also wears a face mask and is shown raising their right arm, holding a baseball in a fist.

A simplified baseball field with elements characteristic of the sport, shown in a three-quarter perspective with the tan infield and pitcher's mound in the center, set against a green grassy outfield background. Three white bases form a diamond shape around the mound. A figure representing a baseball player with a helmet, a striped uniform, and holding a red flag stands on the right side of the image. The lines are bold and the colors are bright and flat.

The illustration shows an athlete performing on the parallel bars in gymnastics. The athlete is upside down with legs split apart in a 'V' shape, gripping the bars firmly. The gymnast is wearing a blue and black leotard on a plain white background.

The image has Olympic-style rings at the top, with five interlocking circles in blue, yellow, black, green, and red. Below the rings are three pictograms representing athletes with disabilities participating in various sports. The first pictogram portrays an athlete using a wheelchair for racing, the second shows an athlete in a combative sport, seemingly fencing, and the third displays an athlete in a wheelchair about to throw a discus. The pictograms use simple black lines on a white background and they symbolize the Paralympic Games.

A simplified depiction of a penalty kick in soccer. A player in a blue shirt and black shorts is standing on a green field with a black and white soccer ball at his feet, preparing to kick towards the goal. The goalkeeper, in the goal, wears a gray shirt and black shorts and is holding his arms outstretched to the sides to defend the goal. The goal has a white frame and a black net.

A simplified illustration of a soccer scene with a goal, a goalkeeper sitting on the crossbar, and five players standing in a line on a green field. Below the document, two hands are shown with palms facing up, as if they are presenting the document. The image represents a metaphor for official documents or application processes related to personal identification or welfare services.

name_en: Wish to Change My Feelings Notification
description_brief: Two rubber stamps, one on the left and one on the right, separated by a right-pointing red arrow in the center. The stamp on the left has a black handle and red ink on its base. The stamp on the right has a grey handle and a clean base. The base of both stamps displays a pattern or text in red. The contrasting colors between the handles and the inked versus clean bases symbolize a before-and-after transformation or a process of approval.

A simple illustration of a calendar. "MONDAY" is spelled out at the top, and below is a typical calendar grid for one week. The number "1" is highlighted in red, indicating the first day of the month, and numbers continue through "7", highlighted in yellow, representing the end of the week. The rest of the calendar days are blank.

An analog clock with its hands indicating a time, and a speech bubble that contains the text "15분전에," which translates to "15 minutes before" in Korean. The clock appears to be symbolizing 15 minutes prior to a given hour, possibly part of a reminder or notification.

A gray analog clock with black hands indicating a time of approximately 10:10. To the right of the clock, a thick, two-tone arrow starts from the bottom in gray and transitions into red as it curves upwards to form a counterclockwise semi-circular arrow. The background of the illustration is white.

A weekly calendar grid with cells representing days of the week, numbered 1 to 7. A blue banner above the grid with Korean text "기념일/일정," translating to "Anniversary/Schedule" in English. Two starburst shapes indicating special events or highlights; one is yellow and in the cell representing day 1, and the other is red and in the cell representing day 7.

The illustration depicts a clock with a dark gray face and black numbers indicating the hours. The clock has three hands – an orange second hand, a black minute hand, and a black hour hand, indicating a specific time. To the right of the clock, there is a white speech bubble with three horizontal lines, symbolizing text or conversation. This image represents the "appointment" or "schedule" concept.

A stylized representation of a calendar with a red header and three rings or binders at the top. On the main, white part of the calendar, there is a large number "4" followed by the character "月" symbolizing the month of April. The calendar is outlined in black for enhanced visibility.

Two stylized cartoon characters who appear to be happy and interacting with each other. One character is whispering into the ear of the other character, who is smiling and holding their hand to their mouth as if surprised or excited. There is a calendar page with "4/1" prominently displayed at the top, and Korean text "만우절" below it, which translates to "April Fool's Day" in English. The overall impression is a playful and friendly depiction associated with April Fool's Day.

The illustration shows a simplified representation of a calendar page. The top part is red, with three rings suggesting a flipable desk calendar. On the white portion, there's a large black numeral "4" at the top, followed by the word "APRIL" in bold capital letters. The image symbolizes the date "April 4th".

A stylized tree with a brown trunk and green leafy canopy is shown next to a representation of a tear-off calendar page that shows the date as "4/5." Below the date is written in Korean "식목일," which translates to "Tree Planting Day."

A circular sign mounted on a stand with an orange background and the Korean text "도착해요" written in black, which translates to "Arrival" or "I have arrived" in English. The sign could refer to a location or checkpoint.

A clock with its hands pointing to around 10:10, and a crescent moon to the right of it overlapping partially. The clock has a blue face with a simple gray outline, and the moon is yellow with a black outline. The image appears to indicate nighttime or nighttime activities.

A simplified, stylized depiction of two green mountains with a bright sun shining above them, indicating daylight. In the foreground, there is a round yellow clock with black hands pointing to twelve o'clock. The clock is on the left side of the image, while the sun is on the right side above the mountains. The image seems to represent midday or the concept of time in relation to the natural cycle of day and night.

A stylized illustration of a calendar. The top part of the calendar is red, with the rest of the body in white. On the red header, there are three rings, suggesting that it's a flip-style calendar. On the main white area of the calendar, there is a large numeral "8" followed by a Kanji character "月," which represents the month of August.
A simple calendar icon with a red top border and three black rings binding it. The number "8" is centered and above the word "AUGUST," indicating the eighth day of the month of August.

Stylized illustration of a red tree with a brown trunk and three leaves, one attached to the branch and two fallen. The tree and leaves suggest an autumn theme, symbolizing the season in relation to time and schedules. The background is white.

An illustration of a birthday cake with strawberries on top and six colorful balloons tied to it. Below the cake is a banner with the Korean word "생일," which translates to birthday. The image represents a birthday celebration.

A simplistic illustration of a round birthday cake with a layer of cream on top, adorned with strawberries cut in half and placed in a circular pattern. Each strawberry half appears to be topped with a small dollop of cream or icing. The image suggests a minimalistic or cartoon-like design.

An illustration shows a yellow envelope with a card partially inserted. The visible portion of the card has a few horizontal lines suggesting text on a white background with a pink top corner. Below the envelope, there is a label with Korean text "생일카드" which translates to "Birthday Card".

Two gift boxes, suggesting a concept of birthday gifts. The gift on the left is tall and purple with a yellow ribbon, while the gift on the right is shorter and orange with a blue ribbon. Both gifts have bows on top and are placed above a label with the Korean text "생일선물," which translates to "birthday present."

Three colorful party hats adorned with stars and streamers. The party hats are in shades of blue, purple, and pink, with yellow tips and multicolored stars scattered across them. Below the party hats, there is a banner with the Korean text "생일파티," which translates to "Birthday Party" in English. The overall image conveys a festive and celebratory mood, commonly associated with birthday parties.

An illustration of a person with black hair, black dots for eyes, and a line for a mouth. Three curved lines are coming out of the person’s mouth, representing exhalation, with the word "AIR" next to these lines. On the right, there's a stylized image of a red siren or alarm light, mounted on a grey base, with black lines suggesting an active state or making noise.

The illustration displays a stylized human figure with a simple, smiling face, and short black hair. The figure is wearing a teal-colored shirt and has one arm raised with the palm facing forward in a stopping or pausing gesture, against a plain white background.

A simplified human figure with a small, round head, dot eye, line mouth, and a ponytail. The figure is wearing a teal shirt and is submerged up to their chest in a fluffy, white substance resembling soap suds or foam, suggesting a bath. Above them, there are small, round bubbles floating in the air. The overall image seems to depict cleanliness, relaxation, and leisure.

The illustration depicts a stylized figure resembling a meditating Buddha. The figure is seated in a traditional meditation pose, with legs crossed, wearing a red robe draped over one shoulder. The head is surrounded by a halo of simple lines indicating radiance or enlightenment. The overall style is cartoonish and simplified, with bold lines and flat colors. The image symbolizes peace, meditation, enlightenment, Buddhism, or a related concept in the context of time and schedules.

A simple calendar with a red top border and white lower half, with a spiral binding at the top. The calendar displays "01" in large, bold numbers, indicating the first day of a month, with "MON" written underneath in smaller letters, indicating it is a Monday.

A stylized drawing of two cheerful children, a boy and a girl with big smiles, wearing white shirts with heart symbol on girl's shirt. To the right, there's a calendar page displaying 5/5 and the Korean text "어린이날" which translates to "Children's Day."

The illustration features a cartoon Santa Claus wearing red and white, holding up a decorated Christmas tree. There's a hanging calendar to the right with the words "크리스마스," translating to "Christmas" in Korean.

A bright yellow circle resembling the sun with a few orange specks. Below the sun, there is a traditional Korean hat called "gat". On the right side of the image, there is a calendar with its pages flipped to the top, displaying the Korean characters "추석", which means "Chuseok," a major harvest festival in Korea. The image suggests a representation of the Chuseok holiday.

A stylized scene features two green hills against a light gray background. Above the hills on the left side, there is a partially obscured orange sun with visible sunrays, suggesting either sunrise or sunset. On the right, there are two gray clouds, indicating partially cloudy weather. The image could symbolize a day with mixed weather conditions.

Two cartoon-style clouds, white with a gray outline, and a slight shadow effect at the base of each for dimensionality. The larger cloud is on the left and the smaller one on the right, with both clouds adjacent to one another.

A cartoon character and a calendar. The character appears to be a young person with short hair, shivering with a pained expression, hugging their own body. To the character's right, there is a calendar with a drawing of two ice cubes, one of which is melting and dripping water. The imagery represents cold weather, and corresponds to the Korean word "추운날" translating to "cold day."

The illustration displays a thermometer with a red mercury level indicating a cold temperature. Next to the thermometer is a speech bubble that reads "-10°C." The background features snowflakes of varying sizes, spread out inconsistently across the image. The thermometer is partially surrounded by fluffy white clouds, contributing to the wintry theme of the illustration.

A circular sign with an orange background and Korean text in white that reads "돌아와요", which translates to "Come Back" or "Return" in English, mounted on a straight vertical pole with a round base. The sign appears to be in the style of a typical street or informational sign.

Two stylized figures next to a building façade with multiple windows. One figure is walking towards the left, indicated by a red arrow, and appears to be leading the other figure by the hand out of the building. The image likely represents a concept related to time and scheduling.

A human figure standing on the right side, facing left, wearing a long-sleeved green top and black pants, pointing with their right hand toward a red arrow that extends to the left side of the image. The arrow points at a dotted circular outline. The Korean phrase "다가와요" (dagawayo), which means "coming" or "approaching", is present in the image.

An illustration of three buildings potentially representing an urban landscape with a large red "X" mark over them. There are clouds above the buildings indicating an overcast or polluted atmosphere. The background is a yellowish-brown circle. The image seems to portray something undesirable or prohibited related to urban buildings.

A stylized drawing of a smiling man standing to the left beside a birthday cake with strawberries on top, placed on the right. Below the image is Hangul text that reads "아빠생일", which translates to "Dad's Birthday". The design appears to represent a father's birthday.

A simplified cartoon image of a person standing to the right, presenting or gesturing towards a clock face with three dots that symbolize the passing of time. The design is set against a light blue square backdrop. The person is smiling, has short hair, and is wearing a green jacket with a white shirt and a necktie featuring a pattern of diamonds in alternating dark and light colors.
A simplified, stylized representation of a calendar or a notepad with a spiral binding at the top. In the center of the page, there is Korean text "날짜," which translates to "date".
A monochromatic illustration of three buildings with varying heights against a backdrop of sky with stylized, cartoonish clouds; the overall image conveys a cityscape scene.

The illustration shows a clock with hour and minute hands, the minute hand being red, and a partially submerged moon with craters in a body of water with ripples and bubbles around it. The scene suggests early morning time, corresponds to "새벽", the Korean word for "dawn" or "early morning". The elements are set against a plain white background.

A stylized representation of a desk calendar. The top portion of the calendar is red, and the lower part, which shows the date pages, is white. Printed on the calendar is the phrase "DAY AFTER TOMORROW". There is a curved arrow pointing to the left, indicating the flipping of a page to signify the concept of "the day after tomorrow". The colors used are primarily red, white, black, and a touch of gray for shading.

A stylized representation of a person standing next to a large calendar or notepad with a prominent blue "+" (plus sign) symbol on it. The person has a neutral expression and is pointing upwards towards the symbol with their right hand. The symbol is often associated with medical facilities such as hospitals or clinics. The illustration appears to represent a hospital appointment day or a day to visit a medical facility.

A two-dimensional, icon-like graphic of a wheelchair in shades of gray and blue on the left. On the right, there is an illustration of a calendar page with the date "4/20" and the Korean text "장애인의 날," which translates to "Day of Persons with Disabilities." The image represents a specific day dedicated to raising awareness about persons with disabilities, marked on April 20th.

A simplified, stylized representation of a desk calendar with the top part colored red. On the white part of the calendar, there is Korean text "하루" and a red rightward pointing arrow, suggesting the passing or scheduling of a day. The corner of the page is curled up, implying a page being turned or the progression of time.

A stylized cityscape with three buildings and a large, mushroom-shaped cloud above the buildings, suggesting an explosion or a similar catastrophic event. The buildings are gray with black outlines, and the cloud is depicted with light blue and white.

Illustration depicts a stylized white cloud with three red arrows pointing downward, indicating descent or pressure. Arrows move toward a flat, blue horizontal bar at the bottom, symbolizing force being exerted from above onto something below.

A simple illustration of a calendar with a red header and white lower half. The top part features two rings and the number "12" followed by the character "月," representing the month of December. This illustration signifies the last month of the year in a calendar format.

The illustration depicts a flat design of a calendar page representing the month of December. The top portion of the calendar is in red with the rest in white. It shows "12" in large, bold numbers, followed by the word "DECEMBER" beneath it, suggesting the date December 12th. The rings of the calendar are at the top of the image and are colored in black.

The image features a signpost with a circular sign with an orange background at the top. On the sign, there are white Korean characters "떠나요" (ttéo-na-yo) inscribed, which translates to "leave" or "depart".

A signpost with a circular sign with an orange background. The sign features the Korean text "출발" in the center, which translates to "departure" in English. The sign is attached to a straight vertical pole that stands on a flat base. The design is reminiscent of a minimalistic, stylized street or train station sign used to indicate the point of departure for travelers. A thin black outline surrounds the sign and pole.

A brown diary or planner with the Korean word "다이어리" on the cover which translates to "diary". There are colored tabs sticking out on the side of the diary in red, green, yellow, and blue colors, representing different sections.

The illustration depicts an abstract shape resembling a downward pointing arrow, solid red with a thin black outline. Its shaft is a vertical rectangle extending upward to connect to a dotted incomplete circle. The icon suggests a concept related to direction, motion, or a process in the "Time and schedules" category, and could serve as a visual cue in a user interface or informational signage.

An illustration depicting cracked ground in a desert landscape with lines crisscrossing to create the appearance of dried, cracked earth and large cracks in the foreground. The background features smooth, rounded mounds or hills, suggesting sand dunes or barren hills, and a solid color sky with no clouds or sun is above.

A simplified, cartoon-like representation of an urban scene experiencing an earthquake. The image features three grey, slanted or broken buildings indicating structural damage, and a prominent crack running through the yellow-brown ground, illustrating seismic activity. The image conveys the concept of a cityscape affected by an earthquake.

A simple, stylized design of three figures standing in a line, shoulder to shoulder, smiling and looking directly ahead. The figure on the left is holding a ballot box with a peace symbol in red and enclosed in a prohibition sign (a red circle with a diagonal line). The figures have identical faces with minimal features (dots for eyes, a simple line for a mouth) and are differentiated by the colors of their shirts and pants. The colors of their clothing from left to right are blue, grey, and black.

Two icons side by side on a white background. On the left, a stylized simple drawing of a person wearing a cloak or hooded garment in a yellowish-orange color. On the right, a red siren or emergency light with a black base, having a semi-oval shape and includes white markings, as well as three black ellipses in the center that intersect in a circular pattern.

An illustration containing three elements. On the left, a drawing of a multi-story building, in the center, a large red 'X', and on the right, an image of a person with an unhappy expression, wearing headphones and in front of a laptop or monitor with a yellow screen. These elements could symbolize the cancellation of a work event, the closure of a building, or a person's dissatisfaction with a schedule or appointment.

A flagpole with two flags and a sign hanging beneath them. The left flag is blue with a yellow emblem resembling a symbol for currency or wealth in the center. The right flag appears to be the national flag of South Korea, with a white background, a central red and blue yin-yang symbol, and four black trigrams at the corners. The sign below the flags is orange and displays four Asian characters written in a stylized script.

A stylized person runs down a flight of stairs, wearing a green top and blue pants. A square green exit sign features the white silhouette of a person running through a doorway in the top left corner. The white background contrasts with the colorful drawing. The image symbolizes urgency or the need to quickly go somewhere, related to the phrase "대피훈련" meaning "evacuation drill".

A simple, stylized calendar with a red top and the rest in white, bound by three rings. The word "매일" is written in the center of the white area, which translates to "every day" in English. The illustration represents daily scheduling or a daily calendar.

A simplified representation of a spiral-bound desk calendar. The top part of the calendar has text that reads "EVERY WEEK." Below it, numbered boxes representing days of the week, with numbers 1 through 7. The boxes are shaded in gray, except for the box with the number 7, which is highlighted in yellow, indicating a particular emphasis on this day.

A simple illustration of a calendar with a red top border where the binding rings are located. The words "EVERY DAY" are printed in bold, black, uppercase letters on the white page, indicating a daily schedule or routine.

An illustration of a calendar icon with a red upper portion showing two rings suggesting a spiral-bound calendar. The main section displays the number "2" followed by the character "월," representing February. The color scheme is primarily red, white, and black.

A simplified drawing of a calendar page representing the month of February. The top portion of the calendar is red, with the rest being white. It has three rings or bindings at the top, suggesting a flip calendar. Prominently displayed are the number "2" and the word "FEBRUARY". This image could be associated with a specific day in February, which could be useful for events, reminders, or indicating the date.

The illustration includes a stylized building with multiple windows on the left, a big red "X" symbol in the center top, and a simplistic figure of a person walking to the right, dressed in casual attire with a blue top, black pants, and shoes, bearing a small bag on their shoulder. The image represents leaving a building or a situation marked as incorrect or undesirable.

An illustration of two buildings, a taller one to the left and a shorter one to the right, with water drops falling from multiple windows. Clouds above the buildings are also releasing water drops, indicating rain. The entire scene is encapsulated within a water body at the bottom, representing flooding or heavy rainfall accumulating around the buildings.

Four candles in a row, each with a different color scheme. From left to right, the first candle is striped with pink and white, the second with orange and white, the third with green and white, and the last with blue and white. All of the candles have a flame on top.

A series of icicles hanging from an icy ledge of varying sizes and lengths. Some droplets of water are depicted falling from the tips of two icicles, suggesting melting. This could represent the concept of "freezing" or a cold environment.
Four Korean characters in black set against a white background. The characters are "금요일," which translate to "Friday" in English. The text is in a bold, sans-serif font.

A simple representation of a desk calendar with the word "FRIDAY" at the top. The calendar displays a grid with dates; the first row is fully visible, showing numbers 1 through 7. The number 5 is circled in red, and the days number 6 and 7 are highlighted in yellow. The calendar has a ring binding at the top.

Two stylized characters standing side by side, each with a smile. Between them is a large birthday cake topped with strawberries and whipped cream. Below the cake, there is a banner with Korean text that reads "친구생일," which translates to "Friend's Birthday". The overall image conveys a friendly and celebratory atmosphere.

A stylized character resembling a historical or mythical figure with a black beard and mustache, a serious expression, thick and dark eyebrows, and small eyes with black dots for pupils. The character has a white, flowing mane that could be a beard or part of an outfit, and is wearing a brown tunic-like garment with a straight yellow line down the center. The image is presented on a plain white background.

A stylized, simplistic illustration of a person standing upright. The person is depicted with a round head, a teal or green top, blue pants, and black shoes. To the left of the figure, there is a red leftward-pointing arrow. The image seemingly represents direction, movement, or placement.

A circular sign mounted on a vertical pole with a stable base. The sign has an orange background with Korean text "돌아가요" in white in the center. The sign has a thin black border, and the pole and base are also in black, providing a contrast with the sign. It symbolizes a concept related to "Time and schedules" in Korean language context.

A simple line drawing of a multi-story building on the left and an airplane depicted in mid-flight on the right. Between the building and the airplane, there is a red rightward-pointing arrow, indicating movement from the building to the airplane. The image symbolizes departure from a workplace or office building to catch a flight.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person walking towards the right with a large arrow pointing in the same direction. To the left of the person, there is an outlined structure resembling a building or a doorway. The person is wearing a green top and blue pants. The image signifies the concept of "going out" or "exit."

A stylized drawing of a person walking towards the left side of the image towards a building with multiple windows. There is a large red arrow pointing towards the entrance of the building. The person is featureless with a round head and is dressed in casual attire, carrying a briefcase.

The illustration shows a simplified representation of a person in business casual attire walking to the right away from a multi-story building. The person seems to carry a bag over their shoulder. A large red arrow points to the right from the building toward the direction in which the person is walking, indicating departure.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person standing inside an elevator, wearing a teal long-sleeve shirt and blue pants. The individual has a neutral expression. Above the elevator, there are two red arrows pointing upwards, indicating the "going up" motion. The elevator is framed by a metallic gray outline.

A brightly colored rainbow with red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple stripes, arching between two fluffy white clouds against a light blue background. The rainbow is a stylized, cartoon-like representation.

A simplified and stylized map of the Korean peninsula, with a calendar page set over its southern part. The calendar page prominently displays the South Korean flag in its center, surrounded by pink five-petaled flowers at the bottom, likely representing cherry blossoms.

A simple line drawing of a calendar with three rings holding the pages together. On the page of the calendar, there is Korean text that reads "한글날," which translates to "Hangul Day". Below the calendar icon is more Korean text, which appears to be handwritten, it reads "가나다," representing the first three letters of the Hangul alphabet.

A stylized character walking on clouds, featuring a round head, and no detailed facial features, dressed in a green long-sleeve shirt and blue pants, holding a small white circle. The phrase "눈싸움해요" (nunsseumhaeyo), which means "snowball fight", is related to the image portraying a winter or snow activity concept.

An image featuring two symbols: a stylized sun with rays extending outwards and a thermometer with the red indicator near the top, accompanied by a speech bubble with "40°C" inside. The image represents the concept of a hot day or a heatwave.

The illustration contains four icons: a bright yellow sun with rays on the top left, a red siren or emergency light on the top right, an image of a thermometer with red liquid inside on the bottom left, and a speech bubble reading "40°C" indicative of hot weather. The symbols collectively suggest a heatwave warning or high-temperature alert.

A simple illustration of a desk calendar displaying a week view with days numbered from 1 to 7. The top part of the calendar has the Korean characters "연휴," translating to "holiday" or "vacation." The first and last days are highlighted in red, suggesting holiday days, while the others are shaded in grey.

A calendar with a ring binding at the top displays the word "HOLIDAY" in bold, uppercase letters above a grid representing a week. The grid is arranged in a standard calendar format with numbers 1 through 7, indicating the days of the week. The first and sixth days are highlighted in red, suggesting that they are holidays. The other days are shown with a grey overlay.

A stylized sun with a face and pointed rays positioned above two green hills or mountains. The sun is centered and bright orange. The hills are colored in two shades of green. The overall image conveys bright, sunny weather.

Blue water droplets arranged in no specific pattern on the upper half of the image. A circular icon with a gold-yellow border in the bottom half, inside the circle, there's a gray background with the number "32%" prominently displayed in white text. The image appears to represent humidity, and the percentage inside the circle could indicate the level of humidity. There's also Korean text "습도", meaning humidity.

A cartoon-style drawing of a figure with short hair, smiling, wearing a long-sleeved green top, and pointing upwards towards a wall clock with no numbers, only three hands indicating the time. The action could symbolize an emphasis on time or a schedule.

A stylized image of the sun with a large, round, yellow-orange center, surrounded by a series of pointed rays, in sharp contrast to the plain bright blue background. The image has a cartoon-like appearance.

A stylized illustration of a person with a simple smiley face, short black hair, and wearing a teal shirt. The person is pointing towards an open window that shows a view of a vibrant landscape. There is a winding road disappearing into the distance, flanked by green hills or mountains under a blue sky with white clouds. The phrase "밖으로나가고싶어요" (I want to go outside) is also included.

The illustration depicts a person sitting at a desk with a somber or frustrated facial expression. The person is holding a pen in their right hand and there's a large stack of paper on the desk to their left. There are two sweat droplets near the person's head, symbolizing stress or hard work.

A stylized person with a cheerful expression and arms raised joyfully in the air. The character has a simple, rounded head with a broad smile and eyes represented by simple dots. They are wearing a long-sleeve turquoise shirt.

A stylized image representing morning time, featuring a circular red sun with rays and a round analog clock displaying a time of roughly 7 o'clock. The elements are stylized with thick outlines, using red for the sun, blue for the clock face, and black for the hands of the clock and the outlines. The background is white.

A cartoon-style illustration of a person with a neutral or slightly unhappy facial expression, sweating, standing to the left of a rising arrow resembling a growth chart. The background includes a ruler or scale on the left. The person is wearing a long-sleeve teal shirt and blue pants. The upward arrow is red.

A graphic of two cartoonish clouds, one larger and in the foreground, the other smaller and partially overlapping. To the left of the larger cloud, there are three vertical squiggly lines symbolizing shivering or cold. The clouds are white and outlined in black. The Korean phrase "쌀쌀해요", translating to "I'm shivering" or "It's chilly" is used.

An illustration of a bright yellow sun with a round center and triangular sun rays around it. Above the sun, there are three wavy lines representing heat emanating from the sun. This symbol could possibly represent hot weather, summertime, or a sunny day.

A cartoon drawing of a young male with short hair, expressing discomfort or concern by placing one hand over his forehead. The person is wearing a simple, plain short-sleeved shirt. He is standing next to a stylized orange and yellow sun with exaggerated rays. There's a small swirl line above the person's head.

A cartoon character, seemingly male, with a short haircut and a simple facial expression. He's wearing a long-sleeved teal shirt and is pointing upwards. There is a window with a wooden frame and white curtains parted in the middle, showing vertical lines representing rain.

Illustration of a window with wooden frame, showing stylized blue water droplets indicating rain. There are white curtains on either side, giving an indoor perspective. The image symbolizes rainy weather or the occurrence of rain. "비가 와요" (It's raining) is written, suggesting weather context in Korean language.

A stylized window framed by curtains. The window is divided into panes, and outside the window, there are simple circular shapes that represent falling snow. The image conveys the concept of snow falling, associated with the Korean phrase "눈이-내려요" which translates to "It's snowing."
A cartoon-style depiction of a yellow sun with rays extending outward and an orange center. Around this sun, there are three small fluffy clouds outlined in black. This image represents a sunny day.

A simple representation of a calendar with a red header and three rings or bindings. Below the red header is a white background with the characters "1月" prominently displayed in the center, denoting the month of January.

A simplified representation of a calendar page. The top part is red, with ring bindings showing that it is a flip-style calendar. The lower part features a large number "1," indicating the date and below it, the word "JANUARY" is written in capital letters, signifying the month. The style denotes the first day of a January on a wall or a desk calendar.

A simple illustration of a calendar icon. The top part of the calendar is red, and there are three rings or loops binding the calendar. The character "1月" is displayed in black on the white body of the calendar, indicating January. It represents the time and schedules category, for the month of January.

A flat-style illustration of a desktop calendar. The calendar has a red top with two rings holding the pages, and the main body where "7월" is written in large black font, which translates to "July" in English. The image typically represents the month of July in the context of time, schedules, or planning.

A simplified representation of a calendar page with a red top, attached with rings to the main white page. On the white page, the number "7" is prominently displayed in large, bold font, with the word "JULY" beneath it.

The desk calendar icon depicts a mixed color page - red on top and white at the bottom, bound together with three rings. The page prominently displays the character "6月", which translates to "June" from Japanese or Chinese.

A flat-design desk calendar page with a red top border and white lower half. The calendar has three rings or binding elements along the top edge. On the white section, there is a large numeral "6" and below it, the word "JUNE" in capital letters. The image symbolizes the month of June.

A circular logo with stylized elements representing different weather conditions. name_en: Please Put in the Umbrella Stand

The overall image conveys a sense of quickness or speed. The image symbolizes speed or the need for haste in the context of time and schedules.

The image may symbolize a warning or alert for rainy or stormy weather conditions.

The overall image could potentially symbolize a weather warning or emergency alert, relating to rain or flooding.

description_brief: A simple artwork of two weather symbols with an arrow placed between them and a question mark below the arrow. On the left, a cluster of clouds with rain, representing bad weather, and on the right, a sunny symbol representing good weather. Below the arrow, there's a large red question mark which signifies the uncertainty of when the weather will change.

A cartoon-style image of a person with arms raised above, forming a heart shape with their hands and smiling. The person is wearing a teal top. Below the person is an assortment of colorful candies, including lollipops, wrapped candies, and candies with various patterns and designs, along with the term "화이트데이" (White Day).

An illustration depicting a stylized representation of wind with a fluffy cloud at the upper left side. Several swooping, curved lines with spiral ends emanate from the cloud, suggesting movement and gusts of air. The image is a simple, black outline and grayscale.

The illustration depicts a stylized representation of wind or airflow, with three swirling lines emanating from a central point, suggesting movement or gusts of wind. To the right of the wind swirls, there is a red siren or alarm light with a prominent X-shaped structure within it. On the top left, there is a small cloud. The visual elements suggest the concept of a wind warning or advisory.

A traditional weathervane with a directional arrow and a sphere at the top of a vertical pole. The arrow, pointed horizontally towards the right, is red and stylized. Below the weathervane, there are three white swirls representing wind currents on a plain white background.

A simplified, stylized anemometer, a device used for measuring wind speed, featuring a vertical pole with three horizontal arms, each with a circular cup at the end. A fourth cup sits atop the center where the arms converge. To the bottom right, there are three curved lines that resemble gusts of wind. The color scheme includes gray for the pole and cups, yellow for the top circular indicator, and black outline for the wind gust illustrations. The background is white.

A stylized, bare tree with a few leaves attached to its branches and several leaves that have fallen to the ground, which is covered with a layer of snow. The tree has a simple brown trunk with branches extending upwards in a Y-shape. The leaves are a mix of brown and green colors, and the snow is depicted as a wavy white line at the base of the tree. The image could symbolize the fall or winter season.

A colorful illustration depicts a stylized building with numerous windows and snow on its roof, a clock at the center of the roof, and a snowman wearing a hat to the right of the building. There are stylized snowflakes above the building, indicating it's snowing. Korean text "겨울방학," at the bottom translates to "winter break" or "winter vacation." Colors include white, gray, orange, red, and green.

An illustration depicts a person sitting at a desk with a computer monitor, smiling and appearing to work. Behind them are symbols of the night: a crescent moon and several stars. The person is dressed in business casual attire with a shirt, tie, and a visible bag strap.

An illustration of a two-page open calendar. The left page has the Korean word "어제" (meaning "yesterday") written in black font with the number "1." The right page displays the number "2" with a red background. The calendar appears to be lying flat with a slight perspective angle.

A stylized desk calendar with a red header and a mostly white body with a grey corner peeling back symbolizing a page turn. The word "YESTERDAY" is written in black capitals on the white background. A red left-pointing arrow is centered below this text, reinforcing the concept of the previous day or looking back in time.

The illustration shows a simplified representation of a person and a car. The person appears to be male, with a frown on his face and wearing a sling on his left arm. He is standing to the left side of the image. To the right of the person is a stylized car, drawn in a cartoon-like fashion. The illustration likely conveys the concept of a traffic accident or injury related to vehicular incidents.

From left to right: an elderly woman with grey hair, wearing a brown top and a beige skirt; a middle-aged woman with black curly hair, dressed in a yellow top and a green skirt; a younger adult woman with straight black hair, wearing a pink cardigan, white blouse, and a purple skirt; and a young girl with black hair in pigtail buns dressed in a pink shirt and a red skirt. Above the second character from the left is a red downward-pointing triangle, and a symbol "어른", which means "adult" in Korean.

A stylized airplane colored in two shades of blue, with the main part in light blue and the tail and rear wing section in a darker blue. The airplane has a single propeller at the front and three wheels. The aircraft is depicted in a side profile.

A simplified graphic depicting an airbag deployed within a steering wheel. The steering wheel is shown in gray with white space representing the shape and sections of the wheel.
