Two hands hovering above a stack of green banknotes with "10000" printed on the top note. To the right, there is a simple, stylized red car in profile view. The image represents a financial transaction related to transportation.

A stylized image of a building with numerous windows and a blue facade, a darker blue door, and a sign on the top front with the Korean text "보험사," which translates to "Insurance Company" in English. There's an image of a traditional red phone book with the receiver hanging on its side and a series of grey dots representing phone numbers or text entries. The overall image suggests contacting an insurance company.

A simplified illustration of a control tower commonly seen at airports. The drawing features a tall white tower with a long, vertical stem. At the top of the tower, there are two stacked disparate levels with blue horizontal bands, which appear to be observation decks, and a small dome on the very top. The graphic uses a limited color palette consisting of white, blue, and black outlining.

An illustration of a simplified crane truck with an orange cabin, a gray back section and three black wheels. A black telescopic crane is extended upwards and angles towards the right, with a yellow hook at the end.

name_en: Crosswalk signal denied for cars turning left
description_brief: An illustration depicts three elements: a pedestrian traffic signal with a red "do not walk" figure and a black "walk" figure, a large red "X" symbol in the middle, and an orange car facing left with a red leftward-pointing arrow in front of it. The symbols may be related to pedestrian and vehicle traffic rules, suggesting no crossing or no entry for vehicles in a certain direction.

An stylized image portraying a cruise or ferry terminal with a large sign arching over the top that reads "유람선 선착장," translating to "cruise ship dock" or "ferry terminal." A simplified drawing of a passenger ship or terminal building with various decks is set against blue water. A green platform at the bottom, possibly the boarding area, extends towards the viewer, with two vertical elements on either side suggesting the boundaries of the dock. The image appears framed, like a sign.

A simplified representation of a currency exchange booth with a yellow sign with black text that reads "$ 환전소," which translates to "$ Currency Exchange" in English. Below the sign is an image of a smiling person with short hair, wearing professional attire that includes a gray jacket with a black-and-white patterned shirt or tie. The individual is standing behind a counter depicted with a blue line, suggesting a service window. The background is white.

An illustration depicts two stylized figures: one standing behind a check-in counter wearing a suit and tie, possibly representing a check-in attendant or ticket officer, and another walking and pulling a rolling suitcase. The counter has a sign that reads "세관" in Korean, indicating a customs checkpoint, possibly at an airport or border control facility.

An upright, rolling red suitcase with a retractable handle. There is a visible crack or tear on the side of the suitcase, and next to this damaged area, there's a yellow four-pointed star shape, indicating impact or damage. This image seems to symbolize a damaged travel bag (luggage).

A stylized icon of an airplane taking off over a green background suggesting land or a runway below. The airplane is depicted from a side angle, with its nose pointed upwards indicating ascent. The image typically signifies a departure or airport symbol in the context of traffic and transportation.

A simplified depiction of a train station with a grid-patterned building on the left. A modern train, colored blue, turquoise, and yellow is on the right of the building. A red arrow in front of the train points towards the station, accompanied by the word "출발역" meaning "departure station" in Korean. The illustration represents transportation services.

A simplified, stylized image of an airplane in gray with a blue cockpit window, two wings and a tail. Above and to the right of the airplane is a red circle with a white clock face indicating a time of 10:10. The image appears to represent a departure time for a flight.

A simplified illustration of a calendar with its rings at the top. The calendar features Korean characters that say "출발일시," translating to "Departure Date" or "Departure Time" in English. The image can be used as a symbol for indicating the departure date or time in the context of traffic and transportation. The visual style is line art.

An illustration shows three vehicles, two grey and one yellow, forming a triangle. Each car is shown from a top-down view, with the roof and windows visible. The cars have a basic shape with rounded corners, and they all have four black tires. The yellow car stands out due to its bright color compared to the grey cars. This visual may denote concepts such as car sharing, parking arrangements, or a transportation service.

An iconographic representation of two beige chairs facing each other with a simple brown table between them. This image could indicate a spot where people can sit and possibly eat, as in a dining car on a train or a rest area designated for eating in a transportation hub.

A stylized representation of a green, blue, and yellow train facing to the right. A large red circular arrow starting from the back of the train indicates a reversal or turn around motion. Beneath the train and the arrow, there is a red "X" symbol suggesting prohibition or non-permission. The word "직통" in Korean is displayed, which translates to "direct" or "non-stop" in English.

A horizontal arrow pointing towards the right direction with an uppercase letter "E" at the end of the arrow. The arrow represents direction, and the letter "E" symbolizes the "East" direction. The arrow is black, and the letter "E" is red, both set against a plain white background.

A human hand is holding a card that has a silhouette of a person's head and shoulders in a portrait orientation, resembling an ID photo. The card has Hangul (Korean script) text that says "장애인등록증", which translates to "Disability Registration Card." The hand appears to be presenting the card.

An illustration shows two adjacent seat icons, one in green and the other in yellow. Above the yellow seat, there is a symbol of a person seated with a crutch. Above this symbol, there's a red downward pointing triangle. These indicate that the seat is designated for individuals with disabilities or those who may require assistance, and the triangle is used to draw attention to the priority seating.

A stylized representation of a driver's license featuring a rectangle with rounded corners. On the left side, there is a cartoon-like character with a simple smiling face wearing a suit and tie. To the right of the character, there's text in Korean. Beneath the text is a section with blue wavy lines and a circular pattern. The background has a light sandy texture with touches of blue. The overall image is indicative of official identification.

A cartoon character of a person holding a steering wheel. The person has a cheerful expression with a slight smile and rosy cheeks, brown hair, and is looking straight ahead. The steering wheel appears to be a simple, stylized representation with three spokes and a central hub. The image relates to driving or transportation.

A stylized representation of a person driving from the chest up, with a simple and friendly facial expression. The individual has a short, nondescript hairstyle and is wearing a teal-colored, short-sleeved shirt. They are holding a stylized steering wheel with both hands. The steering wheel is shown in a circular shape with an inner ring and a symbol that indicates the horn or the center of the wheel. The illustration represents the action of driving in the context of traffic and transportation.

A cartoon representation of a person driving a car viewed from the front, with the driver visible through the windshield. The driver is smiling and holding the steering wheel. The car has its headlights on, and a gray border around the image suggesting a parking space. The image may possibly indicate a parking area or the act of driving.

A stylized, simplistic representation of the front of a car with a happy person sitting in the driver's seat. The driver has a smiley face, is wearing a seatbelt, and holds the steering wheel with both hands. The car features headlights and a gridded front grill.

A side view of a simplified dump truck with a yellow cab, one visible window, and a brownish-gray rectangular cargo area. The truck has two black wheels—one at the front near the cab and one towards the rear. The vehicle is depicted in a flat, two-dimensional style with minimal detail. No text or additional symbols are present in the image.

The illustration depicts a Duty Free Shop with a red sign on top with the words "DUTY FREE SHOP" in white letters. Below the sign on the left, there is a circular logo with a black border that contains a dollar sign. To the right of the logo, there is a depiction of the shop’s entrance, which includes a set of glass sliding doors.

An icon representing a person using a wheelchair with a bench is on the left side of the image. Above this icon is a red, upside-down triangle. On the right side, there are two purple seats. There is a Korean text "전동휠체어자석," below the wheelchair icon, which translates to "electric wheelchair seats." The image indicates a reserved seating area for individuals using electric wheelchairs in a public transportation setting.

A stylized representation of a lift, showing a side view with a partial cutaway, revealing an open door and a small platform inside. Above the platform, there's a control panel with a few indicator lights. There are support beams on each side of the lift and a box-like structure above it, which likely contains the lift's mechanical system. The image uses a basic color scheme with blue, grey, black, and red colors.

A side view of a stylized, cartoon-like gray car with black wheels. An engine, characterized by visible cylinders or engine parts colored silver with a hint of orange, is depicted on the front end. A small red triangle, likely indicating a caution or warning sign, points toward the engine.

The illustration depicts a pair of gray automatic ticket gates with glass panels, typically seen in transit stations. Between the gates, there is a red downward-facing arrow, indicating the direction of movement through the gates.

A simplified, stylized map of the Korean peninsula in green. A red arrow points towards the southern part of the peninsula indicating a direction of movement. To the right of the peninsula, there's a graphical representation of an airplane in gray with blue accents on its nose and tail, flying towards the left. The arrow indicates the concept of "입국" which translates to "entry" or "arrival into a country."

A stylized illustration of an escalator is depicted with a series of steps leading upwards from the bottom of the image. There are two parallel moving handrails on either side of the steps, curving at the top and bottom. The color scheme is grey for the steps and blue for the handrails.

The illustration represents a subway or train line map with a series of red dots connected by lines, forming a loop with a branch. Above the loop of red dots, there are Korean characters "에버라인" referring to a particular line or transportation service. Above the text, there is a red rectangle, potentially symbolizing a stop or an important part of the line.

A minimalistic illustration of a person standing in front of grey doors, likely of a train or subway car. Above the person, there's an arrow pointing upwards, indicating either the exit or the direction to board the train. The person is wearing a teal shirt and blue pants. The background is white, emphasizing the symbols and character.

A two-part illustration of a seatbelt, with a grey strap and a male seatbelt end (buckle tongue) on the left side and the female receptacle (buckle) on the right side. The image represents the concept of safety restraints used in automobiles.

A simplified illustration of a female figure representing a "transportation staff member" or "conductor." She is wearing a blue uniform with a peaked cap that has a badge or emblem on the front. The uniform includes a double-breasted jacket with buttons and a shirt with a collar underneath. She has a pleasant expression with a small smile on her face, and her long hair is straight and falls down her shoulders.

Two cartoon-style vehicles in a minor collision. An orange car viewed from the front, with a driver visible through the windshield. A grey car from a side angle, with its back end slightly raised. A red star-shaped burst is between the two cars, symbolizing the point of impact.

A stylized image of a ship with a streamlined design, a prominent bow and a superstructure at the top with windows indicating multiple decks. The colors used are primarily shades of grey and blue, with a white hull.

A flat illustration of a blue and gray ferry or boat with a prominent gray hull and a blue structure on top, which includes windows. There are two visible black circular shapes towards the bottom of the boat, possibly representing the wheels of a wheelhouse or support structures for docking. The ferry is in a profile view.
Two simplistic illustrations of jet planes, depicted side by side, oriented horizontally. The planes are olive green with minimal detailing, and are meant to symbolize military fighter jets.

A simplified side view of a red fire engine. The number "119" is displayed on its side. The fire truck features a ladder rack on top, a cab with windows for the driver and passengers, and visible wheel wells for the three wheels. There's a light on the top of the cab, used for emergency signaling. The image represents fire services within the context of traffic and transportation.

A colorful drawing of a green bus with black outline details and windows shaded in white. Four colors indicated at the front of the bus—yellow, blue, green, and red—arranged horizontally in a row of circles. Above the bus, there is Korean text "첫차" followed by a red question mark, translating to "first bus". The illustration conveys a question about the first bus.

An icon illustrating a car tire viewed straight on. The tire is black with a wheel rim design that includes five pairs of spokes and small circular shapes at the center, representing lug nuts or bolts. This symbolizes concepts related to vehicles, tire services, or automotive themes.

The image depicts a yellow forklift with black wheels and a black seat inside the operator's compartment. The forklift is shown in profile with the gray lifting apparatus positioned toward the left and having two vertical metal prongs intended for sliding into and carrying materials.

A simple grid pattern representing a map, laid out flat. On top of this grid is a prominent, yellow five-pointed star. The star is centered on the grid, suggesting a point of interest or an important location on a map. The iconography denotes a location of significance, such as a landmark, destination, or place of note in the context of traffic and transportation.
A round grey symbol with a horizontal line passing through its center, and a golden yellow star with five points on the right side, partially overlapping the circle.

A simple, flat design of a fuel canister, commonly known as a jerry can, with an angled upper section that includes a handle for carrying. There is a prominent "X" symbol marked on its surface, possibly indicating that the canister is empty or that the use of fuel is prohibited or restricted in this context.

A side view of a green garbage truck with a stylized design. The truck's body has angled lines suggesting the texture of metal panels, a compacting unit at the back, and is equipped with three black wheels with white reflection highlights. The driver's cab is colored in a lighter shade of green. A small yellow detail represents the truck's headlight. The illustration has thick black outlines for a cartoonish look.

The illustration depicts a pair of side-by-side seats with cushions for the back and seating area, armrests on both sides of each seat, and supports connecting the seats to the floor. There is Hangul text above the seats. The seats are associated with public transportation.

A blue bus with its doors open and a red arrow pointing downwards, indicating the action of alighting from the bus. To the right of the bus, there's a smiling person, a young male character with brown hair, facing us and standing straight. The image symbolizes "get off," "exit," "alight from" a bus.

A simplified illustration of a person standing in the doorway of a blue bus, depicted in a side view. The person is wearing a green top and blue pants, with a smile on their face. Directly below the person, there is a red arrow pointing downwards, indicating the action of alighting or getting off the vehicle. The image conveys the concept of a passenger about to exit a bus.

The illustration depicts an airport terminal with a stylized roof and windows or pillars. There is an airplane taking off or flying overhead, its fuselage facing towards the right. On the facade of the terminal, a rectangular sign with Korean text translates to "Gimpo International Airport." The colors used are mainly blue, white, and gray, with black for outline and detail.

Two animated male characters; one with spiky auburn hair, smiles, with his left hand extended outward, wearing a white T-shirt and brown shorts, seemingly prepared to walk. The other has short brown hair, also smiling, standing straight with his hands at his side, wearing a white T-shirt and light blue shorts. Both characters have large, cartoonish feet. Overall, their expressions and stance suggest friendliness, the act of offering or asking for assistance.

A cartoon-style drawing of a person with a neutral expression, short hair, wearing a long-sleeve green shirt pointing at a red sign. The sign has white Korean text "버스전용차선" (Bus Lane), and a white upward arrow below the text. The sign and the figure are against a plain white background.

The illustration features a stylized representation of a subway or train station entrance with two vertical rectangular pillars on either side, supporting an overhead structure that partially extends out, resembling a canopy or a station roof. The structure has rectangular windows or panels. Between the two pillars, there’s a prominent red arrow pointing downwards towards the entryway, indicating the location where passengers would enter the station.

name_en: Going inside the plane with a suitcase
description_brief: The illustration shows a person walking to the right, carrying a rolling suitcase. Above the traveler is an airplane angled as if it is taking off or flying, with its nose pointing upward. A red curved arrow leads from the person toward the airplane, indicating the action of boarding or getting on a plane. The style is cartoonish with basic and clear shapes.

A simplified representation of a subway or railway system map, featuring various lines interconnecting at multiple points, each line distinguished by a different color such as black, blue, green, and brown. The lines run horizontally, vertically, and diagonally across the image, with small circles indicating stations where lines intersect.

A cartoon representation of a ship captain standing in front of a large passenger ship. The captain is dressed in a traditional uniform, which includes a blue jacket with gold buttons and epaulettes, a white shirt with a black tie, and a captain's hat with a gold emblem. The captain is smiling, looking forward, and giving a thumbs-up with the right hand. Behind the captain is the front portion of a gray and white passenger ship with windows lining the upper deck.

A side view illustration of a helicopter with visible main rotor blades on top, a tail rotor on the back end, a clear cockpit window, and skids as landing gear. It has a teal and light grey color scheme.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a frontal view of a car. The car is gray with visible front and rear bumpers, tires, a windshield, and side mirrors. On the front left side, a prominent yellow circle, symbolizing a headlight, has four arrows radiating from it, indicating the car's headlight beam shining brightly. This seems to represent "high beam headlights" or "bright lights" in road safety and transportation.

A side view of a yellow and black bus with dark-tinted windows, two visible wheels, and a mirror protruding from its right side. The side of the bus features Hangul (Korean script) characters "우등버스", which translates to "premium bus".

The illustration presents a high-speed bus terminal, known as "고속버스터미널" in Korean, which is written on a sign above the structure. Below this sign, there is a shelter with three bays, each housing a drawing of a bus. Each bus is labeled with Korean text above them, indicating "luxury" ("호화"), "express" ("직행"), and "general" ("일반"), denoting the types of buses available at the terminal. The background is white.

A flat, stylized illustration of a single-story building with a blue roof and an orange facade visible through the outlined windows. It has two white doors at the entrance and a sign with the Korean text "휴게소" (translates to "rest area"), indicating a highway rest stop or service area.

A rectangular highway sign with a green background and white borders. It has a blue and red shield symbol in the center representing a highway number reading "60." The word "Seoul" appears in white Latin letters beside the shield; above it, the Korean characters "서울" are displayed, corresponding to "Seoul" in Korean. White arrows on either sides of the shield suggest a straight direction. The Korean characters "서울," indicating westward direction, are in the upper left corner.

The illustration depicts a horse-drawn carriage. The carriage is an enclosed four-wheeled vehicle with a door on the side, windows, and a rectangular body. It's colored brown with orange accents. The horse is white with a grey mane and tail, and wearing a blue harness, attached to the carriage. The wheels of the carriage are large and wooden with red spokes. The image could be used as a symbol for transportation, especially old-fashioned or historical transport.

A simplified graphic of a building, presumably a hospital, with a large plus sign on its top. To the right of the building, there is a red arrow pointing towards a figure of a person standing upright. The person is wearing pajama-like attire with a pattern, which signifies a patient's clothing or hospital garb. The overall image conveys the concept of a person going towards a hospital for admission or treatment. The image is associated with the phrase "입원치료" that signifies "hospital treatment" or "hospital admission" in Korean.

A hot air balloon with four vertical sections each with distinct colors: orange, yellow, green, and blue. Beneath the balloon is a brown basket, indicating the passenger compartment. It's a stylized design without any additional details or background elements.
An illustration of a large, yellow, teardrop-shaped hot air balloon with a basket underneath. A simple, smiling human figure with a round head, wearing a blue top is standing in the basket.

A simplified, stylized figure of a person walking towards the left. In front of the person is a large, three-dimensional, outlined square with an arrow pointing into its center from the left side. To the right of the person is a large, red question mark.

name_en: How Long is the Journey to the Destination?
description_brief: An illustration with three primary elements: a line drawing of a clock indicating a specific time, a stylized line drawing of a car viewed from the side, and a large red question mark above the car. To the left of the car, there are two red arrows pointing to the left, with the upper arrow being longer than the lower one, set against a plain white background.

An orange taxi cab facing leftward, indicated by a red arrow pointing in that direction. Above the taxi to the right, there's a clock and a red question mark next to it, suggesting a question about the duration of a trip or travel time. The overall imagery seems to inquire about how long it will take to reach a destination using the taxi.

name_en: How many hours does it take to return by car?
description_brief: The illustration presents three main elements: a simple drawing of a clock with its hands indicating approximately ten minutes past ten, two horizontal arrows, one above the other, pointing towards the left, with the top arrow longer than the bottom one; these arrows are colored in red, and a stylized, gray outline of a classic car with black tires and detailing. The car is facing the right side.

name_en: How to get from here to there - Please tell me the way
description_brief: A simplified cartoon-style depiction of a grey multi-story building with rows of windows. A large red arrow points left towards the building, with a red question mark above it, indicating uncertainty. A cartoon character of a person with a smiling face, green shirt, blue pants, and black shoes stands to the right, possibly needing directions to the building.

An illustration featuring two hands in a handshake, a document with several lines of text, with the top line reading "합의서" (translates to "agreement" or "contract"), and a red question mark symbolizing inquiry. The image represents the process of reaching an agreement and questioning the terms of a contract.

A simple illustration of an old-fashioned train with a steam locomotive and a single car holding three orange cargo boxes. The locomotive is gray with a black smokestack. Above the train, there is a long, horizontal red arrow pointing to the left.

Two images are shown side by side. On the left, a window with a view of blue skies, white clouds, and a small yellow circle representing the sun. On the right, a cartoon hand is shown in a thumbs-up gesture. The background is white.

A simplified, stylized figure of a person sitting in a wheelchair. The person is shown in profile with a round head and straight body, wearing a teal top and dark pants. The wheelchair has large detailed spokes, a smaller wheel in the front, and handles extending upwards from the back. The style of the illustration is flat with outlined features and minimal shading.

name_en: I Want to Cancel the Reservation
description_brief: A person in a teal-colored long-sleeve shirt and short hair is pointing at a calendar-like sign on their left. The sign features a big red "X" mark and a yellow section with the word "예약" written in black, which translates to "reservation". The image suggests a cancellation of a reservation.

The illustration shows three distinct elements: two human hands, one holding a gray cup or mug and the other holding a single gold-colored coin; and a graphic of a seagull in flight, with a white body and gray wings accented with black wingtips.

name_en: I want to file a complaint/report
description_brief: The image features a cartoon-style illustration of a person with a simple, smiling face and short hair, dressed in a long-sleeved teal shirt. The individual is pointing at a document titled "고소장" hung on an invisible wall. The document contains several lines of text in a structured, list-like format, indicating a formal document or application. The image appears to represent someone filing or indicating a complaint or report, relating to traffic and transportation issues.

name_en: I Want to Get a Driver's License
description_brief: A character pointing towards a driver's license that features a photo of a person on the left and Korean text on the right. The character is smiling, possibly indicating a desire to obtain or showcase a driver's license.

A simplified, cartoon-style drawing of a person walking toward a computer screen which displays a keyboard and a large medical cross symbol. There are two horizontal arrows pointing towards each other, symbolizing interaction or exchange. The screen text reads "I want to get telemedicine" in Korean, suggesting the concept of telehealth or online medical consultation.

A simple illustration of a person walking to the right depicted in a cartoonish style with a black outline. The person wears a teal-colored long-sleeve shirt, and blue pants. Their stride suggests motion and directly behind them is a red arrow, also pointed to the right. The overall imagery suggests the concept of going somewhere or movement in the context of traffic and transportation.

name_en: I want to join Driver's Insurance
description_brief: A rectangular sign with Korean text that reads "운전자보험" (which translates to "Driver's Insurance" in English). Below the sign, there are two human hands positioned as if they are presenting the sign.

name_en: I want to look outside the window
description_brief: A stylized person with a round head and a green long-sleeve shirt standing in front of a window, looking outside. The window divided into two panes, each pane shows a simplified scene of fluffy white clouds against a light blue sky, with a yellow sun in the top right corner. The person's face is not detailed with their back facing the viewer.

name_en: I want to sit by the window
description_brief: The illustration shows a stylized airplane window with a view of the sky and clouds. Next to the window is an airplane seat facing the window with a hand symbol pointing towards it. There is a Korean phrase "창가에 앉고 싶어요" meaning "I want to sit by the window."

A simple rectangular design resembling a card with a light grey background. In the center, bold, capitalized black letters spell out "CARD," which is centrally aligned. It features a thin black border framing the rectangular shape. The illustration could represent a payment card or a travel card.

The illustration shows a rectangular traffic sign bordered in gray. The background is black with Korean white text that reads "이번역 갈아타 내리실문". A bright yellow arrow pointing to the right is at the bottom-right of the sign. The sign has a green hue around the text area suggesting it might be illuminated or reflective.

An illustration depicts a scene where a person, standing behind a counter marked with the Korean word "입국", is in a uniform with a name tag. This official is smiling and facing a second person who is presenting a passport. The second person is also standing and appears to be a traveler engaging with the immigration process. It's set on a plain white background.

The illustration depicts two human figures interacting at a counter. A person wearing a suit with a badge is on one side of the counter, representing a service employee. Another person, who seems to be a customer, is holding a book or a document with the Korean word "여권" on it, which translates to "passport". The counter has a sign with Korean characters "출국심사," which means "immigration" or "departure examination". The setting suggests the processing of travel documents before departing a country.

The illustration shows a simple representation of an airplane meal tray. The tray contains compartments with different food items: a space for the main dish which is empty, a small bowl with green soup or sauce with yellow specks, a compartment with a portion of fruit or a side dish, and another section with a piece of cheese or butter. There's a simplified airplane icon in the top left corner.

An illustration of a stylized airport. It features an airplane in flight with a white body and dark grey wings and tail fin, a sleek, modern light blue structure possibly symbolizing an airport terminal, and a white high-speed train accented with a light blue line. Above the terminal is a signboard with white Korean text "인천 국제공항" which translates to "Incheon International Airport."

A simplified diagram of a subway or metro system map. It features a network of lines with various angles and turns; some of these lines are interconnected, while others are separate. The diagram layout is geometric, with straight lines meeting at points marked by dots, which likely represent stations. There are no text labels or color-coding.

The illustration depicts a cartoon character of a person standing behind a counter labeled with the Korean word "안내," which means "information" or "guidance". The character is a friendly, smiling figure with red hair, wearing a green jacket adorned with polka dots, and a headset, raising their left hand in a welcoming or informative gesture. It appears to represent an information desk or assistance point in a transportation context.

Three green bus or train seats in a row with armrests and back supports. On the left, a flat blue surface that resembles a window, suggesting these seats are against a wall. Above the middle seat, there is a red downward-facing triangle, possibly indicating a stop request button or a location for passengers to pay attention to.

A billboard screen displays a symbol representing the outdated web browser, Internet Explorer. The screen is rectangular with rounded corners and showcases the iconic "e" logo with a diagonal line through it, indicating it is no longer in service or is prohibited. The billboard's base has a trapezoidal shape.

A symbol representing a gate or entrance with two palm trees on either side. Above the gate, there is a sign with the Korean text "제주국제공항", which translates to "Jeju International Airport". Above this sign, there is a simple depiction of an airplane in flight. The airplane is oriented toward the left side of the image, indicating taking off or flying. The overall image uses a limited color palette with blue, white, dark gray, green, and touches of orange.

A cartoon image of an orange bus with a sign that reads "유치원버스" in Korean, which translates to "Kindergarten Bus" in English. The bus has a large front windshield, side windows, and a door in the middle. The tires are simple circles, indicating its illustrative and non-realistic style. The image represents a bus typically used to transport children to and from kindergarten in Korea.

A logo with the text "KOREAN AIR" in blue capital letters. Inside the 'O' of "KOREAN" is a stylized version of the South Korean flag in red and blue, with the yin-yang symbol and four sets of three black bars (trigrams), representing the four cardinal directions (heaven, earth, water, and fire).

Three illustrations of food items: a brown grilled fish on a plate, a bowl of white rice, and a bowl with a yellow substance probably representing soup or sauce. These elements together represent a traditional Korean meal, denoted by the term "한식" (hansik), meaning "Korean food." They appear to be a pictogram symbolizing Korean cuisine or a place where Korean food is served.

A stylized representation of a high-speed train, possibly a Korean Train Express (KTX). The train has a streamlined shape with a rounded nose, colored in shades of white, blue, and gray. It appears to be running on a dual-track railway system. The windows are simple black lines and the headlamps are a pale yellow color.

A green bus viewed from its side, with black outlined windows and a simplified design. The bus has four black wheels and has three colored circles in a horizontal line—yellow, blue, and green—under the windows. A simplified illustration of a person standing behind a railing or barrier, interpreted as a bridge or an observation deck. The figure is shown from the back, wearing a teal shirt and black pants. In the background, there is a stylized sun partially hidden behind a cloud, and another smaller cloud to the right in the sky. The illustration suggests the concept of 'wanting to see the bridge', relating to the traffic and transportation category.

The illustration features a cartoon character, a young boy with a cheerful expression, short, spiky, brown hair and rosy cheeks. He is wearing a white t-shirt and is holding a grey seat belt with a metal buckle in his right hand. The image emphasizes the importance of wearing a seat belt for safety while traveling.

An illustration depicts a plate with two distinct food items: a round, grid-patterned object that resembles a waffle or grilled item with a drizzle of sauce, and two round, bun-like objects. The text "양식" translates to "western food." It appears not to represent traffic or transportation, but an image of food.

A simple directional arrow is pointing towards the left, with a stylized "W" character in red color placed near the base of the arrow's tail, indicating the direction "west". The arrow includes two lines converging at a point to create the arrowhead, with a straight line forming the shaft; all these elements are on a plain white background.

An icon including a blue wheelchair symbol on a grey platform, a red downward-pointing triangle indicating caution, and two green seats with black legs. The illustration likely represents a designated wheelchair area with priority over the standard green seats in public transportation or waiting areas.

name_en: When does the first bus start?
description_brief: A simple, cartoon-style drawing of a green bus positioned horizontally. The bus has windows and wheels, above it, a crescent moon surrounded by four stars and a large red question mark. The Korean text translates to "When does the first bus start?" The background is plain white. The image appears to pose a question related to nighttime bus services.

name_en: When is the First Bus in the Morning?
description_brief: A cartoon-style depiction of a green bus facing left, with black outlines and windows, visible wheels, and colorful circles under the windows. Above the bus, there are large black characters "A," and "M," followed by a red question mark, implying a question about the morning (A.M.) time schedule or availability of the bus service. The image conveys a question regarding when the first bus departs or operates in the morning.

name_en: When is the last bus service?
description_brief: A stylized green bus on a backdrop representing night time with a black sky, yellow stars, and a crescent moon. A large red question mark is next to the bus, suggesting a question about night time bus services.

name_en: When is the last bus time?
description_brief: A cartoon-style drawing of a green bus. Above the bus, to the left, are bold black letters "P.M", and to the right of the letters is a red question mark, symbolizing inquiry about a particular time in the afternoon or evening. The background is white.

A stick figure person on the left side, depicted with a teal top and blue pants, alongside a smiling facial expression. Above the person's head is a red question mark. To the right of the person is a simplified side view of a gray car, with a red arrow pointing from the car towards the person. The image could represent questions about vehicle arrival times, pedestrian right-of-way, or similar transportation-related queries.

name_en: Where is the Bus Stop for the Opposite Direction?
description_brief: The illustration depicts two signs on posts. On the left, there is a circular sign with a red dotted border and a dotted human face inside it, with a red line dashed diagonally. On the right, there is a circular sign with a blue background and a white border containing a white bus symbol.

A simple drawing of a teal chair with a darker shade for the seat and a lighter shade for the backrest, and brown legs on the left side. On the right of the chair is a large red question mark on a plain white background.

A stylized representation of a subway or train map interchange station. It features a central hub depicted as a large circle with a question mark in the center. Extending from this central circle are four lines, each terminating in smaller circles, depicting multiple routes or connections available from this hub. The design uses simple geometric shapes and a minimalistic color scheme with grey lines, yellow and red colors on the central hub, and black and white in the question mark.

name_en: Which bus number should I take?
description_brief: A stylized green bus with six windows along its side, and symbols representing passengers visible through the bus windows. Above the bus, there is Korean text "멀 버스" followed by a red question mark. The text indicates "Which bus number should I take?". The overall image is a visual representation related to bus transportation.

An illustration of wind, represented by three curved lines with spirals at one end. The design uses soft gray gradients to give depth and dimension to each swirling line, suggesting movement and flow. There is a thicker outline around each shape against the white background.

The illustration shows three stylized bus or train seats in a side view, arranged horizontally, colored in shades of beige and brown. To the left of the seats, there is a light blue rectangle denoting a window. Above the window-seat area, there is a red downward-pointing triangle.
A stylized image of a car windshield with a wiper. On the right side, there's a schematic representation of a windshield wiper in red, with its motion path indicated by a dotted circular arc.

A stylized image of a sailboat with a single central mast having two sails with alternating white and blue horizontal stripes. At the top of the mast, there is a small yellow circle. The hull of the boat is white, and there's a red and white lifebuoy attached to the right side of the boat. The illustration is easily recognizable as a symbol for a yacht or sailboat, which corresponds to "요트" in Korean, relating to traffic and transportation over water.

A stylized image depicting a person with black hair, wearing a teal-colored top, smiling and holding a device on their wrist on the right side. On the left side, there is a light gray car with motion lines trailing behind it, indicating speed.

name_en: "A student is planning to take a year off to study abroad"
description_brief: Two hands holding up a sheet of paper with the Korean characters "학연계" written on it. In the center, a speech bubble with the English letters "ABC" inside it. On the right, a stylized drawing of an airplane. The elements combined may represent aspects of university life that involve academic studying, language learning, and international opportunities.

A simple, line-drawn, spiral-bound desk calendar. At the top of the calendar, above the grid that represents the days of a month, there is Korean text "1학기" which translates to "1st semester." This could be associated with university life, marking the beginning of an academic term.

A simple black and white line art illustration of a desk calendar. At the top of the calendar, the text "2학기" is written, which translates to "2nd semester" in English. The calendar shows a grid layout that suggests the dates or days of a month.

The illustration depicts a traditional black academic mortarboard with a yellow tassel. Below the mortarboard is a white paper or card displaying the number "4.0", symbolizing academic achievement or the pursuit of excellent grades.

A line-drawn image featuring two main elements. On the left side, there is an icon of a school or university building with multiple windows and a bell at the top. On the right side, there's a document with several horizontal lines suggesting text and a title at the top that reads "성적증명서" in Korean, which translates to "transcript" or "grade report." It appears to convey the concept of academic records or transcripts in university.
A simple representation of an orange door with a rectangular sign featuring the Korean text "행정실", which translates to "administration office." There's a small round doorknob visible on the door.

name_en: Apply for Leave of Absence for Studying for Civil Service Exam
description_brief: An illustration depicts two hands holding up a paper with Korean characters "휴학계," which translates to "leave of absence application" in English. Below these hands, there are two keyboards. An arrow points from the keyboard with a Wi-Fi symbol to another keyboard without the Wi-Fi symbol, suggesting a transition or sending of information. This could symbolize the process of applying for a leave of absence through an online system.

A simplified drawing of a university campus, featuring two buildings with numerous windows. Each building has a symbol that could represent a clock or a seal above the central part. A large red question mark is illustrated above the university complex.

The illustration shows two stylized figures. On the left is a person in a wheelchair, facing the right. In the middle, a red arrow points from the person in the wheelchair towards a student on the right, sitting at a desk, holding a pen. The image communicates the idea of accessibility or assistance for individuals with disabilities in a university or educational setting.

A simplified drawing of a building that resembles a school or a university with multiple windows, a central door, and a clock or emblem on the top center. Alongside there is an image of a document with the Korean text "재학증명서" (jaehakjeungmyeongseo) which translates to "Certificate of Enrollment" or "Enrollment Verification" in English, with several lines indicating where text would be filled in. The drawing is monochrome with no shading or color.

A stylized representation of a timetable or schedule chart labeled with the Korean text "시간표," meaning "timetable." The chart is a grid with some cells colored in. A pencil lies diagonally across the bottom right corner, with an eraser behind it. The image connotes the concept of planning, scheduling, or registering for classes.

The illustration features a guitar and a target with an arrow in the bullseye, placed next to each other. Above the objects, there is a sign with Korean text "00동아리", which translates to "00 Club". The image represents a club related to music and archery or target-based activities.

name_en: Considering Having a Meal in the Student Cafeteria?
description_brief: A stylized image of a meal tray within a window or serving hatch, found in a student cafeteria. On the tray, there are four items representing a balanced meal: white rice, a drumstick, two vegetable sides, and a round item which could be a bread roll or a cookie. Above the image, there is a question mark, suggesting uncertainty about student meals in a dining hall.

An orange-colored closed door with a rectangular sign featuring the Korean text "과사무실" on the upper part. Below the sign, there is a small, dark-colored doorknob on the right-hand side. The door represents a department office ("과사무실") at a university in Korea.

An illustration shows a stack of papers or a report with the word "Report" written at the top. The papers appear to have lines of text, with the bottom right corner turned up indicating a pile of documents. A large red question mark is to the right of the stack of papers, suggesting a question or uncertainty about the report.

A simple house shape with a brown roof and a lighter brown frame. Inside the house are four smiling faces arranged in a two-by-two grid. Each face is stylized with two black dots for eyes and a curved line for a mouth. The illustration suggests a concept of "housing" or "community living" with a reference in Korean, "하숙", which means "dormitory".

A simple representation of a smiling face within a house-like outline. The face has minimal features: two dots for eyes and a curved line for a mouth. The house outline consists of a brown triangular roof atop a tan rectangular base, which frames the face. The background is white. The image could symbolize concepts of staying at home, safety, comfort, or residential life.

A simplified, stylized depiction of a wheelchair connected to an electric plug. The side view of the wheelchair features a large wheel, a small wheel at the front, a seat back, and a handle. The wheelchair is suggested to be electrically powered and requires charging, symbolizing the necessity for charging facilities for electric wheelchairs.

Two stylized figures sitting on chairs, facing a whiteboard with a word written in Hangul, "종강". The figures have round heads and no discernible facial features, and their bodies, arms, and legs are represented by simple lines and shapes. They are wearing pink tops with grey pants. There's a small brown shelf with two blue books on the whiteboard. The background is plain white. The illustration possibly indicates the end of a semester or a period of study.

A simplified line drawing of a traditional building with multiple windows, resembling a school or university. On the right side of the image, a representation of a document or certificate with "ENGLISH" written across the top in bold, followed by horizontal lines suggesting text. The document symbolizes an academic document related to the English language.

An illustration featuring a building that resembles a school or university, a figure of a person walking away from the building, and a large stack of bills labeled "10000." The person appears to be wearing casual clothes. The image suggests a relation to education, tuition, or scholarship.

A stylized illustration featuring a desk calendar with a grid, accompanied by the Korean text "축제" on its lower part, which translates to "festival." A party popper is visible from behind the calendar, with its contents bursting out in a spray of colorful streamers and confetti. The party popper and the confetti suggest a festive occasion marked on the calendar.

A stylized gray building with multiple windows, indicative of a university or an academic building. In the foreground, there is a black graduation cap, also known as a mortarboard, with a gold tassel. Below the graduation cap is the Korean word "대학교," which translates to "university."

Cartoon-style drawing of a person with a round head, neutral facial expression, and short hair. They are wearing a long-sleeved teal shirt with a vertical white badge or label on the left side. The badge has the Korean text "신입생" translating to "new student." The character is depicted from the waist up with no background details.

name_en: Going to Military and Taking a Break from School
description_brief: A cartoon character in military attire, wearing a helmet and carrying a rifle. The character is smiling and has both hands raised in an open-palmed gesture in front of a placard with Korean text written on it that says "휴학계," which translates to "Leave of Absence Application." This represents a military person applying for leave, likely from university.

A simplified, stylized landscape that includes a flag on the left with the letters "MT", a pair of green mountains in the background, a blue winding river flowing from the mountains towards the foreground, and a brownish-yellow field at the bottom. On the right side, there's a red and white rectangular sign with Korean text "리마" on it. The overall theme appears to represent a retreat or outdoor excursion setting.

An illustration featuring two cartoon characters. On the left, a figure with short hair, wearing a green and teal shirt, holding a grey book with "졸업" (Graduation in Korean) written on it. On the right, a character with longer hair wearing a pink and red top, also holding a grey book with "졸업" written on it. Both characters are smiling and gazing straight ahead. The image could represent students or graduates in the context of university life, specifically relating to graduation.

An illustration of a person wearing a graduation cap and gown, appearing to smile with a simplistic, cartoon-style appearance. The gown is black, the term "졸업사진" refers to a graduation photo in Korean.

A simple line drawing of a multi-story building with numerous windows, showcasing its design as a generic health center. The building features a sign on the top with Korean text "보건센터" and a medical cross symbol, which translates to "Health Center".

name_en: Hoping to get a seat in the front of the classroom
description_brief: A simplified illustration of a large green chalkboard mounted on a wall with a small red downward triangle below it. In front of chalkboard, two desks or tables with chairs around them, suggesting a classroom setting. The desks and chairs have brown tabletops and black legs. The setting suggests a university or school environment.

name_en: How do you fare in exams?
description_brief: An illustration of a piece of paper with text, indicating a document or an exam sheet, next to a pencil. Above is a keyboard, with a large red question mark featured prominently to the right, symbolizing confusion or the need for answers.

The image shows a stylized illustration of a paper with the word "시험" (which translates to "test" or "exam") at the top. Below the title, there are several lines of text representing the test content. To the right of the paper, there is a red question mark. The image conveys a concept associated with university life, specifically questions or confusion about a test.

The illustration includes a green price tag with the number "10000" and a red question mark above it. A book with a white cover and a red spine is displayed on the right side, with the word "BOOK" written in block letters on an orange rectangle. It conveys a concept related to the cost or value of a book.

The illustration shows an open book with blank pages on the left and a cartoon character of a person with a neutral expression, pointing to their temple, on the right. Above the character's head is a red question mark, indicating thinking or questioning.

A smiling cartoon character standing in front of a building labeled "OO대학," in a university setting. The character is a male figure with dark hair, wearing a green top, blue pants, and carrying a backpack on one shoulder. The building behind him has several windows, indicative of a typical school or university structure. The overall image represents university life.

The illustration depicts a person wearing a graduation cap with a golden tassel. The individual has a cheerful expression and is pointing to himself with his left thumb. The character is dressed in a teal shirt. The overall image conveys the concept of a student or graduate.

name_en: I couldn't attend class last time because I was sick
description_brief: An illustration of a person sitting at a desk looking disappointed or upset. Next to the person is an image of a document with the words "강의실" (classroom) having a large red 'X' across it suggesting denied access or attendance. The overall image conveys a sense of a student who missed a lecture.

A simplified, cartoon-style character smiling and holding a square academic cap. The character has a short hairstyle and is wearing a shirt with teal or turquoise sleeves. The graduation cap is grey with a gold tassel hanging to the side, symbolizing graduation or completion.

A vibrant red question mark symbolizing inquiry or confusion. Below it, an open book or booklet with the right page visible, showing the words "출석부" in white text on a dark gray background. The term "출석부" refers to an attendance register, suggesting a concept related to university life or an issue about attendance. This could resonate with the phrase "출석부를 러졌어요," meaning "I lost the attendance book" in Korean.

name_en: I personally think it's a really good opportunity.
description_brief: An illustration of a stylized figure of a person standing straight, facing forward, and smiling. They appear to be wearing a teal long-sleeve top and navy blue pants. Their hands are pressed together in front of them in a gesture that seems to signify gratitude, respect, or prayer. The representation conveys a sense of contentment, politeness, or positivity.

name_en: I Want to Apply for Learning Support Tools
description_brief: The illustration contains a laptop with a blank screen, with two human hands approaching the laptop from either side. The hand on the left side appears to be flat with the palm facing down, while the hand on the right side has the fingers extended toward the keyboard. The image conveys a concept related to computer-related tasks and possibly academic support or learning assistance.

name_en: I Want to Complete Double Majors
description_brief: A simplified, cartoon-style figure of a person holding two graduation caps, one in each hand. The figure is smiling and appears to be cheerful. The character is wearing a teal long-sleeved shirt. The graduation caps are black with yellow tassels hanging down. The image symbolizes a desire for academic success or aspiration to attain multiple degrees.

name_en: I want to engage in volunteer activities.
description_brief: A stylized character, appearing male, with a simple round head and a small dot for an eye, is depicted walking to the right. He is wearing a green long-sleeve shirt and dark blue pants. He is pushing or pulling a large, detailed, segmented machinery wheel with a thin handle that extends up to his hands. The character's posture and position of his arms suggest motion, as if he is actively moving the wheel. The style of the illustration is flat and lacks texture or shading.

A simple, flat design illustration features a person from the waist up, smiling, wearing a blazer with a light shirt and dark tie, seated behind a desk holding a pen in their right hand. To the person's left side, there is a red backpack on the desk suggesting that the person might be a student. Above the illustration, there is text in Korean, "상담," which translates to "Consultation" in English. The image conveys the concept of a student ready for or seeking a consultation.

name_en: I Want to Join a Club
description_brief: A colorful graphic illustration of a human hand holding a pen, pointing to a piece of paper with Korean text "동아리 가입석", translating to "Joining a club." Above the paper, symbols of club activities are depicted: an archery target with an arrow in the center and an acoustic guitar.

An illustration shows a simplistic drawing of an airplane from a side view. Above the airplane, there is a speech bubble containing the letters "ABC." The image potentially symbolizes language learning or studying abroad.

name_en: I Want to Support Disabled Special Admissions
description_brief: The illustration depicts a wheelchair symbol in side view with black outlines and gray detailing for the wheel spokes, located on the left side of the image. A human hand, with a minimalist design featuring a turquoise sleeve, is holding a pen poised to write. In the background, there's a sign or paper bearing Korean text: "장애인 특별전형". The image relates to accessibility, support, and special accommodations for disabled individuals.

name_en: I'm in the middle of studying again
description_brief: There's a student ID card featuring a photo of a person with short hair, smiling, and wearing a blazer. The ID card has Korean text "학생증", which translates to "student ID" and includes some text lines, looking like personal information. Below the student ID card, there is a simplified representation of a building with multiple windows, symbolizing a school or university. Above the building, there is a clock. On the right side of the image, there is a hand raised up high, symbolizing volunteering or asking a question.

A simplistic drawing of a person walking towards the left, indicated by a large red arrow pointing in that direction. To the right of the person, there is an image of a building that resembles a school or university, characterized by a symmetrical front facade, multiple windows, and a clock at the top center. The person is rendered in blue pants and a green top. The building is grey with white windows. The concept symbolizes a person entering a university or starting their academic journey. The Korean text "입학했어요" means "I entered school" or "I've been admitted to school."

Two simplified cartoon-style figures seated at a table facing each other. On the left is a silhouette figure with long black hair, on the right is a figure with visible facial features and short hair, wearing a green top and blue pants. Between and slightly above them, a large red heart symbol hovers, signifying a romantic or affectionate connection. The overall image conveys a concept of dating or getting to know each other.

name_en: Is this Room 00 the Lecturer's room?
description_brief: A closed door with the Korean text "강의실" (translation: "lecture room" or "classroom") displayed on the upper part of the door. A red question mark is located to the right of the door, indicating uncertainty. The door is plain and brown with a simple, round doorknob on the right side, against a white background.

A pair of human hands are placed on either side of a paper or document with a large red checkmark and Korean text at the top. The document appears in grayscale. The hands are in a neutral, flat color with no detailed features. This image symbolizes a concept such as attendance confirmation, document approval, or task completion in a university setting.

Two simplified, stylized characters seated in chairs, facing a large presentation board or blackboard displaying the Korean text "표강". They're in a classroom setting. The presentation board has a wooden frame, there's a book or some sort of material on the desk in front of them. The characters' backs are to the viewer, implying they're focused on the board.

A stack of three horizontal hardcover books with a graduation cap on top. One book is visibly labeled "BOOK" on its spine. The graduation cap, also known as a mortarboard, is black with a yellow tassel hanging to one side. The overall image symbolizes higher education or university studies, representing academic achievements, learning, or graduation.

A yellow bus with a white and black "MT" flag on top. The bus has windows through which three people can be seen, each with a simple representation featuring a round head and a turquoise top. The bus has large black wheels and appears to be stylized in a minimalistic manner. The image might represent a shuttle bus transporting students to an MT-related event.

An illustration depicts a pair of hands holding up a document, which has some text at the top in the Korean language. The rest of the document is blank. The image symbolizes the need for a certificate of some kind, possibly relating to academic or university affairs, consistent with the Korean phrase "영문증명서가필요해요", meaning "I need an English-language certificate".

An open book with text lines representing studying or reading, a wall clock indicating the passage of time, and a calculator signifying calculations or numerical work. There's a red upwards arrow next to the clock, symbolizing the need for more time. The text "시험시간연장이필요합니다," translates to "I need an extension of exam time" in English.

A hand holding a pair of glasses in front of an open book with text lines. Above the book, there is Korean text that reads "시험," which translates to "Exam" in English. The image represents the theme of exam preparation or study.

A simple drawing of a desk with a red chair in front. To the right side of the desk-chair combination, there's a large red "X" mark. The illustration conveys a message about the absence or unavailability of space, possibly indicating "no space available" or "no seating available" in a library at a university.

The illustration depicts a simple cartoon character in academic attire, including a black mortarboard with a red tassel and graduation gown worn over a white shirt with a black tie. The character has a friendly expression with dot-like eyes. Above the character is the Korean word "박사" which translates to "Ph.D.", indicating that the figure represents a doctoral graduate.

A stylized graphic of a printer or copier. It has a paper tray with one sheet half-emerged, appearing to be in the process of printing. The top part of the device is slightly open. The machine has a minimalistic design with a small screen or label at its front. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring shades of grey and black on a white background.

name_en: Planning to take a leave of absence due to ill health
description_brief: The illustration shows a person from the chest up, sitting behind what appears to be a desk or table. The individual has short hair, a neutral expression, and is wearing a green top. Above the person's head, there's a sign held by two hands saying "휴학계". The phrase "몸이안좋아서휴학하려고해요" is also included in the image, implying the individual is contemplating a leave of absence from university.

name_en: Please check if the building has facilities for the disabled
description_brief: A simplified drawing of a building with a universal accessibility symbol of a person in a wheelchair on a circular background. Above this symbol are small square windows, indicating multiple floors. To the right of the building is a large red question mark, suggesting a question about the building's accessibility for individuals who use wheelchairs.

A classroom-style printer or photocopier with an open lid and a single paper on top of it. Alongside the photocopier, there is a magnifying glass superimposed over a piece of paper marked with a plus sign. The image represents the concept of photocopying or enlarging documents.

name_en: Please help with the study materials
description_brief: The illustration depicts a stylized representation of an open book at the top and two flat hands with palms facing upwards beneath it. The book is rendered in a brownish color. The hands are drawn in a minimalistic manner and are colored to suggest human skin. They are positioned side by side, slightly spread apart. The image conveys a concept that may be associated with offering to receive or needing help with studies.

name_en: Please issue a certificate of enrollment.
description_brief: A pair of hands holding up a document with Korean text at the top, titled "재학증명서", which translates to "Certificate of Enrollment". The rest of the document appears to be blank, with space for additional text or information. The background is plain and white.

An illustration depicts a pair of hands holding up a piece of paper with Korean text at the top. The rest of the document below the text is blank. The hands and text are in a darker color and the background is white.

The illustration features a pair of hands holding up a document with Korean text at the top and two placeholder lines beneath the text. The background is white, and the hands are shown from a frontal perspective, grasping the bottom corners of the paper. The color scheme includes skin-toned hands and black text on a white paper background.

name_en: Please issue a tuition payment certificate
description_brief: The illustration depicts two hands holding a paper vertically. The paper has Korean text at the top which reads "등록금납입증명서" (translation: "Tuition Payment Certificate"). The hands are shown from a side view and are placed at the bottom of the paper, as if presenting or offering it upwards. The background is white.

name_en: Please print out the lecture plan
description_brief: A stylized image of a printer from a front perspective, with geometric shapes to represent the main body and paper trays. A sheet of paper with Korean text that reads “강의계획서출력해주세요,” which translates to "Please print out the lecture plan," is in the paper output tray. The color scheme consists of shades of grey for the printer, with black outlines, and white for the sheet of paper.

name_en: Please Provide an Umbrella for Wheelchair Use
description_brief: An illustration shows a yellow and white umbrella attached to a single wheel, and two hands open, palms up, on each side of the wheel. Above the left hand, there is a small red triangular shape. The "휠체어용우산빌려주세요" translates from Korean to "Please give your wheelchair umbrella," suggesting a reminder or request to provide an umbrella for wheelchair users.

name_en: Please provide the department office phone number.
description_brief: The illustration depicts a closed door with a sign that reads "과사무실" (department office in English) and an image of a telephone with a question mark above it. The visual represents the concept of looking for or inquiring about the telephone number for a department office.

name_en: Please submit the Dormitory Application Form
description_brief: The illustration features a rectangular box with Korean text inside that says "기숙사 입사 신청서" (Dormitory Application Form). Below the text box, there are two stylized hands with their palms facing up, as if they're holding or presenting the box above. The overall image suggests the concept of submitting or presenting a dormitory application form.

name_en: Please submit the scholarship application form
description_brief: A piece of paper with the Korean text "장학금 신청서" which translates to "Scholarship Application Form" in English. Below the paper, two hands are shown as though they are raising the paper up or presenting it. The visual is likely used to represent the action of submitting a scholarship application.

A female figure with long black hair, smiling, wearing a pink blazer and skirt, holding a white document or folder in her right hand. She stands next to a chalkboard with a wooden frame displaying the Korean text "교생," meaning "student teacher" or "practice teaching". Below the text, there's a small brown object resembling an eraser. The image symbolizes an educational setting, particularly student teaching.

A simple line drawing of a printer. The printer is from a front perspective, it has a paper feed tray with blank paper loaded on top and a printed document with several lines of text emerging from the output slot.
