An illustration with three distinct icons. On the left, there's an image of an office building with the text "007일" at the top. In the middle, there's a large red question mark. On the right, there's an image of a calendar with some of the squares filled in red. The phrase "쉬는날은언제입니까," roughly translates to "When is the day off?" suggesting the concept of querying about days off or vacation days in a workplace.

An illustration depicts three individuals seated around a round table in a staff meeting scenario. Two of the individuals are seated at the sides, while the third is at the head of the table. Each person is in a suit and faces the viewer. Above the scene hangs a wall clock, indicating time related to the meeting. They are stylized with simple smiles and no detailed facial features.

A yellow, two-paneled folder on the left, slightly open. To the right, an analog clock with hands pointing to ten minutes past ten. Above the clock, a red question mark. The arrangement symbolizes a question about the timing of an event or a deadline concerning work or job-related documents.

name_en: When will the job be completed?
description_brief: A cartoon character who appears to be a construction worker wearing a hard hat with a green cross symbol and a white shirt with a badge. They are holding a bundle of wooden planks under their arm. To the left is a large red question mark, and to the right is a calendar with the top right-hand corner colored red. The phrase "작업은언제끝나냐" translates to "When will the work be completed?" in Korean. The illustration symbolizes the uncertainty about the completion date of a work or project.

name_en: When will we know the results?
description_brief: An illustration with Korean text "합격" at the top, which means "pass" or "success." To the left of the text is an image of a simple analog clock showing the time, with its hands pointing near the times of ten and two. To the right of the text is a red question mark.

The illustration shows two cleaning tools: a broom with green bristles and a yellow handle on the left, and a yellow dustpan with a yellow handle on the right. A large red question mark is beside the dustpan. The broom and dustpan are depicted leaning towards each other. The question mark suggests uncertainty or a query about the cleaning tools or their location.

name_en: Where are the used tools placed?
description_brief: An illustration with three main elements: a hammer with a brown handle and a silver head next to an orange wrench on the left; a red arrow in the center pointing to the right; and a dashed pink square with a pink question mark above it on the right, suggesting a placeholder for an unknown object or concept related to the tools.

A light brown door with a black frame has a rectangular sign with the Korean characters "휴게실" (break room) written in black. A red question mark is next to the door, indicating inquiry or the search for the location of a break room. The illustration is two-dimensional.

An illustration featuring a figure on the left wearing a green safety vest, a white helmet with a green cross, and holding a large broom. On the right side, there's a multi-story office or apartment building in simple line art style with a prominent red question mark above it. The illustration represents the concept of cleaning services and a question about where those services are needed.

A simplified representation of a construction site, which is indicated by a house outline with a triangular roof on top. Inside the outline, there is an image of a hammer to the left and a partially constructed brick wall to the right. Above the house outline, there is a red question mark. The image relates to a construction site or the concept of building or querying about construction status.

An illustration of a construction worker wearing a hard hat with a circular logo and a high-visibility vest. Next to him, a simplified drawing of a multi-story building with several windows, and a large red question mark over it. The image conveys a concept related to querying about a job site or workplace location.

A smiling woman standing behind a counter that has the Korean word "매점" (convenience store or snack bar) written on its front. On the counter, there is a cash register. Above and to the right of the woman, there is a large red question mark.

A simple character, drawn in a flat, minimalistic style, appears as a worker or an engineer, with a hard hat. The character is wearing a suit and smiling. A large red question mark is positioned to the right of the figure, perhaps symbolic of a query "Where is the manager/supervisor?" in a workplace context.

An image of a tall building on the left, with the Korean text "007기업". In the center, there is a large red question mark. To the right, there is a stylized green silhouette of a piece of land. The image conveys a question regarding the location of the "007 Enterprise".

A simple illustration of a document with Korean text at the top, which reads "참가신청서," meaning "application form" or "registration form." Below the text are a few horizontal lines suggesting a format of a standard form with fields to be filled out. To the right of the document is a red question mark, symbolizing inquiry or uncertainty.

An illustration of a warehouse or a store-like building with a symmetrical facade and a central, closed double door. Above the entrance, there is a pitched roof with blue stripes, appearing as tiles or panels. A large red question mark is visible to the upper right of the building, symbolizing inquiry or the unknown.

An illustration depicts an office building on the left and a figure of a person walking to the right. There is a large red question mark above the building. The image represents a person questioning their career or job path, and the uncertainty about decisions related to the workplace such as where to work or employment opportunities.

An illustration of three simple, red chairs with brown legs, evenly spaced and aligned horizontally. Above the chairs is centered Korean text "부서" and a large red question mark to the right of the text. The image could symbolize a query about departmental placement or related to seating or departments.

A flat design image of an office door in a light brown color with a darker brown frame. On the door, there's a nameplate with the text "00부서" written in Korean, which translates to "00 Department". To the right of the door, there is a large red question mark, indicating inquiry or uncertainty about the department.

A smiling person wearing a green shirt and a hard hat with a symbol on it is between two doors, each labeled with "OO부서" (which means "OO department" in Korean) with a large red question mark between the person and the doors. The image relates to "어떤부서소속입니까," which translates to "Which department is it?" or "Which department does it belong to?"

The illustration shows two folders side by side, one beige and one yellow, each with a flap open at the top. Above the folders, there is a large red question mark centered between them. The phrase above says, "어떤 서류가 필요한가요?" which translates to "Which document is needed?" from Korean.

An illustration of two small, single-story buildings side by side, both with a central entrance consisting of double doors. The building on the left has a monochrome façade and a pitched roof, while the one on the right includes a yellow-striped pattern on its roof. Above and slightly between the two buildings is a large red question mark, suggesting a choice or decision between the two options.

Two trucks side by side, with their cargo boxes facing the viewer. On the left is a truck with a predominantly orange front, and on the right is a truck with a yellow front. Between the two trucks, centered above them, is a large red question mark. The image seems to symbolize decision-making, comparison, or choices in a workplace or job-related context.

A cartoon character, appearing to be a construction worker, wearing a safety helmet with a green cross. There is a small stack of three simple orange bricks to the left of the worker. Above the worker's head, there is a large red question mark. The image suggests a concept related to workplace safety questions or uncertainty about a construction job.

A figure in professional attire with a safety helmet, suggesting an engineer or supervisor, is holding a clipboard. Beside the figure are two oversized objects—a hammer and a wrench—representing tools or manual work. Above these objects are two large red question marks, suggesting confusion, decision-making, or questioning about work or management issues. The query "공구관리는누가합니까?" translates to "Who manages the tools?" indicating an inquiry into the responsibility or ownership of tool management in a job setting.

name_en: Why were you absent from work?
description_brief: The image is a simplified graphic of a building, appearing to be an office or workplace, with the number "007" on its top signage board. Over the building is a large red "X" and to the right of the building is a large red question mark. The design appears to communicate the idea behind the Korean phrase "왜결근했습니까?" which translates to "Why were you absent from work?"

name_en: Wishing to Apply for a Job
description_brief: A sign with the Korean text, "구직 신청," translating to "Job Application" in English. Below the sign, two hands with palms facing up, indicating a gesture associated with requesting something. The image represents intent to apply for a job or the job application process.

A simplified person with an unhappy facial expression standing in front of a building that resembles an office or corporation. Above the building, there's a clock displaying "007" and the Korean text "일" which translates to "work". Two "angry" or "exasperated" sweat droplets above the person's head, representing frustration or stress. The image represents the stress associated with work life.

Two cartoon-style figures wearing yellow construction helmets and grey shirts, moving or placing a large orange gear or mechanical part on a grey surface. This suggests cooperative work typically found in construction or manufacturing settings. The image portrays themes related to teamwork, construction, mechanics, or labor. The Korean text "작업" translates to "work" or "operation," reinforcing the image's association with work-related activities.

A cartoon-style image of a person with a smile seated at a desk in front of a computer monitor. The person appears to be wearing a casual teal-colored top. Above the person, a large hand is pointing at them from the top-left corner. The hand wears a sleeve that matches the color of the worker's top. The overall image indicates a workplace setting involving supervision or task assignment.

A building on the left, depicted as a tall rectangle with numerous square windows, a single door, and the Korean text "업무" at the top. On the right, a close-up of a human hand holding a pen, appearing to write or sign a document filled with lines of text. The overall imagery symbolizes office work, paperwork, and the concept of business or job-related education.

The illustration has two main elements. On the left, a multistory office building with numerous windows and a label "기사사" which might refer to the building's function or name. On the right, a house icon with an upper-body illustration of a smiling professional, suggesting a home office concept. The design portrays the concept of remote work or balancing workplace and home life, corresponding to the Korean term "기수사생활," meaning "work-life balance."

A simplified, flat design character from the waist up is wearing a green shirt and a yellow hard hat with a white cross symbol. The character looks neutral or slightly concerned. To the right of the character, there's a large red question mark, followed by a red exclamation mark. Below the exclamation mark, there is a red "X" mark placed over a brown rectangle. The symbols could represent uncertainty, attention, or a warning.

Three figures standing side by side, each labeled with a number above their head—1, 2, and 3. All three figures are wearing safety helmets with a symbol on the front, uniform gray long-sleeve tops, dark gray pants, and black shoes, possibly representing the concept of teamwork or labor force in a workplace environment.

A person sitting at a desk with a computer inside a house outline. The person is wearing a green top and blue pants, and the house outline has a brown roof. The image conveys the idea of working from home. "재택근무" (remote work or telecommuting) is written in Korean.

An illustration with two main elements - a calendar on the left with the word "주말" (weekend) above it, highlighting Saturday and Sunday in red and blue. On the right, is an individual sitting at a desk, working on a computer and looking cheerful with a red question mark above their head. This image is associated with themes of work-life balance, weekend work, and workplace queries.

A red-bordered triangular warning sign with an exclamation mark in the center and Korean characters "위험" (Danger in English) below it. Below the warning sign is an image of a green stack of currency with "10000" printed on the band wrapping the notes, which is a generic representation of money.

An illustration depicts three separate buildings linked together by dashed lines that meet at a red triangle at the bottom center.   1. The top building is blue with white windows, and has three tall chimneys, each emitting a small puff of smoke, indicating that it might be a factory. 2. The second building on the bottom left is smaller, with a gray roof, one visible window, and one door. 3. The third building on the bottom right has a striped yellow and black roof with a single window and door, suggesting a storage facility or a cautionary operations building.  The red triangle indicates a central point or concept that the buildings are connected to.

An illustration of a person wearing workplace safety gear, including a yellow safety helmet with a green cross, a blue shirt, and a high-visibility yellow vest. Next to the character is a signboard with Korean text "안전수칙," ("Safety Rules") and several lines suggesting further text.

An illustration featuring two icons. The top icon is a depiction of a calendar, with the binding at the top and a grid representing the days of a month. Below the calendar is an icon of a currency bill with a numerical value of "10000" prominently displayed. The currency has a band of color, suggesting a security strip.

name_en: Would it be okay to schedule it for next time?
description_brief: A stylized person on the right with a smiling face, short hair, wearing a green long-sleeved shirt, showing a 'okay' hand gesture. On the left, a spiral-bound calendar with a grid design is displayed, indicating scheduling or planning. The overall image expresses satisfaction or confirmation related to scheduling for a future date.

name_en: Would you go on a business trip?
description_brief: An illustration with three main elements arranged vertically. At the top, a drawing of an airplane in flight. In the middle, a building with the Korean text "007기업" which translates to "007 Enterprise". Below the building, a red question mark. At the bottom, a calendar with a grid of dates. Each element is outlined in black with some coloring—white for the airplane and grey for the building and calendar.

An illustration depicting a hand making a thumbs-up gesture. To the upper right of the hand is a red outlined equilateral triangle with a hollow center. The background is plain and white. This image may symbolize positivity, approval, success, or achievement.

A stylized hand placing a striped card into the top of a time clock. The time clock has a prominent, circular clock face with the hands indicating a time of approximately ten minutes past ten. The card and the time clock represent the action of clocking in with a time card at a workplace.
